**__" የመኪናው አንዱ የፊት ጎማ ከነቸርኬው ወልቆበት ፊት ለፊት ይጓዝ ከነበረ ሲኖትራክ ጋር በመጋጨቱ ነው አደጋው የደረሰው " - የኦሮሚያ ክልል ትራፊክ ደህንነትና ቁጥጥር ዋና መምሪያ

➡️ በሁለት ሰዎች ላይ ከባድ ጉዳት ደርሷል !__**

__የማዕከላዊ ኢትዮጵያ ክልል ገቢዎች ቢሮ ኃላፊ አቶ አሊ ከድር ፤ በኦሮሚያ ክልል ምስራቅ ሸዋ ዞን ሉሜ ወረዳ  ከሞጆ ወደ ባቱ ይጓዙበት የነበረው ላንድ ክሩዘር ተሽከርካሪ ባጋጠመው የግጭት አደጋ ህይወታቸው አልፏል።

ቃላቸውን ለኢትዮጵያ ቴሌቪዥን የሰጡት የኦሮሚያ ክልል ትራፊክ ደህንነትና ቁጥጥር ዋና መምሪያ ኃላፊ ኮማንደር  በላቸው ቲኪ ፥ በፈጣን መንገድ ከሞጆ ወደ ባቱ ይጓዝ የነበረ ላንድ ክሩዘር ተሽከርካሪ ከሲኖ ጋር በመጋጨቱ የአንድ ሰው ህይወት ወዲያው ሲያልፍ በሁለት ሰዎች ላይ ከባድ ጉዳት መድረሱን ገልጸዋል።

አደጋው የደረሰው ከቀኑ 9፡20 ሲሆን ኮድ3-75541 ኢት ላንድክሩዘር መኪና  አንዱ የፊት ጎማ ከነቸርኬው ወልቆበት ፊት ለፊት ይጓዝ ከነበረ ሲኖትራክ ጋር በመጋጨቱ ምክንያት መሆኑን ተናግረዋል።

በወቅቱ ምንም ዓይነት ግጭት ሳይኖር የፊት ጎማው የወለቀበት ምክንያት እየተጣራ መሆኑን ለቴሌቪዥን ጣቢያው አመልክተዋል።

በምክትል ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ማዕረግ የዴሞክራሲ ሥርዓት ግንባታ ማስተባበሪያ ማዕከል ኃላፊና የብልፅግና ፓርቲ ምክትል ፕሬዝዳንት አቶ አደም ፋራህ ፥ በአቶ አሊ ከድር ድንገተኛ ህልፈተ የተሰማቸውን ሀዘን ገልጸው ፤ ዛሬ በጽህፈት ቤታቸው ከተካሄደ የአመራሮች ስብስባ ወደ ስራ ሲመለሱ አደጋው እንዳጋጠመ ጠቁመዋል።

**__" The accident occurred when one of the front wheels of the car collided with a Sinotruck that was traveling in front of the Necherkew Wolkobet " - Oromia Regional Traffic Safety and Control Directorate

➡️ Two people were seriously injured! __**

__Head of the Central Ethiopia Regional Revenue Bureau, Ato Ali Kedir; The Land Cruiser vehicle they were traveling in from Mojo to Batu in the East Shewa Zone of the Oromia Regional State has died in a collision accident.

Speaking to Ethiopian Television, Commander Beleh Tiki, the Head of the Oromia Regional Traffic Safety and Control Directorate, said that a Land Cruiser vehicle traveling from Mojo to Batu on the expressway collided with a Sinotruck, killing one person and seriously injuring two others.

The accident occurred at 9:20 a.m. and was caused by the collision of one of the front tires of a Land Cruiser truck with the code 3-75541 with a Sinotruck traveling in front of the Necherkew Wolkobet.

He told the television station that there was no collision at the time and the cause of the front tire coming off is being investigated.

Deputy Prime Minister and Head of the Coordination Center for Democracy and Prosperity Party, Ato Adem Farah, expressed his condolences over the sudden death of Ato Ali Keder, noting that the accident occurred when he was returning to work from a leadership meeting held at his office today.

__**“ በጸጥታው ችግር በፈለግነው ሰዓትና መንገድ የህክምና መሳሪያዎችን ግጭቶ ባለባቸው አካባቢዎች ፈጥኖ ከማድረስ አኳያ መሠረታዊ ችግሮች አሉ ” - የአማራ ክልል ጤና ቢሮ
**
ጤና ሚኒስቴር  “ዳታና ድጂታል ጤና ሳምንት”ን በተመለከተ ከክልል የጤና ቢሮዎች ጋር ዛሬ በኤልያና ሆቴል መርሃ ግብር አዘጋጅቶ ነበር።

መድረኩ ለቀጣዮቹ ቀናት ይቆያል የተባለ ሲሆን፣ የተለያዩ የክልል ጤና ቢሮ ኃላፊዎችና ተካዮች ተገኝተዋል። በመርሃ ግብሩ ከተገኙት መካከል የጸጥታ ችግር ያለበት አማራ ክልል አንዱ ነው።

የጤና አገልግሎትን በሚጠበቀው መልኩ ለማህበረሰቡ ተደራሽ ከማድረግ አንጻር ምን እየተሰራ እንደሆነ፣ የጸጥታው ችግር ያደረሰውን አሉታዊ ተፅዕኖ በተመለከተ ከጋዜጠኞች የቀረበላቸው የክልሉ ጤና ቢሮ ኃላፊ አቶ አብዱልከሩም መንግስቱ ምላሽ ያሉትን ሰጥተዋል።

**ጤና ቢሮ ኃላፊው ምን መለሱ ?
**
“ በችግርም ውስጥ ሆኖ መስራት የሚችል የጤና አመራር እየተገነባ ያለበት ሂደት ላይ ነው። ይሄ ውጤታማ ነው? አይደለም? የሚለውን ለማወቅ የአገልግሎት ከሰጣጣችንን እየፈተሽን ነው።

ቀደም ሲል የክትባት አገልግሎት የማይሰጣቸው የነበሩ ህፃናት ክትባት እንዲሰጣቸው ለማድረግ ከፍተኛ ጥረት የምናደርግበት፣ 60% በመቶ እናቶች በጤና ባለሙያ የወለዱበት ሁኔታ ነው ያለው።

ነገር ግን በወቅታዊ የጸጥታ ችግሩ ምክንያት ተንቀሳቅሶ ከመስራት አኳያ፣ በተለይ ሃይጂንና ሳኒቴሽን ስራዎችን በአደረጃጀት ከመስራት አኳያ ማህበረሰቡን ቤት ለቤት ማስተማር ይጠይቃል። 

በዚህ ረገድ መሠረታዊ ተግዳሮቶች እንዳሉ፣ የጸጥታው ችግር የጎዳበት ሁኔታ እንዳለ በግልጽ ያዬንበት ሁኔታ ነው ያለው። ሌላው ጉዳት ብለን የምናስበው የወረርሽኝ ክስተቶች አሉ። 

የወባና የኮሌራ ወረርሽኝ የተከሰተበት ሁኔታ ነው ያለው በክልላችን። እነዚህን ከመከላከልና ከመቆጣጠር አንጻር ከሚመለከታቸው አካላት ጋር የተሰሩ ስራዎች ቢኖሩም ወባ የሚራባበትን ቦታ የማዳፈን ሥራ በትክክል መሰራት አለበት።

ማህበረሰቡ ለመንቀሳቀስ ከመስጋቱ ጋር ተያይዞ ኬዞቹ እየጨመሩ ያሉበት ሁኔታ ነው ያለው፤ አሁን እየቀነሰ መጥቷል። ግን ከሚያዚያ እስከ ሰኔ ያሉት የወባ መራቢያ ወራት እጅግ ፈታኝ ከመሆናቸው ጋር ተያይዞ ስራን የሚጠይቅ ነው።

በጸጥታው ችግር በፈለግነው ሰዓትና መንገድ የህክምና መሳሪያዎችን በተለይ በጣም ግጭቶ ባለባቸው አካባቢዎች ፈጥኖ ከማድረስ አኳያ መሠረታዊ ችግሮች አሉ። ችግሩን ለመፍታት ከማህበረሰቡ፣ ከመንግስት ጋር በመወያዬት እየተሰራ ነው ” ብለዋል።

ቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ
አዲስ አበባ

__**“ There are fundamental problems in delivering medical equipment to conflict-affected areas at the right time and in the right way due to the security situation ” - Amhara Regional Health Bureau
**
The Ministry of Health organized a program with regional health bureaus today at Elyana Hotel regarding the “Data and Digital Health Week”.

The forum is expected to last for the next few days, and various regional health bureau heads and representatives were present. Among those who attended the program was Amhara Regional State, which is one of the regions with security problems.

The Regional Health Bureau Head, Ato Abdulkerum Mengistu, responded to reporters’ questions about what is being done to make health services accessible to the community in the expected manner and the negative impact of the security situation.

**What did the Health Bureau Head answer?

**
“We are in the process of building a health leadership that can work even in a crisis. Is this effective? We are testing our service delivery to find out.

We are making great efforts to vaccinate children who were previously not receiving vaccination services, and 60% of mothers are being delivered by health professionals.

However, due to the current security situation, it is necessary to educate the community from house to house in terms of organizing hygiene and sanitation activities. 

In this regard, there are fundamental challenges, and the security situation is clearly visible. Another disadvantage that we consider is the occurrence of epidemics. 

There is a situation where malaria and cholera outbreaks have occurred in our region. Despite the work done with the relevant bodies to prevent and control these, the work of eliminating malaria breeding sites must be done properly. 

The community is moving in connection with the threat The cases are increasing; now they are decreasing. But the malaria breeding season from April to June is very challenging, so it requires work.

There are fundamental problems in terms of delivering medical equipment at the right time and in the right way, especially in the most conflict-affected areas. We are working with the community and the government to solve the problem,” he said.

Tikvah Ethiopia
Addis Ababa

አቶ አሊ ከድር በመኪና አደጋ ህይወታቸው አለፈ።

የቀድሞው የስልጤ ዞን አስተዳዳሪና በአሁኑ ሰዓት የማዕከላዊ ኢትዮጵያ ክልል ገቢዎች ቢሮ ሀላፊ የነበሩት አቶ አሊ ከድር በዛሬው እለት ኦሮሚያ ክልል ሞጆ የፍጥነት መንገድ ላይ በደረሰባቸው የመኪና አደጋ ህይወታቸው ማለፉ ታውቋል።

አቶ አሊ ከድር ከስልጤ ዞን ምስረታ በኋላ ዞኑን የመሩ ስምንተኛው አስተዳዳሪ የነበሩ ሲሆን በዚህም ከህዳር 2012 እስከ ሀምሌ 2016 ዞኑን በዋና አስተዳዳሪነት መምራታቸው ይታወቃል።

ከሀምሌ 2016 ጀምሮ የማዕከላዊ ኢትዮጵያ ክልል ገቢዎች ቢሮ ሀላፊ ነበሩ።

የስልጤ ዞን አስተዳደር ሀዘኑን ገልጾ ለህዝቡ፣ ለቤተሰብ፣ እና ወዳጅ ዘመድ መጽናናትን ተመኝቷል።

Ali Kedir dies in car accident.

Former Silte Zone Administrator and current Head of the Central Ethiopia Regional Revenue Bureau, Ali Kedir, has died in a car accident on the Mojo Expressway in Oromia Regional State today.

Ali Kedir was the eighth administrator to head the Silte Zone after its establishment, and served as the Chief Administrator from November 2012 to July 2016.

He had been the Head of the Central Ethiopia Regional Revenue Bureau since July 2016.

The Silte Zone Administration expressed its condolences and offered condolences to the people, family, and friends.

__**“ ኃላፊዎች ያልተገባ ነገር በማድረግ ከሚጠመዱ ጤና ባለሙያዎች ለሚያነሷቸው ጥያቄዎች ተገቢ ሥራ ይስሩ ” - የኢትዮጵያ ጤና ባለሙያዎች ማኀበር
**
የኢትዮጵያ ጤና ባለሙያዎች ማኅበር፣ “ጤና ባለሙያዎች እያደረጉት ያለው እንቅስቃሴ ሰላማዊ የዳቦ ጥያቄ ነው” ሲል ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ተናገረ።

የድሬዳዋው ሳቢያን ሆስፒታል ጠቅላላ ህክምና ሀኪም ዶ/ር ሀብታሙ አለሙ ደረሰብኝ ያሉትን በደል እንዳሳወቁት፣ ለጉዳዩ መፍትሄ እንዲሰጥ የድሬዳዋ ከተማ አስተዳደር ጤና ቢሮን በደብዳቤ እንደጠየቁ የማኅበሩ ፕሬዚደት አቶ ዮናታን ዳኛው ተናግረዋል።

ሌሎች የጤና ባለሙያዎችም የተለያዩ የመብት ጥያቄዎችን እያነሱ ይገኛሉ፤ ተመሳሳይ ችግር እንዳይገጥማቸው ምን ዋስትና አላቸው? መፍትሄውስ ምንድን ነው ? የሚል ጥያቄ ለማኀበሩ አቅርበናል።

**አቶ ዮናታን ዳኛቸው ምን መለሱ ?
**
“ ኢትዮጵያ ፈርማ አባል የሆነችበት የኢንተርናሽናል ሌቭል ኦርጋናይዜሽን የባለሙያዎችን፣ የሠራተኞችን የመሰብሰብና የመደራጀት መብትን ይፈቅዳል።

ስለዚህ ኢትዮጵያ የፈረመችውን ሕግ ማክበር ያስፈልጋል። ባለሙያዎችን ማሰር፣ ማሸማቀቅ መፍትሄ ይሆናል ብለን አናምንም። ቀዳሚ መፍትሄው የሚሆነው ባለሙያዎች የሚያነሷቸው ጥያቄዎችን በወቅቱ መመለስ ነው።

ጤና ባለሙያዎች እያደረጉት ያለው እንቅስቃሴ ሰላማዊ የዳቦ ጥያቄ ነው። ሰላማዊ፤ ዲሲፕሊንድ የሆነ፣ በተማሩ ሰዎች የሚመራ፣ ምንም አይነት የፓለቲካ ዓላማም ሆነ አጀንዳ የሌለው እንቅስቃሴ ነው።

ያን እንቅስቃሴ ወደ ሌላ አቅጣጫ ሳይቀይር መንግስት እንነጋገር ብሎ መድረኮችን ፈጥሮ መፍትሄ ማስቀመጥ አለበት። በማሰር፣ በመደብደብ፣ በማሸማቀቅ፣ በማስፈራራት ችግሩን አይፈታም። 

ጥያቄው የቆዬና ሥር የሰደደ ነው። የተለያዬ ስያሜ ሰጥቶ ይህንን እንቅስቃሴ ማኮላሸት አይቻልም ” ብለዋል።

**የማኀበሩ የማኀበሩ ም/ፕሬዚዳንት አቶ መለሰ ባታ ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ምን አሉ ?
**
“ የዶክተር ሃብታሙ ጉዳይ በግልጽ ስላመለከቱና ለህዝብ ስለደረሰ እንጂ ሌሎች መብታቸውን የሚጠይቁ ጤና ባለሙያዎችም ተመሳሳይ፣ አለፍ ሲልም ያላግባብ ከስራ እስከመባረር እና መታሰር የደረሱ አሉ።

ይህን ማህበሩ በተለያዩ ጊዜያት ድምፅ ከመሆን አልፎ በሚችለው መጠን የተቋሙ ኃላፊዎችን አነጋግሮ ነበር። የጤና ተቋማት ኃላፊዎች በጤና ባለሙያዎች ያልተገባ ነገር በማድረግ ከሚጠመዱ ጤና ባለሙያዎች ለሚያነሷቸው ጥያቄዎች ተገቢ ሥራ ይስሩ ” ሲሉ አሳስበዋል።

የጠቅላላ ህክምና ሀኪሙ ዶክተር ሀብታሙ የመብት ጥያቄ በማንሳታቸው በሚሰሩበት ቢሮ አስተዳደራዊ በደል እንደደረሰባቸው ለማኀበሩ አሳውቀዋል።

ቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ

__**“ Officials should act appropriately to the demands of health professionals who are busy doing inappropriate things ” - Ethiopian Health Professionals Association
**
The Ethiopian Health Professionals Association, “The movement that health professionals are carrying out is a peaceful demand for bread,” told Tikvah Ethiopia.

The association’s president, Ato Jonathan Dagni, said that Dr. Habtamu Alemu, a general practitioner at Dire Dawa Sabian Hospital, informed them of the alleged abuse and requested the Dire Dawa City Administration Health Bureau to provide a solution to the issue.

Other health professionals are also raising various rights issues; what guarantees do they have to prevent them from facing the same problem? What is the solution? We have submitted a question to the association.

**What did Ato Jonathan Dagnichew answer?

**
“The international level organization that Ethiopia is a member of allows professionals and workers to assemble and organize.

Therefore, Ethiopia must respect the law it signed. We do not believe that arresting and shaming professionals will be the solution. The primary solution is to answer the questions raised by professionals in a timely manner.

The movement that health professionals are carrying out is a peaceful demand for bread. It is a peaceful; disciplined, led by educated people, and does not have any political goals or agenda.

The government should create forums to discuss the movement without diverting it to another direction and provide a solution. Arresting, beating, shaming, and threatening will not solve the problem.

The problem is old and deep-rooted. It is not possible to undermine this movement by giving it a different name,” he said.

**What did the association’s vice-president, Ato Melese Bata, tell Tikvah Ethiopia?

**
“Dr. Habtamu’s case has been openly brought to the attention of the public, but other health professionals who have been demanding their rights have also been unfairly dismissed and imprisoned.”

The association has repeatedly raised this issue with the heads of the institutions. They urged the heads of health institutions to take appropriate action against health professionals who are caught up in inappropriate behavior.”

General practitioner Dr. Habtamu informed the association that he had been subjected to administrative abuse in the office where he worked for raising his rights.

Tikvah Ethiopia

ነዋሪዎቹ በሰጡት ቃል ፤ ዕድሜያቸው ከ5 እስከ 8 የሆኑት የነዚህ ህፃናት አስክሬን የተገኘው ከአንድ ቀን ተኩል በኋላ ነው።

ሁለቱ ህፃናት ወንድማማች ሲሆኑ ሦስተኛው ደግሞ የአክስታቸው ልጅ እንደሆነ ተነግሯል።

የቀብር ስነ-ስርዓታቸው ሚያዝያ 18/2017 ዓ.ም ተፈጽሟል።

በወንዙ ከአሁን በፊትም ተመሳሳይ አሳዛኝ አደጋ ተከስቶ  እንደነበረ ነዋሪዎች የገለጹ ሲሆን ወላጆች መተኪያ የሌላቸው ህፃናት ልጆችን ውሎ መከታተል እንደሚገባ ተጠቁሟል። 

መረጃው የድምፂ ወያነ ሪፓርተር ነው።

**" The bodies of the children aged 5-8 were found after a day and a half "- Residents

🔴 Two of the deceased are brothers and one is their cousin!**

Three children who went to bathe in a river called Mai Geni in the Seyeti Adiabo Woreda Kebele Adi Khulte Dabre village in the Northwestern Zone of Tigray have been killed.

The three children from Dabre village went to one of the wells in the river to bathe in the early hours of April 17, 2017, but they were unable to come out alive.

Residents said that their bodies could not be found in the well in the river for a day and a half.

According to the residents; the bodies of these children aged 5-8 were found after a day and a half.

The two children are brothers and the third is their cousin.

Their funeral was held on April 18, 2017.

Residents said that similar tragic events have occurred in the river before, and it was pointed out that parents should monitor children who have no replacements. 

The information is from the reporter of the Voice of Ethiopia.

**“  አለምአቀፉ የገንዘብ ተቋም IMF፣ ብድር ለመስጠት ይህን አባልነት እንደ ቅድመ ሁኔታ ይጠቀምበታል ”  - የኢኮኖሚ ባለሙያ
**
ኢትዮጵያ የአለም የንግድ ድርጅት አባል ለመሆን ከ1996 ጀምሮ፣ ላለፉት 20 አመታት እየተደራደረች ትገኛለች፡፡ 

እስካሁን ድረስ ከተቋሙ ጋር አምስት ዙር ድርድሮች የተደረጉ ሲሆን፣ በተለይ በቅርቡ በስዊዘርላንድ፣ ጄኔቫ የተደረገው አምስተኛው ድርድር መልካም ውጤት የተገኘበት እንደሆነ የንግድና ቀጣናዊ ትስስር ሚኒስቴር አስታውቆ ነበር።

ኢትዮጵያ፣ የሚጠበቅባትን ቅድመ ሁኔታዎች በማሟላት በሚቀጥለው አመት የአለም ንግድ ድርጅት ሙሉ አባል እንደምትሆንም ተገልጿል።

ለመሆኑ የአለም ንግድ ድርጅት አባል መሆን የሚያስገኘው ጥቅም ምንድነው ? ፣ ሀገራት የድርጅቱ አባል ሲሆኑ ምን ያገኛሉ ፣ ምንስ ያጣሉ ? በሚሉት ሐሳቦች ዙርያ አንድ የኢኮኖሚ ባለሙያን ጠይቀናል፡፡ 

ባለሙያው አቶ ክቡር ገና፣ ከቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ጋር ባደረጉት ቃለ ምልልስ፣ “ በኢትዮጵያ በኩል እስካሁን የነበረው ሒደት ያዝ ለቀቅ የበዛበት ነበር፣ አሁን ግን መንግስት ጠንከር ብሎ የገፋበት ይመስላል፣ ድርጅቱን ለመቀላቀልም ጫፍ ላይ ተደርሶዋል ” ብለዋል፡፡  

አቶ ክቡር ገና፣ ድርጅቱን ለመቀላቀል የሚጠየቁትን ቅድመ ሁኔታዎች አብራርተዋል።

**የኢኮኖሚ ባለሙያው ምን አሉ ?**

“ ድርጅቱን ያቋቋሙት እና ቀድመው የተቀላቀሉ ሀገራት፣ ያስቀመጡዋቸው ህጎችና ቅድመ ሁኔታዎች አሉ፡፡ ወደ ድርጅቱ የሚመጡ ሀገራ እነዛን ቅድመ ሁኔታዎች ማሟላት ይጠበቅባቸዋል፡፡ 

ለምሳሌ፣ ኢትዮጵያ የዚህ ድርጅት አባል ለመሆን በምታደርገው ድርድር ሒደት፣ የድርጅቱ አባላት እና በኢትዮጵያ የንግድ ዘርፍ ያገባኛል የሚል ሀገር ሁሉ ጥያቄውን ያቀርባል፡፡ 

በአጠቃላይ ሲታይ ግን፣ የአንድ ሀገር የንግድ ዘርፍ ለውጭ ባለሃብቶች ክፍት መደረግ አለበት የሚል ነው፡፡ 

የአለም ንግድ ድርጅት ዋና አለማ፣ የሀገሪቱ ሀብት ለውጭ ባለሀብቶች ተስተካክሎ እንዲቀርብ ማድረግ ነው፡፡ እንደ ፋይናንስና ቴሌኮሚኒኬሽን ያሉ ዘርፎች ለውጭ ባለሀብቶች እንዲከፈቱ ያስገድዳል፡፡ እዛ ድርጅት ውስጥ ሲገባ የፖሊሲ ለውጥ መደረጉ አይቀርም፡፡ ከአለም ንግድ ድርጅት ህግጋትና ደንቦች ጋር የሚጣጣም ፖሊሲ ይወጣል፡፡ የኢትዮጵያ መንግስትም በዚህ በኩል የፖሊሲ ማስተካከያ ያደርጋል፡፡ 

የአለም ንግድ ድርጅት ውስጥ መግባት ማለት ስምምነትን መቀበል ማለት ነው፣ ከአለም ንግድ ድርጅት አሰራር ጋር የሚጣጣም ፖሊሲ ብቻ ነው ማውጣት የምትችለው፡፡ እንደፈለጉ ፖሊሲ ማውጣትና መቀያየር ያበቃል፡፡ ”

**ለአባል ሀገራቱ ምን ጥቅም ያመጣል፣ ኢትዮጵያስ ምን ትጠቀማለች ?  **

“ የኢትዮጵያ ገበያ ለውጭ ባለሀብቶች ክፍት ሲደረግ፣ ለውጭ ምርቶች የቀረጥ ቅነሳ ይደረጋል፡፡ 

ከውጭ የሚገቡ ምርቶች አሁን ከሚጣልባቸው ቀረጥ ባነሰ መጠን ወደ ኢትዮጵያ ይገባሉ፡፡ በዚህም ሸማቹ ይጠቀማል፣ እነዛን ምርቶች ዝቅ ባለ ዋጋ ይገዛቸዋል፡፡ 

በሌላ በኩል የመንግስት ገቢ ይቀንሳል፡፡ ቀድሞ ከፍተኛ ቀረጥ በማስከፈል ያገኘው የነበረው ገቢ ይቀንስበታል፡፡ 

በሌላ በኩል ደግሞ፣ በገበያው ውስጥ ተወዳዳሪ ስለሚበዛ፣ በአለምአቀፍ የጥራት ደረጃ ያልተመረተ ምርት ተወዳዳሪ አይሆንም፡፡ 

የድርጅቱ አባል ሲኮን፣ የሌሎች ሀገራት ምርቶች ቀድሞ ከነበረው ቀረጥ ባነሰ መጠን ይገባሉ፡፡ በዚህ ጊዜ፣ ምርታቸውን በአለም አቀፍ የጥራት ደረጃ የማያመርቱ የኢትዮጵያ ድርጅቶች በሙሉ ከባድ ፈተና ላይ ይወድቃሉ፡፡ በተለይ ቀላል የማኑፋክቸሪንግ ዘርፎች ከባድ ውድድር ሊገጥማቸው እንደሚችል አንዳንድ ጥናቶች ያሳያሉ፡፡ የምርትቻው ጥራት አለምአቀፋዊ ደረጃን ያልጠበቀ ከሆነ፣ ሊወዳደሩ አይችሉም፡፡ 

የሀገር ውስጥ አምራቾች እስከዛሬ ድረስ በቀረጥ ጥበቃ ሲደረግላቸው ቆይተዋል፡፡ ቀረጥ ለሀገር ውስጥ አምራቾች ከለላ የሚሰጥበት አሰራር ነው፡፡ የድርጅት አባል ስትሆን ግን፣ ይህ ከለላ ይቀራል፡፡ ”

**ምን ያህል የቅድመ ዝግጅት ስራዎች ተከናውነዋል ?
**
“ የአለም ንግድ ድርጅት አባል ለመሆን ስንወስን፣ ቀድመው መከናወን የሚገባቸው ስራዎች ነበሩ፡፡ ቀድሞ የፖሊሲ ለውጥ ማድረግ እና አምራች ዘርፉን መደገፍ ይገባ ነበር፡፡ በዚህ በኩል ጥያቄ አለኝ፣ ብዙ አልተሰራም ብዬ ነው የማስበው፡፡ የሀገር ውስጥ አምራቾች አቅማቸው እንዲዳብርና ለውድድር እንዲዘጋጁ አልተደረጉም፡፡ ይህ ባለመደረጉ፣ አባልነቱ አሁን ያሉትን ድርጅቶች ያዳክማቸዋል፡፡ 

ለአባልነቱ የሚደረገው ንግግር እና ውይይትም በአብዛኛው የመንግስት ሐላፊዎችን ብቻ ያካተተ ነው፡፡ የንግዱ ማህበረሰብና መሪዎቹ፣ የአለም ንግድ ድርጅትን ከመቀላቀል ጋራ ተያይዞ ሊመጣ የሚችለው ችግር በትክክል ምን እንደሆነ አላስቀመጡም፡፡ በድርድሩ እንኳን መሳተፍ ባይቻል፣ ቀድሞ መደረግ ስላለበት ነገር ግን ሀሳብ መስጠት ይቻል ነበር፡፡ ”

**ድሆች ሀገራት ከዚህ ድርጅት ይጠቀማሉ ?
**
“ የሚጠቀሙ ሀገራት ይኖራሉ፣ ግን ምን ያህል ናቸው፣ በምን ዘርፍ ነው የተጠቀሙት የሚለው መታየት አለበት፡፡ በአብዛኛው ግን ተጠቅመዋል ለማለት አያስደፍርም፡፡ 

አብዛኛውን ጊዜ ከአፍሪካ ሀገራት የሚፈለገው እርሻ ምርታቸውንና የማዕድን ሀብታቸውን ለውጭ ገበያ እንዲያቀርቡ ነው፡፡ ይህን ለማድረግ ድርጅቱ ድጋፍ ይሰጣል፡፡ 

የሀገራቱ ህዝብ ከድህነት እንዲወጣና የተሻለ ህይወት እንዲኖረው ማድረግ የሚለው ግን የአለም ንግድ ድርጅት አሰራር ውስጥ ቦታ የለውም፡፡ 

ውጤቱ ይህ ከሆነ፣ የነዚህ ሀገራት መንግስታት ለምን አባል መሆን ይፈልጋሉ ለሚለው ጥያቄ፣ መልሱ ተፅዕኖ ስለሚደረግባቸው ነው፡፡ 

የዛ ድርጅት አባል መሆን፣ ሌሎች የንግድ ቀጣናዎች ውስጥ ለመግባት ይጠቅማል፣ አለምአቀፍ ንግድ ላይ አለመስማማት ካለ፣ በድርጅቱ በኩል የሚታይበት ሁኔታ ይኖራል፣ የውጭ ኢንቨስትመንትን ይስባል፣ የሚሉ ምክንያቶችም ይቀርባሉ፡፡ 

የአለም ንግድ ድርጅት ግልፅ አሰራር እንዳለው አድርጎ ነው ራሱን የሚያቀርበው፣ የድሆቹን ሀገራት ሀሳብ እንደሚሰማም ይገልፃል፡፡ በተግባር ሲታይ ግን እንደዛ አይደለም፡፡ ወደዛ ለመግባት አለምአቀፉ የገንዘብ ተቋምም ያስገድዳል፡፡ 

IMF ብድር ለመስጠት የዚህን ድርጅት አባልነት እንደ ቅድመ ሁኔታ ያቀርቦዋል፡፡ ከእኔ ብድር መውሰድ ከፈለጋችኹ፣ አንዱ ማሟላት ያለባችሁ ቅድመ ሁኔታ፣ የአለም ንግድ ድርጅት አባል መሆን ነው ይላቸዋል፡፡ ”

**“The International Monetary Fund (IMF) uses this membership as a precondition for granting loans” - Economist

**
Ethiopia has been negotiating to become a member of the World Trade Organization (WTO) for the past 20 years, since 1996. 

So far, five rounds of negotiations have been held with the organization, and the Ministry of Trade and Regional Integration announced that the fifth round of negotiations held recently in Geneva, Switzerland, was a success.

It was also announced that Ethiopia will become a full member of the WTO next year by fulfilling the required conditions.

So, what are the benefits of becoming a member of the WTO? What do countries gain and what do they lose when they become members of the organization? We asked an economist about these ideas. 

In an interview with Tikvah Ethiopia, expert Ato Kebur Jena said, “The process on the Ethiopian side so far has been a lot of holding back, but now it seems that the government has pushed hard, and they have reached the point of joining the organization.” 

Ato Kebur Jena explained the prerequisites for joining the organization. 

**What do economists say?**

“ The countries that established the organization and those that have already joined have set rules and conditions. Countries that are coming to the organization are expected to meet those conditions. 

For example, in the negotiation process for Ethiopia to become a member of this organization, the members of the organization and all countries that want to trade in Ethiopia submit their requests. 

In general, however, a country’s trade sector should be opened to foreign investors. 

The main goal of the WTO is to make the country’s resources available to foreign investors. It requires sectors such as finance and telecommunications to be opened to foreign investors. When you join that organization, there will be a change in policy. A policy that is consistent with the rules and regulations of the WTO will be issued. The Ethiopian government will also make policy adjustments in this regard. 

Joining the WTO means accepting an agreement, with the WTO’s procedures You can only make policies that are compatible. You can make and change policies as you wish.”

**What benefits does it bring to the member states, and what does Ethiopia benefit from? **

“When the Ethiopian market is opened to foreign investors, tariffs on foreign products will be reduced. 

Imported products will enter Ethiopia at a lower rate than they are currently subject to. This will benefit the consumer, who will buy those products at a lower price. 

On the other hand, government revenue will decrease. The revenue that was previously generated by charging high tariffs will decrease. 

On the other hand, since there are more competitors in the market, products that are not produced at international quality standards will not be competitive. 

When the organization is a member, products from other countries will enter at a lower rate than before. At this time, all Ethiopian companies that do not produce their products at international quality standards will face a serious challenge. Some studies show that light manufacturing sectors will face severe competition. If the quality of the products does not meet international standards, they will not be able to compete. 

While domestic manufacturers have been protected by tariffs to date They have been. The system of tariffs is a system of protecting domestic producers. But when you become a member of an organization, this protection is lost. ”

**How ​​much preparatory work has been done?
**
“ When we decided to become a member of the WTO, there were things that should have been done beforehand. There should have been policy changes and support for the manufacturing sector. I have a question about this, I think not much has been done. Domestic producers have not been helped to develop their capabilities and prepare for competition. If this has not been done, membership will weaken the existing organizations. 

The talks and discussions about membership have mostly involved only government officials. The business community and its leaders have not really identified what the problems that may arise from joining the WTO are. Even if they cannot participate in the negotiations, they should have given their suggestions in advance. ”

**Do poor countries benefit from this organization?

**
“There are countries that use it, but how many of them are there and in what sectors they use it remains to be seen. But it is safe to say that they mostly use it. 

Most of the time, what is required of African countries is to export their agricultural products and mineral resources. The organization provides support for this. 

However, the idea of ​​helping the people of these countries to get out of poverty and have a better life has no place in the WTO’s system. 

If this is the result, the answer to the question of why the governments of these countries want to be members is that they are influenced. 

Being a member of that organization is useful for entering other trade zones, if there is a disagreement on international trade, there will be a situation where the organization will be seen, and it will attract foreign investment, and other reasons are given. 

The WTO presents itself as having a transparent system, and it claims to listen to the opinions of the poor countries. But in practice, that is not the case. The International Monetary Fund is also not It requires. 

The IMF has made membership in this organization a condition for granting loans. If you want to take a loan from me, one of the conditions you have to fulfill is membership in the WTO, they say.”

🔈#የጤናባለሙያዎችድምጽ__

**“ መጀመሪያ እየሰራሁ ወደነበረበት ሳቢያን ሆስፒታል ተመልሸ ስራዬን እንድቀጥል ይደረግልኝ ” - የጠቅላላ ሀኪሙ ዶ/ር ሀብታሙ አለሙ
** 
__• __**“ የዝውውር ዓላማ ክፍት ቦታ ሲኖር ሥራንና ሠራተኞቸን ማገናኘት ነው እንጂ ዝውውር የቅጣት ውጤት አይደለም ” - ማኀበሩ
**
በድሬዳዋ ሳቢያን ጠቅላላ ሆስፒታል የጠቅላላ ሀኪም ዶክተር ሀብታሙ አለሙ ደረሰብኝ ላሉት በደል ፍትህ እንዲያሰጣቸው በኢትዮጵያ ጤና ባለሙያዎች ማኀበር በኩል በደብዳቤ አቤት ብለዋል።

**ቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ የተመለከተው የአቤቱታ ደብዳቤያቸው ምን ይላል ?
**
በጠቅላላ ሀኪምነት ከአዲስ  አበባ ዩኒቨርሲቲ ከተመረቁ በኋላ ወዳስተማረቻቸውና ያሳደገቻቸው ድሬዳዋ ከተማ ለሦስት ወራት የነፃ አገልግሎት እንደሰጡ ይገልጻል።

በኋላም በአስተዳደሩ በወጣ ማስታወቂያ ወድድር አልፈው በ2016 ዓ/ም በሆስፒታሉ በትጋትና ከፍተኛ ፍቅር ህብዝን ሲያገለግሉ እንደነበር ያስረዳል።

ከሰሞኑን እንደ ሀገር በተጀመሩ የጤና ባለሙያዎች የመብት ጥያቄዎች ሰላማዊ እንቅስቃሴ በፅሑፍ ያላቸውን ተሰሚነት በመጠቀም ሌሎችን በማንቃት ሲሳተፉ የጤና ቢሮው ኃላፊዎች ከዚህ እንዲታቀቡ ቢያስጠነቅቋቸውም የመብት ጥያቄ ማንሳት እንደማያቆሙ ማሳወቃቸውን ይጠቅሳል።

ይህን ባሳወቁ ማግስትም (ማክሰኞ ሚያዚያ 14/2017 ዓ/ም) በተፃፈላቸው ደብዳቤ ጥፋት እንዳለባቸው ተገልጾ የሥራ ቦታ እንዲቀይሩ መደረጋደቸውን ያትታል።

ሀኪሙ ይህንኑ እርምጃ፣ “ ህገ ወጥና ስርዓቱን ያልተከተለ በቂም በቀል የተጻፈ ደብዴቤ አግባብ አለመሆኑ እና የሥም ማጥፋት መሆኑን ” ገልጸው፣ ውሳኔው ተቀልብሶ ሲሰሩበት ወደነበረው ሳቢያን ሆስፒታል እንዲመለሱ እንዲደረግላቸው የኢትዮጵያ ጤና ባለሙያዎች ማኀበርን በደብዳቤ ጠይቀዋል።

**ማኀበሩ ለድሬዳዋ ጤና ቢሮ የጻፈው ደብዳቤስ ምን ይላል ?
**
ሀኪሙ ወደ ሌላ ጣቢያ እንዲዘዋወሩ መደረጋቸውን ገልጾ፣ “በፌደራል መንግስት ሠራተኞች አዋጅ መሠረት የዝውውር ዋና ዓላማ ክፍት ቦታ ሲኖር ሥራንና ሠራተኞቸን ማገናኘት ነው እንጂ ዝውውር የቅጣት ውጤት አይደለም” ብሏል።

** 
__• __**“ The purpose of the transfer is to connect the work and the employees when there is a vacancy, and the transfer is not a punishment ” - The Association
**
The Ethiopian Health Professionals Association has appealed in a letter to the General Physician Dr. Habtamu Alemu of Dire Dawa Sabian General Hospital to provide justice for the injustice he suffered.

**What does their letter of complaint, which Tikvah Ethiopia has seen, say?
**
After graduating from Addis Ababa University as a general physician, they provided free services to Dire Dawa city, where they were educated and raised, for three months.

Later, in a notice issued by the administration, he explained that he had been serving the people of the hospital with great dedication and love in 2016.

He mentioned that when he participated in the peaceful movement of health professionals demanding their rights that had recently started as a country, using his voice in writing to awaken others, the health bureau officials warned him to refrain from this, but he informed them that he would not stop raising his rights demands.

The day after he informed them (Tuesday, April 14, 2017), he wrote to them stating that they had committed a crime and ordered them to change their place of work.

The doctor described this action as “illegal, unjust, and a vendetta against the system,” and wrote to the Ethiopian Health Professionals Association to reverse the decision and allow him to return to Sabian Hospital, where he worked.

**What does the association’s letter to the Dire Dawa Health Bureau say?
**
The doctor explained that he was transferred to another station, saying, “According to the Federal Government Employees Proclamation, the main purpose of transfer is to connect workers with jobs when there is a vacancy, and transfer is not a punishment.”

However, he cited the reason for the internal transfer as “disciplinary problems,” and asked the bureau to return the doctor to his place of work since there was no documented disciplinary offense against him.

A man who killed a person and hid his body for 6 years has been arrested and sentenced to prison, the Sheka Zone Police said.

In the area known as Mich River, in the Ki Woreda of the Sheka Zone, Southwestern Ethiopia, on November 12, 2011, unidentified armed bandits called from the forest, brutally shot and killed a private victim, threw his body in the forest, and ate it for hyenas, has been arrested and sentenced to prison after years of searching.

Deputy Commander Lisanework Tesfaye, Head of the Public Relations and Image Building Division of the Sheka Zone Police Department, told Tikvah Ethiopia, “The man has been hiding from the area for the past 6 years, committing this heinous crime with his accomplices.”

He was arrested after local residents tipped him off to the charges and tried to integrate into society.

The Sheka Zone Police, along with the Yeki Woreda Police and other justice institutions, have been investigating the case in absentia.

After the man was arrested 6 years later, the Sheka Zone High Court, after a lengthy hearing on the case filed by the prosecutor, sentenced him to 18 years in prison.

The police indicated that they are monitoring the case to arrest those involved in the crime and those who commit crimes such as bush hunting.

**
በሥሩ እስከ 5000 ሰዎችን የሚያንቀሳቅሰው ሰላም የህፃናት መንደር በሚገኝበት አዲስ አበባ ከተማ ከፍተኛ የውሃ ችግር እንደተጋረጠበት ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ገለጸ፡፡

**አቶ ጎይቶም ተ/ሚካኤል በሰላም የህጻናት መንደር የሮፋም ምክትል ዋና ስራ አስኪያጅ**__ **ምን አሉ ?**
__
“ ከሦስቱ የከርሰ ምድር ውሃዎች ሁለቱ ደርቀዋል፡፡ አንዱ በጣም በትንሹ ውሃ እየሰጠን ይገኛል፡፡ ከእድሜ ብዛትና የከተማ አካባቢ በመሆኑ በአካባቢያችን በርካታ የውሃ ጉድጓዶች እየተቆፈሩ በመምጣታቸው አጭር ጥልቀት ስላለው እጥረት ገጥሞናል።
 
በመሆኑም ወዳጆች፣ አብረውን የሚሰሩ ፓርትነሮችን ጠርተን የውሃ ጉድጓድ በራስ አቅም ተረዳድተን መቆፈር እንድንችል የገቢ ማሰባሰቢያ የእራት ፕሮግራም ለማዘጋጀት ወስነናል ” ብለዋል፡፡

ችግሩን ለመቅረፍ ምን ያክል ገንዘብ ያስፈልጋል ? የውሃ ችግሩ እንዴት አደረጋችሁ ? በችግሩ ሳቢያ ለምን ያክል አላስፈላጊ የውሃ ወጪ እየተዳረጋችሁ ነው? ስንልም አቶ ጎይቶምን ጠይቀናል።

**ምን መለሱ ?

**“ በትንሹ እስከ 8 ሊትር ውሃ በሰከንድ ውስጥ ሊሰጥ የሚችል 350 ሜትር ጥልቀት ያለው ጉድጓድ መቆፈር ያስፈልጋል፡፡

ዋጋው በአሁኑ ሁኔታ እስከ 18 ሚሊዮን ብር  ይጠይቃል። የውሃ ችግሩ ከባድ ችግር ነው፡፡ ያለችን የከርሰ ምድር በሰከድ አንድ ሊትር ውሃ ነው የምትሰጠን፡፡ የመንግስት ውሃ በመካከል አክሰስ አለን፡፡ ግን በፕሮግራም ስለሆነ ብዙ ማግኘት አልተቻለም፡፡

ችግሩ አሁን የባሰ ደረጃ ደርሷል፡፡ ያለችው የጉድጓድ ውሃ ከተቋረጠች ችግሩ በጣም የከፋ ይሆናል፡፡ በቀን አምስት ቦቴ ውሃ እናስመጣለን፤ ያ ማለት በትንሹ 4000 ብር ነው አንድ ቦቲ፡፡ የከርሰ ምድር አማራጭ ውሃ ባለመኖሩ በወር 200 ሺሕ ብር እያስወጣን ነው ” ሲሉ መልሰዋል።

**ሰላም የህፃናት መንደር ማነው ?

__**“The two groundwaters have dried up; the problem has now reached a critical level. It will cost 18 million birr to solve the water problem” - the organization
**
Addis Ababa, where the Selam Children’s Village, which serves up to 5,000 people, is facing a severe water crisis, Tikvah Ethiopia was told.

The organization said this during a fundraising dinner organized to raise money to dig a water well.

**Ato Goytom T/Michael, Deputy General Manager of Rofam, Sallam Children's Village**__ **What do they say?**
__
“Two of the three groundwater sources have dried up. One is providing us with very little water. Due to the age and urban area, we are facing a shortage due to the fact that many water wells are being dug in our area and they are of short depth.
 
Therefore, friends, we have decided to organize a fundraising dinner program so that we can dig water wells ourselves by inviting our partners,” he said.

How much money is needed to solve the problem? How did you solve the water problem? Why are you incurring unnecessary water costs due to the problem? We asked Ato Goytom.

**What did he answer?

**“ A 350-meter deep well that can provide at least 8 liters of water per second needs to be dug.

The cost currently is up to 18 million birr. The water problem is a serious problem. Our existing groundwater supplies one liter of water per second. We have access to government water in the meantime. But since it is on a program, we cannot get much.

The problem has now reached a worse stage. If the existing well water is cut off, the problem will be even worse. We import five bottles of water a day; that is, one bottle costs at least 4,000 birr. Since there is no alternative groundwater water, we are spending 200,000 birr per month,” he replied.

**Who is Salam Children’s Village?
**
The organization has been in existence for more than 38 years, initially to raise children who lost their parents for various reasons, and later on, it has been providing other services.

It raises about 300 orphans. It teaches 3000 students in the school. It has about 200 children in daycare centers. There are 1000 trainees in the training center. At least 1000 people are treated in the clinic every day.

**" It allows micro and small enterprises (traders and agents, small businesses) to start or expand their businesses with secured and unsecured loans of up to 1.2 million birr " - Ethio Telecom**

Ethio Telecom today launched a program to introduce new financial products under Siinqee Bank, a financial support provider worth 15 billion birr. 

The products announced are four products under the Tele Birr Super App 'Financial service with Siinqee '. 

The services are:
- Web Loan Service, 
- Small and Medium Enterprise (SME) Loan Service, 
- Micro Savings 
- Device Financing Services. 

The loan services will be provided to customers based on their financial activities on Tele Birr and will be based on their ability to meet their credit limits. 

Of the 15 billion birr provided by Synqe Bank, 10 billion birr will be used to provide loans to small and medium enterprises. 

The loans will be made entirely digitally through the Tele Birr Super App and will be made with or without collateral. 

The agreement with Synqe Bank will allow micro and small enterprises (traders and agents, small businesses) to obtain loans of up to 1.2 million birr with or without collateral to start or expand their businesses. It is also indicated that up to 10 billion birr will be provided annually. 

Ethio Telecom, which has been providing 960 thousand devices (mobile handsets) annually, will provide up to 2 million devices annually under the current Synqe Bank agreement, said its CEO Frehiwot Tamiru.

**" አስተዳደራዊ በደል በድሬዳዋ ጤና ቢሮ ተፈፅሞብኛል " - የሳቢያን ሆስፒታል ሀኪም ዶክተር ሀብታሙ አለሙ 

➡️ " በሆስፒታሉ ከተቀጠረ ጀምሮ እስካሁን ድረስ የቀረበበት የዲስፕሊን ጉድለት የለም " - የሳቢያን ሆስፒታል የዲሲፕሊን ኮሚቴ**

በድሬዳዋ አስተዳደር ጤና ቢሮ ሳቢያን ሆስፒታል የጠቅላላ ህክምና ሃኪም የሆኑት ዶክተር ሀብታሙ አለሙ በሀገር አቀፍ ደረጃ የህክምና ባለሙያዎች ያቀረቡትን ቅሬታ በመደገፋቸው በቢሮው አስተዳደራዊ በደል ተፈፅሞብኛል በማለት ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ቅሬታቸውን አቅርበዋል።

ቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ የተመለከተውና ለባለሞያው የተጻፈው ደብዳቤ " ለስራ በተመደበበት ክፍል የሙያ ስነምግባርን በተፃረረ መልኩ በእናቶች እና በህፃናት ክፍል ወላድ እናቶችን በተደጋጋሚ ማመናጨቅ፣ መሳደብ እና ያለአግባብ ማመላለስ እና ማስጠንቀቂያ ቢሰጥም ባለመታረሙ ወደ ገኦዳ ጉዱንፈታ ጤና ጣቢያ አዘዋውረናል " የሚል ነው።

**የጤና ባለሙያው ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ምን አሉ ? **

" በሀገር አቀፍ ደረጃ የህክምና ባለሙያዎች የደመወዝ ጭማሪ ይደረግልን ተብሎ ቅሬታ ሲያቀርቡ ለምን ሃሳቡን ደገፍክ ብለው የድሬዳዋ ከተማ ጤና ቢሮ ሃላፊ እና ምክትል ደውለው ለምን ይሄን አደረክ አሉኝ፣ እኔም ጥያቄው እንደሀገር ነው የቀረበው፣ እንደ ድሬዳዋ አይደለም፣ ይሄ ደግሞ የመብት ጥያቄ ነው ብየ መለስኩኝ ።

የሃላፋዎች ምላሽም በድሬዳዋ ከተማ አንደዚህ መንቀሳቀስ አትችሉም፣ የከተማችንን ስም ያቆሽሽብናል፣ ስለዚህ የህክምና ባለሙያው ዝም ነው ማለት ያለበት አሉኝ።

በነጋታው ከሰዓት የዝውውር ደብዳቤ እና የዲስፕሊን ጉድለት አለብህ ብለው ከሃላፊዎች ሲሰጠኝ የጤና ቢሮ ሃላፊዋን ዶክተር ፅጌሬዳን ለማናገር ቢሮ ስሄድ ባለማግኜቴ ስልክ በመደወል ሳናግሯቸው ቅድሚያ ስሜን አጥፍተሀል እና ፌስቡክ ላይ ይቅርታ ብለህ ፃፍ ከዚያ ውጭ አላናግርህም አሉኝ " ሲሉ አስረድተዋል።

ቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ በዚህ ላይ ስማቸው የተጠቀሰው የድሬዳዋ ከተማ አስተዳደር ጤና ቢሮ ኃላፊ ዶ/ር ጽጌረዳ ክፍሌ እንዲሁም ምክትል ኃላፊ አቶ ዩሱፍ ሰይድ ለማነጋገር በተደጋጋሚ ስልካቸው ላይ ቢደውልም ምላሽ ማግኘት አልቻልም።

**በጉዳዩ ላይ የሳቢያን ሆስፒታል የዲሲፕሊን ኮሚቴ ምን አለ ?**

ዶ/ር ሀብታሙ " እንደ ሆስፒታል በዲስፕሊን ተፅፎብኝ የሚያውቅ ደብዳቤ የለም " ማለታቸውን ተከትሎ ቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ የሳቢያን ሆስፒታል የዲሲፕሊን ኮሚቴ ሰብሳቢ የሆኑትን ዶክተር አባይነህን ጠይቋል።

በምላሻቸውም " በሆስፒታሉ ከተቀጠረ ጀምሮ እስካሁን ድረስ የቀረበበት የዲስፕሊን ጉድለት ክስ #የለም " ሲሉ ማረጋገጫ ሰጥተዋል።

ቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ይህንን መረጃ እያዘጋጀ በነበረበት ወቅት የሆስፒታሉ ስራ አስኪያጅ ሲስተር መስከረም አሰፋ በኃላፊነት ቦታቸው ላይ እንደሌሉ ሰምቷል።

ሲስተር መስከረም ይኽ መረጃ እስከተዘጋጀበት ጊዜ ከሥራ እረፍት እንዲያደርጉ እንጂ ዝውውርም ሆነ እድገት እንዳልተሰጣቸው ለማረጋገጥ ችለናል።

ቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ከደመወዝ ጥያቄው ጋር በተገናኘ እንዲሁም በዚህ መረጃ ላይ ለቀረቡት ቅሬታዎች የድሬዳዋ ከተማ አስተዳደር ጤና ቢሮ ሃላፊዎችን ለማናገር ያደረግው ጥረት ባለመሳካቱ ምላሻቸውን ማካተት ሳይቻል ቀርቷል። 

በጉዳዩ ላይ ቢሮውም ሆነ ማንኛውም አካል ምላሽ እና ማብራሪያ ለመስጠት ፈቃደኛ ከሆነ ለማስተናገድ ዝግጁ መሆኑን ይገልጻል።

**" Administrative abuse has been committed against me at the Dire Dawa Health Bureau " - Sabian Hospital Physician Dr. Habtamu Alemu 

➡️ " There has been no disciplinary action against me since I was hired at the hospital " - Sabian Hospital Disciplinary Committee**

Dr. Habtamu Alemu, a general practitioner at Sabian Hospital, Dire Dawa Administrative Health Bureau, has filed a complaint with Tikvah Ethiopia, supporting the complaints of medical professionals nationwide.

The letter that Tikvah Ethiopia has received and written to the professional states that " He repeatedly harassed, insulted and mistreated mothers in the maternity and children's departments in a manner contrary to professional ethics in the department he was assigned to work in and despite warnings, he was transferred to Geoda Gudunfeta Health Center without correction."

**What did the health professional say to Tikvah Ethiopia? **

"When medical professionals nationwide complained that we should be given a salary increase, the head and deputy of the Dire Dawa City Health Bureau called me and asked why did you do this, and I replied that the request was made as a country, not as a Dire Dawa, and this is a request for rights.

The response of the officials was that you cannot act like this in Dire Dawa City, you are tarnishing the name of our city, so the medical professional should keep quiet.

The next morning, when I was given a transfer letter and disciplinary failure from the officials, when I went to the office to speak to the head of the health bureau, Dr. Tsigereda, because I could not find her, I called her on the phone and said, "You have erased my name first and wrote an apology on Facebook and I will not talk to you anymore," he explained.

Tikvah Ethiopia has repeatedly contacted the head of the Dire Dawa City Administration Health Bureau, Dr. Tsigereda Kifle, and the deputy head, Ato Yusuf Sayed, but they have not responded.

**What is the Sabian Hospital Disciplinary Committee’s response on the matter?**

Following Dr. Habtamu’s statement that “there is no disciplinary letter written to me by the hospital,” Tikvah Ethiopia contacted Dr. Abayneh, the chairman of the Sabian Hospital Disciplinary Committee.

In response, he confirmed that “there has been no disciplinary case filed against him since he was hired at the hospital.”

While Tikvah Ethiopia was preparing this information, it was learned that the hospital’s manager, Sister Sesem Assefa, was no longer in her position.

We were able to confirm that Sister Sesem has been placed on leave and has not been transferred or promoted as of the time of this information being prepared.

Tikvah Ethiopia has been unable to reach the Dire Dawa City Administration Health Bureau regarding the salary issue and the complaints raised in this report. 

It is ready to accommodate any response or clarification from the bureau or any other party on the matter.

Tikvah Ethiopia
Addis Ababa

**
“ ጤና ባለሙያዎች ላይ እየደረሰ ያለው የግድያ ወንጀል ከቀን ወደ ቀን አሳሳቢ እየሆነ ነው ” - ማኀበሩ
**
በደመወዝ ከመበደላቸው በባሰ ሁኔታ ጤና ባለሙያዎች ላይ የሚፈጸሙ ግድያዎች እየተሰባባሱና አሳሳቢ እየሆኑ መምጣታቸውን የኢትዮጵያ ጤና ባለሙያዎች ማኀበር ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ገለጸ።

የማኀበሩ ፕሬዚደንት አቶ ዮናታን ዳኛው በሰጡን ቃል፣ “ ጤና ባለሙያዎች ላይ እየደረሰ ያለው የግድያ ወንጀል ከቀን ወደ ቀን አሳሳቢ እየሆነ ነው ” ብለዋል።

**የማኀበሩ ፕሬዚደንት ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ምን አሉ ?
**
“ የሀገርን ስብራት የሚጠግኑ ጤና ባለሙያዎችን፣ ሀኪሞችን መግደል የትውልድን የነገ ተስፋ ማጨለም ነው። በኢትዮጵያ ሀኪሞች ተገደሉ ሚለው መርዶ ከመደጋገሙ የተነሳ የዘወትር ዜና ሆኗል።

ብዙ ዋጋ ከፍለው የሰውን ሕይወት የሚታደጉ፣ ችግሮችን ተጋፍጠው የተቀማን ህልም የሚያለመልሙ ሀኪሞች ለምን ይገደላሉ?

እድሜያቸው ለጋ የሆነ፣ ሀገርን ብዙ የሚያገለግሉ፣ ሀገር ብዙ የደከመችባቸውን ሀኪሞች መግደል የሀገርን የነገ እጣ ፈንታ የሚያበላሽ አሳፋሪ ተግባር በመሆኑ ሁሉም ዜጋ በእኩል ሊያወግዘውና ሊታገለው ይገባል።

መንግስት ጤና ባለሙያዎች የሚሰሩበትን አካባቢ ከየትኛውም አደጋ ነፃ መሆኑን ማረጋገጥና ምቹ የሥራ አካባቢ መፍጠርን ቀዳሚ ተግባሩ አድርጎ ሊሰራ ይገባል።

አብዛኞቹ ጤና ተቋማት ደህንነታቸው በበቂ ሁኔታ የተጠበቀ አለመሆኑ ደግሞ ጉዳዩን የበለጠ ውስብስብ ያደርገዋል።

በገቡት ቃል ኪዳን መሰረት ሁሉንም ዜጋ ያለ ምንም ልዩነት ሚያገለግሉ፣ የፓለቲካ ውግንና የሌላቸው ጤና ባለሙያዎችን ያነጣጠር የግድያ ወንጀል በምንም መመዘኛ ተቀባይነት የለውም።

በአስቸኳይ እልባት ይሻል ” ነው ያሉት።

ከቀናት በፊት መራቢቴ ወረዳ በእናት ሆስፒታል የጠቅላላ ህክምና ሀኪም የነበረው ዶክተር ገብረሚካኤል ወልደ መላክ ቤተሰብ ጥየቃ በመኪና እየሄደ በነበረበት ወቅት  “ በተተኮሰበት ጥይት ” መገደሉን የቅርብ ሰዎቹ ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ መግለጻቸው ይታወሳል።

ከወራት በፊት ደግሞ የባሕርዳር ዩኒቨርሲቲ ህክምናና ጤና ሳይንስ ኮሌጅ የጥበበ ግዮን ግቢ ስፔሻላንስድ ሆስፒታል የቀዶ ህክምና አገልግሎት ክፍል ዳይሬክተር ዶክተር አንዷለም ዳኘ በተተኮሰባቸው ጥይት መገዳላቸው አይዘነጋም።

“The murders of health professionals are becoming more serious day by day” - The Association
**
The Ethiopian Health Care Professionals Association told Tikvah Ethiopia that the murders of health professionals are becoming more serious and serious, worse than the murders of doctors.

In a statement given to us by the Association’s President, Ato Yonatan Al-Dahiye, “The murders of health professionals are becoming more serious day by day.”

**What did the Association’s President say to Tikvah Ethiopia?

**
“ Killing health professionals and doctors who are repairing the country’s brokenness is a threat to the future of a generation. The news that doctors have been killed in Ethiopia has become a regular news due to the repetition of the news.

Why are doctors who have paid a lot of money to save human lives, who have faced problems and have fulfilled their dreams, killed?

Killing doctors who are young, who have served the country a lot, and for whom the country has worked hard is a shameful act that destroys the future of the country, and all citizens should condemn and fight against it equally.

The government should ensure that the environment where health professionals work is free from any danger and create a comfortable working environment as its priority.

The fact that most health institutions are not adequately protected makes the issue more complex.

A murder that targets health professionals who serve all citizens without any discrimination and have no political affiliations, in accordance with their promises, is unacceptable under any circumstances.

An urgent solution It is better.”

A few days ago, Dr. Gebremichael Wolde Melkal, a general practitioner at the Merabite Woreda Mother Hospital, was killed by a “shotgun” while driving his family’s car, his close relatives told Tikvah Ethiopia.

A few months ago, Dr. Andualem Dapen, the director of the surgical services department at the Tikvah Gion Campus of the Bahirdar University College of Medicine and Health Sciences, was killed by a gunshot.

Tikvah Ethiopia

#Mesob

A pilot program has been launched to provide a one-stop service for 12 federal institutions.

"Mesob One-Stop Service" is a service that combines various government services under one roof and uses digital technologies.

The system is said to enable citizens to easily access the services of various federal institutions using a complete set of digital options.

This is said to eliminate the hassle of visiting different offices, waiting in long queues, and dealing with paper-related tasks.

12 federal government institutions have joined the pilot project that has now started and it has been announced that they have provided 41 public services.

The services include licensing, digital ID registration, and others.

In total, 12 institutions are providing 41 services in one place under the pilot program:

1. National Identification Service

2. Immigration and Citizenship Service

3. Document Verification and Registration Service

4. Ministry of Revenue

5. Ministry of Trade and Regional Integration

6. Ministry of Labor and Skills

7. Ethiopian Investment Commission

8. Ministry of Foreign Affairs

9. Educational Assessment and Examination Service

10. Ethio Post

11. Commercial Bank of Ethiopia

12. Ethio Telecom.

All institutions are providing services through technology, the Prime Minister’s Office said.

ነገ ሚያዝያ 19 ቀን 2017 ዓ/ም በ " ኢትዮጵያ ታምርት " የ10 ኪ.ሜ የሩጫ ውድድር ምክንያት መንገዶች ለተሽከርካሪዎች ዝግ እንደሚደረጉ የአዲስ አበባ ፖሊስ አሳውቋል።

የውድድሩ መነሻ ቦታ መስቀል አደባባይ ሲሆን ለገሃር መብራት፣ ቡናና ሻይ ሜክሲኮ አደባባይ፣ አፍሪካ ህብረት ሳር ቤት (ፑሽኪን አደባባይ) ፣ ቄራ አዲሱ መሿለኪያ ድልድይ፣ ጎተራ ማሳለጫ ፣ አጎና ሲኒማ ፣ ግሎባል ሆቴል፣ መስከረም ማዞሪያ ፣ ጥላሁን አደባባይ፣ ሳንጆሴፍ መብራት አድርጎ መስቀል አደባባይ ያበቃል። 

በዚህም መሠረት  ፡- 
➡️ ከቅዱስ ዑራኤል አደባባይ ወደ መስቀል አደባባይ (ባምቢስ መቅረዝ ሆስፒታል መስቀለኛ ላይ)
➡️ ከኦሎምፒያ አደባባይ ወደ መስቀል አደቤይ (ኦሎምፒያ አደባባይ ላይ) 
➡️ ከብሔራዊ ቤተመንግሥት ወደ መስቀል አደባባይ (ብሔራዊ ቤተመንግሥት ላይ)
➡️ ከሀራምቤ መብራት ወደ ሳንጆሴፍ መብራት 
➡️ ከብሔራዊ ቲያትር ወደ ለገሀር መብራት 
➡️ ከሠንጋ ተራ  ወደ ሜክሲኮ አደባባይ
➡️ ከአረቄ ፋብሪካ ወደ ሜክሲኮ አደባባይ 
➡️ ከልደታ ወደ ሜክሲኮ አደባባይ
➡️ ከልደታ ፀበል ወደ አፍሪካ ህብረት መብራት 
➡️ ከካርል አደባባይ ወደ ሳር ቤት አደባባይ 
➡️ ከቫቲካን ወደ ሳርቤት አደባባይ 
➡️ ከቄራ አልማዝዬ ሜዳ ወደ ቄራ መብራት 
➡️ ከጎፋ ገብርኤል አቅጣጫ ወደ ጎፋ መስቀለኛ በስር
➡️ ከዮሴፍ  ወደ ጎተራ ማሳለጫ 
➡️ ከመስቀል ፍላዎር ወደ አጎና መስቀለኛ 
➡️ ከጋዜቦ አደባባይ ወደ በቅሎ ቤት ድልድይ ከንጋቱ 11:00 ሰዓት ጀምሮ ፕሮግራሙ እስከሚጠናቀቅ ድረስ ለተሽከርካሪ ዝግ እንደሚሆኑ ተገልጿል።

**__" 30 እና 40 አመታት የኖረ፣ ቤት ንብረት ያፈራ፣ ቤተሰብ የመሰረተ ሰው ብዙ ነው፡፡ ኑሮውን ሁሉ በ3 ቀን ውስጥ ማቋረጥ አይችልም__ " __- በጅቡቲ የሚኖር ኢትዮጵያዊ__**

__የጅቡቲ መንግስት በሀገሩ የሚኖሩ ሰነድ አልባ ኢትዮጵያውያንን በፈቃዳቸው ለቀው እንዲወጡ፣ እንደዛ ካልሆነ ግን የግዳጅ አፈሳ እንደሚጀመር ማስታወቁ ይታወሳል። 

ቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ውሳኔውን አስመልክቶ በጅቡቲ የሚገኙ ኢትዮጵያዊያን ምን ላይ ይገኛሉ ሲል የተለያዩ ኢትዮጵያዊያንን አያነጋገረ ይገኛል።

አስተያየታቸውን የሰጡንና የጅቡቲ ነዋሪ የሆኑት ኢትዮጵያዊ አቶ ኑሩ አስፋው መንግስት የዜጎችን ስቃይ ለመቀነስ በዲፕሎማሲያዊ አካሔድ ጣልቃ መግባት አለበት ባይ ናቸው፡፡

እሳቸው በጅቡቲ በህጋዊ መንገድ እየኖሩ መሆናቸውን የጠቀሱት አስተያየት ሰጪው፣ ነገር ግን ህጋዊ ሰነድ የሌላቸው ኢትዮጵያውያን እጅግ በርካቶች እንደሆኑ ተናግረዋል፡፡ ከዚህ ውስጥ 30 እና 40 አመታት የኖረ፣ ትላልቅ የንግድ ድርጅቶችን የከፈቱ፣ ሀብትና ንብረት ያፈሩ፣ አግብተው የወለዱ ኢትዮጵያውያን አሉ ብለዋል፡፡

" በአሁኑ ጊዜ ህዝቡ በከፍተኛ ግራ መጋባት ውስጥ ነው ያለው፣ በሦስት ቀናት ውስጥ የሚይዘው የሚጨብጠው ነገር የለም " ብለዋል አቶ ኑሩ፡፡ 

የኢትዮጵያ መንግስት በአስቸኳይ ከጅቡቲ መንግስት ጋራ ተነጋግሮ ዜጎቹን ከጭንቀት እንዲታደግም ተማፅነዋል፡፡ __

__**አቶ ኑሩ በዝርዝር ምን አሉ ?**
__
__" በተገለፀው ማስታወቂያ መሰረት መመዝገብ የጀመሩ አሉ፣ በመኪና መውጣት የጀመሩም አሉ፡፡ ነገር ግን አብዛኛው ምንም ዓይነት እንቅስቃሴ እያደረገ አይደለም፡፡ አሁን 3 ቀን ብቻ ነው የቀረው፡፡ በአውሮፕላንና በባቡር መውጣት አትችልም፣ ህጋዊ የጉዞ ሰነድ ካልያዝክ፡፡ ከጅቡቲ ውጡ የሚለው ጉዳይ የተሳሳተ ይመስለኛል፡፡

በጣም ብዙ ኢትዮጵያዊ ስደተኛ ነው ያለው፣ ከኢትዮጵያዊ ቀጥሎ የመኖች ናቸው፡፡ ግን ሁሌም ውጡ የሚባሉት ኢትዮጵያውያኖች ናቸው፡፡ ምክንያቱን አላውቅም፡፡ በፖሊስ ሁሌም አፈሳ አለ፣ የሚታፈሱት ኢትዮጵውያን ናቸው፡፡ ሌሎች ዜጎች ላይ እንደዛ ሲደረግ አይታይም፡፡ ከዚህ በፊትም እንደዚሁ ሰዎችን የመያዝ፣ የማሰር፣ ገንዘብ ተቀብሎ የመልቀቅ ሁኔታዎች ነበሩ፡፡

አንዳንዴ ግጭት በሚፈጠርበት ጊዜ (ኢትዮጵያዊው እርስ በርሱ ይጋጫል አንዳንዴ)፣ ወንጀል በሚፈፀምበት ጊዜ እንደዚህ ውጡ ምናምን ስለሚባል፣ ሰው ትኩረት አልሰጠውም ነበር፡፡ እንደዚህ በይፋ ለቃችሁ ውጡ ተብለን አናውቅም፡፡ በዚህ ምክንያት ችላ ብሎት ተዘናግቷል፡፡ የአሁኑ ለየት የሚያደርገው በመንግስት ደረጃ በይፋ መገለፁ ነው፡፡

ሰው በጣም ተደናግጧል፡፡ ቀነገደቡ ይራዘማል የሚል ተስፋ ነበረው፡፡ አሁን 3 ቀን ቀርቶታል፡፡ መፍትሔ ከመዘየድ ይልቅ ዝም ብሎ መጨነቅ ላይ ነው ያለው ስደተኛው፡፡ የንግድ ተቋማት ያሉዋቸው ሰዎች ብዙ ናቸው፡፡ በ5 ቀን ምን ማድረግ ይችላሉ ?__ __" ብለዋል።__

**__ንብረት ያፈሩ ሰዎች እንዴት ህጋዊ ሰነድ የላቸውም ?__**

አቶ ኑሩ ለዚህ ጥያቄ ምላሽ ሲሰጡ __" ሰው ጅቡቲ ሀገሬ ናት ብሎ ነው እስካሁን የሚያስበው፡፡ እንዲህ አይነት ነገር ይመጣል ብሎ አያስብም፡፡ ኢትዮጵያና ጅቡቲ እንደ አንድ ሀገር ነው የሚታሰቡት፡፡ 

ራሳቸው ጅቡቲዎችም እንደዛ ነው የሚሉት፣ አሁንም በመንግስታቸው ውሳኔ ደስተኞች አይደሉም፡፡ በዚህ ተዘናግተው ነው ለአመታት ያለ ህጋዊ ሰነድ የሚኖሩት፡፡ ጅቡቲንና ኢትዮጵያን ለያይቶ ማየት አይቻልም፡፡ " __ብለዋል

አክለውም " ለሚባረሩት ዜጎች መንግስት ሊደርስላቸው ይገባል " ሲሉ ተማጽነዋል።

__" እዚህ ያለው ህዝብ ንብረቱን ሸጦ፣ በራሱ ተመዝግቦ፣ ተረጋግቶ የሚወጣበት እድል ሊመቻችትለት ይገባል፡፡ በ3 ቀን ውስጥ ለቃችሁ ውጡ ማለት አግባብ አይደለም፡፡

በጅቡቲ የኢትዮጵያ ኤምባሲና የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር የዜጎችን ስቃይ የሚቀንስበትን መንገድ ማመቻቸት አለባቸው፡፡ ወደ ሀገራቸው ከተመለሱም በኋላ የሚቋቋሙበት ዕድል መመቻቸት አለበት፡፡ 

አፈሳ ከተጀመረ አደገኛ ነገር ነው፡፡ ተይዘህ ወደ ማቆያ ትገባለህ፣ ከዛም በግድ ተጭነህ ትባረራለህ፡፡ ንብረት አትይዝም፣ ገንዘብህን አትሰበስብም፣ ቤተሰቦችህን የመሰናበት ዕድል አይኖርህም፡፡ ካለህበት ሁሉ ተለቅመህ ነው የምትወሰደው፡፡ 

የቤት ሰራተኞች አሉ፣ ደመወዛቸውን እንኳን በወቅቱ አይሰጡዋቸውም፣ ደመወዝ ሳይዙ ሊባረሩ ነው ማለት ነው፡፡ መንግስት እንዲደርስላቸው ነው የምማፀነው፡፡ " ሲሉ ተናግረዋል።__

__ቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ጉዳዩን እየተከታተለ የሚያቀርብ ይሆናል።__

**__" There are many people who have lived for 30 and 40 years, built a house, and started a family. They cannot end their entire lives in 3 days__ " __- Ethiopian living in Djibouti__**

__It is worth noting that the Djibouti government has announced that undocumented Ethiopians living in the country must leave voluntarily, otherwise they will be forced to leave. 

Tikvah Ethiopia has not spoken to various Ethiopians about the decision to ask what Ethiopians in Djibouti are doing.

An Ethiopian resident of Djibouti, Ato Nuru Asfaw, who gave his opinion, said that the government should intervene through diplomatic channels to reduce the suffering of citizens.

The commenter, who mentioned that he is living in Djibouti legally, said that there are many Ethiopians without legal documents. Among them are Ethiopians who have lived for 30 and 40 years, opened large businesses, built wealth and property, married and had children, he said.

"The people are currently in a state of great confusion, there is nothing to grasp in three days," said Ato Nuru. 

He appealed to the Ethiopian government to urgently talk to the Djibouti government and save its citizens from anxiety. __

__**What did Mr. Nuru say in detail?**

__
__" There are those who have started registering according to the announcement, there are those who have started leaving by car, but most of them are not doing anything. Now there are only 3 days left. You cannot leave by plane or train, unless you have a valid travel document. I think the issue of leaving Djibouti is wrong.

There are a lot of Ethiopian refugees, next to Ethiopians are Yemenis. But it is always Ethiopians who are told to leave. I do not know the reason. There is always a police crackdown, Ethiopians are the ones who are being arrested. This is not seen with other citizens. There were situations like this before, where people were arrested, imprisoned, and released for money.

Sometimes when there is a conflict (Ethiopians sometimes clash with each other), when a crime is committed, people do not pay attention because they are told to leave. You left publicly like this We have never been told to leave. For this reason, he ignored it and was distracted. What makes it different now is that it has been officially announced by the government.

People are very shocked. He was hoping that the deadline would be extended. Now there are 3 days left. Instead of delaying a solution, the refugee said that he is just worrying. There are many people who have businesses. What can they do in 5 days?__ __" he said.

**__How do people who have built up property not have legal documents?__**

Ato Nuru responded to this question __" People still think that Djibouti is their country. They do not think that such a thing will happen. Ethiopia and Djibouti are considered one country. 

The Djiboutians themselves say that, and they are still not happy with their government's decision. They are distracted by this and have been living without legal documents for years. It is impossible to see Djibouti and Ethiopia separately. " __He said

He added, "The government should reach out to the deported citizens."

__"The people here should be given the opportunity to sell their property, register themselves, and leave safely. It is not appropriate to say, 'Leave within 3 days.'

The Ethiopian Embassy in Djibouti and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs should find a way to reduce the suffering of the citizens. They should also be given the opportunity to settle down after they return to their country. 

If the deportations start, it is dangerous. You will be arrested and put in detention, then you will be forcibly deported. You will not keep your property, you will not collect your money, you will not have the opportunity to say goodbye to your family. You will be taken away from everything you have. 

There are domestic workers, they are not even paid on time, they are about to be deported without receiving their salaries. I am pleading with the government to reach out to them. " He said. __

__Tikvah Ethiopia will be following up on the matter. __

Addis Ababa

ይህ ነገር ሲሆን አንድ ጉዳዩን በአይነ ቁራኛ ሲከታተል የነበር እግረኛ የመኪናውን ሰሌዳ በስልኩ ፎቶግራፍ አንስቶ ለኢትዮጵያ ፌደራል ፖሊስ ትራፊክ ቁጥጥርና አደጋ ምርመራ አመራርና አባላት ፖሊስ ይሰጣል።

የትራፊክ ፖሊሶች የደረሳቸውን መረጃ መሠረት በማድረግ ተጠርጣሪዎቹን በጂፒኤስ በመከታተል አራቱንም ተጠርጣሪዎች ልደታ አካበቢ በቁጥጥር ሥር አውለዋቸዋል።

በተጨማሪም ተጠርጣሪዎቹና በተሽከርካሪ ላይ ፈታሻ ተደርጓል። በዚህም ከተለያዩ ግለሰቦች የሰረቋቸው፦
- ሰባት ተች እስክሪን የሞባይል ስልኮችን፣ 
- ሁለት በተን ስልክ 
- ከተለያዩ ግለሰቦች የተሰረቀ  84,485 ብር፣
- አምስት ባለ አምስት መቶ ሪያል  ፣ አንድ የባለ ሁለት መቶ ሪያል፣ ሦስት ባለ አስር ሪያል ፣ ሁለት ባለ አምስት ሪያል ኖት መያዙን ኢትዮጵያ ፌደራል ፖሊስ አስታውቋል።

የግል ተበዳይ ወ/ሪት በላይነሽ ንብረታቸውን ተረክበው በሰላም ወደ ቤተሰቦቿ እንዲሄዱም አድርጓል ፖሊስ።

የኢትዮጵያ ፌደራል ፖሊስ ትራፊክ ፖሊሶችም  በኤግዚብትነት የተያዙ ንብረቶችና ተጠርጣሪዎችን ለቦሌ ክፍለ ከተማ ፖሊስ መምሪያ ለሀርቡ ፖሊስ ጣቢያ አስረክበዋል።

Ms. Belenesh Bedore is returning to her country after working in Beirut.

When she arrived at Bole International Airport, 4 suspects pretended to be metered taxi drivers and drove her away in a Corolla car with license plate number B 96905 and code 2-AA.

After a short while, they said, "Get off here so we don't get caught in traffic, cross over to the other side and we will wait for you."

When she heard the woman get off, she loaded her bags and "sheeshee" committed a robbery and escaped.

While this was happening, a pedestrian who was following the case with a camera took a photo of the car's license plate with his phone and gave it to the Ethiopian Federal Police Traffic Control and Accident Investigation Department and members.

Based on the information received, the traffic police tracked the suspects with GPS and arrested all four suspects.

In addition, the suspects and their vehicle were searched. As a result, they stole from various individuals:
- Seven touchscreen mobile phones,
- Two cell phones,
- 84,485 birr stolen from various individuals,
- Five five-hundred riyals, one two-hundred riyals, three ten riyals, and two five riyals notes, the Ethiopian Federal Police announced.

The police also helped the private victim, Ms. Belaynesh, to return safely to her family.

The Ethiopian Federal Police traffic police also handed over the seized properties and the suspects to the Bole Sub-City Police Department and Harbu Police Station.

#ትሊዴፓ**

" ከብልጽግና ጋር ልክ እንደሌሎቹ በአገር ውስጥ እንደሚንቀሳቀሱ ፓርቲዎች ተባብሮ ለመሥራት ይችላል እንጂ የሚያገናኘው ነገር የለም፤ ገለልተኛ እና ነጻ ፓርቲ ነው " - የቀድሞ የህወሓት አመራር** 

በጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ የምስራቅ አፍሪካ ጉዳዮች ሚኒስትር አቶ ጌታቸው ረዳ የሚመራው ከህወሓት የተከፈለው ቡድን አዲስ የፖለቲካ ፓርቲ ለማቋቋም በሂደት ላይ መሆኑን ከአመራሮቹ መካከል አንዱ ለቢቢሲ አማርኛ አገልግሎት ገልጸዋል።

የፖለቲካ ፓርቲው በሊብራል ዴሞክራሲ ጽንሰ ሃሳብ የሚመራ ሲሆን " ትግራይ ሊብራል ዴሞክራሲያዊ ፓርቲ " በማለት ለመጠራት ውስኗል።

" **ስሜ አይጠቀስ " ያሉ አንድ የቀድሞ የህወሓት አመራር ስለ ፓርቲው ምስረታ ምን አሉ ?**

__- " የፓርቲው ስያሜ የፖለቲካ ፓርቲውን ለመመሥረት በእንቅስቃሴ ላይ ባሉ ሰዎች የተመረጠ እንጂ ከምርጫ ቦርድ እውቅና ስላላገኘ ጉባዔ ሲካሄድ ሊቀየር ወይንም ሊሻሻል ይችላል። "

- " የህወሓት ሕጋዊነት ስለሚያበቃ የህወሓት የፖለቲካ ዓላማዎችን ለማሳካት የሚያስችለን አዲስ የፖለቲካ ፓርቲ ለመመሥረት ተገድደናል። "

-  " የፓርቲው ሕገ ደንብ እና ፕሮግራሞቻችን አርቅቀን ጨርሰናል። "

- " አሁን ላይ የደጋፊዎችን ፊርማ በማሰባሰብ ላይ እንገኛለን። "

- " የኢትዮጵያ ምርጫ ቦርድ ያስቀመጣቸውን መስፈርቶች ገና ስላልተሟሉ እስካሁን ድረስ ለቦርዱ በይፋ የቀረበ ጥያቄ የለም። "

- " የኢትዮጵያ ምርጫ ቦርድ ቡድኑ ለምዝገባ እየሄደበት ያለውን ሂደት ያውቃል። "

- " ፓርቲው ክልላዊ ፓርቲ ነው። ከኢትዮጵያ ምርጫ ቦርድ በግንቦት የመጀመሪያ ወር ላይ ቅድመ እውቅና እናገኛለን ብለን እንጠብቃለን። "

- " የትግራይ ጊዜያዊ አስተዳደር የአንድ ዓመት ጊዜ ካበቃ በኋላ ክልላዊ መንግሥትን ለመመሥረት በሚደረገው ምርጫ እንሳተፋለን። "

- " ከኢትዮጵያ ምርጫ ቦርድ እውቅና ካገኘን በኋላ ከባለሀብቶች እስከ የቀን ሠራተኞች ድረስ በአባልነት እና በአመራርነት ተቀላቅለው ሊሳተፉበት ይችላሉ። "

- " ትግራይ ሊብራል ዴሞክራቲክ ፓርቲ ከብልጽግና ጋር ልክ እንደሌሎቹ በአገር ውስጥ እንደሚንቀሳቀሱ ፓርቲዎች ተባብሮ ለመሥራት ይችላል እንጂ የሚያገናኘው ነገር የለም፤ ገለልተኛ እና ነጻ ፓርቲ ነው።__ "

የትግራይ ሊብራል ዴሞክራቲክ ፓርቲ እየመሠረቱ ካሉተ አንጋፋ ሰዎች መካከል ፦

በሁለት ተከፍሎ እርስ በእርሱ ሲካሰስ የቆየው ህወሓት የኢትዮጵያ የምርጫ ቦርድ ባስቀመጠው ቀነ ገደብ ጉባዔ ማካሄድ ባለመቻሉ ከፓርቲነት ሊሰረዝ እንደሚችል ቦርዱ ማስታወቁ ይታወሳል።

" It has nothing to do with prosperity, just like other parties operating in the country; it is an independent and independent party" - Former TPLF leadership** 

A group that split from the TPLF, led by the Prime Minister's Minister of East African Affairs, Ato Getachew Reda, is in the process of establishing a new political party, one of its leaders told BBC Amharic.

The political party is guided by the concept of liberal democracy and has decided to call itself the "Tigray Liberal Democratic Party".

" **My name will not be mentioned " What did a former TPLF leader say about the formation of the party?**

__- " The name of the party was chosen by the people who are active in establishing the political party, but it has not been recognized by the Election Board, so it can be changed or improved during the conference. "

- " Since the legitimacy of the TPLF is ending, we are forced to establish a new political party that will enable us to achieve the political goals of the TPLF. "

- " We have completed the party's constitution and programs. "

- " We are currently collecting signatures from supporters. "

- " Since the requirements set by the Ethiopian Election Board have not yet been met, no official request has been submitted to the board. "

- " The Ethiopian Election Board is aware of the process the group is going through for registration. "

- " The party is a regional party. We expect to receive preliminary recognition from the Ethiopian Election Board in the first month of May. "

- " Tigray Interim After the one-year term of the administration, we will participate in the elections to establish a regional government. "

- " After we receive recognition from the Ethiopian Election Board, everyone from investors to daily wage earners can join and participate in the elections as members and leaders. "

- " The Tigray Liberal Democratic Party can work together with prosperity like other parties operating in the country, but it has nothing to do with it; it is an independent and independent party. __ "

Among the senior figures forming the Tigray Liberal Democratic Party are:
• Former Tigray Regional State Interim Administration President Ato Getachew Reda, 
• Former TPLF Politburo member and Tema Chief Executive Officer Ato Beyene Mekru 
• Professor Kindeya Gebrehiwot. (Professor Kinda was recently appointed as the Minister of Education Advisor to Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed) 

It is worth noting that the TPLF, which has been divided into two and has been blaming each other, may be deregistered from the party after failing to hold a convention by the deadline set by the Ethiopian Electoral Board.

The TPLF led by Dr. Debretsion, which is facing the threat of deregistration, has been stating that it is inappropriate to register with the board as an organization that negotiated with the Ethiopian government and signed the Pretoria Agreement.

The members of the TPLF Central Committee led by Ato Getachew, who are concerned about the deregistration of the TPLF, stated in a statement issued weeks ago that they had called on the group led by Dr. Debretsion to hold a joint convention, but they did not receive a positive response.

Therefore, "we are forced to form a new political party that will enable us to achieve the TPLF's political objectives as the legitimacy of the TPLF is ending," he said.

**" Workers are unable to meet their basic needs due to low wages and high income tax deductions " - ESMACO**

The Ethiopian Trade Union Confederation (ETUC) has said that the living conditions of millions of Ethiopian workers continue to be precarious.

The confederation made this statement in a press release on the occasion of the 136th International Workers' Day, which will be celebrated globally and for the 50th time in Ethiopia next Thursday.

ESMACO said that "inflation has severely weakened the purchasing power of wage earners."

The confederation, which noted that the minimum wage floor has not yet been determined, said that workers are unable to meet their basic needs due to low wages and high income tax deductions.

"Some employers and union leaders are fired, harassed or transferred to distant places just for standing up for their members or advocating for their rights," said Ato Kassahun Folo, president of the Ethiopian Trade Union Confederation. 

"During the discussion held regarding the questions sent to the Prime Minister regarding the difficult situation of the employees, our questions were accepted and forwarded to the relevant ministers; however, although some questions were answered, basic and key questions of the workers were not answered," he said.

" __**Technical and Vocational Education Alone, 13.5 Million Birr in Grade Advancement Not Paid" - Southern Ethiopian Teachers Association
**
The Southern Ethiopian Teachers Association told Tikvah Ethiopia that there is a huge arrears of salaries, grade advancement and other benefits that have not been paid to teachers on time.

They said that although the complaints were resolved better this year compared to last year, the arrears of benefits have not been paid, and that they have not been paid grade advancement and education improvements since 2015, and that the regional government's Technical and Vocational Education Bureau and the association have requested it.

"We need half of it, 14 million. 'We will pay half in two or three months; we will pay the rest in the next fiscal year,'" they said.

"The region has a very high budget deficit, a cash problem. Compared to last year, this year is very good. They were paying salaries at 30%, 50%. The education system was not being implemented. This year, salaries were sent directly from the region and salaries were sent to problem areas," he said.

When asked how much arrears there are for teachers in the region at the time, the association's president, Ato Amanuel Paulos, said that about 13.5 million birr had not been paid for technical and vocational training alone.

However, he pointed out that the amount of unpaid salaries in the region, including others, is still being collected and is high.

**What did Ato Amanuel add?

**
"We have not collected the detailed information from each woreda yet. There are about 93 woredas in the region. There is a problem in urban areas. Cities like Sodo, Arbaminch, Dilla, Areka collect their own revenue well and have paid. The problem is in rural woredas. If we put it in monetary terms, it is a lot of birr. 

And the technical and vocational colleges alone have not paid the promotion fee of about 13.5 million.

However, in the general education sector, there are those in each woreda who have not been paid for five, six months, one or two years. How much will that be? There are those who have paid what we collected in the past. But we have not collected information as of yet," he said.

He urged teachers to focus on learning and teaching and to be effective, their salaries and benefits should be paid on time.

Tikvah Ethiopia

**" The cow gave birth to a hippopotamus-like calf without a tail. The calf died immediately and the cow died the next day " - Residents

🔴 " I was shocked by what I saw when I arrived! " - Local veterinarian**

In Geze Gofa Zone, Geze Kencho Kebele, Geze Gofa Woreda, South Ethiopia Region, a cow gave birth to a hippopotamus-like calf after hours of labor with the help of people, but the calf died immediately and the cow died the next day, the cow's owner and local residents told Tikvah Ethiopia.

The cow's owner, Ato Isaias Alfate, explained to Tikvah Ethiopia about the case, saying, "The cow had given birth three times before. This time, her belly was unusually high; when it was time to give birth, her movements were slow."

"We expected her to give birth peacefully as usual, but we were worried that she would continue to labor for more than 5 hours, so we called the local veterinarian and explained the situation, but the specialist was not nearby and did not reach us quickly. Later, the cow became weak and the local people said, 'Let's tie the leg that came out and pull it out,' and the calf died immediately after being pulled out," they said.

Local residents told us that the calf, which looked like a hippopotamus, weighed approximately 50 kilograms. The next day, the cow also died.

"When I arrived, I was shocked by what I saw," said local veterinarian Hezekiah Habtamu. "It was born without a tail and looked more like a hippopotamus than a calf."

Two people died of cholera in a cholera outbreak in a village called "Bure Babuna" in the Amhara Region a week ago, the regional Public Health Institute said.

The people died between 5/ and 12/2017, one in the village and the other after going to the Sekela district where he lives, Sister Derb said.

Since March 19, 2017, the disease has been spreading in three areas of the region, namely:

- "Bermen Giorgis" in Qara Woreda, West Gondar Zone;

- "Andasa" Tsebel in Bahir Dar Woreda, North Gojjam Zone; and

- "National" Tsebel in Jawi Woreda, Awi Ethnic Administration Zone.

Two weeks ago, a new outbreak occurred in a Tsebel area called "Bure Babuna" in Bure Woreda, West Gojjam Zone, said Sister Sifa Derb.

Since the cholera outbreak in Qara Woreda, Bermel Giorgis on December 24, 2017, 15 people have died in the epidemic.

Sister Sabiha added that more than 2,118 people have been infected with the virus.

Sister Sabiha, who said that no deaths were recorded last week, urged the community to protect themselves from the disease by knowing the routes of transmission as the disease is still spreading rapidly.

የኢትዮጵያውያን ስደተኞች አቤቱታ ከጅቡቲ !

(ቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ)

“ ንብረታችሁን በአማና/በአደራ ሰጥታችሁ ውጡ እያሉን ነው፡፡ ንብረታችንን ጥለን መውጣት አንችልም፣ ከፍተኛ ስጋትና ጭንቀት ውስጥ ወድቀናል፡፡ መውጣት ለሚፈልጉትም፣ የተዘጋጀ የትራንስፖርት አገልግሎት የለም፡፡  መምጫ የሌለው ህዝብ ብዙ ነው፡፡ የኢትዮጵያ መንግስት፣ ጊዜ እንዲሰጠን ጥረት ያድርግ ” -  አቶ መሐመድ አሚን፣ የጅቡቲ ነዋሪ

የጅቡቲ መንግስት በሀገሩ የሚኖሩ ሰነድ አልባ የሌሎች ሀገራት ዜጎች በፈቃዳቸው ሀገሪቱን ለቀው እንዲወጡ፣ እንደዛ ካልሆነ ግን የግዳጅ አፈሳ እንደሚጀመር አስታውቋል፡፡ 

የጅቡቲ መንግስት የሰጠው የአንድ ወር ቀነገደብም ከነገ ወዲያ ማለትም ሐሙስ ዕለት ያበቃል፡፡ 

በጅቡቲ የሚገኘው የኢትዮጵያ ኤምባሲም፣ ዜጎች ወደ ሀገራቸው የሚመለሱበትን ሰነድ ለመስጠት ካለፈው እሁድ እስከ ነገ ዕሮብ ድረስ ምዝገባ እንደሚያካሒድ ገልፆዋል።

በዚህ መሀል ግን፣ ሀገር ልቀቁ የተባሉት ኢትዮጵያውያን ከፍተኛ ጭንቀትና ድንጋጤ ላይ መውደቃቸውን ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ገልፀዋል፡፡

ዛሬ ጠዋት ከጅቡቲ በስልክ አስተያየታቸውን የሰጡን አቶ መሐመድ አሚን፣ በዚያች ሀገር ንብረት ማፍራታቸውን፣ እንደዚሁም ቤተሰብም መመስረታቸውን ተናግረው፣ " የአሁኑ የጅቡቲ መንግስት ውሳኔ አስደንግጦናል፣ ምን ማድረግ እንዳለብንም ጨንቆናል " ብለዋል፡፡ 

ሀብትና ንብረት ያፈሩ፣ ትላልቅ የንግድ ተቋማት የከፈቱ ኢትዮጵያውያን ብዙ ናቸው የሚሉት አቶ መሐመድ፣ ንብረታችንን ምን እናድርገው ? ብለን ስንጠይቅ፣ " ለአማና/በአደራ ሰጥታችሁ ውጡ ተብለናል " በማለት ገልፀዋል፡፡ 

የኢትዮጵያ መንግስት ጊዜ እንዲሰጠን ዲፕሎማሲያ ጥረት ያድርግ ሲሉም ጠይቀዋል፡፡

**አቶ መሐመድ አሚን በዝርዝር ምን አሉ ?**

" ሰነድ አልባ ከሆኑት ኢትዮጵያውያን አንዱ ነኝ፡፡ ሀብት ንብረት አፍርቻለሁ፡፡ ሀገሪቱን ለቃችሁ ውጡ የሚለው መግለጫ የወጣው ህጋዊ የመኖሪያ ሰነድ ለሌላቸው ለሁሉም የውጭ ሀገራት ዜጎች ነው፡፡ ነገር ግን በሰላሙም ጉዜ ትኩረት የሚደረግበት የኢትዮጵያ ዜጋ ነው፣ ብዛትም ስላለን ይመስለኛል፡፡ 

እኛ በተለያዩ ስራዎች ላይ በስፋት እንሳተፋለን፣ በዛው ልክ ትኩረትና ክትትል ይደረግብናል፡፡ አሁን ከተሰጠው የአንድ ወር ጊዜ ውስጥ፣ ሶስት ቀናት ብቻ ነው የቀረን፡፡ የኢትዮጵያ ኤምባሲ ጊዜው እንዲራዘም ጥያቄ አቅርቦ ስለነበረ፣ ጥሩ ምላሽ ይኖራል በሚል ተዘናግተናል፡፡ ከኤምባሲያችን ምላሽ እየጠበቅን ነበር፡፡ ኤምባሲው የመውጫ ጊዜው በሶስት ወራት እንዲራዘም ጠይቆ ነበር፡፡ የጅቡቲ መንግስት ግን ለየትኛውም ሀገር በተለየ መንገድ የምናደርገው ለውጥ የለም ብሏል፡፡ ኤምባሲውም፣ 10 ቀን ሲቀረው ነው የመጨረሻውን ማስታወቂያ የነገረን፡፡ 

የተሰጠው ጊዜ በጣም አጭር ከመሆኑ የተነሳ ሰው ሰግቷል፣ በጣም ተደናግጧል፡፡ እስከ ሐሙስ ድረስ ነው ያለን ጊዜ፡፡ በዚህ ጊዜ ውስጥ ምን እንደምናደርግ ግራ ገብቶናል፡፡

ገንዘብ አለ፣ ንብረት አለ፣ ምግብ ቤት ያለው አለ፣ ሱቆች አሉን፡፡ እኔ ንብረት አለኝ፣ ቤተሰብ አለኝ፡፡ የጅቡቲ መንግስት እያለን ያለው ንብረታችሁን ለጅቡቲ ሰዎች በአማና/በአደራ ሰጥታችሁ ውጡ ነው፡፡ ንብረታችንን እንዴት ነው ጥለን የምንሔደው፣ ማንን አምነን ነው እንደዛ የምናደርገው፡፡ ዘግተን መውጣት ብቻ ነው ያለን እድል፣ እኛ ምንም ነገር ሳንዘጋጅ ቀኑ ደረሰብን፣ ሁሉም ነገር በጥድፊያ ነው እየሆነ ያለው፡፡ የሚሆነው ነገር እንግዲህ ፈጣሪ ብቻ ነው የሚያውቀው፡፡ 

በዚህ ሰዓት ማለት የምፈልገው፣ አሁንም ጊዜው ተራዝሞ ህዝቡ ንብረቱን ሸጦና ይዞ ተረጋግቶ የሚወጣበት ሁኔታ እንዲመቻች ነው፡፡ አቅም ለሌላቸው ዜጎችም፣ ብዙም የማይሰሩና ሰርተውም ደመወዛቸውን ያላገኙ ዜጎች ስላሉ፣ በባቡርም፣ በአየርም፣ በመኪናም ነፃ የትራንስፖርት አገልግሎት እንዲመቻችላቸው ነው የምማፀነው፡፡

ሚዲያዎችም ድምፅ ሊሆኑን ይገባል " ብለዋል።   

ሌላኛው አስተያየት ሰጪ አሕመድ ያሲን በህጋዊ መንገድ እየኖሩ እንደሆኑ ገልፀው፣ ነገር ግን " እየሆነ ያለው ያሳዝናል " ብለዋል፡፡ 

ሀብትና ንብረት አፍርተው ለበርካታ አመታት የኖሩ ኢትዮጵያውያን ብዙ ናቸው ብለዋል፡፡ 

እነዚህ ዜጎች ንብረታቸውን ሸጠው በአንድ ወር ጊዜ ውስጥ ለመውጣት አዳጋች እንደሚሆንባቸውም ተናግረዋል፡፡ 

**አቶ አሕመድ ያሲን ምን አሉ ?**

" በጅቡቲ እስከ 200 ሺህ የሚገመት ኢትዮጵያዊ እንደሚኖር ይገመታል፡፡ ከዚህ ውስጥ ህጋዊ ሰነድ ያለው በጣም ጥቂቱ ነው፡፡ ምክንያቱም፣ ህጋዊ የመኖሪያና የመስሪያ ሰነድ ለማግኘት ሒደቱ ቀላል አይደለም፡፡

አብዛኞቹ የኢትዮጵያ ዜጎች የመኖሪያ ፈቃዱን እያኙ አይደሉም፡፡ የኢትዮጵያ ኤምባሲም በቀላሉ ፓስፖርት አይሰጠንም፣ ያለ ፓስፖርት ደግሞ ህጋዊ ሰነድ አትጠይቅም፡፡ 

እዚህ ያሉት ኢትዮጵያውያን ብዙ ችግር አይተው የኖሩ ናቸው፡፡ ዜጎቻችን ንብረታቸውን ሸጠው ለመውጣት ጊዜ የላቸውም፣ እንሽጥ በብንልም ገዢ አናገኝም፤ ንብረት ይዘን መውጣት አንችልም፡፡ አሁን ኤምባሲው የይለፍ ወረቀት እየሰጠ ነው፣ ግን ደግሞ የተዘጋጀ ትራንስፖርት የለም፡፡ ሰራተኞች ደመወዛቸውን አልወሰዱም፡፡ 

በኢትዮጵያ መንግስት በኩል ነፃ ትራንስፖርት ማዘጋጀት ነበረባቸው፣ አቅም የሌላቸው ስራ ያቆሙ ዜጎች አሉ፡፡ ስለዚህ ለነዚህ ሁሉ መታሰብ አለበት፡፡ ኢትዮጵያ ውስጥ ሲደርሱም መንግስት በክብር ቢቀበላቸው እላለሁ፡፡ መልሰው እንዲቋቋሙም መንግስት ድጋፍ እንዲያደርግልቻው ጥሪ አቀርባለሁ "  ብለዋል።

በጉዳዩ ዙርያ፣ በጅቡቲ ከሚገኘው የኢትዮጵያ ኤምባሲ ስልክ ደውለን አስተያየት ለመጠየቅ ብንሞክርም ምላሽ አላገኘንም፡፡

Ethiopian Refugees Appeal from Djibouti!

(Tikvah Ethiopia)

“We are telling you to leave your belongings in trust. We cannot leave our belongings, we are in great fear and anxiety. There is no transportation service for those who want to leave. There are many people who have no place to go. The Ethiopian government should try to give us time.” - Ato Mohamed Amin, resident of Djibouti

The Djibouti government has announced that undocumented citizens of other countries living in the country must leave the country voluntarily, otherwise they will be forced to leave. 

The one-month curfew given by the Djibouti government will end tomorrow, Thursday. 

The Ethiopian Embassy in Djibouti has announced that it will hold registration from last Sunday to tomorrow, Wednesday, to issue documents for citizens to return to their country.

Meanwhile, Ethiopians who have left the country have expressed great anxiety and panic, Tikvah Ethiopia reported.

Ato Mohammed Amin, who spoke to us by phone from Djibouti this morning, said that they have built up property and started a family in that country, adding, "The current decision of the Djibouti government has shocked us, and we are worried about what to do." 

Ato Mohammed, who says that there are many Ethiopians who have built up wealth and property and opened large businesses, said, "What should we do with our property?" When asked, "We were told to leave it in trust." 

He also asked the Ethiopian government to make diplomatic efforts to give us time.

**What did Mr. Mohamed Amin say in detail?**

"I am one of the undocumented Ethiopians. I have accumulated wealth. The statement that you should leave the country is for all foreign citizens who do not have legal residence documents. But I think it is Ethiopian citizens who are being paid attention to in peace, because we are in large numbers. 

We are widely involved in various activities, and we are being paid the same amount of attention and monitoring. Now, out of the one-month period given, there are only three days left. Since the Ethiopian Embassy had requested an extension, we were worried that there would be a good response. We were waiting for a response from our Embassy. The Embassy had requested an extension of the departure period by three months. However, the Djibouti government said that we would not make any changes to any country. The Embassy made the final announcement with 10 days left. 

The period given was so short that people were afraid, very He is shocked. We have until Thursday. We are confused about what to do in this time.

There is money, there is property, there is a restaurant, there are shops. I have property, I have a family. The Djibouti government is telling us to leave your property in trust with the people of Djibouti. How can we leave our property, who do we trust? The only option we have is to leave, the day has come without us preparing anything, everything is happening in a hurry. Only God knows what will happen. 

What I want to say at this time is that the time is still extended so that the people can sell their property and leave peacefully. Since there are citizens who cannot afford it, who do not work much and who have not received their salaries, I am pleading for free transportation services by train, air, and car.

The media should also be our voice," he said. 

Another commentator, Ahmed Yasin, said they are living legally, but "what is happening is sad." 

He said there are many Ethiopians who have built up wealth and property and have lived there for many years. 

He said it would be difficult for these citizens to sell their property and leave within a month. 

**What did Mr. Ahmed Yasin say?**

"It is estimated that there are up to 200,000 Ethiopians in Djibouti. Very few of them have legal documents. Because, the process of obtaining legal residence and work documents is not easy. 

Most Ethiopian citizens do not have residence permits. The Ethiopian embassy does not easily give us passports, and without a passport, it does not ask for legal documents. 

The Ethiopians here have experienced many problems. Our citizens do not have time to sell their property and leave, even if we sell it, we will not find a buyer; we cannot leave with our property. Now the embassy is issuing passports, but there is no transportation available. Employees have not received their salaries. 

The Ethiopian government should have arranged free transportation, there are citizens who have stopped working because they cannot afford it. Therefore, all of these should be considered. I would like the government to welcome them with honor when they arrive in Ethiopia. "I call on the government to support them in their reintegration," he said.

We tried to reach the Ethiopian Embassy in Djibouti for comment on the matter, but we did not receive a response. 

However, a staff member of the embassy sent us a short text message stating that the registration process for the return of citizens is going well. 

If you need further clarification, please contact the Ministry of Foreign Affairs Spokesperson's Office. If we receive further clarification from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, we will provide it. 

Tikvah Ethiopia
Addis Ababa

ለዲቪ (Diversity Visa) 2026 ማመልከቻ የሞሉ በ dvprogram.state.gov ብቻ የማረጋገጫ ቁጥራቸውን በማስገባት ውጤቱን ወይም ማሸነፍ አለማሸነፋቸውን መመልከት ይችላሉ።

NB. የማረጋገጫ ቁጥር ማመልከቻው ሲሞላ የተሰጠ ነው። ይህ ቁጥር የጠፋበት Forgot Confirmation Number በማለት አስፈለጊ መረጃ በመሙላት በኢሜል አዲስ ቁጥር ማግኘት ይቻላል።

ለ2026 የፊስካል ዓመት እስከ 55,000 የሚደርስ የዳይቨርሲቲ ቪዛ (DV) ተዘጋጅቷል። ይህ ቁጥር ብቁ የሆኑ ሀገራትን ሁሉ የሚጠቃልል ሲሆን #ኢትዮጵያም አንዷ ናት።

የዲቪ ሎተሪ መውጫ መድረሱን ተከትሎ " የዲቪ (DV) ሎተሪ አሸንፋችኋል ፣ ከአሜሪካ ኤምባሲ ነው ምንደውለው / ይህን ኢሜል / ቴክስት የምንልከው " በማለት የሚያጭበረብሩ አካላት ስለሚኖሩ አመልካቾች ሊጠነቀቁ ይገባል።

The winners of the US Diversity Visa (DV) Lottery 2026 will be announced on Saturday, April 25, 2017.

Applicants for the DV (Diversity Visa) 2026 can check their results or win or not by entering their confirmation number at dvprogram.state.gov.

NB. The confirmation number was issued when the application was submitted. If you have lost this number, you can get a new number by email by filling in the Forgot Confirmation Number field.

Up to 55,000 Diversity Visa (DV) applications have been made available for the 2026 fiscal year. This number includes all eligible countries, and #Ethiopia is one of them.

Following the release of the DV lottery, applicants should be wary of scammers claiming to have won the DV lottery, saying "You have won the DV lottery, we are calling you from the US Embassy / sending you this email / text."

The only way to know whether an applicant has received a DV 2026 is through the website mentioned above.

The United States admits 55,000 people from Africa (including Ethiopia), Asia, Europe, North America, South America, and Australia through the DV lottery each year.

የቅድስት መንበር ባወጣው መግለጫ " በክርስቶስ አንድ አካል የሆኑ ምዕመናን ሁሉ ለብፁዓን ካርዲናሎች በህብረት እንዲፀልዪ " ሲል ጥሪ አቅርቧል።

በቫቲካን የካርዲናሎች ጉባኤ እየተካሄደ የሚገኝ ሲሆን 7ኛ ቀኑን ይዟል።

የእግዚአብሔርን ፈቃድ ለመስማት ምዕመናን ይህን ልዩ ወቅት የጸጋና የመንፈሳዊ ማስተንተኛ ወቅት አድርገው እንዲወስዱ መላው የእግዚአብሔር ሕዝብን ለጸሎት ጋብዘዋል።

ከቅድስት መንበር የወጣው መግለጫ " ከፊት ከሚመጣው ትልቅ ውሳኔ እና አጣዳፊነት አንፃር እግዚአብሔር በመንፈስ ቅዱስ መሪነት ከማያልቅ ጥበብ ያድል ዘንድ ራሳችንን ትሁት የእርሱ መሳሪያ አድርጎ መስጠት ይገባል " በማለት ገልጿል።

ለቅዱስነታቸው ስርዓተ ቀብር እና ለካርዲኖሎች ጉባኤ ወደሮም ያቀኑት ብፁዕ ካርዲናል አቡነ ብርሃነኢየሱስ ሊቀጳጳሳት ዘካቶሊካውያን ምዕመናን አዲስ ርዕሰ ሊቃነ ጳጳሳት እስከሚገኝ ድረስ በፀሎት እንዲበረቱ አደራ ብለዋል።

የአዲሱ ርዕሠ ሊቃነ ጳጳሳት ምርጫ በመጭው ሚያዝያ 29 የሚጀምር ሲሆን 133 ካርዲናሎች እንደሚሳተፉበት ተገልጿል።

The statement from the Holy See states, "In view of the great and urgent decisions that lie ahead, we must humbly offer ourselves as instruments of God, so that, guided by the Holy Spirit, God may choose from his infinite wisdom."

Cardinal Abune Berhane Yesus, who is in Rome for the funeral of His Holiness and the Congregation of Cardinals, has urged Catholics to remain steadfast in prayer until a new pope is elected.

__ከትላንት በስቲያ የማዕከላዊ ኢትዮጵያ ክልል ገቢዎች ቢሮ ኃላፊ አቶ አሊ ከድር ስብሰባ ጨርሰዉ በመጓዝ ላይ እያሉ በመኪና አደጋ ሕይወታቸውን ማጣታቸው ይታወሳል።

**__" The head of the office did not have a personal escort from the beginning " - Central Ethiopia Police

🔴 " The driver is currently receiving treatment at Adama Referral Hospital! "__**

__It is worth noting that the head of the Central Ethiopia Regional Revenue Bureau, Ato Ali Keder, lost his life in a car accident while traveling after a meeting yesterday.

The information circulating on social media that Ato Ali was accompanied by two people, described as ' his escort and his driver ', is fundamentally false information, Inspector Tamrat Desalegn, the coordinator of the traffic sector of the Central Ethiopia Regional Police Commission, told Tikvah Ethiopia.

" The head of the office did not have a personal escort from the beginning ", Inspector Tamrat said, " The only person who was with him was his driver " 

"However, we have seen many social media outlets spreading and receiving false information, stating that Mr. Ali Kedir was accompanied by his personal escort and driver during the accident, saying that they were both seriously injured and admitted to the hospital and that they both passed away last night." The information is fake news fabricated to gain undue popularity and inappropriate publicity, he said.

The driver is currently receiving treatment at Adama Referral Hospital, he told Tikvah Ethiopia.

Tikvah Ethiopia

__**“ ‘እኛን በርሃ ሊያስቀሩን የሚችሉ ኃይሎች ሳይሆኑ ከወዲሁ በእንጪጩ መቀጨት አለባቸው፣ ባንዳዎች ናቸው’ የሚል ፕሮፓጋንዳ ከተሰራ በኋላ እርምጃ ተወስዷል ” - አቶ አበራ ንጉስ ስለ 63 ሰዎች ግድያ

“ ድርጊቱ ዝቅ ሲል የእድሜ ልክ እስራት ከፍ ሲል ደግሞ የሞት ፍርድ ቅጣት ያስቀጣል ! ” 
**
ቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ እነ ደብረጽዮን ገ/ሚካኤል (ዶ/ር)፣ አቶ ጌታቸው ረዳና ሌሎች 18 ግለሰቦችን ጨምሮ ላቀረባችሁት የግድያ ወንጀል ማስረጃ አለ ? ሲል ከዚህ ቀደም በጊዜያዊ አስተዳደሩ ፍትህ ቢሮ ኃላፊ ሆነው ለሰሩት፣ ጠበቃና የሕግ ባለሙያ አቶ አበራ ንጉስ ጥያቄ አቅርቧል።

**ጠበቃና የሕግ ባለሙያው ምን መለሱ ?
**
“ የቀረበው የወንጀል መደበኛ ክስ ሳይሆን የጥቆማ ክስ ነው። ጥቆማ ይዞ ለመነሳት ወንጀሎች ከተፈጸሙ መፈጸማቸው በቂ ነው።

ግድያና ሌሎች ከባባድ ወንጀሎች ከተፈጸሙ ጥቆማ ለመስጠት በቂ ነው። ጥቆማ ሰጪ እንዲያውም ማስረጃ ላይጠበቅበት ይችላል። ምክንያቱም በወንጀል ፍትህ አስተዳደር ትልቁ ሚና ወንጀለኞችን ለይቶ ለሕግ ማቅረብ የመንግስት ብቸኛ ሥራ ነው ” ብለዋል።

በርካታ አመራኖችና ሠራተኞች አስተዳደራዊ አገልግሎት እንዲሰጡበት በ2013 ዓ/ም በትግራይ ክልል ተቋቁሞ የነበረውን ጊዜያዊ አስተዳደሩንም ለክሱ መነሻ አድገዋል።

**አቶ አበራ ስለድርጊቱ አክለው ምን አሉ ?
**
“ ሕወሓት በወቅቱ ከፌደራሉ መንግስት ጋር ባደረገው ጦርነት በርሃ መውረድ ብቻ ሳይሆን የተመረጠ መንግስትን ለመመለስ የትጥቅ ትግል/የሽምቅ ውጊያን ምርጫው አድርጎ በትግራይ ይንቀሳቀስ እንደነበር፤ በኋላም ሰኔ 21 ወደ መቀሌ እንደተመለሰ የሚታወቅ ሀቅ ነው።

በዚህ መሀል ላይ እኔ የጊዜያዊ አስተዳደሩ የፍትህ ቢሮ ኃላፊ ሆኘ አገልግያለሁ። ሕወሓት ከበርሃ ገና ወደ መቐለ ሳይገባ ግድያዎች ይፈጸሙ እንደነበር የምናውቀው እውነታ ነው።

በክሱ ከቁጥር 1 እስከ 7 የተጠቀሱት በወቅቱ ለነበረው እንቅስቃሴ 'ሴንተራል ኮማንድ' ተብለው ወታዳራዊና ፓለቲካዊ ጉዳይ ሲመሩ የነበሩ ሰዎች ይህ ጊዜያዊ አስተዳደር የተመረጠ መንግስትን ተክቶ/ብልጽግናን ያደራጀው ኃይል የተገኙ ስለሆኑ፣ ብልጽግናም በወቅቱ ‘ጠላት’ ተብሎ ተፈርጆ ስለነበር ልክ በፍረጃው ደረጃ ‘ጠላት ናቸው’ ተብለው ተፈርጀዋል። 

ፍረጃውን ተከትሎ ሴንራል ኮማንድ ጥር 21/ 2013 ዓ/ም የጊዜያዊ አስተዳደር አመራሮችና ተግተው የሚሰሩ ከፓለቲካ ከሹመት ውጪ ያሉ የመንግስት ሠራተኞችን፥ ‘እኛን በርሃ ሊያስቀሩን የሚችሉ ኃይሎች ሳይሆኑ ከወዲሁ በእንጪጩ መቀጨት አለባቸው፣ ብሔራዊ ጥቅም አሳልፈው የሰጡ ባንዳዎች ናቸው’ የሚል ቅጥያ ስም ተሰጥቶ ፕሮፓጋንዳ ከተሰራ በኋላ እርምጃ ተወስዷል።

የወረዳና ዞን አስተዳዳሪዎች ሪፓርት ያደረጉልን ነበር። የ63 ሰዎች ግድያ፣ የአንድ ሰው የግድያ ሙከራ ድርጊት ዛሬ ቀረበ እንጂ ወደ 38ቱን ትግራይ እያለን የሰበሰብናቸው/ከየወረዳ የመጡልን ናቸው በወቅቱ። 

ስለዚህ ግድያ ተፈጽሟል ምንም ጥያቄ የለውም። አስተዳደራዊ ሥራ ሲሰሩ የነበሩ፣ የፓርቲ ፓለቲካ አጀንዳ ያነገቡ አይደሉም።

በወቅቱ ሲደረግ በነበረው ጦርነትም ከፌደራል መንግስቱ ጋር ወግነው ወታደራዊ ሥራ ያልሰሩ ናቸው። የተገደሉት፥ በረድኤት፣ በሕክምና፣ ወይ አስተዳደራዊ ሥራ ሲሰሩ የነበሩ ብቻ እንደሆነ የሚታወቅ ሀቅ ነው” ብለዋል።

በሕጉ መሠረት በእንዲህ አይነት ወንጀል የተጠረጠሩ ሰዎች ለፍርድ ሲቀርቡ የምን ቅጣት ይጠዝቃቸዋል? ለሚለው ጥያቄም፣ “ድርጊቱ ዝቅ ሲል የእድሜ ልክ እስራት ከፍ ሲል ደግሞ የሞት ፍርድ ቅጣት ያስቀጣል ” የሚል ምላሽ ሰጥተዋል።

ቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ 
አዲስ አበባ

__**“ Action was taken after the propaganda that ‘They are not the forces that can leave us in the desert, they should be punished with sticks, they are gangs’ was made” - Ato Abera Igbos about the murder of 63 people

“ If the act is low, life imprisonment is the punishment, and if it is high, the death penalty is the punishment! ” 
**
Tikvah Ethiopia, including Debretsion Geber Michael (Dr.), Ato Getachew Reda and 18 other individuals, is there any evidence for the murder charges you have filed? Ato Abera Igbos, a lawyer and legal expert who previously served as the head of the Justice Bureau of the interim administration, asked.

**What did the lawyer and legal expert answer?
**
“The case is not a formal criminal case, but a complaint. If crimes are committed, it is enough to start with a complaint.

If murder and other serious crimes are committed, it is enough to give a complaint. The complainant should not even be expected to provide evidence. Because the biggest role in criminal justice administration is to identify and bring criminals to justice, it is the sole job of the government,” he said.

Several leaders and workers have also used the temporary administration established in Tigray Region in 2013 to provide administrative services as a basis for the case.

**What did Mr. Abera say about the incident?

**
“It is a known fact that the TPLF not only fought against the federal government in Barha but also chose to engage in armed struggle/guerrilla warfare in Tigray to restore an elected government; and later returned to Mekelle on June 21.

In the meantime, I served as the head of the Justice Bureau of the interim administration. It is a known fact that the TPLF was committing murders before it entered Mekelle from Barha.

The persons mentioned in the indictment from numbers 1 to 7, who were leading the military and political affairs of the movement at that time, were the ‘Central Command’, since this interim administration was the force that replaced the elected government/organized the Prosperity Movement, and Prosperity was also classified as an ‘enemy’ at the time, so they were classified as ‘enemies’ at the same level. 

Following the verdict, the Central Command on January 21/ 2013 The leaders of the interim administration and government employees who are working hard and are not in politics, ‘They are not forces that can leave us in the desert, they should be killed immediately, they are gangs who have betrayed the national interest’ and action was taken after propaganda was made.

Woreda and zone administrators had reported to us. The killing of 63 people, the attempted killing of one person was reported today, but we collected 38 people while we were in Tigray/were brought to us from each woreda at the time.

So there is no question that killings took place. They were doing administrative work, they were not pursuing a party political agenda.

They did not do military work alongside the federal government during the war that was going on at the time. It is a known fact that those who were killed were only those who were doing aid, medical treatment, or administrative work,” he said.

According to the law, when people suspected of such crimes are brought to trial, what punishment is given? They responded, “If the crime is minor, life imprisonment is imposed, and if it is major, the death penalty is imposed.”

Tikvah Ethiopia 
Addis Ababa

__**“ 63 የሚሆኑ የጊዜያዊ አስተዳደር አመራሮችና ድጋፍ ሰጪ ሠራተኞች እንዲገደሉ በፈጸሙት ጀኖሳይድ ወንጀል ተጣርቶ ህጋዊ እልባት እንዲያገኝ አመለከታለሁ ” - የክስ ጥቆማ አቅራቢ
**
ደብረፅዮን ገ/ሚካኤል (ዶ/ር) ፣ አቶ ጌታቸው ረዳን ጨምሮ ሌሎች 18 ከፍተኛ የትግራይ የፓለቲካና የሠራዊት አመራሮች በ63 ሰዎች የግድያ ወንጀል የክስ ጥቆማ ቀረበባቸው።

የከስ ጥቆማ አቅራቢድ ፣ የፌደራል የመከላከያ ሰራዊት ከህዳር አስከ ሰኔ 16/2013 ዓ/ም የተለያዩ የትግራይ አከባቢዎች ተቆጣጥሮ ባስተዳደረበት ወቅት የጊዜያዊ አስተዳደር ፍትህ ቢሮ ኃላፊ ሆነው የሰሩት፣ ጠበቃና የሕግ ባለሙያ አቶ አበራ ንጉስ ናቸው።

“ ወደ 63 የሚሆኑ የጊዜያዊ አስተዳደር አመራሮችና ድጋፍ ሰጪ ሠራተኞች እንዲገደሉ በፈጸሙት ጀኖሳይድ ወንጀል ተጣርቶ ህጋዊ እልባት እንዲያገኝ አመለከታለሁ ” ሲሉም የክስ ጥቆማ አቅርበዋል።

የክስ ጥቆማ ከቀረበባቸው መካከል፦ 
- ደብረፅዮን ገ/ሚካኤል (ዶ/ር) 
- አቶ ጌታቸው አሰፋ 
- አቶ ጌታቸው ረዳ ካሕሳይ
- ወ/ሮ ፈትለወርቅ ገ/ሄር
- ሌተናል ጀነራል ታደሰ ወረደ
- ሌተናል ጀነራል ፃድቃን ገ/ትንሳኤ ይገኙበታል።

ትላንት ለኢፌደሪ ፌዴራል ፓሊስ ኮሚሽን፣ ለወንጀል ምርመራ የጠቅላይ መመሪያ የቀረበውና የተመለከትነው፣ የክስ ጥቆማ ፅሑፍ የተጠቀሱት የፓለቲካና የሰራዊት አመራርሮች የኢፌዴሪ የወንጀል ህግ አንቀፅ  269 (ሀ)፣  (ለ) በመተላለፍ በ63 ሰዎች ግድያና በአንድ ሰው የግድያ የሙከራ በማካሄድ የዘር ማጥፋት ወንጀል መፈጸማቸውን ያትታል።
