__**“ I will investigate and seek legal settlement for the genocide committed by the killing of 63 interim administration leaders and support staff ” - Indictment Submitter
**
Debretsion Gebre Michael (Dr.), Ato Getachew Reda and 18 other senior Tigray political and military leaders have been indicted for the murder of 63 people.

The indictment was filed by Ato Abera Igbo, a lawyer and legal expert who served as the head of the Interim Administration’s Justice Bureau when the Federal Defense Forces controlled and administered various areas of Tigray from November to June 16/2013.

“ I will investigate and seek legal settlement for the genocide committed by the killing of 63 interim administration leaders and support staff ” he said in the indictment.

Among those charged are: 
- Debretsion Gebre Michael (Dr.) 
- Ato Getachew Assefa 
- Ato Getachew Reda Kahsay
- Ms. Fetlework Gebre Her
- Lt. Gen. Tadesse Werede
- Lt. Gen. Tsadkan Gebre Tensae.

The indictment, which was submitted to the Federal Police Commission yesterday and reviewed by the Federal Police Commission, alleges that the political and military leaders mentioned in the indictment committed the crime of genocide by committing the murder of 63 people and the attempted murder of one person in violation of Article 269 (a), (b) of the Federal Criminal Code.

The individuals charged with the crime were charged with the crimes committed against the leaders of the interim administration established by the federal government to govern Tigray from October to June 2013 during the Tigray War. 

The indictment clearly lists the names of the 18 defendants, the 63 deceased, and the leaders and staff who were allegedly subjected to assassination attempts.

**ብፁዕ አቡነ ገብርኤል በመኖሪያ ቤታቸው ተአቅበው እንዲቆዩ ቋሚ ሲኖዶስ ወሳኔ አሳለፈ።**

የኢትዮጵያ ኦርቶዶክስ ተዋሕዶ ቤተክርስቲያን ቋሚ ሲኖዶስ ብፁዕ አቡነ ገብርኤል ከቤተክርስቲያኗ የነገረ ማርያም አስተምህሮ ውጪ በፍኖተ ጽድቅ ጠቅላላ ማኅበር አዳራሽ የሰጡትን ትምህርትና በማኅበሩ ሚዲያ የተላለፈበትን ሁኔታ በተመለከተ በዛሬ መደበኛ ጉባኤ ተወያይቶ ለመወሰን በያዘው ቀጠሮ መሰረት ውይይት ካደረገ በኋላ ውሳኔ አሳልፏል።

በዚህም ፦

1. ፍኖተ ጽድቅ ጠቅላላ ማህበር በተለያዩ ጊዜያት ከቅድስት ቤተ ክርስቲያኗ አስተምህሮ ውጪ በሚዲያው ያስተላለፈው የስሕተት ትምህርት የቤተክርስቲያኗን አባቶች፣ ሊቃውንቱንና መላው ሕዝበ ክርስቲያኑን ያሳዘነ በመሆኑ በማህበራት ምዝገባ ክትትልና ቁጥጥር መምሪያ በኩል ጊዜያዊ የእገዳ ደብዳቤ እንዲደርሰው እና በመምሪያው በኩል አስፈላጊው ጥብቅ ክትትል እንዲደረግ ሆኖ በጉዳዩ ላይ የመጨረሻ ውሳኔ መስጠት ይቻል ዘንድ 5 አባላት ያሉት ኮሚቴ እንዲቋቋም አድርጓል።

ቋሚ ሲኖዶስ ያቋቋማቸው አጣሪ ልዑካን አጠቃላይ የማህበሩን ሁለንተናዊ እንቅስቃሴ እና በሚዲያው ያስተላለፋቸውን የስህተት ትምህርቶች በተመለከተ ከጠቅላይ ቤተ ክህነት ጽ/ቤት እና ከማህበራት ምዝገባ፣ ቁጥጥርና ክትትል መምሪያ ጋር በመነጋገር በሚገባ መርምርውና አጣርተው በአጭር ጊዜ ውስጥ ከውሳኔ ሐሳብ ጋር ለቋሚ ሲኖዶስ እንዲያቀርቡ ወስኗል።

2. ብፁዕ አቡነ ገብርኤል “ ማርያም ቤዛዊተ ዓለም ” አትባልም በማለት ከቤተ ክርስቲያኗ የነገረ ማርያም አስተምህሮ ውጪ የሰጡት ሕጸጽ ያለበት ትምህርት በሊቃውንት ጉባኤ በኩል በሚገባ ተመርምሮና ተጣርቶ ከመፍትሔ ሐሳብ ጋር ለቋሚ ሲኖዶስ በአስቸኳይ እንዲቀርብ ብፁዕነታቸውም ጉዳዩ ተጣርቶ የመጨረሻ ውሳኔ እስኪያገኝ ድረስ በመንበረ ፓትርያርክ ጠቅላይ ቤተ ክህነት ጽ/ቤት ግቢ ውስጥ በሚገኘው መኖሪያ ቤታቸው በተአቅቦ እንዲቆዩ ወንሷል።

3. ብፁዕ አቡነ ፊልጶስ የደቡብ ኦሞና አሪ ዞኖች ሀ/ስብከት ሊቀ ጳጳስ የቅድስት ሥላሴ መንፈሳዊ ዩኒቨርሲቲ ፕሬዝደንት እና ብፁዕ አቡነ በርናባስ የደቡብ ካሊፎርኒያ ሀገረ ስብከት ሊቀ ጳጳስ ያስተላለፏቸው የስሕተት ትምህርቶችና በሌሎችም መምህራን የተላለፉ ነቀፋ ያለባቸው ትምህርቶች ካሉ የሊቃውንት ጉባኤ ከቤተ ክርስቲያኒቱ አስተምህሮ አንጻር በሚገባ መርምሮና አጣርቶ ከመፍትሔ ሐሳብ ጭምር በአጭር ጊዜ ውስጥ ለቋሚ ሲኖዶስ እንዲያቀርብ ወስኗል።

4. የኢትዮጵያ ኦርቶዶክስ ተዋሕዶ ቤተ ክርስቲያን መገናኝ ብዙኃን ስርጭት ድርጅት ለፍኖተ ጽድቅ ጠቅላላ ማህበር ሚዲያ የአየር ሰዓት የሰጠበትን ዝርዝር ሁኔታና ከማኅበሩ ጋር በተያያዘ አየር ላይ ያዋላቸውን ትምህርቶች የሚያሳይ ሪፖርት እንዲያቀርብ እንዲደረግ ወስኗል።

መረጃው የቤተክርስቲያኒቱ የሕዝብ ግንኙነት መምሪያ ነው።

**The Standing Synod of the Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church has decided to suspend His Holiness Abune Gabriel in his residence.**

The Standing Synod of the Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church has decided to suspend His Holiness Abune Gabriel in his residence after holding a regular meeting today to discuss and decide on the teaching that was given by him in the hall of the Fnote Seksatka General Association outside the teachings of the Church of the Virgin Mary and the situation that was broadcasted in the media of the association.

Thus:

1. Since the Fnote Seksatka General Association has on various occasions broadcasted the wrong teachings in the media outside the teachings of the Holy Church, which has saddened the fathers of the Church, the scholars and the entire Christian community, the Department of Registration and Supervision of Associations has issued a temporary suspension letter to him and the necessary strict monitoring has been carried out by the Department, and a 5-member committee has been established to make a final decision on the matter.

The Permanent Synod has decided to establish an investigative delegation to thoroughly investigate and investigate the overall activities of the association and the erroneous teachings conveyed in the media, in consultation with the Office of the Patriarchate and the Department of Registration, Control and Supervision of Associations, and to submit a decision to the Permanent Synod within a short period of time.

2. The Council of Scholars has decided to thoroughly investigate and investigate the objectionable teachings of His Holiness Abune Gabriel, who stated that “Mary is not called the Redeemer of the World” and that they are contrary to the Church’s teaching on Mary, and to submit a decision to the Permanent Synod immediately. His Holiness has also decided to remain in isolation in his residence in the premises of the Patriarchate’s Office until the matter is investigated and a final decision is reached.

3. His Holiness Abune Philip, Archbishop of the Southern Omona and Ari Zones, President of the Holy Trinity Theological University, and His Holiness Abune Barnabas, Archbishop of the Southern California Diocese, have decided that the Council of Elders, in light of the teachings of the Church, should thoroughly investigate and examine the erroneous teachings and objectionable teachings conveyed by other teachers, and submit them to the Permanent Synod within a short period of time, including a solution proposal.

4. It has been decided that the Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church Media Network shall submit a report showing the details of the airtime given to the General Association of Righteousness Media and the teachings they have broadcast in connection with the Association.

The information is from the Public Relations Department of the Church.

**“ 10,900 Birr seems like a lot when we see it in name, but it is only a name. When 42% is deducted from this, the salary does not reach the employee” - Ato Ayalew Ahmed
**
The Ethiopian Trade Union Confederation told Tikvah Ethiopia that the tax payment guidelines that are deducted from the salary of government and private sector employees should be amended to balance the salaries.

**What did Ato Ayalew Ahmed, Head of the Federation's External and Public Relations Department, say?
**
“The tax deducted from the salary was a directive issued 20 years ago when the purchasing power of money was strong, and it made salaries below 600 birr subject to tax. The law was passed when 600 birr was a very high salary or when many people were earning 600 birr.

Now, those who are paid a salary of 10, 900 birr are only in name because the maximum 35% is deducted from the salary.

When we see 10, 900 birr in name, the name seems like a lot, but it is only a name. When 35%, an additional 7% of the pension is deducted, and a total of 42% is deducted, the salary does not reach the employee. 

So when you hear that 10,900 birr salary sounds like a lot, but when 42% is deducted, the salary has dropped significantly. 

Workers then go to a hotel with the money they earn, drink tea and coffee, and then pay a second tax They should. They should pay taxes when they buy pasta and macaroni.

So the total amount is being deducted from the income tax or the salary is being deducted in a way that does not benefit the workers.

Therefore, these issues should be revised. Taxes are useful for the government, for development; for the country. We know this very well. But it should be studied in a reasonable way, supported by research in a way that does not harm the workers or the country.

Because 600 birr is said to be free; 600 birr is not a salary now. So there is no such thing as a free salary in this country. 

There is no free salary. Those who are at a certain level, it may be up to 1500 or 2000 birr, these people should be free. This is based on research, not my proposal.

The one above 10,935 will be cut by 20 or 30%; It is expected that the exemption will be 10, 20, 25, 30%.

In this crisis, when the wages of workers are being paid at a very low level, there should be an improvement,” he said.

**What about the salaries of private and government employees?

__**__
“ Regarding government employees, those who are managed by the government budget have been subject to some adjustments in the last macroeconomic policy; the question is whether the adjustment is sufficient or not? As expected.

On the other hand, there are private employees.

These two groups live in the same country; they go to the same market; they do not have the ability to buy in the same market. Therefore, work must be done to equalize them.

Employers are also waiting for the minimum wage floor to be raised; they say that the wage floor will be resolved soon because there is a high demand. The Employers’ Federation, the Confederation of Workers, and the government also believe this.

So why is it delayed? Our question. The Employment and Labor Law 1156/2011 was enacted in 2011. When we discussed the need to establish a board to study the minimum wage in the law, the problem that existed before 2011 made us agree. 

We spent six years before that, six years after that, a total of 12 years discussing wages. If it is written in the law, it must be implemented,” they said.

የኢትዮጵያ ሠራተኞች ማኅበራት ኮንፌደሬሽን (ኢሰማኮ) የሠራተኞች ቀን የሠራተኞችን ጥያቄዎች በዳሰሰ መልኩ በዋና መስሪያ ቤቱ ከ500 የሚልቁ የሠራተኛ ማኅበር መሪዎችና ተሳታፊዎች በተገኙበት ተከብሮ መዋሉን ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ገለጸ።

ተቋሙ በዓሉ በሌሎች ክልሎችም በፓናል ወይይት ጨምር በደማቅ ሁኔታ መከበሩን አስረድቷል። 

የዝቅተኛ የደመወዝ ወለል ጥያቄ ምላሽ ባለማግኘቱ ሠራተኞች ወደ አጸያፊ ሥራ ለመሰማራት እየተገደዱ፣ በሕገ ወጥ መንግድ እየተሰደዱ በመሆኑ ለጉዳዩ አፋጣኝ መፍትሄ እንዲሰጥም አሳስቧል።

የፌደሬሽኑ የቀድሞው ፕሬዜዳንት የአሁኑ የውጪና ሕዝብ ግንኙነት መምሪያ ኃላፊ አቶ አያሌው አህመድ፣ የዝቅተኛ የደመወዝ ወለልና ሌሎች ጥያቄዎች ምላሽ እንዲያገኙ ተቋሙ ሲያሳስብ ቢቆይም የዘንድሮው በዓልም ጥያቄዎች ምላሽ ባልተሰጠበት ሁኔታ መከበሩን ተናግረዋል።

**አቶ አያሌው ምላሽ ያላገኙ ጥያቄዎች በተመለከተ ምን አሉ?
**
“በግል ኢንዱስትሪዎች፣ በኮንስትራክሽን ሥራ፣ እርሻ አግሮ ኢንዱስትሪ የተሰማሩ በጣም በርካታ ሠራተኞች 2000 ባልሞላ 1000 ብር አካባቢ ባለደመወዝ ነው እየሰሩ ያሉት፡፡ በዜጎች እጅግ በጣም ከፍተኛ የሆነ ጉዳት እየደረሰ ነው፡፡ 

እኛ አናየውም በቤታቸው ውስጥ እነርሱ የሚያዩት በየቤቱ ከፍተኛ የሆነ ክራይሲስ እንዳለ ነው የሚያሳየው፡፡ 

ሠራተኞችን ጋር በአካል የተነጋገርንብት በርካታ የሆነ መረጃ ስላለን ሠራተኞች ከሥራ ሰዓት ውጪ እየሰሩ ባለበት መስርያ ቤት፣ ከዚያ ውጪ ደግሞ በሌሎች ጸያፍ በሆኑ መነገር በሌለባቸው ነገሮች ሁሉ የተሰማሩበት ሁኔታ አለ፡፡

እንደዚህ አይነት ሁኔታዎችን ማንኛውም ህብረተሰብ እያቀው ዝም ማለት የለበትም፡፡ ዜጎች ናቸው፤ ልንደርስላቸው ይገባል፡፡ 

ደመወዛቸው በቂ ካልሆነ ወዳላስፈላጊ የሥራ ዘርፍ መሰማራታቸው አይቀርም፡፡ ከሥራ ላይ ተነስተው ወደ ስደትመው መሄዳቸውም የታወቀ ነው፡፡ በሕገ ወጥ መንገድ የሚሰደዱበት ሁኔታ ለሀገሪቷም ገጽታ አይጠቅምም፡፡

ችግራቸውን ሊያየው፣ ሊያደምጠው፣ ሊያስተካክለው የሚገባ መንግስት ባለበት አገር የዚህ ጥያቄ ምላሽ መዘግት የለበትም” ብለዋል፡፡ 

በሠራተኞች የሚስተዋሉ ችግሮች ካሉበት ሳይብሱ በመንግስት እንዲፈቱ ለማድረግ አሁንም ጥያቄያቸው መቀጠሉን ገልጸው፣ አፋጣኝ ምላሽ እንዲሰጥ አሳስበዋል።

(የታክስ፣ የመንግስትና የግል ሠራተኞች የደመወዝ ገለዳይ በተመለከተ የተቋሙ ማብራሪያ በቀጣይ ይቀርባል)__

__**“ Many workers in private industries and construction work are working for a salary of around 1000 birr” - ISEMACO
**
The Confederation of Ethiopian Trade Unions (ISEMU) told Tikvah Ethiopia that Workers’ Day was celebrated at its headquarters in a manner that addressed the workers’ demands, with more than 500 trade union leaders and participants in attendance.

The organization explained that the holiday was also celebrated in other regions with a panel discussion. 

It also urged an immediate solution to the issue, as workers are being forced to engage in menial jobs and are being forced to migrate illegally due to the lack of a response to the minimum wage.

Former President of the Federation, current Head of the Department of External and Public Relations, Ato Ayalew Ahmed, said that despite the institution's repeated calls for answers to the minimum wage and other issues, this year's holiday was celebrated without any answers.

**What does Ato Ayalew have to say about the unanswered questions?

**
“A large number of workers in private industries, construction, agriculture and agro-industry are working with salaries of less than 2000 and around 1000 birr. Citizens are suffering a great deal. 

We do not see it, but what they see in their homes shows that there is a huge crisis in every home. 

We have spoken to the workers in person, and we have a lot of information that shows that workers are working outside working hours in the workplace, and apart from that, they are engaged in other unspeakable things.

No society should remain silent about such situations. They are citizens; we must reach out to them. 

If their salaries are not enough, they will inevitably engage in unnecessary work. It is also known that they will leave their jobs and go to work. The situation of illegal migration is not good for the image of the country.

To see their problems, "In a country where there is a government that should listen and fix it, the response to this request should not be delayed," he said. 

He stated that the government is still continuing to resolve the problems faced by the workers, and urged them to provide an immediate response.

(The institution's explanation regarding the tax, government and private sector salary deductions will be provided later)__

“ ባለፉት አመታት ብዙ ሃብትና ንብረት ያፈራው ስደተኛ እንደዚሁም ደመወዝ ያልተከፈላቸው በርካታ ስደተኞች አሁንም ችግር ላይ ናቸው ” - አቶ አሕመድ መሐመድ**

የጅቡቲ መንግስት፣ ሰነድ አልባ የውጭ ሀገር ዜጎች ሀገር ለቀው እንዲወጡ ያስቀመጠው ቀነገደብ ነገ አርብ፣ ሚያዝያ 24 ቀን 2017 ዓ.ም እንደሚጠናቀቅ ታውቋል፡፡ 

በጅቡቲ የሚኖሩ ኢትዮጵያውያን ስደተኞች ደግሞ፣ ቀነገደቡ በማጠሩ፣ ለአመታት ያፈራነውን ንብረታችንን ጥለን ለመውጣት ተቸግረናል ይላሉ፡፡ 

የጅቡቲ መንግስት፣ ቀነገደቡን እንዲያራዝምላቸውና የኢትዮጵያ መንግስትም ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ጥረት እንዲያደርግ ዳግም ተማፅነዋል፡፡ 

በሌላ በኩል፣ በዚያች ሀገር የቆዩ ኢትዮጵያውያን ስደተኞች፣ በድሬዳዋና በወሎ በኩል በመኪና መውጣት መጀመራቸውን የትራንስፖርት አገልግሎት ሰጪ ከሆኑት ኢትዮጵያውያን አንዷ ወይዘሮ ኩብራ መሐመድ ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ተናግረዋል፡፡ 

አቶ አሕመድ መሐመድ የተባሉ አስተያየት ሰጪ በበኩላቸው፣ በተለይም ሀብት ንብረት ያፈራ ስደተኛ ተረጋግቶ እንዲወጣ፣ ቀነገደቡ እንዲራዘምለት ጠይቀዋል፡፡  

**ወይዘሮ ኩብራ መሐመድ ምን አሉ ?**

“ አሁን ይውጡ የተባሉት ሰዎች ቀኑ በጣም አጥሮባቸዋል፡፡ ደመወዝ ያልወሰዱ፣ ብድሮቻቸውን ያልተቀበሉ፣ ይህ ነገር ይመጣብናል ብለው ያላሰቡ በርካቶች ናቸው ያሉት፡፡ 

ቤተሰብ የመሰረቱ፣ ንብረት ያፈሩ፣ ልጆቻቸውን ትምህርት ቤት ያስገቡ ሁሉ አሉ፡፡ የእኛ ማህበረሰብ በጣም ችግር ላይ ነው ያለው፡፡ መደጋገፍ እንኳን አይችልም፡፡ 

ህዝቡ ምናልባት የመሳፈሪያ ትንሽ ገንዘብ ካገኘሁ እያለ ወደ ኮሚኒቲ ይሔዳል፣ እየተመዘገበ ነው፡፡ ሆኖም፣ ከዛ የተገኘ ገንዘብ ያለ አይመስለኝም፡፡ 

በጅቡቲ 27 አመት ኖሬያለሁ፡፡ መኪና ገዝቼ ወደ ኢትዮጵያ የትንስፖርት አገልግሎት መስጠት ከጀመርኩ ደግሞ 18 አመት ይሆነኛል፡፡ ከጅቡቲ ወደ ወሎ ነው መንገደኞችን የምናመላልሰው፡፡ በዚህ ዘርፍ የተሰማራን ወደ 100 የምንሆን ኢትዮጵያውያን አለን፡፡ አሁን ተመላሾችን እያጓጓዝን ነው ያለነው፡፡ 

ከጅቡቲ ወደ ከሚሴ፣ ባቲ፣ ኮምቦልቻና ደሴ እናደርሳቸዋለን፡፡ ከጅቡቲ እስከ ድሬዳዋ እና አዲስ አበባ የሚሔዱም አሉ፡፡ 

ከጅቡቲ እስከ ከሚሴ 8000 ብር ይከፍላሉ፡፡ ከጅቡቲ ድሬዳዋ ደግሞ 2000 ብር ነው፡፡

አሁን ውጡ ከተባለ በኋላ፣ በየቀኑ በትንሹ 1000 ሰው ይወጣል ከጅቡቲ፡፡ አብዛኛው የቀን ሰራተኛ፣ የጥበቃ ሰራተኛ፣ የቤት ሰራተኛ የነበሩ ናቸው፡፡ በቡድን ተከራይተው እየኖሩ፣ ሌተቀን በመስራት ቤተሰቦቻቸውን ሲረዱ የቆዩ ናቸው፡፡ 

ዛሬ እራሱ አራት መኪኖች ስደተኞችን ጭነው ወጥቷል፣ ከአስር እስከ አስራ አምስት ሰዎች ይይዛል አንዱ መኪና፡፡ የትራንስፖርት አገልግሎት ሰጭዎች የመሳፈሪያ ዋጋ እንዳይጨምሩ አደራ እላለሁ፡፡ ምናልባትም ባለበት እንዲቀጥል፣ ከተቻለም እንዲቀንስ እንነጋገራለን፡፡ የእኛ ማህበረሰብ ስቃይ ላይ ነው ያለው፣ መንግስት ይድረስለት፡፡ ”

አቶ አሕመድ መሐመድ  ምን አሉ ?

“ እርስ በርስ መደጋገፍ እንኳን የምንችለው ሀብት ንብረታችንን የመሸጥ ዕድል ሲሰጠን ነው፡፡ ያኔ ገንዘብ ያለው፣ ለሌለው እያካፈለ ተደጋግፎ ለመሔድ የትራንስፖርት ወጪውን ይሸፍንለት ነበር፡፡ አሁን ይህን የምናደርግበት ሁኔታ ላይ አይደለንም ያለነው፡፡

ደመወዛቸውን ያልወሰዱ በርካታ ሰራተኞች አሉ፣ ምክንያቱም ይህ ወቅት ደመወዝ የሚከፈልበት ሰዓት አይደለም፡፡ ደመወዛቸውን እስኪወስዱና እዳቸውንም እንስኪከፍሉ ድረስ ሊታገሱዋቸው ይገባል፡፡ 

በጅቡቲ ለረዥም አመታት ሲኖሩ ሀብትና ንብረት ያፈሩ ስደተኞች አሉ፡፡ ከ 2 እስከ 4 ሱቅ ያላቸው ኢትዮጵያውያን አሉ፣ አንድ ሱቅ ያላቸው እማ ብዙ ናቸው፡፡ አንድ ሱቅ የሌለው የለም ማለት ትችላለህ፡፡ ቀደም ሲል ብዙም ክትትል ስላልነበረ፣ ህዝቡ የመኖሪያ ፈቃድ ሳይኖረው ሀብት አፍርቷል፡፡ 

ወደ ሀገርም ስንመለስ የባሰ ችግር ላይ እንዳንወድቅ፣ የቤተሰብ ሸክም እንዳንሆን፣ ያፈራናትን ንብረት፣ በቤት ውስጥ ያለችንን ሀብት እንደ ምንም ሸጠን ለመውጣት ጊዜ ስጡን ነው እያለ ያለው ህዝቡ፣ እዚሁ እንቅር ተውን አላለም፡፡ 

ለረዥም ጊዜ ያፈራውን ንብረት ሰብስቦ፣ የሚሸጠውን ሸጦ፣ የሚይዘውን ደግሞ ሸክፎ ለመሔድ ጊዜ ስጡን ነው እያለ ያለው፡፡ በስነ ስርዓት ወጥተን እንሒድ ነው እያልን ያለነው፡፡ አሁን እየተባለ ያለውን የመውጫ ቀን እየተጠባበቁ ለዘረፋ የተዘጋጁ ወሮበሎችም አሉ፡፡ ንብረታችንን ዘርፈው ሊከፋፈሉት አሰፍስፈዋል፡፡ ገና ሳንሔድ፣ እዚሁ እያለን፣ ይህ ንብረት ለእኔ ነው እየተባባሉ ናቸው ያሉት፡፡ 

ይህ ማህበረሰብ፣ የኢትዮጵያ መንግስት ጥሪ በሚያቀርብበት ሰዓት ወደኋላ ያላለ፣ ለሀገር ጉዳይ ያለችውን እያዋጣ ሲልክ የነበረ ነው፣ አስተዋፅኦ ያደረገ ነው፡፡ አሁን በዚህ ሰዓት የኢትዮጵያ መንግስት ሊደርስለት ይገባል፡፡ ”

ቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ በጉዳዩ ላይ በጅቡቲ ያለው የኢትዮጵያ ኮሚኒቲ የአመራር አባላትን አስተያየት ለማግኘት ያደረግነው ጥረት አልተሰካም፡፡ 

ሆኖም፣ የኮሚኒቲው አንድ የስራ አስፈፃሚ አባል፣ “ ለጥያቄያችሁ ምላሽ የለኝም ” የሚል የፅሑፍ አስተያየት አድርሰውናል፡፡ 

የኮሚኒቲው አመራሮች ምላሽና አስተያየት የሚሰጡን ከሆነ ወደፊት እናቀርባለን፡፡ 

አዲስ አበባ ከሚገኘው የጅቡቲ ኤምባሲና ከውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴርም እንደዚሁ አስተያየት ካገኘን ይዘን እንቀርባለን፡፡

ቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ
አዲስ አበባ

**🔈**#EthiopianVoice**

“ At least 1,000 people are leaving Djibouti by car every day. Most of them are engaged in temporary jobs ” - Ms. Kubra Mohammed

“ The migrants who have made a lot of money and assets over the years, as well as many migrants who have not been paid their salaries, are still in trouble ” - Mr. Ahmed Mohammed**

The Djibouti government has announced that the deadline for undocumented foreigners to leave the country will end tomorrow, Friday, April 24, 2017. 

Ethiopian migrants living in Djibouti say that they are having a hard time leaving their assets that they have built up over the years due to the deadline. 

They have once again appealed to the Djibouti government to extend the deadline and for the Ethiopian government to make diplomatic efforts. 

On the other hand, Ethiopian refugees who have been in the country have started leaving by car via Dire Dawa and Wollo, Ms. Kubra Mohammed, an Ethiopian transport service provider, told Tikvah Ethiopia. 

Commentator Ahmed Mohammed, on his part, called for an extension of the deadline, especially for refugees who have made money and have made a fortune. 

**What did Mrs. Kubra Mohammed say?**

“The people who are being asked to leave now are very tired. There are many who have not received their salaries, who have not received their loans, who did not think that this would happen to us. 

They have started families, have made property, have sent their children to school. Our community is in great trouble. They cannot even support themselves. 

People go to the community, maybe if they get a little money for transportation, they are being registered. However, I do not think there is any money from that. 

I have lived in Djibouti for 27 years. It will be 18 years since I bought a car and started providing transportation services to Ethiopia. We transport passengers from Djibouti to Wollo. We have about 100 Ethiopians engaged in this sector. We are currently transporting returnees. 

From Djibouti to Misse, Bati, We will take them to Kombolcha and Dessie. There are also those who go from Djibouti to Dire Dawa and Addis Ababa. 

From Djibouti to Missie they pay 8000 birr. From Djibouti to Dire Dawa it is 2000 birr.

Now after the order to leave, at least 1000 people leave Djibouti every day. Most of them were day laborers, security guards, domestic workers. They were living in groups and working part-time to support their families. 

Today, four trucks have already left with refugees, each truck can hold ten to fifteen people. I urge transport service providers not to increase the fare. Perhaps we will talk to them to keep it where it is, and if possible, reduce it. Our community is suffering, the government should help. ”

What did Mr. Ahmed Mohamed say?

“ We can only support each other when we are given the opportunity to sell our wealth. Back then, those who had money would share with those who did not, covering their transportation costs. We are not in a position to do that now.

There are many workers who have not received their salaries, because this is not the time to pay salaries. They should be patient with them until they receive their salaries and pay their debts. 

There are immigrants who have been living in Djibouti for many years and have accumulated wealth and property. There are Ethiopians who have 2 to 4 shops, and many who have one shop. You can say that there is no one who does not have one shop. Because there was not much supervision in the past, the people have accumulated wealth without having a residence permit. 

The people who are saying, "Give us time to sell our assets and leave so that we don't fall into worse trouble when we return to our country, so that we don't become a burden to our families," are not saying, "Let's leave here." 

They are saying, "Give us time to collect the assets we have produced for a long time, sell what we can sell, and pack what we can carry." We are saying, "Let's leave in an orderly manner." There are also thugs who are waiting for the day of departure that is being said now. They have looted our assets and are going to divide them up. Before we go, while we are here, they are saying, "This property is mine." 

This community, when the Ethiopian government calls, did not back down, it was contributing to the country's cause, it made a contribution. Now, the Ethiopian government should reach out to it at this time. ”

Tikvah Ethiopia’s efforts to reach the leadership of the Ethiopian community in Djibouti on this issue were unsuccessful. 

However, an executive member of the community wrote to us, “I do not have an answer to your question.” 

If the community leaders respond and provide feedback, we will provide it in the future. 

If we receive similar feedback from the Djibouti Embassy in Addis Ababa and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, we will provide it.

Tikvah Ethiopia
Addis Ababa

**__" የመንግስት አካላት በተደጋጋሚ የኢትዮጵያ ሰራተኞች ለሚያቀርቧቸው ጥያቄዎች ምላሽ ለመስጠት ዳተኛ ሆነዋል " - ኢሰማኮ__**

**__የኢትዮጵያ ሰራተኛ ማህበራት ኮንፌዴሬሽን (ኢሰማኮ) ምን አለ ?__**

__" በኢትዮጵያ ዝቅተኛ የደመወዝ ወለል እንዲወሰን እንዲሁም እስከ 35 በመቶ የደረሰው ከደመወዝ ላይ የሚቆረጠው ግብር እንዲቀንስ ከዚህ ቀደም ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩን ጨምሮ በተዋረድ ያሉ የስራ ሃላፊዎችን ብንጠይቅም እስካሁን ሁነኛ ምላሽ አላገኘንም " ብሏል።

የኢሰማኮ ፕሬዝዳንት አቶ ካሳሁን ፎሎ ፥ ከ1 ዓመት ከ6 ወር በፊት ከጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ዐቢይ አህመድ ጋር ተወያይቶ እንደነበር ይህን ተከትሎ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ የሚመለከታቸውን የመንግስት አካላት በጉዳዩ ላይ ጥናት አድርገው እንዲያቀርቡ አቅጣጫ ሰጥተው እንደነበር አስታውሰዋል።

" ጥናት እንዲከወን አቅጣጫ ቢሰጥም፤ ምላሽ ባለማግኘታችን ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩን በድጋሚ በደብዳቤ ለመጠየቅ ተገድደናል " ብለዋል።

ጥያቄዎቹ በጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ ተቀባይነት ቢያገኙም  ጥናቱን አከናውኑ የተባሉ የመንግስት መስሪያ ቤቶችን " ከምን ደረሰ ?  ብለን በተደጋጋሚ ደጅ ብንጠናም ምላሽ አጥተናል " ብለዋል።

" ዝቅተኛ የደሞዝ ወለል መወሰን እንደ ሃገር በልቶ ማደር የሚችል እንዲኖር ያስችላል ምርታማነትንም ይጨምራል "  ያሉት አቶ ካሳሁን " ኮንፌደሬሽኑም በጉዳዩ ዙሪያ የበኩሉን ጥናት እየከወነ ነው " ብለዋል።

በሌላ በኩል እስከ 35 በመቶ የሚደርሰው ከደሞዝ ላይ የሚቆረጠው ግብር እንዲቀንስ ጥያቄ እየቀረበ ነው።

በተለይም በጣም ዝቅ ያለ ደመወዝ የሚከፈላቸው ሰራተኞች በኑሮ ውድነቱ ምክንያት በልቶ ለማደር እየከበዳቸው ነው።

**__" Government bodies have repeatedly failed to respond to the demands of Ethiopian workers " - ISEMACO__**

**__What does the Ethiopian Confederation of Trade Unions (ISEMACO) say?__**

__" We have previously asked the Prime Minister and other high-ranking officials to set a minimum wage in Ethiopia and reduce the tax on wages, which has reached 35 percent, but we have not received a proper response yet," he said.

ISEMACO President Ato Kassahun Folo recalled that he had discussed the matter with Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed 1 year and 6 months ago, following which the Prime Minister directed the relevant government bodies to conduct a study on the matter.

" Although we were directed to conduct a study, we were forced to write to the Prime Minister again due to the lack of a response," he said.

Although the questions were accepted by the Prime Minister, we have repeatedly asked the government departments that conducted the study, "What happened?", but we have not received any response.

"Setting a minimum wage floor allows a country to survive and increases productivity," said Ato Kassahun. "The Confederation is also conducting its own research on the issue."

On the other hand, there is a request to reduce the tax on wages, which is up to 35 percent.

In particular, workers who are paid very low wages are finding it difficult to survive due to the high cost of living.

Ato Kassahun indicated that there are ministries and departments that have been instructed to conduct a study on this and that ISEMACO is pressuring them to bring the issue to a close.

"We will continue to press until the questions asked are answered," he said.

**" We have taken action against the teacher " - Education Bureau **

A teacher who punished her student with an inappropriate and offensive punishment for saying "You did not do your homework" has been suspended and placed under legal supervision.

The Addis Ababa City Administration Education Bureau has announced that it has taken action against a teacher who punished a Grade 2 student at the Peace Bere Pre-Primary and Primary School in Kolfe Keraniyo District, Kolfe.

It indicated that the suspension of the teacher is a measure to put her under the shadow of the law.

The bureau stated that the bureau will work to ensure that the teacher, who was placed under the shadow of the law, receives legal treatment and justice.

"The student has received treatment and is in good health," the bureau said, adding that "she will start her classes tomorrow."

**" የጅቡቲ ኢትዮጵያውያንን የማስወጣት ዕቅድ ምክንያቱ ፖለቲካዊ ነው፡፡ ሀገሪቱ በእቅዷ መሰረት በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩትን ስደተኞች ጨክና ታባርር እንደሆነ የምናየው ይሆናል፡፡ በእቅዷ ገፍታ ከሄደችበት በእሷም ላይ የሚያስከትለው መዘዝ አለ " - አበባው ምናዬ (ዶ/ር)**

የጅቡቲ መንግስት በሀገሩ የሚገኙ የውጭ ሀገር ዜጎች በአንድ ወር ጊዜ ውስጥ በፈቃዳቸው ለቀው እንዲወጡ፣ ካልሆነ ግን በግዳጅ እንደሚባረሩ አስታውቋል፡፡ 

ሰነድ አልባ የሆኑ የውጭ ሀገር ዜጎች ሀገሪቱን ለቀው እንዲወጡ የተሰጣቸው ቀነገደብም፣ በመጪው ቅዳሜ ይጠናቀቃል፡፡ 

ይህ መንግስታዊ ትዕዛዝ ያተኮረው በእኛ ላይ ነው የሚሉት በዚያች ሀገር የሚኖሩ ኢትዮጵያውያን ስደተኞች በበኩላቸው፣ በአጭር ጊዜ ውስጥ መውጣት ስለማንችል ተጠንቀናል ብለዋል፡፡ ከዚያ አልፈው የመንግስትን እርዳታ ጠይቀዋል፡፡ 

ቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ በጉዳዩ ዙርያ ሙያዊ አስተያየት እንዲያጋሩ የጠየቅናቸው ባለሙያ በበኩላቸው፣ ይህ የጅቡቲ እቅድ ፖለቲካዊ ይዘት እንዳለው ገልፀው፣ ወደ ተግባር ከተሸጋገረ ለእሷም ከባድ መዘዝ ያስከትላል ይላሉ፡፡ 

በአዲስ አበባ ዩኒቨርሲቲ፣ የማህብረሰብ ሳይኮሎጂ መምህር እና የፍልሰትና የስደት ጥናት ማዕከል አስተባባሪ የሆኑት አበባው ምናዬ (ዶ/ር)፣ ጉዳዩ ጂኦፖለቲካዊ ነው፣ መፈታትም ያለበት በውይይት ነው ብለዋል፡፡  
**
አበባው ምናዬ (ዶ/ር) ምን አሉ ?
**
" ብዙ ጊዜ እንደምናየው እንዲህ ዓይነት ውሳኔ የሀገራት ፖለቲካዊ ግንኙነት ነፀብራቅ ነው፡፡ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነቶች በሰዎች ፍልሰት ላይ ከፍተኛ ተፅዕኖ አላቸው፡፡ 

መልካም ግንኙት ሲኖርህ የሌላ ሀገር ዜጎችን ትንከባከባለህ፣ አሉታዊ ግንኙነት ሲኖርህ ደግሞ የሌላውን ሀገር ዜጋ ታስወጣለህ፡፡ የጅቡቲም አንዱ ምክንያት ይኼ ሊሆን ይችላል፡፡ 

ሁለተኛው ምክንያት ደግሞ፣ በሱዳን በኩል ያለው የፍልሰትና የስደት በር አሁንም እንዳለ ቢሆንም ብዙ ችግር ገጥሞታል፡፡ ስለሆነም፣ ከኢትዮጵያ የሚነሱ ፍልሰተኞች ወደ ጅቡቲ መስመር አቅጣጫ ቀይረዋል፡፡ ይህ መስመር በጣም ተጨናንቋል አሁን ከሌሎቹ በበለጠ፡፡ ይህም በፍልሰተኞች ፍሰት ጅቡቲን ሊያስመርራት ይችላል፡፡ ነገር ግን፣ አሁን ጅቡቲ ውጡልኝ እያለቻቸው ያለችው ነባር ፍልሰተኞችን ነው፡፡ አዳዲሶቹን አይደለም፡፡ ይህ ደግሞ ነገሩን ፖለቲካዊ ያደርገዋል፡፡ " 

**ፖለቲካዊ ምክንያቱ ምንድነው ?**

" የኢትዮጵያ የወደብ አማራጮችን መፈለግና በጅቡቲ ወደቦች ላይ ጥገኛ ላለመሆን የሚደረገው ጥረት ያስደነግጣታል፡፡ ኢትዮጵያ ደግሞ አማራጮችን እያፈላለገች ነው ያለችው፡፡ 

ከኢትዮጵያ በጣም ከፍተኛ ገቢ ሲያገኝ የነበረ ሀገር፣ ኢትዮጵያ የሌሎች ሀገራት ወደቦችን ለመጠቀም ስታማትር ይደነግጣል፡፡ 

ለምሳሌ፣ ኢትዮጵያ ከኤርትራ ጋር ሰላም የፈጠረች ጊዜ ለጅቡቲ አስደንጋጭ ነበር፡፡ ' ኢትዮጵያውያኑ ኤርትራ ላይ ወደብ ካገኙ፣ ጥለውኝ ይሔዳሉ ' ነው የምትለው፡፡ 

ስለዚህ ስደተኞችን የማባረር እቅዱ ትርጉም፣ 'ሌላ ወደብ አታማትር፣ እዚሁ ቆይልኝ፣ ካማተርክ ግን እኔ ደግሞ ያለችኝን ዱላ እወረውራለሁ ነው፡፡ ' ይህን ዱላ ትወረውረዋለች ወይ የሚለውን፣ የምናየው ይሆናል፡፡ ከተወረወረ ግን ለሁለቱም ሀገራት ጎጂ ነው የሚሆነው፡፡ 

በርግጥ የተወሰኑ በየመንገዱ የምታገኛቸውን ሚስኪኖች ከመንገድ ለቃቅማ ልታስወጣ ትችላለች፡፡ የኢትዮጵያን ግብረመልስ ለመመዘንና ለማየት የሚደረግ ማስፈራሪያ ነው የሚመስለኝ፡፡ ሆኖም፣ ከኢትዮጵያ በኩል ይፋዊ የሆነ ግብረ መልስ አልተሰማም እስካሁን፡፡ 

ጅቡቲ ወደ ተግባር ከተሸጋገረች፣ ከዚህ በኩል የሚገጥማት ግብረመልስ ምን ሊሆን እንደሚችል አናውቀውም፡፡ "

**ጅቡቲ ወደ እርምጃ ብትገባ ጉዳቱ ምንድነው ?**

" ይህ እቅድ፣ ከማስፈራራት አልፎ ቀጥታ ወደ እርምጃ የሚለወጥ ከሆነ፣ ያልተጠበቀ ጉዳት ነው የሚያስከትለው፡፡ ጅቡቲም ትልቅ ችግር ውስጥ ትወድቃለች፡፡ አንደኛ፣ ያች ሀገር ሰራተኛ የላትም፡፡ በብዛት የሚሰሩት የእኛ ሰዎች ናቸው፡፡ ስለዚህ ይጎዳታል፡፡ ሁለተኛ ደግሞ ኢትዮጵያ አፀፋዊ እርምጃ ብትወስድስ የሚለው መምጣት አለበት፡፡ 

ውሀ እና መብራት ከዚህ ነው የሚቀርብላት፣ ጫትም ጭምር፡፡ ሀገሪቱ በኢትዮጵያ የወደብ ኪራይ ገቢ ላይ በእጅጉ ጥገኛ ናት፡፡ የጅቡቲ ዜጎች ድሬዳዋ ድረስ እንደፈለጉ ነው የሚኖሩት፡፡ እነዚህ ጥቅሞች እያገኘች፣ የኢትዮጵያን ዜጎች ላስወጣ ማለቷ፣ ለማስፈራራት ነው እንጂ የሚመስለኝ፣ የሚተገበር መሆኑን እጠራጠራለሁ፡፡ 

እነዚህን ጥቅሞች ወደ ጎን አድርጋ ለምን እንደዛ እንዳሰበች ሊገባኝ አልቻለም በእውነት፡፡ የሚታሰብ ነገር አይደለም፡፡ እቅድዋን ብትተገብረው፣ እኛም እንጎዳለን፣ ግን ጅቡቲ ላይ የሚያስከትለው መዘዝ የበለጠ ነው የሚሆነው፡፡ "

**ባለሙያው በሰጡት ምክረሀሳብ ምን አሉ ?**

" በጅቡቲ ከ250 እስከ 300 ሺህ ኢትዮጵያዊ እንደሚኖር ነው የሚገመተው፡፡ ይህ ማለት ከጅቡቲ ህዝብ አንድ አምስተኛው ያህል እንደ ማለት ነው፡፡ ከዚህ ውስጥ አብዛኛውን የማጓጓዝ አቅም ከዬት ታመጣለች፡፡ 

ስደተኛ ከመደንገጥ ይልቅ፣ ይህን ሁሉ ሰው እንዴት በተደራጀ መልኩ ከሀገር ሊያስወጡት እንደሚችሉ ማየት ነው የሚሻለው፡፡ በጅቡቲ አቅም ስደተኛውን እንዴት አድርገው ነው አደራጅተው ወደ ሀገሩ ሊመልሱት የሚችሉት፡፡ የኢትዮጵያ መንግስት ይህ እቅድ ጉዳት ስለሚያስከትል ከጅቡቲ መንግስት ጋር መወያየት ነው ያለበት፡፡ 

ይሔ ፖለቲካዊ ሪአክሽን ነው፣ ጂኦፖለቲካዊ ነው፣ መፍትሔው ውይይት ነው፡፡ 

ከኢትዮጵያ በኩል ግፊት ቢደረግ፣ ጅቡቲ እቅዷን ዳግም የምታጤነው ይመስለኛል፡፡ ቁጭ ብሎ መወያየት የስፈልጋል፡፡ 

ለሁሉም ግን መዘጋጀት ጥሩ ነው፡፡ ስደተኛው ደግሞ መንግስት የሚሰጠውን አቅጣጫ ተከትሎ ሰነዶቹን እያዘጋጀ፣ የሚሆኑትን ነገሮች መጠባበቅ አለበት፡፡ የጅቡቲ መንግስት ጨክኖ ይህን እርምጃ የሚወስድ ከሆነ፣ ኢትዮጵያ ብዛት ያለውን ተመላሽ ስደተኛ ለመቀበል መዘጋጀት አለባት፡፡ "

**" The reason for Djibouti's plan to deport Ethiopians is political. We can see that the country will forcefully deport thousands of refugees according to its plan. If it goes ahead with its plan, there will be consequences for it too " - Abebaw Mnaye (PhD)**

The Djibouti government has announced that foreign citizens in the country must leave voluntarily within a month, otherwise they will be forcibly deported. 

The order to leave the country for undocumented foreigners will end next Saturday. 

Ethiopian refugees living in the country, who say this government order is aimed at us, said they are worried because they cannot leave in a short time and have asked for government help. 

Experts we asked Tikvah Ethiopia to share their professional opinions on the issue said that this Djibouti plan has a political content and will have serious consequences for it if it is implemented. 

Abebaw Mnaye (PhD), a lecturer in social psychology and coordinator of the Center for Migration and Emigration Studies at Addis Ababa University, said that the issue is geopolitical and should be resolved through dialogue. 
**
What did Abebaw Mnaye (PhD) say?
**
"As we often see, such decisions are a reflection of the political relations between countries. Diplomatic relations have a huge impact on the migration of people. 

When you have good relations, you take care of the citizens of another country, and when you have negative relations, you expel the citizens of another country. This could be one of the reasons for Djibouti. 

The second reason is that the Sudanese border crossing is still there, but it has faced many problems. Therefore, migrants leaving Ethiopia have diverted to the Djibouti route. This route is now more congested than the others. This could cause Djibouti to suffer from the flow of migrants. However, what Djibouti is now saying is to let the existing migrants go. Not the new ones. This also makes the matter political. " 

**What is the political reason?**

" Ethiopia's efforts to find port alternatives and not be dependent on Djibouti's ports It is shocking. Ethiopia is also looking for alternatives. 

A country that has been receiving a lot of revenue from Ethiopia, is shocked when Ethiopia tries to use the ports of other countries. 

For example, when Ethiopia made peace with Eritrea, it was shocking for Djibouti. 'If the Ethiopians find a port in Eritrea, they will leave me alone', she said. 

So the meaning of the plan to expel the refugees is, 'If you don't find another port, stay here, but if you don't, I will throw the stick I have. ' Whether she will throw this stick, we will see. But if she does, it will be harmful to both countries. 

Of course, she can throw some poor people she meets on the road. It seems to be a threat to gauge and see Ethiopia's reaction. However, there has been no official reaction from Ethiopia so far. 

If Djibouti takes action, we don't know what the reaction will be from this side. "

**What is the harm if Djibouti takes action?**

" This plan, if it goes beyond threats and directly turns into action, will cause unexpected damage. Djibouti will also be in a big problem. First, that country has no workers. Most of the workers are our people. So it will be hurt. Second, what if Ethiopia takes countermeasures? 

It gets its water and electricity from here, as well as khat. The country is heavily dependent on the rent from the Ethiopian port. Djiboutian citizens live as they please in Dire Dawa. While getting these benefits, I think it is to scare the Ethiopian citizens and I doubt it will be implemented. 

I really don't understand why she thought that by putting these benefits aside. It is not something that can be imagined. If you implement your plan, we will also be affected, but the consequences for Djibouti will be even greater. "

**What did the expert say about the recommendations?**

" It is estimated that there are 250,000 to 300,000 Ethiopians in Djibouti. This means about one-fifth of the population of Djibouti. Most of the transportation capacity will come from Ethiopia. 

Instead of panicking about the refugees, it is better to see how they can get all these people out of the country in an organized manner. How can they organize the refugees and return them to their country with Djibouti's capacity? The Ethiopian government should discuss this plan with the Djiboutian government because it will cause harm. 

This is a political reaction, it is geopolitical, the solution is dialogue. 

If pressure is exerted from Ethiopia, I think Djibouti will reconsider its plan. We need to sit down and discuss it. 

But it is good for everyone to be prepared. The refugee should also follow the government's directions, prepare the documents, and wait for the things to happen. If the Djibouti government takes this step, Ethiopia should be prepared to receive the large number of returning refugees. "

The Council of Ministers held its 44th regular session today and passed a resolution on various issues.

One of the resolutions passed was a draft proclamation to regulate the manner in which foreigners can become owners or possessors of immovable property.

The council said, "This legal framework for foreigners to acquire and use land in a manner that does not affect the rights of citizens to:
- Encourage foreign capital to invest in our country, 
- Further stimulate housing development and accessibility, 
- Maintain a balance between housing demand and supply, 
- Create employment opportunities for citizens will be of great importance."

After discussing the draft proclamation, it unanimously decided to forward it to the House of People's Representatives.

Another issue the council decided on was a draft regulation to implement the African Continental Free Trade Area Agreement (AfCFTA) tariff reduction.

"The agreement will help expand trade among member countries, strengthen market linkages, develop value chains, and promote economic transformation," he said.

"It is important to determine the customs tariff rates on goods imported from member countries so that trade between member countries can be facilitated without being hindered by tariffs, and the regulation will be implemented within one month from the date of its publication in the Federal Gazette," he said.

#AddisAbaba

ከለሊት 10:00 ጀምሮ በአዲስ አበባ መንገዶች ይዘጋሉ።

116ኛው የኢትዮጵያ ፖሊስ ምስረታ በዓል ነገ እሁድ ሚያዚያ 26/2017 ዓ/ም በመስቀል አደባባይ በተለያዩ ወታደራዊ ትርኢቶች ይከበራል።

በዚህም ምክንያት መንገዶች ለተሽከርካሪ ዝግ እንደሚደረጉ የአዲስ አበባ ፖሊስ አስታውቋል።

➡️ ከ22 አደባባይ ወደ ወደ ቅዱስ ዑራኤል -መስቀል አደባባይ (22 አደባባይ በተመሣሣይ ዘሪሁን ህንፃ መስቀለኛ ላይ)

➡️ ከአትላስ መብራት ወደ ቅዱስ ዑራኤል አደባባይ (አትላስ መብራት እና ፒኮኪ መብራት ላይ)

➡️ ከቦሌ ወሎ ሠፈር መታጠፊያ ወደ ኦሎምፒያ አደባባይ (ኦሎምፒያ አደባባይ ላይ) 

➡️ ከወሎ ሠፈር ጀምሮ እስከ ጋዜቦ አደባባይ ውስጥ ውስጡን ወደ ዋናው መንገድ የሚያስወጡት

➡️ ከመስቀል ፍላዎር አደባባይ ወደ ጋዜቦ አደባባይ (መስቀል ፍላዎር አደባባይ ላይ)

➡️ ከጋዜቦ አደባባይ ወደ ኤግዚብሽን ውስጥ ለውስጥ ወደ ፊላሚንጎ (ጋዜቦ አደባባይ ላይ)

➡️ ከቅዱስ ቂርቆስ ቤ/ክርሰቲያን ወደ ለገሃር መብራት ( ቅዱስ ቂርቆስ ወደ ጋዜቦ ላይ)

➡️ ከአጎና መስቀለኛ ወደ ጥላሁን አደባባይ 

➡️ ከሜክሲኮ አደባባይ ወደ ለገሀር መብራት (ሜክሲኮ አደባባይ ላይ)

➡️ ከፓርላማ መብራት ወደ ውጭ ጉዳይ (ፓርላማ መብራት ላይ)

➡️ ከጥይት ቤት ወደ ቅዱስ ገብርኤል (ጥይት ቤት መታጠፊያ ላይ )

➡️ ከሴቶች አደባባይ ወደ ካዛንቺስ ቶታል (ሴቶች አደባባይ ላይ) ከለሊቱ 10:00 ሰዓት ጀምሮ ፕሮግራሙ እስከሚጠናቀቅ ድረስ መንገዶቹ ዝግ ይሆናሉ።

በተጨማሪም፦ 
- ከቅዱስ ዑራኤል ወደ መስቀል አደባባይ 
- ከኦሎምፒያ ወደ መስቀል አደባባይ 
- ከጥላሁን አደባባይ ወደ መስቀል አደባባይ 
- ከለገሃር መብራት ወደ መስቀል አደባባይ 
- ከሀራምቤ መብራት ወደ መስቀል አደባባይ እንዲሁም 
- ከብሔራዊ ቤተመንግሥት ወደ መስቀል አደባባይ ከዛሬ ጀምሮ ዝግ ተደርጓል።

የአሜሪካ ዳይቨርሲቲ ቪዛ (DV) 2026 አሸናፊዎች ይፋ ተደረጉ።

የ2026 ዲቪ (DV) ሎተሪ ዛሬ ምሽት ይፋ ተደርጓል።

ለዲቪ /DV/ 2026 ማመልከቻ የሞሉ በ https://dvprogram.state.gov/ESC ብቻ የማረጋገጫ ቁጥራቸውን በማስገባት ውጤቱን / ማሸነፍ አለማሸነፋቸውን መመልከት ይችላሉ።

የማረጋገጫ ቁጥር ማመልከቻው ሲሞላ የተሰጠ ቁጥር ሲሆን ይህ ቁጥር የጠፋበት Forgot Confirmation Number በማለት አስፈለጊ መረጃ በመሙላት በኢሜል አዲስ ቁጥር ማግኘት ይቻላል።

" የዲቪ (DV) ሎተሪ አሸንፋችኋል፣ ከአሜሪካ ኢምባሲ ነው እምንደውለው / ኢሜይል / ቴክስት የምንልከው "  በሚል የሚያጭበረብሩ አካላት ስለሚኖሩ አመልካቾች ጥንቃቄ ሊያደርጉ ይገባል።

አሜሪካ በየዓመቱ ከአፍሪካ (ኢትዮጵያን ጨምሮ) ፣ እስያ ፣ አውሮፓ፣ ሰሜን አሜሪካ፣ ደቡብ አሜሪካ እና አውስትራሊያ 50 ሺህ ሰዎችን በዲቪ (DV) ሎተሪ ወደ ሀገሯ ታስገባለች።

ለ2026 የፊስካል ዓመት እስከ 55,000 የሚደርስ የዳይቨርሲቲ ቪዛ (DV) ተዘጋጅቷል። ይህ ቁጥር ብቁ የሆኑ ሀገራትን ሁሉ የሚጠቃልል ሲሆን #ኢትዮጵያም አንዷ ናት።

The winners of the US Diversity Visa (DV) 2026 have been announced.

The 2026 DV lottery was announced tonight.

Applicants who have applied for the DV/2026 program can check their results by entering their confirmation number at https://dvprogram.state.gov/ESC.

The confirmation number is a number that was given to them when they applied. If you have lost this number, you can get a new number by filling in the Forgot Confirmation Number form and sending an email.

Applicants should be careful as there are scammers who claim to be "You have won the DV lottery, we are calling/emailing/texting you from the US Embassy."

The United States admits 50,000 people each year from Africa (including Ethiopia), Asia, Europe, North America, South America, and Australia through the Diversity Visa (DV) lottery.

#ታርጋ

__በኢትዮጵያ የሚመዘገቡ ሁሉም ተሽከርካሪዎች 'ኢት' የሚል መለያ እና የኢትዮጵያ ካርታ ያለበት አዲስ የመለያ ሠሌዳ ቁጥር እንዲኖራቸው ሊደረግ ነው።

በአገሪቱ ያሉ ተሽከርካሪዎች የመለያ ቁጥር ሠሌዳ እንደሚቀየር ተነግሯል።__

**በትራንስፖርት እና ሎጂስቲክስ ሚኒስቴር የወጣው መመሪያ ምን ይዟል ?**

__- አዲሱ መመሪያ በአሁኑ ሰዓት በሥራ ላይ ያሉ የተሽከርካሪ ሰሌዳዎች ላይ የሚቀመጠውን የተለያዩ ክልሎች እና የከተማ አስተዳደሮች መለያዎችን አላካተተም።

- በመላው ኢትዮጵያ አገልግሎት ላይ የሚውሉት የሠሌዳ ቁጥሮች ተመሳሳይ መለያ እንዲኖራቸው ይደረጋል።

- ሁሉም የተሽከርካሪ መለያ ቁጥር ሠሌዳዎች በእንግሊዝኛ እና በግዕዝ ፊደላት ኢትዮጵያን የሚያመለክት አጭር ጽሁፍ እና የኢትዮጵያ ካርታ ይኖራቸዋል።

- በሀገሪቱ የሚመዘገቡ ሁሉም ተሸከርካሪዎች የሚለጥፉት የመለያ ቁጥር ሠሌዳ ላይ የኢትዮጵያ ካርታ እና ኢትዮጵያ ባጸደቀችው ዓለም አቀፍ ስምምነት መሠረት የተሰጣትን ሀገራዊ ልዩ ምልክት "ETH" እንዲሁም "ኢት" የሚል የግእዝ ፊደላት እና የላቲን ፊደላት ይዘት እንዲኖረው ይደረጋል፡፡

- የመለያ ቁጥር ሠሌዳ አሰጣጡ ሦስት የላቲን ፊደላትን እና አራት ቁጥሮችን በመጠቀም ተከታታይ ቁጥር ያላቸው የመለያ ቁጥር ሠሌዳዎችን እንዲመረቱ ይደረጋል።

-  የተሽከርካሪዎች የመለያ ቁጥር ሠሌዳዎች የቀለም ኅብር፣ ፊደላት በተጨማሪ የመለያ ቁጥር ሠሌዳዎቹ ሲመረት ለቁጥጥር እና ለምዝገባ ዓላማ የሚያገለግሉ መረጃዎችን የሚሰጡ ምሥጢራዊ ምልክቶችን እያንዳንዱ የሠሌዳ ዓይነት እንዲኖረው ይደረጋል።

- የመለያ ቁጥር ሠሌዳዎቹ የተሽከርካሪዎችን ባለቤት፣ የሚሠጡትን አገልግሎት እና የኃይል አጠቃቀምን የሚያመለክቱ ቀለማት እንዲሁም ሌሎች መለያዎች ይኖራቸዋል።

- በኤሌክትሪክ ወይም ታዳሽ ኃይሎች የሚሠሩ ተሽከርካሪዎች ሰሌዳ ከሌሎች በተለየ መልኩ " አረንጓዴ ትራንስፖርት (Green Transport) " የሚል የጽሁፍ መለያ ይይዛል።

- ልዩ መግለጫ ያለው የተለየ የመለያ ቁጥር ሠሌዳ  የሚፈልጉ ግለሰቦች በሚያቀርቡት ጥያቄ መሠረት ለሚጠይቅ እንደሁኔታው በልዩ ሁኔታ ሊሰጣቸው ይችላል።

- አዲሱ የሠሌዳ ዓይነት ከዚህ ቀደም በተመዘገቡ ተሽከርካሪዎች ላይም ተግባራዊ ይሆናል።

- መመሪያው በሥራ ላይ ከመዋሉ በፊት የተመዘገቡ ተሽከርካሪዎች የቀድሞውን ሠሌዳ ለመዝጋቢው አካል በመመለስ አዲስ የተሸከርካሪ የመለያ ቁጥር ሠሌዳ መውሰድ ይኖርባቸዋል።

- የተሽከርካሪ ባለቤቶች ነባሩን ሠሌዳ በመመለስ አዲሱን የሚወስዱት የትራንስፖር እና ሎጅስቲክስ ሚኒስቴር በሚያዘጋጀው የጊዜ ሠሌዳ መሠረት ነው።

በአጼ ሚኒሊክ ዘመን የመጀመሪያዋ ተሽከርካሪ ወደ ኢትዮጵያ ከገባች ጊዜ አንስቶ ለመኪኖች የመለያ ቁጥር መሠጠት እንደተጀመረ የሚነገር ሲሆን፣ ከዚያ በኋላ ወደ ሥልጣን በመጡት አስተዳደሮች ቢያንስ ሦስት ጊዜ የተሽከርካሪዎች መለያ ሠሌዳ ቁጥር ለውጥ ተደርጓል።

በንጉሥ ኃይለ ሥላሴ ዘመን የነበረው የሠሌዳ ቁጥር፣ ወታደራዊው መንግሥት ወደ ሥልጣን ከመጣ በኋላ የተቀየረ ሲሆን፣ በደርግ ዘመን የነበረው ደግሞ ኢህአዴግ ሥልጣን ከያዘ በኋላ ለውጥ ተደርጎበታል።

በኢህአዴግ ዘመን ለአገልግሎት የበቃው እና እስካሁንም በሥራ ላይ ያለው የተሽከርካሪዎች መለያ ቁጥር ሠሌዳ 'ኢት' የሚል መለያ ካላቸው ከተወሰኑ ተሽከርካሪዎች ውጪ አብዛኞቹ የሚንቀሳቀሱባቸውን ክልሎች እና የከተማ አስተዳደሮች ስም ሁለት ፊደላትን የያዙ ናቸው።

ይህ መረጃ ባለቤትነቱ የቢቢሲ አማርኛው አገልግሎት ነው።

#License Plate

__All vehicles registered in Ethiopia will have a new license plate number with the letter 'ET' and a map of Ethiopia.

It has been reported that the license plate of vehicles in the country will be changed.

**What does the directive issued by the Ministry of Transport and Logistics contain?**

__- The new directive does not include the labels of different regions and city administrations that are currently on vehicle plates.

- License plate numbers used throughout Ethiopia will have the same label.

- All vehicle license plates will have a short text referring to Ethiopia in English and Ge'ez letters and a map of Ethiopia.

- The license plate of all vehicles registered in the country will have a map of Ethiopia and the national symbol "ETH" given to Ethiopia in accordance with an international agreement ratified by Ethiopia, as well as the Ge'ez letters and Latin letters.

- The number plate shall be issued using three Latin letters and four numbers to produce serial number plates.

- In addition to the color scheme and letters of the vehicle number plates, each type of plate shall have a code that provides information for control and registration purposes.

- The number plates shall have colors and other markings indicating the owner of the vehicle, the service provided and the energy consumption.

- The plates of vehicles powered by electric or renewable energy shall bear a text label that is different from others, stating "Green Transport".

- Individuals who require a special number plate with a special description may be granted a special license plate upon request.

- The new type of plate shall also apply to previously registered vehicles.

- Vehicles registered before the directive comes into effect must return their old plates to the registration authority and obtain a new vehicle registration plate.

- Vehicle owners must return their existing plates and obtain a new one according to a schedule prepared by the Ministry of Transport and Logistics.

It is said that the issuance of registration numbers for vehicles began during the reign of Emperor Menelik, when the first vehicle entered Ethiopia, and since then, the registration number of vehicles has been changed at least three times by successive governments.

The registration number used during the reign of Emperor Haile Selassie was changed after the military government came to power, and the registration number used during the Derg era was changed after the EPRDF took power.

The vehicle registration plates that were put into service during the EPRDF era and are still in use today, except for a few vehicles with the letter 'E', most of them contain the two-letter names of the regions and city administrations in which they operate.

**" ከህገወጥ ስደተኞች ጋር የተባበረ የጅቡቲ ዜጋ፣ ከ 50 ሺህ እስከ 500 ሺህ ፍራንክ እንደሚቀጣ ማስጠንቀቂያ ተሰጥቷል " - በጅቡቲ የሚኖር ኢትዮጵያዊ
**
የጅቡቲ መንግስት፣ ሰነድ አልባ ስደተኞች ሀገሪቱን ለቀው እንዲወጡ ከአንድ ወር በፊት ያስተላለፈው ትእዛዝ ዛሬ ሚያዝያ 25 ቀን 2017 ዓ.ም እንደሚጠናቀቅ ታውቋል፡፡ 

የጅቡቲ ባለስልጣናትም ከትናንትና በስቲያ ማታ አርቲዲ ዌብ ቲቪ/RTD WEB TV/ በተባለ ሚዲያ በዚሁ ጉዳይ ላይ ውይይት አካሂደው ነበር።

ውይይቱን መካተላቸውን የገለጹልን አቶ መሐመድ ያዮ ጁሀር፣ የባለስልጣናቱ ውይይት ምን እንደነበር እንዲህ ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ አስረድተዋል።

**አቶ መሐመድ ያዮ ጁሀር ፦**

" በቴሌቪዥን ውይይቱን ካደረጉት ሰዎች መካከል አንድ ጀነራል አለበት፣ አንድ የህግ ሰውም ነበረበት፡፡ ለጅቡቲዎች ለራሳቸው ህጋዊ ያልሆነን ሰው ሲተባበበሩ ከተገኙ ቅጣት እንደሚያስከትልባቸው ነው ሲናገሩ የነበረው።

ይህ ቅጣት ከ 50 ሺህ እስከ 500 ሺህ የጅቡቲ ፍራንክ የሚደርስ እንደሆነ ገልፀዋል፡፡ ህጋዊ ሰነድ ያላቸው ዜጎች፣ ቀነገደቡ ካበቃ በኋላ ባሉት ቀናት መታወቂያዎቻቸውን ይዘው እንዲንቀሳቀሱም አስጠንቅቀዋል፡፡ ትክክለኛ ሰነድ ስለመሆኑም ጭምር የሚያረጋግጡበት መሳሪያ እንዳላቸው ገልፀዋል፡፡ 

የጅቡቲ ህዝብ ለሰራተኞቹ ደመወዝ እንዲከፍል አዘዋል፡፡ በተሰጠው ቀነገደብ ውስጥ የሰራተኞቻችሁን ደመወዝ ክፈሉ፣ በስርዓት አስተናግዱዋቸው፣ ችግር እንዳታደርሱባቸው ሲሉም ነበር፡፡ 

በአጠቃላይ ግን፣ ባለሥልጣናቱ ሰነድ አልባ ስደተኞችን ለማባረር በቂ ዝግጅት ማድረጋቸውን ነው የተረዳሁት፡፡ ፖሊስ፣ የህዝብ ደህንነትና ወታደሩ ሁሉም የመንግስት አካላት ተዘጋጅተዋል፡፡ 

በመጀመሪያ ደረጃ ጎዳና ላይ ያሉትን በማስወጣት፣ ከዛም በሁሉም ሰፈሮች አሰሳ በማካሔድ እንዲወጡ ይደረጋል ነው ያሉት፡፡ እንዳውም ድሮንም ተዘጋጅቶ፣ ወደ ጅቡቲ አዲስ ሰው እንዳይገባ ጥበቃ እንደሚደረግ ገልፀዋል፡፡ " ሲሉ የውይይቱን ጭብጥ አስረድተዋል።

ምናልባት የማባረሩን ዘመቻ ቅዳሜ ባይጀምሩትም ከዛ በኋላ ግን ሊጀምሩት እንደሚችሉ ነው የተገነዘብኩት፡፡

በውይይታቸው በግልፅ ያልተቀመጠ ነገርም ግን አለ፡፡ ብዙ ህዝብ ነው ያለው እዚህ፡፡ እነሱ በሚሉት ቀን ውስጥ ተጠቃልሎ የሚወጣ ህዝብ አይደለም ያለው፡፡ " 

**አሁን ባለው ሁኔታ ስጋታቸው** **ምንድነው ?**

" ህዝቡን ከሰበሰቡት በኋላ፣ ምንድነው የሚያደርጉት፣ ከብዛቱ አኳያ አንድ ቀን እንኳን ቁርስ ለማብላት የሚቸገሩ ይመስለኛል፣ የት ነው የሚሰበስቡት፣ በምንድነው የሚያጓጉዙት የሚለውን አልጠቀሱም፡፡ 

መንግስት ስደተኛውን ከሰበሰበ በኋላ ምን ያደርገዋል የሚለውን አናውቅም፡፡ በአንድ ወር ጊዜ ውስጥ፣ እንኳን ሀገር መልቀቅ ይቅርና፣ ከቤት ኪራይ ለመልቀቅ እንኳን ይከብዳል፡፡ ዝግጅት ያስፈልጋል፣ መጠለያ አልተዘጋጀም፣ እኛ ህዝብ ነን፣ ክብር ይገባናል፡፡

እኛ የትልቅ ሀገር ዜጎች ነን፣ ለመንግስታችንና ለሀገራችን ክብር ሊኖራቸው ይገባል፡፡ 200 ሺህ ህዝብ ሰብስበው ምንድነው የሚያደርጉት፣ እንዴት ነው የሚያጓጉዙት፣ ግልፅ አይደለም፡፡ ያለው ሁኔታ በጣም ከባድ ነው፡፡

እዚህ ሀገር 20 አመት ኖሬያለሁ፣ በግንባታ ስራዎች ላይ ነው የምሰራው፡፡ በዚህ ስራ ነው ቤተሰቦቼን የማስተዳድረው፡፡ የ 8 ልጆች አባት ነኝ፡፡ አምስቱ ልጆቼ ተማሪዎች ናቸው፣ ከሶስተኛ እስከ ዘጠነኛ ክፍል ይማራሉ፡፡ እነዚህ ልጆች ከትምህርታቸው አቋርጬ ወደ ሀገራቸው እንዴት ነው የማጓጉዛቸው፣ ጨንቆኛል፣ እንቅልፍ አጥቻለሁ፡፡ ይህ የሁሉም ኢትዮጵያዊ ጭንቀት ነው፡፡

ሰው በተለያየ መንገድ እየወጣ ነው አሁንም፡፡ አልወጣም እንዳላለ ይህ ማሳያ ነው፡፡ ግን ንብረት፣ ሀብትና ቤተሰብ ያለው ነው ጊዜ ስጡን እያለ ያለው፡፡ ረዘም ያለና ሰፋ ያለ ጊዜ ተሰጥቶን ቢሆን ኖሮ፣ እስካሁንም ባልቆየን ነበር፡፡ 

አሁንም የምንማፀነው ራሳችንን አዘጋጅተን፣ የልጆቻችንንም ሰርተፊኬት ይዘን በሰላም ሳንንገላታ እንወጣለን ነው፡፡

መንግስታችንም ጫና ያድርግ፣ ይታደገን፣ ከስቃይና መከራ ያድነን፡፡ በክብር እንድንሸኝ ነው የምንፈልገው ከዚህ ሀገር፡፡ እንደ ፍየል ታንቀን፣ ንብረታችንን አስጥለውን ከሚያስወጡን፣ መንግስት ጊዜ በማስጨመሩ በኩል ቢተባበረን መልካም ነው፡፡ "

ቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ
አዲስ አበባ

**" A Djiboutian citizen who associates with illegal immigrants has been warned that he will be fined between 50,000 and 500,000 francs" - Ethiopian living in Djibouti

**
The Djiboutian government has announced that the order issued a month ago for undocumented immigrants to leave the country will expire today, April 25, 2017. 

Djiboutian authorities also held a discussion on the same issue on RTD WEB TV yesterday and last night.

Ato Mohamed Yayo Juhar, who told us that he was present at the discussion, explained to Tikvah Ethiopia what the officials discussed.

**Ato Mohamed Yayo Juhar:**

" Among the people who spoke on television was a general and a lawyer. They were telling Djiboutians that if they are found to be working with someone who is not a legal resident, they will be fined.

They said that this fine would range from 50,000 to 500,000 Djiboutian francs. They also warned citizens with legal documents to carry their IDs with them during the days after the deadline. They also said that they have a tool to verify that it is a valid document. 

They ordered the people of Djibouti to pay their workers. They also said that they should pay their workers' salaries within the given time limit, treat them in an orderly manner, and not cause them any problems. 

In general, however, I understand that the authorities have made sufficient preparations to deport undocumented immigrants. The police, the public The security and military are all government agencies ready. 

They said that first of all, they will evacuate those on the streets, then they will conduct a search in all the settlements. In fact, they have already prepared, and they will protect new people from entering Djibouti. " They explained the topic of the discussion. 

Maybe they will not start the deportation campaign on Saturday, but they will start it later. 

There is something that is not clearly stated in their discussion. There are a lot of people here. They are not the people who will leave in one day as they say. " 

**What is their concern in the current situation** **?**

" After they gather the people, what will they do, I think they will have difficulty eating breakfast even for a day, given the number, they did not mention where they will gather them, how they will transport them. 

We do not know what the government will do after gathering the refugees. In a month, it is difficult to even leave the country, let alone move out of the house rent. Preparation is needed, shelter is not prepared, we are the people, we deserve respect.

We are citizens of a big country, we should have respect for our government and our country. What are they doing with 200 thousand people, how are they transporting them, it is not clear. The current situation is very difficult.

I have lived in this country for 20 years, I work in construction. This is how I manage my family. I am a father of 8 children. Five of my children are students, studying from third to ninth grade. How will I transport these children to their country after dropping out of school, I am worried, I have lost sleep. This is the concern of all Ethiopians.

People are leaving in different ways. This is an example of not saying I will not leave. But those who have property, wealth and family are saying, give us time. If we had been given a longer and more extensive time, we would not have stayed here. 

We still pray that we will prepare ourselves, take our children's certificates and leave peacefully without any harassment.

Our government should also pressure us, protect us, save us from suffering and hardship. We want to leave this country with honor. It would be good if the government cooperated with us by extending the time, as we are being treated like goats, taking away our property and expelling us. "

Tikvah Ethiopia
Addis Ababa

#ሰሌዳ

በኢትዮጵያ የተሽከርካሪ ሰሌዳ (ታርጋ) ለውጥ ለማድረግ የሚያስችል መመሪያ ጸድቋል። 

መመሪያው የተሸከርካሪ የመለያ ቁጥር ሰሌዳ ዓይነቶችና ምልክቶች መወሰኛ እና የአገልግሎት አሰጣጥ መመሪያ ቁጥር 1050/2017 ነው።

የትራንስፖርትና ሎጂስቲክስ ሚኒስትር አማካሪ ከድልማግስት ኢብራሂም፤ " የሰሌዳ ለውጡ ዋና ምክንያት ኢትዮጵያ የተቀበለቻቸውን ዓለም አቀፍ ስምምነቶች ታሳቢ ያደረገ ሰሌዳ እንዲኖር ለማስቻል ነው " ብለዋል።

ከዚህ ቀደም በነበረው የተሽከርካሪ መለያ ቁጥር ሰሌዳ ፦
- የአመራረት እና አሰረጫጨት ችግር፣
- የአወጋገድ ችግር፣
- የአሰራር ክፍተት፣ 
- የሀብት ብክነት፣
- በሲስተም የተደገፈ ስራ አለመኖር ችግር እንደነበር ጠቁመዋል።

ከዚህ በፊት ከነበረው አሰራር ጋር ተያይዞ የዕለት የተላላፊ እና የቋሚ መለያ ቁጥር ሰሌዳ አገልግሎት አሰጣጥ ለፎርጅሪ ለብልሹ አሰራር ለበርከታ ወንጀሎች የተጋለጠ በመሆኑ ይህ መመሪያ ችግሩን ይቀርፋል ሲሉ አስረድተዋል።

" መመሪያው በመላ ሀገሪቱ ተግባራዊ የሚደረግ ሲሆን፤ በተመዘገቡና ለምዝገባ በሚቀርቡ ተሽከርካሪዎች፣ በተሽከርካሪ አምራች /አስመጪ/ገጣጣሚ ድርጅቶች፣ በተሽከርካሪ መዝጋቢ አካላት እንዲሁም በኢትዮጵያ በሚገኙ እና አህጉር አቀፍ ተቋማት እና በግለሰቦች ላይ ተፈጻሚ ይሆናል " ብለዋል።

የተሽከርካሪ መለያ ቁጥር ሰሌዳ ዓይነቶች እና ምልክቶች ዓለም አቀፍ ስምምነቶችን መሰረት በማድረግ፣ በሀገር አቀፍ ደረጃ የመለያ ቁጥር ሰሌዳ አገልግሎት ይዘት በዓይነት እና በመጠን ወጥ እንዲሆን ለማድረግ፣ የመለያ ቁጥር ሰሌዳ ምርት ስርጭት አወጋገድ የተሸከርካሪ መረጃ አያያዝ ቁጥጥሩ በቴክኖሎጂ የተደገፈ ለማድርግ የመመሪያው ዓላማ መሆኑ ተብራርቷል፡፡ #ኤፍኤምሲ

A directive has been approved in Ethiopia to change the vehicle license plate (Targa). 

The directive is Directive No. 1050/2017 on the Determination of Vehicle License Plate Types and Symbols and Service Provision.

Advisor to the Minister of Transport and Logistics, Kedalmagist Ibrahim, said, "The main reason for the license plate change is to enable Ethiopia to have a plate that takes into account the international agreements it has accepted."

He pointed out that the previous vehicle license plate:
- Production and assembly problems,
- Transportation problems,
- Operational gaps,
- Waste of resources,
- Lack of system-supported work.

He explained that the provision of daily temporary and permanent license plate services in connection with the previous system was vulnerable to forgery, corruption, and criminal offenses, so this directive will solve the problem.

"The directive will be implemented throughout the country; it will be applicable to registered and registered vehicles, vehicle manufacturers/importers/assembly companies, vehicle registration bodies, as well as institutions and individuals in Ethiopia and across the continent," he said.

Vehicle Number Plate Types and Symbols Based on international agreements, the purpose of the directive is to ensure that the content of the number plate service is consistent in type and size at the national level, and to ensure that the distribution and management of number plate production and vehicle information management are supported by technology. #FMC

ብፁዕ አቡነ ጴጥሮስ (ዶ/ር)፣ ብፁዕ አቡነ ቴዎፍሎስ (ዶ/ር) እና ብፁዕ አቡነ ያዕቆብ በኢትዮጵያ ኦርቶዶክስ ተዋሕዶ ቤተክርስቲያን ቅዱስ ሲኖዶስ ስብሰባ ለመገኘት እንዲችሉ መንግሥት የሚጠበቅበትን ሁሉ እንደሚያደርግ አሳወቀ።

መንግሥት ዛሬ ምሽት ባወጣው መግለጫ ፥ " ከዚህ በፊት አንዳንድ ወገኖች በፈጠሩት ችግር የተነሣ በኢትዮጵያ ኦርቶዶክስ ቤተ ክርስቲያን ሲኖዶስ ጉባኤ ለመሳተፍ ላልቻሉ ሦስት አባቶች ሁኔታዎች መመቻቸታቸውን አሳውቃለሁ " ብሏል።

በመግለጫው ፤ ሀገራዊ ተቋማት ለሀገረ መንግሥት ግንባታ ያላቸውን የላቀ ሚና   በመረዳት በኢትዮጵያ ኦርቶዶክስ ቤተ ክርስቲያን አባቶች መካከል የተፈጠረው መለያየት እንዲፈታ የመሪነቱን ሚና መጫወቱን አስታውሷል።

የኢትዮጵያ ኦርቶዶክስ ቤተ ክርስቲያን በሀገር ግንባታ የነበራትንና የሚኖራትን ሚና በመገንዘብ አስፈላጊውን ድጋፍ ሲሰጥ መቆየቱን በዚህ አቋሙም እንደሚቀጥል ገልጿል።

" ይሄንን ያልተረዱ አንዳንድ አካላት ችግሮችን ፈጥረው የነበረ ቢሆንም እንኳን፣ መንግሥት ለቤተ ክርስቲያንዋ እና ለምእመንዋ ሲል በሆደ ሰፊነት ለማለፍ ወስኗል " ብሏል።

መግለጫው " አንዳንድ አካላት " ያላቸውን እና የፈጠሩትን ችግሮች በግልጽ ያላብራራ ቢሆንም ችግሩ እንዲፈታ ሲኖዶሱ ጥያቄ ማቅረቡንና ይህንንም ጥያቄ መቀበሉን ይፋ አድርጓል።

" በሂደቱም ተቀራርቦ መነጋገር ከሁሉም የተሻለ የመፍትሔ መንገድ መሆኑ ታይቷል " ብሏል።

ሲኖዶሱ መንግሥት ነገሩን በሆደ ሰፊነት እንዲመለከተው እንደጠየቀና በዚህም ሶስቱ ብፁአን አባቶች ወደ ሀገራቸው ገብተው በቅዱስ ሲኖዶስ ስብሰባ ለመገኘት እንዲችሉ የሚጠበቅበትን ሁሉ እንደሚያደርግ አሳውቋል።

#EOTC

The government has announced that it will do everything possible to ensure that His Holiness Abune Petros (Dr.), His Holiness Abune Theofilos (Dr.) and His Holiness Abune Yacob can attend the Holy Synod of the Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church.

In a statement issued this evening, the government said, "I would like to inform you that the conditions have been improved for the three patriarchs who were unable to attend the Synod of the Ethiopian Orthodox Church due to problems created by some parties."

In the statement, he recalled that he played a leading role in resolving the differences between the patriarchs of the Ethiopian Orthodox Church, recognizing the great role that national institutions play in state building.

He stated that he has been providing the necessary support, recognizing the role that the Ethiopian Orthodox Church has had and will have in nation building, and will continue to do so.

"Although some elements who did not understand this have created problems, the government has decided to be generous for the sake of the church and its believers," he said.

Although the statement did not clearly explain the problems that "some elements" have and have created, it announced that the Synod had made a request to resolve the problem and that it had accepted this request.

"In the process, it has been shown that close dialogue is the best way to resolve the issue," he said.

The Synod announced that it had asked the government to look into the matter generously and that it would do everything possible to allow the three blessed fathers to enter their country and attend the Holy Synod meeting.

message:
#ብስክሌት #ስኩተር

**የአዲስ አበባ ከተማ አስተዳደር የብስክሌት መጋራት አገልግሎት እና የብስክሌት መስመር አጠቃቀም ደንብ ቁጥር 183/2017** **ምን ይላል ?**

የአዲስ አበባ ከተማ አስተዳደር የሞተር አልባ ትራንስፖርት አገልግሎትን ለማስፋፋት እየሰራ እንደሆነ አመልክቷል።

ይህንንም ለማድረግ በኮሪደር ስራዎች ለሞተር አልባ ትራንስፖርት አገልግሎት የሚሰጡ መንገዶች መሰራታቸውን ጠቁሟል።

ከዚህ ጋር በተያያዘም የብስክሌት መጋራት አገልግሎት እና የብስክሌት መስመር አጠቃቀም ደንብ ይፋ አድርጓል።

**ደንቡ ምን ይላል ?**

በብስክሌት የትራንስፖርት አገልግሎት ዘርፍ የሚሰራ ሰው " የኦፕሬተርነት የሥራ ፈቃድ " ማውጣት ይጠበቅበታል።

በኦፕሬተርነት ሥራ ለመሰማራት የሚፈልግ ማንኛውም ሰው የሥራ ፈቃድ ለማግኘት የተለያዩ መስፈርቶች ማሟላት አለበት።

ከነዚህም ውስጥ አንዱ የብስክሌት ወይም ስኩተር ብዛትን ይመለከታል።

ፈቃድ ለማግኘት ብዛቱ 300 (ሦስት መቶ) እና ከዚያ በላይ የብስክሌት እና/ወይም ከ100 (አንድ መቶ) የማያንስ ስኩተር ለአገልግሎት ማቅረብ መቻል ይኖርበታል።

እንዲሁም ደረጃውን የጠበቀ ጂፒኤስ ያለው ወይም የተገጠመለት ብስክሌት ማቅረብ መቻል ይኖርበታል።

የኦፕሬተርነት ፈቃድ ለማግኘት፣ ለማሳደስ ወይም ለመቀየር  የአገልግሎት ክፍያ አለው። በዚህም ፦
- የኦፕሬተርነት የሥራ ፈቃድ ለማግኘት ብር 8,000.00 (ስምንት ሺህ ብር)፤
- የኦፕሬተርነት የሥራ ፈቃድ ለማደስ ብር 5,000.00 (አምስት ሺህ ብር)፤ ወይም
- የጠፋን የኦፕሬተርነት የሥራ ፈቃድ ለመተካት ብር 4,000.00 (አራት ሺህ ብር) መክፈል አለበት።

ለብስክሌት መጋራት አገልግሎት የክፍያ ታሪፍም ይወጣል ተብሎ ይጠበቃል።

**ደንቡ ስለ ተጠቃሚዎች ምን ይላል ?**

እድሜያቸው ከ15 ዓመት በታች የሆኑ ሕጻናት በብስክሌት መስመሩ የሚገለገሉት ከወላጆቻቸው ወይም ከአሰዳጊዎቸቸው ጋር ሲሆኑ ብቻ ይሆናል።

ከኦፕሬተሩ አገልግሎት የሚያገኝ ተጠቃሚስ ?
➡️ የሚመቸውን የብስክሌት አይነት የመምረጥ መብት አለው።
➡️ የቴክኒክ ችግር ሲገጥም በመተላለፊያ ጣቢያ ላይ ከሚገኘው ብስክሌት በመቀየር ጉዞውን የማጠናቀቅ መብት አለው።

ደንቡ ተጠቃሚዎች ተጨማሪ ሰው መጫን እንደማይችሉ ይገልጻል።

**ኦፕሬተር ለአገልግሎት የሚያቀርበው ብስክሌት ምን አይነት ነው ?**

ብስክሌቱት የተመረተበት ዘመን ከሁለት ዓመት ያልበለጠ መሆን አለበት።

የብስክሌቱ ዓይነት ሃይብሪድ፣ በኤሌክትሪክ ባትሪ ወይም በማንዋል የሚሰራ መሆን እንዳለበትም ተገልጿል።

የብስክሌት የቀለም ዓይነት አንድ ወጥ ሆኖ ከሌላው ኦፕሬተር ጋር የማይመሳሰል፤ መሆን አለበትም ይላል ደንቡ።

**Addis Ababa City Administration Bicycle Sharing Service and Bicycle Lane Usage Regulation No. 183/2017** **What does it say?**

Addis Ababa City Administration has indicated that it is working to expand non-motorized transportation services.

To do this, it has indicated that corridor works have been carried out to provide non-motorized transportation services.

In this regard, it has also announced the Bicycle Sharing Service and Bicycle Lane Usage Regulation.

**What does the regulation say?**

A person working in the bicycle transportation service sector is required to obtain an "operator's work permit".

Anyone who wants to work as an operator must meet various requirements to obtain a work permit.

One of these is the number of bicycles or scooters.

To obtain a permit, the number of bicycles or scooters must be 300 (three hundred) and more and/or not less than 100 (one hundred) scooters for service.

They must also be able to provide a bicycle with or equipped with a GPS.

There is a service fee for obtaining, renewing or changing an operator’s license. This includes:
- Birr 8,000.00 (eight thousand birr) to obtain an operator’s license;
- Birr 5,000.00 (five thousand birr) to renew an operator’s license; or
- Birr 4,000.00 (four thousand birr) to replace a lost operator’s license.

It is expected that a fee will be charged for bike sharing services.

**What does the regulation say about users?**

Children under the age of 15 can only use the bike lane when accompanied by their parents or guardians.

What about users who receive services from the operator?
➡️ They have the right to choose the type of bicycle that suits them.
➡️ In case of technical problems, the user has the right to change bikes at the transfer station and complete the trip.

The rule states that users cannot carry more than one person.

**What type of bike does the operator provide for service?**

The bike must be no more than two years old.

The type of bike must be hybrid, electric or manual.

The rule also states that the color of the bike must be uniform and not similar to that of another operator.

Furthermore, an operator cannot operate outside the service and route for which it has been granted an operator's license.

**What does the rule prohibit users from doing?**

- Loading more than the permitted load capacity;
- Eating, drinking, using a mobile phone, smoking while riding a bike;
- Riding a user rented from the operator outside the agreed route;
- Riding a bicycle in a manner that causes danger and disrupts the movement of other bicycle users;
- Riding a bicycle without the handlebars or holding the handlebars with your feet;
- Not giving way to vehicles crossing the bicycle lane and pedestrians during movement;
- Riding a bicycle or on a bicycle lane without permission from the appropriate authority is prohibited.

**What does the regulation say about penalties?**

Any operator:

➡️ Providing services without a GPS or with a GPS that does not work will be fined 3,000 birr.
➡️ Paying more than the approved tariff will be fined 3,400 birr.
➡️ Installing an additional device on the bicycle will be fined 5,000 birr.
➡️ Providing services without an operator's license or without renewing it will be fined 10,000 birr.
➡️ Providing unauthorized bicycle painting services will be fined 10,000 birr.
➡️ Using labels used by another operator will be fined 10,000 birr.
➡️ Operating outside the operator's service and service and travel route will be fined 10,000 birr.

Any user:-

🔴 If found carrying more than the permitted load capacity, a fine of 600 birr will be imposed.
🔴 Eating, drinking, using a mobile phone, smoking while riding a bicycle will be fined 500 birr.
🔴 If a user rented from the operator rides outside the agreed route, a fine of 1,500 birr will be imposed.
🔴 Disturbing the movement of other bicycle path users and riding a bicycle in a dangerous manner will be fined 500 birr.

**__" አስተማሪ ተማሪውን የመምታት መብት የለውም በተማሪዋ ላይ ያደረሰችው ቅጣት ቀላልም ቢሆን እንኳ የአካል ጉዳት በማድረስ በህግ ያስጠይቃታል__ __" - የህግ ባለሙያ__**

__" የቤት ስራ አልሰራሽም " በማለት የሁለተኛ ክፍል ተማሪዋን ተገቢ ያልሆነና አጸያፊ የሆነ ቅጣት የቀጣችው መምህርት ከስራ ታግዳ በህግ ቁጥጥር ስር መደረጓ መገለፁ ይታወሳል።

በመሆኑም መምህርቷ በተማሪዋ ላይ የወሰደችው እርምጃ በህገመንግስቱ አንደት ይታያል ሲል ቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ የህግ ባለሙያ ጠይቋል።

የህግ አማካሪና ጠበቃ ሳሙኤል ግርማ መምህርቷ የወሰደችው እርምጃ " ቀላል የአካል ጉዳት በማድረስ በወንጀል ህጉ 5/ 35 እስከ 3 አመት ፅኑ እስራት ቅጣት " ሊጠብቃት አንደሚችል ተናግረዋል።__

**__የህግ ባለሙያው ምን አሉ ?__**

" __አስተማሪ ተማሪውን የመምታት መብት የለውም በተማሪዋ ላይ ያደረሰችው ቅጣት ቀላልም ቢሆን እንኳ የአካል ጉዳት በማድረስ በህግ ያስጠይቃታል፣ በወንጀል ህጉ ደግሞ 5/ 35 እስከ 3 አመት ያሳስራል፣ ይህ ድርጊት ግን ከዚህም ባለፈ ነው የሚታየው " ብለዋል።

አክለውም " በአስተማሪ የዲስፕሊን መመሪያ በአስተዳደራዊ እርምጃ ከስራዋ ልትሰናበት የሚያስችል ወንጀል ነው " ሲሉ ገልጸዋል።

የህግ ባለሙያው " መምህሯ ቅጣት ያደረሰችባት ተማሪ ከ13 አመት በታች ታዳጊ ከሆነች ይሄ ተገቢ ያልሆነ እና በወንጀል የሚያስጠይቅ ግልፅ የሆነ ጉዳይ ነው " ሲሉ አስረድተዋል።

" መምህሯ ተማሪዋን የመታችበት መሳሪያ ወይም ቁስ የቅጣቱን መጠን ይወስነዋል " ያሉ ሲሆን  በእንጨት፣ በድንጋይ እና በመሳሰሉት ሆኖ በልጅቷ አካል ላይ መፋፋቅ፣ መድማት የአጥንት መሰበር አይነት ጉዳት ከሆነ ያደረሰችባት ከዚህም ከፍ ያለ ቅጣት ሊጠብቃት እንደሚችል ጠቁመዋል።

በተለይም መምህር፣ ሹፌር እና ሀኪሞች በስራ ያገኟቸውን ሰዎች የበለጠ የመጠበቅ ሃላፊነት አለባቸው። ይሄም እንደ ወንጀል ማክበጃ ይታያል ብለዋል።

የህግ ባለሙያው ሳሙኤል ይሄ ጉዳይ ይፋ መደረጉ እና በመምህርቷ ላይ የሚወሰደው እርምጃ ለሌሎች አስተማሪዎች መማሪያ የሚሆን ነው ሲሉ ገልጸዋል።

" በመጨረሻም አሁን ላይ ተማሪዎችን አንደድሮው አይነት ቅጣቶች መቅጣት አይቻልም፣ ምክንያቱም  ከህፃናት መብት ጋር የሚጣረስ ነው " ሲሉ አመላክተዋል።__

**__"A teacher has no right to hit a student. Even if the punishment she inflicted on her student is light, she will be held accountable by law for causing bodily harm. __" - Lawyer__**

__It is worth noting that a teacher who punished her second grade student with an inappropriate and offensive punishment for saying, "You didn't do your homework," was suspended from work and placed under legal supervision.

Therefore, the teacher's action against her student is considered to be in accordance with the Constitution, Tikvah Ethiopia asked a lawyer.

Legal advisor and lawyer Samuel Girma said that the teacher's actions "may be punishable by imprisonment for a term of 5/35 to 3 years for causing minor bodily harm." 

**__What did the lawyer say?__**

" __A teacher does not have the right to hit a student. Even if the punishment she inflicted on her student is minor, she is legally liable for causing minor bodily harm, and under the criminal law, she is also liable for imprisonment for a term of 5/35 to 3 years, but this act goes beyond that," he said. 

He added, "It is a crime that can lead to administrative action for the teacher's dismissal from her job under the teacher's disciplinary guidelines." 

The lawyer explained, "If the student the teacher punished is a minor under 13 years of age, this is clearly an inappropriate and criminal matter." 

"The weapon or object with which the teacher hit the student will determine the amount of punishment," he said, noting that if the girl's body was injured, such as a knife, a stone, or something similar, she could face a higher punishment.

Teachers, drivers, and doctors in particular have a greater responsibility to protect the people they work with. This is seen as a crime, he said.

Lawyer Samuel said that the disclosure of this case and the action taken against the teacher will serve as a lesson to other teachers.

"Finally, it is not possible to punish students with the same punishments now, because it violates the rights of children," he said. __

ከሰሞኑን በኦሮሚያ ክልል አርሲ ዞን ስሬ ወረዳ ወደ 50 የሚሆኑ ሰዎችን አሳፍሮ ሲጓዝ በነበረ ተሽከርካሪ ላይ ታጣቂዎችግድያና እገታ ፈጽመዋል።

እገታውን ተፈጸመ የተባለው ከአዳማ ከተማ በቅርብ ርቀት በሚገኝ በተለምዶ " ቀለጣ ወንዝ " ተብሎ በሚጠራው ስፍራ መሆኑን የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ተናግረዋል።

በርካታ ተሳፋሪዎች ታግተው እንደተወሰዱ፣ ሰሞኑን ሊዳር የነበረ ሙሸራ እንደተገደለ፣ ታጋቾች ራቅ ያለ ቦታ ተወስደው ገንዘብ እየተጠየቀባቸው መሆኑን፣ ከታጋቾች መካከል የተለቀቁም እንዳሉ ነዋሪዎች ነግረውናል።

ሟችን፣ ታጋቾችን በቅርበት የሚያውቁ አንድ አካል በበኩላቸው፣ " ሁሌም ሰኞ፣ ሰኞ ከስሬ ወደ አዳማ ምልልስ የሚበዛበት የገበያ ቀን ነው። ከስሬ ወደ አዳማ በሚሄድ ቅጥቅጥ አይሱዙ ተሳፍረው ከነበሩ ሰዎች የተወሰኑ ሰዎችን መርጠው ወስደዋቸዋል " ሲሉ ገልጸዋል።

" ሟቹንም ልጅ አውቀዋለሁ " ያሉት እኚሁ አካል ታጣቂዎቹ ተኩሰው እንደገደሉት ከእገታ የተለቀቁ ልጆች መናገራቸውን አስረድተዋል።

" ሟቹ ጅብ በልቶት የተወሰነ እጅና የተወሰነ ቁርጥራጭ አካሉ ነው የተገኘው። በማግስቱም ተኩስ ስለነበረ ሌላም ሰው ሞቶ እንደሚሆን ተሰግቶ ነበር " ሲሉም ተናግረዋል።

ከእገታ የተለቀቁት የተወሰኑ ታጋቾች ከፍተኛ መደናገጥ ውስጥ በመሆናቸው ለሚዲያ ማብራሪያ ለመስጠት እንደሰጉ፣ ከ50 ከተሳፋሪዎቹ መካከል 25 ወንድና ሴቶች ተመርጠው እንደታገቱም እኚሁ አካል ነግረውናል።

" ሟቹ የፊታችን እሁድ ነበር ሰርጉ፣ ተኩሰው ገደሉት። ጅብ ልቶት የተገኘው በጣም ጥቂት አካሉ ነው። ለወላጅ ስነ ልቦና ሲባል ህዝቡ ተሰብስቦ የተገኘውን ቀብሯል። ስሬ ኪዳነ ምህረት ቤተክርስቲያን ረቡዕ ቀብሩ ተፈጽሟል " ነው ያሉት።__

__በእገታው ተወሰዱ ስለተባሉ ተሳፋሪዎች ማብራሪያ ለማግኘት ወደ ክልሉ ኮሚዩኒኬሽን ቢሮ ሙከራ ብናደርግም ቢሮው የስልክም ሆነ የመልዕክት ምላሽ አልሰጠም።

__**" He was married last Sunday, they shot him dead. He was eaten by hyenas, only a few of his remains were found" - Relative of the deceased
**
A vehicle carrying about 50 people was recently hijacked and killed by gunmen in the Oromia Regional State of Oromia, Arsi Zone, Sere Woreda.

The hijacking reportedly took place in a place known as "Keleta River", a short distance from Adama city, according to local residents.

Residents told Tikvah Ethiopia that several passengers were kidnapped, that a groom who was about to get married was killed, that the hostages were being taken to a remote location and demanded money, and that some of the hostages were released.

A source close to the hostages said, "Monday is always a busy market day from Sere to Adama. They picked some people from the Isuzu bus that was on the way from Sere to Adama and took them away."

"I know the deceased child," the source said, adding that the children who were released from the hostages said that the gunmen shot and killed them.

"The deceased was eaten by hyenas, and some of his hands and some of his body parts were found. The next day, there was shooting, so it was feared that another person would be dead."

Some of the hostages who were released from the hostages were in a state of shock and were afraid to give a statement to the media, and 25 men and women out of 50 passengers were selected and kidnapped, the source told us.

"The deceased was shot dead on Sunday. Only a few of his remains were found. The people gathered and buried what was found for the sake of the parents' mental health. The funeral was held at the Sere Kidane Mihret Church on Wednesday," they said. __

__We tried to reach the regional communications office for an explanation about the passengers who were allegedly taken away by the hijacking, but the office did not respond to phone calls or messages.

"The political crisis in Tigray is leading to a worse situation, with no winners or losers, and is leading Tigray and its people to a worse situation," the Tigray Civil Society Alliance said in a statement.

"The interim council established by the existing interim administration should allow the new interim administration to continue and exercise its power to monitor the use of public and national budgets for its intended purposes," it said.

**" ፕላስቲክን በሚመለከት የወጣው ህግ እንደ ሃገር የተወሰደ ጥሩ የሚባል ከአካባቢ ጥበቃ ጋር ተያይዞ የተወሰነ ውሳኔ ነው " -ኢንዱስትሪ ሚኒስቴር **

ከሚያዚያ 25 እስከ 29/2017 ዓ/ም የሚካሄደውን የኢትዮጵያ ታምርት ኤክስፖ ዝግጅትን በሚመለከት የኢፌዲሪ ኢንዱስትሪ ሚኒስቴር ሚኒስትር አቶ መላኩ አለበል ማብራሪያ ሰጥተው ነበር።

በዚህም ወቅት ለቀረቡላቸው ጥያቄዎች ምላሽ እና ማብራሪያ ሰጥተዋል። 

ከተነሱላቸው ጥያቄዎች መከል፦ 

• " የደረቅ ቆሻሻ አወጋገድ እና አያያዝን አስመልክቶ የተሻሻለው ረቂቅ አዋጅ ለአንድ ጊዜ ጥቅም አገልግሎት ላይ የሚውሉ የፕላስቲክ ምርቶችን የሚያግድ በመሆኑ ኢንዱስትሪዎች ላይ ሊያመጣ ስለሚችለው ተጽዕኖ ምን ታስቧል? " 

• " ከውጭ የሚገቡ ምርቶችን የመቀነስ እና የሃገር ውስጥ ምርቶችን ከማበረታታት አኳያ ምን እየተሰራ ነው " የሚሉ ጥያቄዎች ይገኙበታል። 

**ሚኒስትሩ** **አቶ መላኩ አለበል ምን መለሱ ?** 

" ገቢ ምርትን የመተካት ስራ እና ተያይዞ ያሉ ጉዳዮችን በተመለከተ ትኩረት መሰጠት ስላለበት ይህንን ለማስፈጸም ስትራቴጂ አዘጋጅተናል። በስትራቴጂያችን መሰረት ካሉን አጠቃላይ ኢንዱስትሪዎች ፣የሰው ሃይል አቅም ፣ከግብአት እና ከመሳሰሉት አኳያ 96 አይነት ምርቶች በአስቸኳይ ልንተካቸው እንችላለን ብለን ለይተናል። 

2017 ዓ/ም 3.1 ቢሊየን ዶላር የሚያወጡ ከውጪ የሚመጡ ምርቶችን መተካት ተችሏል። 

አንዳንድ ምርቶች መቶ በመቶ የተተኩ አሉ አንዳንዶቹ ከመተካት አልፎ ለጎረቤት ሃገራት እያቀረብን ነው ለምሳሌ የሚሊተሪ ልብስ እና ብቅልን ማየት ይቻላል። 

83 ምርቶች ኤክስፖርት ብናደርጋቸው ተወዳዳሪ ሊያደርጉን ይችላሉ ተብለው ተለይተዋል። 

አለም አቀፍ ሁኔታው የተረባባበሸ እና በብዙ ሁኔታ ችግር ያለበት ስለሆነ አብዛኞቹ ምርቶች ከሚገዛባቸው ሃገር ጭምር ለመተነበይ ያስቸገሩ ነገሮች በመኖራቸው ምክንያት ለህብረተሰቡ ምርትን ከሃገር ውስጥ መግዛት አስተማማኝ እና የተሻለ ነው። 

ፕላስቲክን በሚመለከት የወጣው ህግ እንደ ሃገር የተወሰደ ጥሩ የሚባል ከአካባቢ ጥበቃ ጋር ተያይዞ የተወሰነ ውሳኔ ነው። 

በርካታ ውሃማ አካላት በተለይም በከተማ መግቢያ አካባቢ ብንመለከት በፌስታል የተሞላ ነው አንዳንድ የአፍሪካ ሃገራት ቀደም ብለው ከፕላስቲክ ምርት ራሳቸውን ነጻ አድርገዋል። 

በቀጣይ አካባቢ ጥበቃ ላይ ተጽዕኖ እንዳይኖር የግድ ማሻሻል ያለብንን ነገር ማሻሻል ስለሚጠበቅ የፕላስቲክ ምርቶችን በሚመለከት የተወሰነው ውሳኔ ትክክል ነው። 

አዋጁ ፕላስቲክ አምራቾች መቼ እና እንዴት ስራቸውን ያቆማሉ የሚለውን ለማስፈጸምም የተሰጠ ጊዜ አለ መለስ ብሎ መመልከት ያስፈልጋል። 

ከፕላስቲክ ስናገኝ የነበረውን አገልግሎት በምን አማራጭ ምርቶች ለመተካት ታስቧል ? የሚለውን በሚመለከት በኬሚካል ምርምር ማዕከሎቻችን ያሉ ተመራማሪዎች ፕላስቲክን የሚተኩ አካባቢ ተስማሚ የሆኑ ምርቶችን አግኝተው ሰርተፍኬት ወስደዋል። 

ይህንን ምርት ወደ ኢንዱስትሪዎች እያስተዋወቅን ስለሆነ በቀጣይ በስፋት እያመረቱ ህብረተሰቡ የሚፈልገውን አገልግሎት እንዲያገኝ መጪው ትውልድ ያልተበከለ አካባቢ እንዲረከብ ማድረግ አስፈላጊ ነው። 

አምራቾች በተወሰነ ማስተካከያ ሪፕርፕዝ (Repurpose) ይደረጋሉ የኮቪድ ጊዜ የመጠጥ፣ የውሃ እና የአልኮን ፋብሪካዎች ሳኒታይዘር እንዲያመርቱ የተደረገበት ጊዜ ነበር ትንንሽ ማስተካከያዎች እየተደረጉላቸው እነዚህ ኢንዱስትሪዎች ሌላ ምርት እንዲያመርቱ ማድረግ የሚቻልበት እድል አለ። 

ከኢንዱስትሪዎቹ ጋር በመመካከር ሰራተኞቻቸውን እንዳይበትኑ ፣የነበራቸውንም ህይወት እንዳያጡ የማድረግ ስራ ይሰራል " ብለዋል።

ከሚያዚያ 25 እስከ 29/2017 ዓ/ም የኢትዮጵያ ታምርት ኤክስፖ ይካሄዳል።

**"The law on plastic is a good decision taken by the country in connection with environmental protection" - Ministry of Industry **

The Minister of Industry of the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia, Ato Melaku Alebel, gave a briefing on the Ethiopian Industry Expo to be held from April 25 to 29/2017.

During this time, he responded to and provided explanations to the questions presented to him. 

Some of the questions raised include: 

• "What is the impact of the revised draft proclamation on solid waste management and disposal that prohibits single-use plastic products on industries?" 

• "What is being done to reduce imports and promote domestic products?" 

**Minister** **What did Mr. Melaku say?** 

"We have prepared a strategy to implement this, as attention should be paid to the work of replacing imported products and related issues. According to our strategy, we have identified 96 types of products that we can replace urgently in terms of our general industries, human resources, inputs, etc. 

In 2017, 3.1 billion dollars worth of imported products were replaced. 

Some products have been replaced 100 percent, some of them are even being supplied to neighboring countries, for example, military clothing and malt can be seen. 

83 products have been identified as being competitive if we export them. 

Since the international situation is chaotic and problematic in many ways, it is safer and better for the community to buy products from the country due to the unpredictable factors that exist even in the country where most products are purchased. 

The law on plastic is as follows: The country has taken a decision related to environmental protection. 

Many water bodies, especially those near the entrance to cities, are full of plastic waste. Some African countries have already freed themselves from plastic products. 

The decision regarding plastic products is correct, as it is expected that we will improve what needs to be improved so that there is no impact on environmental protection in the future. 

The decree also provides a time limit for when and how plastic manufacturers will stop their work. It is necessary to look back. 

Regarding the question of what alternative products are intended to replace the services we used to get from plastic? Researchers at our chemical research centers have found and certified environmentally friendly products that replace plastic. 

Since we are introducing this product to industries, it is important to continue to produce it widely and ensure that the future generation receives an unpolluted environment so that the society can get the services it needs. 

Manufacturers will be repurposed with some adjustments. During the Covid period, drinking water and alcohol factories were allowed to produce sanitizers. There is an opportunity to make these industries produce other products with small adjustments. 

He said that in consultation with the industries, they will work to ensure that their workers are not dispersed and that they do not lose their lives. 

The Ethiopian Fruit Expo will be held from April 25 to 29, 2017. 

Tikvah Ethiopia

**" ያለ ቅድመ ሁኔታ ከስራ መስመር እንድንወጣ መደረጉ ለዘርፈ ብዙ ችግር ዳርጎናል " - የኤሌክትሪክ ባጃጅ አሽከርካሪዎች **

" በመንግስት አበረታችነት በሚሊዮን የሚቆጠር ገንዘብ በብድርና በዋስትና ጭምር አዉጥተን በቅርቡ የገዛናቸዉ የኤሌክትሪክ ባጃጆች በአስፓልት መንገዶች እንዳሰሩ ተደርገዋል ፤ ይህም ለዘርፈ ብዙ ችግር ዳርጎናል " ሲሉ በሀዋሳ ከተማ የሚገኙ አሽከርካሪዎች ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ቅሬታቸውን አሰምተዋል።

እያንዳንዳቸው በ1 ሚሊዮን 2 መቶ ሺ ብር ገዳማ የሚገዙ 140 በላይ ባጃጆች በከተማው እንደሚገኙ የሚገልፁት አሽከርካሪዎቹ ያለ አንዳች ዉይይትና ቅድመ ሁኔታ ካሳለፍነዉ አርብ ጀምሮ " በአስፋልት መንገዶች እንዳይሰሩ ተብለናል " በሚል የትራፊክ ፖሊሶችና የመንገድ ደህንነት አስከባሪዎች የእንቅስቃሴ ገደብ እንደጣሉባቸው አስረድተዋል።

አንድ ስሙ እንዳይገለጽ የፈለገ የኤሌክትሪክ ባጃጅ አሽከርካሪ አስቀድሞ የቤንዚኑን ባጃጅ ይሰራበት እንደነበርና እሱን ሽጦ የወላጆቹን የቤት ካርታ በማስያዝ የኤሌክትሪክ ባጃጅ መግዛቱን ገልጾ ወደ ስራ ከገባ አንድ ወር ባልሞላ ጊዜ ዉስጥ " በአስፋልት  መንገድ መስራት አትችሉም " ተብለን ከስራ መስመር እንድንወጣ ተደርገናል ብለዋል።

ሌላኛዉ ቅሬታ አቅራቢ ደግሞ " ባጃጁን የገዛሁት መንግስት ለጭስ አልባ ሞተሮች የሰጠዉን ትኩረት በሚገባ ካጠናሁ በኋላ ነዉ በድንገት የተወሰደዉ እርምጃ እጅግ አሳዝኖናል " ሲል ተናግሯል።

ከባጃጅ ግዢዉ በተጨማሪ ለ3ኛ ወገን 12 ሺ ብር ገደማ፣ 2 ፐርሰንት ተብሎ ደግሞ 21 ሺ ብር እና ለታርጋ 10 ሺ ብር ከእያንዳንዱ ባጃጅ ለመንግስት ገቢ አድርገናል የሚሉት አሽከርካሪዎቹ  " ከተማዉንና ዘመኑን የሚመጥን ትራንስፖርት ነዉ " ስንባል ቆይተን በድንገት ከመስመር ዉጡ መባላችን ለዘርፈ ብዙ ችግሮች ዳርጎናል ብለዋል።

በባጃጅ ስራዉ 
- ቤተሰብ የሚያስተዳድሩ ፣ 
- ያስያዙትን የቤት ካርታ ለማስለቀቅ በየቀኑ ገንዘብ በባንክ ገቢ የሚያደርጉ
- ባጃጅ በዕቁብ ብር ገዝተዉ የቀን እቁብ የሚጥሉ፣ 
- ልጆች የሚያስተምሩ 
- ቤተሰብ እጃቸዉን የሚጠብቅና ልዩ ልዩ የግዴታ ወጪዎች ያለባቸዉ አሽከርካሪዎች ይበዛሉ የሚሉት ቅሬታ አቅራቢዎቹ ለከተማዉና ለክሉም መንገድና ትራንስፖርት ቢሮ ሄደን ይኸን ሁሉ ገልፀን ብናመለክትም ተገቢውን ምላሽ አላገኘንም ብለዋል።

አንዳድ የመስሪያ ቤቶቹ ባለሙያዎች " ለምን ዉስጥ ለዉጥ እየሰራችሁ ጥያቄ አትጠይቁም " ይላሉ ነገር ግን የባጃጁ ስሪት ለኮብል ስቶን (የድንጋይ ንጣፍ) መንገድ ፍፁም የማይሆንና በቀናት ዉስጥ 'ሲልድ ባትሪዉንና ዲናሞዉን' ከጥቅም ዉጪ የሚያደርግ መሆኑን ገልፀዋል።

ቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ በጉዳዩ ዙሪያ ከሀዋሳ ከተማ መንገድ ልማትና ትራንስፖርት መምሪያ ኃላፊና ምክትል ኃላፊዉ መረጃ ለማግኘት ያደረገዉ ተደጋጋሚ ሙከራ አልተሳካም።

ምላሻቸዉን ስናገኝ የሚናካትት ይሆናል።

**"Unconditional suspension of our work has caused us many problems" - Electric Bike Drivers **

"The electric bikes we recently purchased with millions of dollars in government incentives, including loans and guarantees, have been used on asphalt roads, which has caused us many problems," drivers in Hawassa city complained to Tikvah Ethiopia.

The drivers, who stated that there are more than 140 bikes in the city, each of which costs 1.2 million birr, said that since last Friday, "we have been told not to work on asphalt roads" by traffic police and road safety officials without any discussion or preconditions.

An electric motorbike driver, who asked not to be named, said that he had previously been working on a petrol motorbike and that he had sold it and bought an electric motorbike by selling it and using his parents' house map. Less than a month after starting work, he was told that "you cannot work on asphalt roads."

Another complainant said, "I bought the motorbike after carefully studying the government's focus on smoke-free engines. We are very disappointed by the sudden action taken."

In addition to the motorbike purchase, the drivers said that they have paid about 12,000 birr to a third party, 21,000 birr as 2 percent, and 10,000 birr for the license plate from each motorbike, saying that "it is a transport that suits the city and the times," but being suddenly called out of line has caused us many problems.

The complaints about the Bajaj business include: 
- managing a family, 
- depositing money in the bank every day to clear the house map they have reserved, 
- buying a Bajaj in cash and throwing it away every day, 
- teaching children, 
- taking care of their families and having various mandatory expenses. The complainants said that there are many drivers who go to the city and the Klum Road and Transport Bureau and explain all this, but we did not get a proper response. 

Some experts in the departments say, "Why are you working on a change and not asking questions?" However, they explained that the Bajaj version is not perfect for cobblestone roads and will "burn its battery and dynamo" in a matter of days. 

Tikvah Ethiopia's repeated attempts to get information from the head and deputy head of the Hawassa City Road Development and Transport Department on the issue were unsuccessful.

We will include their responses when we get them.

Tikvah Ethiopia
Hawassa

#Update #የኢትዮጵያውያንድምጽ

የጅቡቲ መንግስት፣ በሚቀጥሉት ቀናት መጠነሰፊ አፈሳ እንደሚያከናውን አስታወቀ።

የጅቡቲ የሀገር ውስጥ ጉዳዮች ሚኒስቴር፣ ዛሬ ከሰዓት ባወጣው ማስታወቂያ፣ በሚቀጥሉት ቀናት በሰነድ አልባ ፍልሰተኞች ላይ መጠነ ሰፊ አፈሳ እንደሚያደርግ አስታውቋል።

የሀገሪቱ ዜጎችም በማንኛውም እንስቃሴያቸውና ጉዞዎቻቸው ህጋዊ መታወቂያዎቻቸውን ይዘው እንዲንቀሳቀሱ እንዲሁም የመኖሪያ ፈቃድ ያላቸው የውጭ ዜጎች ደግሞ ህጋዊ ሰነዶቻቸውን እንዲይዙ አሳስቧል።

ይህንን ማድረግ "በአፈሳው ዘመቻ፣ የዜጎችን ደህንነት ለመጠበቅና የሕግ አስከባሪዎችን ስራ ለማቀላጠፍ ይረዳል" ሲል ነው ማስታወቂያው ያስቀመጠው። ይህን ትዕዛዝ ማክበር በእጅጉ እንደሚመከርም ነው ያስጠነቀቀው።

በተመሳሳይ በትናንትናው ዕለት፣ የጅቡቲ መንግስት ዜጎቹ ለቀጠሩዋቸው ሰራተኞች ደሞዛቸውን እና ሌሎች ቃል የተገባላቸው ጥቅማጥቅሞችን በአግባቡ እንዲከፍሉ የሚያዝም ማስታወቂያ አውጥቶ ነበር።

በተያያዘ መረጃ በሀገረ ጅቡቲ አርታ በምትባል ከተማ በትላንትናው ዕለት የሰነድ አልባ ስደተኞች አፈሳ መጀመሩን ሰምተናል። 

በጅቡቲ የሚገኙ የመረጃ ምንጮች ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ በሰጡት ቃለመጠይቅ ፥ ከጅቡቲ ከተማ 40 ኪሎ ሜትር እርቃ ከምትገኝ የአርታ ከተማ በርካታ ኢትዮጵያዊያን መታፈሳቸውን ገልፀዋል። 

" አንዱ አስተያየት ሰጪ ስደተኞቹን ወደ ኢትዮጵያ ‎አላሥወጧቸዉም። ከአርታ ሰብስበው ነጋድ የሚባል ከዚህ ቀደም የስደተኞች ማቆያ የነበረ ቦታ ላይ አስቀምጠዋቸዋል " ሲል ተናግሯል።

" ቦታው በጣም አስቸጋሪ ለጤና የማይመች መፀዳጃዉም መተኛዉም እዛዉ የሆነ በጣም ሙቀት ያለበት ማቆያ ነዉ አከማችተዉ ያሥቀመጧቸው " በማለት ገልጿል።

ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ የተላከ ቪድዮም ስደተኞቹ ተጭነው ሲጓጓዙ ያሳያል። 

ከአርታ ታፍሰው የተሰበሰቡት ስደተኞችም ወደ ኢትዮጵያ ተባርረው እንደሆነ ለማወቅ ያደረግነው ሙከራ አልተሳካም።

በጅቡቲ መንግስት እየተሰጡ ላሉ ማስጠንቀቂያዎችና ትዕዛዞች፣ በጅቡቲ የሚገኘው የኢትዮጵያ ኤምባሲ ካወጣው ማስታወቂያ ውጭ፣ ከኢትዮጵያ መንግስት እስካሁን ድረስ የተሰጠ ይፋዊ መግለጫ ይሁን ምላሽ የለም፡፡ 

ቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር በዚህ ጉዳይ ዙርያ መግለጫ የሚሰጥ ከሆነ ተከታትሎ የሚያቀርብ ይሆናል፡፡

ቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ

#Update #EthiopianVoice

The Djibouti government has announced that it will conduct a large-scale crackdown on undocumented migrants in the coming days.

In a statement issued this afternoon, the Djibouti Ministry of Interior announced that it will conduct a large-scale crackdown on undocumented migrants in the coming days.

It also urged citizens to carry their legal identification documents with them in all their activities and travels, and foreigners with residence permits to carry their legal documents.

The statement stated that doing so “will help protect the safety of citizens and facilitate the work of law enforcement officers during the crackdown.” It also warned that compliance with this order is highly recommended.

Similarly, yesterday, the Djibouti government issued a statement urging citizens to properly pay their employees their salaries and other promised benefits.

In a related development, we have heard that the deportation of undocumented migrants has begun in the city of Arta, Djibouti, yesterday. 

Sources in Djibouti told Tikvah Ethiopia that many Ethiopians have been deported from the city of Arta, located 40 kilometers from Djibouti City. 

“They did not deport the migrants to Ethiopia. They collected them from Arta and put them in a former refugee camp called Negad,” one commentator said. 

“The place is very difficult and unsanitary, with no toilets or sleeping facilities, and they are kept in a very hot place,” he said. 

A video sent to Tikvah Ethiopia also shows the migrants being loaded and transported. 

Our attempts to determine whether the migrants collected from Arta were also deported to Ethiopia were unsuccessful. 

There has been no official statement or response from the Ethiopian government to the warnings and orders being issued by the Djibouti government, other than the announcement issued by the Ethiopian Embassy in Djibouti. 

Tikvah Ethiopia will follow up if the Ministry of Foreign Affairs issues a statement on this matter.

Tikvah Ethiopia
Addis Ababa
