**የጤና ሚኒስቴር ስለ ጤና ባለሙያዎች እና ሰራተኞች  ጥያቄ ምን ማብራሪያ ሰጠ ?**

የጤና ባለሙያዎችና ሰራተኞች  ጥያቄዎችን በተመለከተ የጤና ሚኒስቴር የሕዝብ ግንኙነትና ጤና ኮሚኒኬሽን ሥራ አስፈጻሚ ተገኔ ረጋሳ (ዶ/ር) ለሪፖርተር ጋዜጣ ማብራሪያ ሰጥተዋል። 

የጤና ባለሙያዎችን ጥያቄዎች ለመመለስ ምን እየተሠራ እንደሆነ ጥያቄ የቀረበለት ጤና ሚኒስቴር የአጭር፣ የመካከለኛ የረጅም ጊዜ ዕቅድ ይዞ ለችግሮች መፍትሔ ለመስጠት በሒደት ላይ እንደሚገኝ አስታውቋል።

**በጤና ሚኒስቴር የሕዝብ ግንኙነትና ጤና ኮሚኒኬሽን ሥራ አስፈጻሚ ተገኔ ረጋሳ (ዶ/ር) ምን አሉ ?**

- በጤና ባለሙያዎችና በሠራተኞች የሚነሱ ጥያቄዎች ተገቢና ዕውቅና የምንሰጣቸው ናቸው። በዚህም የአጭር፣ የመካከለኛ የረጅም ጊዜ ዕቅድ ተነድፎ ለጥያቄዎቹ ምላሽ ለመስጠት ከሚመለከታቸው አካላት ጋር እየተሠራ ይገኛል።

- ከደመወዝ ጭማሪ ጋር በቀጥታ የማይገናኝ ማበረታቻ ወይም (Non Salary Incentives) ለጤና ባለሙያውና ለሠራተኛው ጠቀሜታው የጎላ ነው ተብሎ ተለይቶ እየተሠራበት ያለ አንዱ ፓኬጅ ነው።

- የደመወዝ ጭማሪ የጤና ባለሙያውንና ሠራተኛውን ጥያቄ ብቻውን ይመልሳል ብለን አናምንም።

- የመኖሪያ ቤት ጉዳይ ዋነኛ ከሆኑ ጥያቄዎች አንዱ ነው የጤና ባለሙያውና ሠራተኛው አገልግሎት እየሰጡ ባሉበት አካባቢ መኖሪያ ቤት መሥሪያ ቦታ እንዲሰጣቸው የሚደረጉ ውይይቶች አሁንም ቀጥለዋል። 

ለአብነት ያህል ፦

የኦሮሚያ ክልልና አዲስ አበባ ከተማ አስተዳደር ለዚህ ጥያቄ ምላሽ ከሰጡት መካከል ተጠቃሽ ናቸው። ይኼ ጥያቄ በኦሮሚያ ክልል ፕሬዚዳንት ጽሕፈት ቤት ተቀባይነት አግኝቶ ለኦሮሚያ ሥራና ከተማ ልማት ቢሮ የጤና ባለሙያዎችና ሠራተኞች በያሉበት የቤት መሥሪያ ቦታ እንዲሰጣቸው ለአፈጻጸም ውሳኔ ተለልፏል።

የአዲስ አበባ ከተማ አስተዳደርም በተመሳሳይ የጤና ባለሙያዎችና ሠራተኞች በማኅበር ተደራጅተው ቤት እንዲሠሩ ውሳኔ ሰጥቶ፣ አፈጻጸም ላይ ይገኛል።

ሌሎች ክልሎችና የከተማ አስተዳድሮችም ይኼንን ጥያቄ በቶሎ እንዲመልሱ ጥሪ አቅርበው፣ ሚኒስቴሩም የሚያደርገውን ጥረት አጠናክሮ ይቀጥላል።

- የቤት መሥሪያ ቦታ ከተገኘ ቤቱ በምን ይሠራል ? የሚለው አብሮ መነሳት ያለበት ጉዳይ ነው። የጤና ባለሙያውና ሠራተኛው ከፍተኛ ባልሆነ ወለድ ብድር የሚያገኝበትን አማራጫ ለማመቻቸት ሚኒስቴሩ ከኢትዮጵያ ንግድ ባንክ ጋር ውይይት ጀምሯል። ሒደቱ ከሌሎች ባንኮች ጋር ይቀጥላል። የብድር ወለድ መጠኑና ምን ያህል ገንዘብ ድረስ መበደር እንደሚቻል  እስካሁን አልተወሰነም ስምምነት ላይ ሲደረስ ወደፊት ይገለጻል።

- ለአገርና ለኅብረተሰብ ጠቃሚ ሥራ የሚሠሩ የጤና ባለሙያዎች ዝውውርና የትምህርት ዕድል የሚያገኙበት አማራጭ ሌላው እየተሠራበት የሚገኝ ጉዳይ ነው።

- የሕዝብ ተወካዮች ምክር ቤት ያፀደቀውና የአተገባበር ደንብና መመርያዎች እየወጡለት የሚገኘው የጤና አገልግሎት አስተዳደርና ቁጥጥር አዋጅ ቁጥር 1362/2017 ብዙ ችግሮችን ይፈታል።

ለአብነት ያህል የጤና ባለሙያውና ሠራተኛው ሥራውን እየሠራ በሚገኝበት ጊዜ ለሚያጋጥሙት በሽታዎች ቤተሰቦቹን ጨምሮ ሕክምና እንዲያገኝ፣ ለዚህም መንግሥት ሙሉ በሙሉ የጤና መድን ክፍያ እንደሚሸፍን ተደንግጓል። ይህም ትልቅ ዕርምጃ ነው። ከዚህ በፊት ብዙም ያልነበረው የሕግ ከለላ ጉዳይ በአዋጁ ምላሽ አግኝቷል።

➡️ የደመወዝ ጭማሪ ለማድረግ ቀን ተቆርጦ የተላለፈ ውሳኔ አለ ወይ? የሚል ጥያቄ ቀርቦላቸው በሰጡት ምላሽ ደግሞ ፦

" በቅርቡ የጤና ባለሙያውና ሠራተኛውን ያካተተ ጭማሪ እንደ አገር ተደርጓል።

በቂ ላይሆን ይችላል፣ ያለውን ጫና ታይቶ የማይጨመርበት ሁኔታ አይኖርም፡፡ ሆኖም በአጭር ጊዜ ይመለሳል ማለት አንችልም፣ በመካከለኛ አልያም በረጅም ጊዜ የሚታይ ጥያቄ ነው " ብለዋል።

- የትርፍ ሰዓት ክፍያ አቤቱታዎችን በሚመለከት መንግሥት ባወጣው መመርያ መሠረት መከፈል አለበት። በበጀትና በተለያዩ ምክንያቶች በተለይ ክልሎች ላይ የሚስተዋሉ ችግሮችን ለመፍታት ብዙ ማስተካከያ ተደርጓል። በዚሁ ሒደት ያልተከፈላቸው የጤና ባለሙያዎች እንዲከፈላቸው እናደርጋለን።

➡️ ዘርፉ ከሲቪል ሰርቪስ አስተዳደር እንዲወጣ የጤና ባለሙያዎች ጥያቄ እያቀረቡ ስለሆነ ሚኒስቴሩ ይኼን እንዴት ይመለከተዋል ? የሚል ጥያቄ የቀረበላቸው በሰጡት ምላሽ ፦

" ጥያቄው ተገቢ ነው፣ ሆኖም ዝም ተብሎ ተነስቶ ሳይሆን በጥናት ነው የሚመለሰው። " ብለዋል።

- የጤና ባለሙያዎች ሥራ ያቆማሉ የሚል እምነት የለኝም። እሱን አደረጉ ማለት የገቡትን የሕክምና ቃል ኪዳን አፍርሰው አባት፣ እናት፣ ወንድምና እህት እንዲሞቱ ማድረግ ይሆናል። ሆኖም የጤና ባለሙያዎች ሥራቸውን እየሠሩ በተገቢው መንገድ አይጠይቁ ማለት አይደለም። ችግሩን ለመፍታት ከሚመለከታቸው የመንግሥት አካላትና ከጤና ባለሙያዎች ማኅበራት ጋር ውይይቶች እየተደረጉ ነው ተጠናክረው ይቀጥላሉ።

- ከዚያ ውጪ ግን ይኼንን አጋጣሚ ጠልፎ ለሌላ ዓላማ ለማዋል በማኅበራዊ ሚዲያው ዘመቻ የጀመረ ጤና ባለሙያ ያልሆነ አካል አለ፡፡ እሱን አስረግጠን መናገር እንችላለን፡፡ እንዲህ ዓይነቱን የጤና ባለሙያዎቹም መለየትና ማጋለጥ አለባቸው።

(ሪፖርተር ጋዜጣ)

**What explanation did the Ministry of Health give about the questions of health professionals and employees?**

Regarding the questions of health professionals and employees, the Public Relations and Health Communication Executive of the Ministry of Health, Tegene Regasa (Dr.), gave an explanation to the Reporter newspaper. 

When asked what is being done to answer the questions of health professionals, the Ministry of Health announced that it is in the process of providing solutions to the problems with a short, medium and long-term plan.

**What did the Public Relations and Health Communication Executive of the Ministry of Health, Tegene Regasa (Dr.) say?**

- We recognize the questions raised by health professionals and employees. Accordingly, a short, medium and long-term plan is being designed and worked on with the relevant parties to respond to the questions.

- Incentives that are not directly related to salary increases or (Non Salary Incentives) are one of the packages that are being developed, which are considered to be of great benefit to health professionals and employees.

- We do not believe that a salary increase alone will answer the health professional and worker's questions.

- The issue of housing is one of the main issues, and discussions are still ongoing to provide housing for health professionals and workers in the areas where they are providing services. 

For example:

The Oromia Regional State and Addis Ababa City Administration are among those that responded to this request. This request was accepted by the Oromia Regional State President's Office and forwarded to the Oromia Works and Urban Development Bureau for implementation.

The Addis Ababa City Administration has also issued a decision to organize health professionals and workers into associations and build houses, which is currently being implemented.

Other regional states and city administrations are also called upon to respond to this request as soon as possible, and the Ministry will continue its efforts.

- If a housing site is found, what will the house be used for? is an issue that should be raised together. The Ministry has started discussions with the Commercial Bank of Ethiopia to facilitate an option for health professionals and workers to obtain loans at low interest rates. The process will continue with other banks. The interest rate and the amount of money that can be borrowed have not yet been determined and will be announced in the future when an agreement is reached.

- Another issue that is being worked on is the option for health professionals who are doing useful work for the country and society to get transfer and education opportunities.

- The Health Service Administration and Supervision Proclamation No. 1362/2017, which was approved by the House of Peoples' Representatives and whose implementing regulations and guidelines are being issued, will solve many problems.

For example, it has been stipulated that health professionals and workers, including their families, will receive treatment for diseases they encounter while working, and for this, the government will fully cover the health insurance fee. This is a major step. The issue of legal protection, which was not very common before, has been addressed by the proclamation.

➡️ Is there a decision to increase wages with a fixed date? In response to the question, he said:

"Recently, an increase has been made nationwide, including health professionals and workers.

It may not be enough, there is no situation where the existing pressure will not be increased. However, we cannot say that it will be restored in the short term, it is a question that will be seen in the medium or long term," he said.

- Overtime pay should be paid according to the government's guidelines regarding complaints. Many adjustments have been made to solve problems that arise due to budget and various reasons, especially in the regions. In the same process, we will pay the unpaid health professionals.

➡️ Since health professionals are requesting that the sector be removed from the civil service administration, how will the ministry deal with this? In response to the question, he said:

"The request is appropriate, but it will not be answered silently, but through research." He said.

- I do not believe that health professionals will stop working. If they do that, it will mean breaking the medical contract they entered into and causing the death of a father, mother, brother and sister. However, this does not mean that health professionals are not doing their job properly. Discussions are being held with the relevant government agencies and health professional associations to resolve the problem and will continue to be intensified.

- Apart from that, there is a non-health professional who has started a campaign on social media to exploit this opportunity for other purposes. We can say for sure about him. Such health professionals should also be identified and exposed.

**__" 70 በመቶ ወጣት ሙስሊሞችን ያቀፈ የኢትዮጵያ ሙስሊም ወጣቶች ካውንስል በይፋ ተመስርቷል "__** **__የአዲስ አበባ ከተማ እስልምና ጉዳዮች ከፍተኛ ምክር ቤት__**

__በኢትዮጵያ እስልምና ጉዳዮች ጠቅላይ ምክር ቤት " ወጣቱን በማብቃት ነገን መገንባት " በሚል መሪ ሃሳብ በዛሬው ዕለት በሚሊኒየም አዳራሽ ባሰናዳው መርሐግብር የኢትዮጵያ ሙስሊም ወጣቶች ካውንስልን መመስረቱን ይፋ አድርጓል።

ቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ መርሃ ግብሩን ተገኝቶ ተከታትሏል።

በመድረኩ " 70 በመቶ ወጣት ሙስሊሞችን ያቀፈ " ነው የተባለው ካውንስሉ ተጠሪነቱ ለኢትዮጵያ እስልምና ጉዳዮች ጠቅላይ ምክር ቤት እንደሆነ ተገልጿል። __

__የኢትዮጵያ እስልምና ጉዳዮች ጠቅላይ ምክር ቤት ፕሬዝደንት ጽህፈት ቤት ዋና ኃላፊ ኡስታዝ አቡበከር አህመድ በዕለቱ " ለመብታቸው የሚታገሉና ግፍን የሚፀየፉ ፍትሃዊ ወጣቶች እንዲፈጠሩ የካውንስሉ አባላት በትጋት ሊሰሩ ይገባል "ሲሉ መልዕክት አስተላልፈዋል።__

__በተጨማሪም " ከኢስላም አስተምህሮና እሴት ርቀው ጊዜያቸውን ተገቢ ባልሆነ ነገር እያጠፉ ያሉ ወጣቶችን ወደ ኢስላም እንዲመለሱ ከማድረግ አንፃር ካውንስሉ ከፍተኛ ኃላፊነት አለበት " ነው ያሉት። __

__የአዲስ አበባ ከተማ እስልምና ጉዳዮች ከፍተኛ ምክር ቤት ፕሬዝደንት ዶክተር ሸይኽ ሱልጧን አማን ኤባ በኩላቸው በምስረታው ላይ ወጣቶች ለሰላም እና ለልማት ዘብ እንዲቆሙ አደራ ብለዋል።__

__የኢትዮጵያ ሙስሊም ወጣቶች ካውንስል ምስረታውን ከጀመረበት ጊዜ ጀምሮ በ5 ወር ውስጥ 70 በመቶ ሙስሊም ወጣቶችን ያቀፈ ሲሆን 11 የአመራር አባላቶች አሉት ተብሏል።

**የካውንስሉ አላማ ምንድን ነው ?**

የካውንስሉ ዋና ፀሀፊ ኢንጅነር ዑስታዝ ከማል አረቦ አህመድ ፥ __"__ወጣቱ ከተደጋጋሚ ስህተቶች በመማር የራሱን ሃሳቦችን የሚያፀርስበት እና ለፍላጎቶቹ መሳካት የሚሰራበት እንዲሁም ለሀገር እና  ለማህበረሰብ ጠቃሚ የሚሆኑትን ስራዎች የሚከውንበት እራሱ የፈጠረው አደረጃጀት ነው " __ብለዋል።

__አክለውም " በካውንስሉ ምሰረታ  ሂደቶች አምስት ወራቶች ውስጥ የወጣቶችን ችግር በመለየት በተለያዩ በሀገሪቱ አካባቢዎች በርካታ ወጣቶችን የስራ ፈጠራና አመራር እንድሆኑ በባለሙያ የታገዘ ስልጠና መሰጠቱን እና ቀጣይነት እንዳለው አንስተዋል__።

__የኢትዮጵያ ሙስሊም ወጣቶች ካውንስል፣ በእስልምና አስኳል አሰተምህሮ ላይ የተመሠረተ፣ በዒባዳ የታነፀ፣ ማንነትና እሴቱን የሚያከብር፣ ለኅብረተሰብ ደኅንነትና ለሀገር ልማት አስተዋፆ የሚያደርግ፣በእምነት፣ እውቀትና በአገልግሎት መሪ የሆነ ወጣት ትውልድ ማፍራትን ራዕዩ መሆኑን ገልፀዋል።__

__በማብሰሪያ መርሃ ግብሩ ላይ የፌዴራል፣ የክልልና የከተማ አስተዳደር መጅሊስ አመራሮችን ጨምሮ ጥሪ የተደረገላቸው የመንግስት የስራ ኃላፊዎች ተገኝተው ለካውንስሉ ሃላፊዎች እና አባላት መልዕክት አስተላልፈዋል።__

ቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ

**__" Ethiopian Muslim Youth Council, Comprising 70 Percent of Young Muslims, Officially Established "__** **__Addis Ababa City Islamic Affairs High Council__**

__The Ethiopian Islamic Affairs Supreme Council announced the establishment of the Ethiopian Muslim Youth Council at a program organized today at Millennium Hall under the theme "Empowering the Youth to Build Tomorrow."

Tikvah Ethiopia attended and followed the program.

At the forum, it was stated that the council, which is said to be "comprising 70 percent of young Muslims," ​​is accountable to the Ethiopian Islamic Affairs Supreme Council. __

__The Chief of Staff of the Ethiopian Islamic Affairs Supreme Council, Ustaz Abubakar Ahmed, said on the day that "the members of the council should work diligently to create just youth who fight for their rights and abhor injustice." __

__He also said that "the council has a great responsibility in terms of helping young people who are away from Islamic teachings and values ​​and are wasting their time on inappropriate things to return to Islam." __

__The President of the Addis Ababa City Islamic Affairs Supreme Council, Dr. Sheikh Sultan Aman Eba, for his part, called on young people to stand up for peace and development at the establishment. __

__The Ethiopian Muslim Youth Council is said to have comprised 70 percent Muslim youth within 5 months of its establishment and has 11 leadership members. 

**What is the purpose of the council?**

The Secretary General of the council, Engineer Ustaz Kemal Arebo Ahmed, said, __"__It is an organization created by the youth, where they can learn from repeated mistakes, formulate their own ideas, work towards achieving their goals, and carry out tasks that are beneficial to the country and society." __

__He added, "The council's establishment process identified the problems of the youth within five months and provided professional training to many youth in various parts of the country to become job creators and leaders, and it is ongoing. __

__The Ethiopian Muslim Youth Council, he said, is based on the core teachings of Islam, built on worship, respecting its identity and values, contributing to the security of society and the development of the country, and leading in faith, knowledge and service. __

__Invited government officials, including leaders of the federal, regional and city administrations, attended the outreach program and conveyed a message to the council's officials and members. __

Tikvah Ethiopia
Addis Ababa

🔈 #የኢትዮጵያውያንድምጽ

የኢትዮጵያ ኤምባሲ፣ ዜጎችን ከጅቡቲ ለማስወጣት ሲያደርገው የነበረውን ምዝገባ በሰው ብዛት ምክንያት መቋረጡን በጅቡቲ የሚገኙት ኢትዮጵያውያን ተናግረዋል።

የጅቡቲ መንግስት፣ ሰነድ አልባ የውጭ ዜጎች ከሀገሩ እንዲወጡ በሰጠው ትዕዛዝ መሰረት፣ በጅቡቲ ያለው የኢትዮጵያ ኤምባሲ፣ ለኢትዮጵውያን ስደተኞች ህጋዊ የጉዞ ሰነድ ለመስጠት ሲያከናውነው የቆየውን ምዝገባ ከቀናት በፊት ማቋረጡን፣ ከዚያው ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ በስልክ አስተያየት የሰጡ ስደተኞች ተናግረዋል፡፡

ስደተኞቹ፣ " ከጅቡቲ የመውጫ ቀነገደቡ በማለቁ ለከፍተኛ ጭንቀት ተዳርገናል፣ የኢትዮጵያ መንግስት ይድረስልን " ሲሉ በድጋሚ ተማፅነዋል፡፡ 

የስደተኞቹን አስተያየት በዝርዝር እንደሚከተለው አቅርበነዋል፡፡  

**አቶ መሐመድ ያዮ ጁሀር ፦**

__" ምዝገባው ከሐሙስ ዕለት ጀምሮ ተቋርጧል። መጀመሪያ መጥታችሁ ተመዝገቡ ተባለ፡፡ ህዝቡ እንደዛ በብዛት ይመጣል ብለው አልጠበቁም መሰለኝ፡፡ ህዝቡ ግን ግልብጥ ብሎ ለመመዝገብ ሲሔድ ከአቅማቸው በላይ ሆነ፡፡ ህዝቡ በብዛት ሲሔድ፣ በአግባቡ አይመዘገብም፡፡ ከዛም በራቸውን ዘጉ፡፡ 

ህዝቡ ደግሞ ኑና ተመዝገቡ ካላችሁን በኋላ ለምን ትዘጉብናላችሁ ብሎ ተናደደ፡፡ በመሀል አንዳንድ ሰዎች መረበሽ ጀመሩ፡፡ የሀገሪቱ የፀጥታ ሀይሎችም ህዝቡ እንዲበተን አደረጉ፡፡ ምዝገባውም ተቋረጠ፡፡ "__

**አቶ ኑሩ አስፋው ፦**

__" የኤምባሲው ምዝገባ ቆሟል። መጀመሪያ ህዝቡ በዛ መጠን የሚመጣ ስላልመሰላቸው፣ ትንሽ መዝጋቢዎችን ነው ያዘጋጁት፡፡ ግን ህዝቡ በአንዴ ግልብጥ ብሎ ሔደ፣ ተመዝግቦ የይለፍ ወረቀቱን ይዞ ለመውጣት፡፡ 

ህዝቡ ሲበዛባቸው፣ ' ቆዩ አንመዘግብም ' ማለት ጀመሩ፣ ህዝቡ ደግሞ ጠርታችሁናል መዝግቡን ማለት ጀመረ፡፡ በዚህ መሀል መዝጋቢዎቹ ፖሊስ ጠሩ፣ ህዝቡን በተኑት ማለት ነው፡፡ በዚህ መልኩ ምዝገባው ተቋርጦዋል፡፡ 

ህዝቡ ከመጠን በላይ ሲበዛባቸው ረብሻ ይነሳል ብለው ሳይሰጉ አልቀሩም፡፡ ቀድመው መዘጋጀት አልቻሉም፣ ይህን ያህል ህዝብ ወጥቶ ይመዘገባል ብለው አልጠበቁም፡፡ 

በቀላሉ መውጣት የሚችለው ስደተኛ፣ ደመወዙን የተቀበለ፣ ስራ ያልነበረው፣ በጊዜያዊ ስራ ላይ ተሰማርቶ የነበረው ሁሉ በብዛት እየወጣ ነው፡፡ መውጣት የቻለው እየወጣ ነው፡፡ ያልወጣነውም ጉዳያችንን ቋጭተን እንወጣለን፣ አንወጣም አላልንም፡፡ ትእዛዝ አናከብርም አላለንም፡፡ ለምን ጊዜ መጨመር አልፈለጉም፣ ህዝቡ ያለምንም ማስፈራራት በራሱ ጊዜ ወጥቶ ያልቃል፡፡ ይህን ለምን መገንዘብ አልፈለጉም፡፡ 

ገንዘቡን ያልሰበሰበው፣ ደመወዙን ያልተቀበለው፣ ሀብትና ንብረቱን ያልሸጠው ነው መሔድ ያልቻለው፡፡ ወዴት ጥሎት ይሒድ፡፡ ይህ ህዝብ የመጣውን ይምጣ ብሎ ተቀምጦዋል፣ ንብረቴን ጥዬ አልሔድም፣ ለዘራፊም ጥዬ አልወጣም እያለ ነው፡፡ ዘራፊው ደግሞ አሰፍስፎ የሰውን ንብረት ለመዝረፍ እየተጠባበቀ ነው ያለው፡፡ 

በኤምባሲው በኩል ምንም ዓይነት የመፅናኛ ቃላት እንኳን እየሰማን አይደለንም፡፡ እንዴት አንድ ሰው ወጥቶ የሆነ ነገር አይልም፣ እንዴት አቅጣጫ አይሰጥም፡፡ ይህን እንጠብቅ ነበር ከኤምባሲው፡፡ 

አሁን የመጨረሻው ቀን በመሆኑ ያፍሱናል እያለ ህዝቡ እንቅልፍ አጥቷል፡፡ ቢያንስ ' እንረዳሃለን፣ ጥያቄህ ልክ ነው፣ የለፋህበትንና የደከምክበትን ንብረትና ሀብት እንደ ዋዛ ጥዬ አልወጣም ማለትህ ተገቢ ነው ' እንዴት አይሉም፡፡ ' የቻልነውን እያደረግን ነው፣ ከጎንህ ነን፣ አይዞህ ' እንዴት አይሉንም፡፡ 

ኤምባሲው፣ ' ንብረትህን ቆፍረህ ቅበረው ' እንኳን ቢለን ደስ ይለን ነበር፣ ዝም ከማለት፡፡ የጅቡቲ መንግስትም ዕድል ካልሰጠን፣ የእኛም ኤምባሲ ካላፅናናን እኛ ምን እንሁን፣ ያሳዝናል በእውነት፡፡ 

በፊት ከዚህ ህዝብ እርዳታ ሲጠየቅ ኢትዮጵያዊ እየተባለ ነበር የሚጠራው፣ ዛሬ ድንገት ይህ ክፉ ጊዜ ሲመጣ ሁለት አይነት ስም ወጣለት፣ ህጋዊና ህገወጥ የሚል፡፡ ይህ ትክክል አይደለም፡፡ የኢትዮጵያ ሚዲያዎችም ድምፅ እንዲሆኑን መልዕክታችንን አስተላልፉልን፣ እባካችሁ፡፡ "__

**አቶ አሕመድ መሐመድ ፦**

__" ዛሬ ከመቼውም ጊዜ በላይ ስጋቱና ጭንቀቱ ከበድ ብሏል፡፡ 

ጅቡቲ ያለው ህዝብ እየወጣ ነው፣ አልወጣም አላለም፡፡ ደመወዙን የወሰደ፣ መሳፈሪያ ያገኘ ሰው እቃውን እየጠቀለለ እየወጣ ነው ያለው፡፡ ግን ይህ ህዝብ ብዛት ያለው ነው፣ በአንድ ቀን በሁለት ቀን ወጥቶ የሚያልቅ አይደለም፡፡ 

ደመወዙን ሳይቀበል፣ የሰጠውን ዱቤና ብድር ሳይሰበስብ፣ ንበረቱን ሳይሸጥ ሳይለውጥ እንዴት ይውጣ፡፡ የእኛ ኤምባሲ ለዚህ ህዝብ ትንሽ ቀን ማስጨመር እንዴት ተሳነው ? የኢትዮጵያ ህዝብ እንዴት በሔደበት ሁሉ እንግልት፣ ስቃይና ለቅሶ እጣ ፈንታው ይሆናል፡፡ ይህን ድምፃችንን ለሚመለከተው አካል እንድታስተላልፉልን እንለምናችኋለን፡፡ ንብረቱ በቁሙ እየተወረሰ እንዴት ዝም ይባላል፡፡ አለወጉ እየተሰቃየ ነው፡፡ እዚህ ያለው ነገር በጣም አስጊና አስፈሪ ነው፡፡ ይህ ህዝብ ያለውን ንብረት ይዞ እንዲወጣ ዕድል ፍጠሩለት፡፡ የለፋበትን የደከመበትን ንብረት እንዲሰበስብ እድል ይሰጠው፡፡ እቃውን ሰብስቦና አስሮ ወደ ሀገሩ እንዲመለስ የሚመለከተው አካል ያመቻችልን፡፡ 

ወሮበላው ንብረታችንን ለመዝረፍ አሰፍስፎ እየጠበቀ ነው፡፡ ጫና መፍጠር ያለባቸው አካላት፣ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትራችን እንዴት ዝም ይለናል፣ እኛን ለምን ከስቃይ አይታደገንም፣ እኛ አንወጣም ብለን አላመፅንም፣ ንብረታችንን ሰብስበን እንድንወጣ ትንሽዬ ቀን መርቁልን ነው እያል ያለነው፡፡ 

የጅቡቲ መንግስት ትዕዛዝ አክባሪዎች ነን፡፡ ህዝቡ ከመቼውም ጊዜ በላይ በጭንቅና በመከራ ውስጥ ነው ያለው፡፡ የኢትዮጵያ የሀይማኖት አባቶችም ቢሆኑ የጅቡቲን መንግስት ይለምኑልንና ቀነገደቡን ያራዝሙልን፡፡ ይህ ቀን ካልተራመዘ የከፋ አደጋ ላይ እንወድቃለን፡፡ "
__
ቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ስለ ምዝገባው መቋረጥና ስለ ስደተኞቹ አቤቱታ ከኢትዮጵያ ኤምባሲና ከኮሚኒቲው አመራሮች አስተያየትና ምላሽ ለማግኘት ያደረገው ጥረት አልተሳካም፡፡ በነዚህ ጉደዳዮች ዙርያ ከነዚህ አካላት አስተያየት ስናገኝ ይዘን እንቀርባለን፡፡

🔈 #EthiopianVoice

Ethiopians in Djibouti have reported that the Ethiopian Embassy has suspended the registration process for the evacuation of citizens from Djibouti due to the large number of people.

In line with the Djiboutian government’s order to deport undocumented foreigners, the Ethiopian Embassy in Djibouti has suspended the registration process for Ethiopian refugees to obtain legal travel documents, refugees who spoke to Tikvah Ethiopia over the phone said.

The refugees said, “We are deeply worried because the deadline to leave Djibouti has passed, please help us.” 

We have provided the refugees’ comments in detail below. 

**Ato Mohamed Yayo Juhar:**

__" Registration has been suspended since Thursday. They said come and register first. I don't think they expected the people to come in such large numbers. But when the people rushed to register, it became too much for them. When the people came in large numbers, they did not register properly. Then they closed their doors. 

The people also got angry saying, "Come and register, why are you closing us?" Some people started to get agitated. The country's security forces also ordered the people to disperse. Registration was also suspended. "__

**Ato Nuru Asfaw:**

__" The embassy registration has been suspended. At first, they did not expect the people to come in such large numbers, so they prepared a small number of registrars. But the people rushed in one go, registered and took their passes To leave. 

When the crowd grew, they started saying, 'Stay, we will not register,' and the crowd also started saying, 'You called us, we will register.' In the meantime, the registrars called the police, which meant dispersing the crowd. In this way, the registration was interrupted. 

They must have feared that when the crowd grew too large, there would be a riot. They could not prepare in advance, they did not expect that so many people would come out and register. 

The refugees who could easily leave, those who had received their salaries, those who did not have jobs, and those who were engaged in temporary work are leaving in large numbers. Those who were able to leave are leaving. Those who did not leave said, 'We will settle our affairs and leave, we will not leave. We will not obey orders.' Why did they not want to extend the time, the crowd will leave on its own time without any threats. Why did they not want to understand this? 

Those who did not collect their money, did not receive their salaries, He who has not sold his property has not been able to go. Where should he go? These people are sitting and saying, "Let him come, let him come," and they are saying, "I will not leave my property, nor will I leave it to a robber." The robber is also waiting to rob people's property. 

We are not even hearing any words of comfort from the embassy. How can someone not come out and say something, how can they not give directions? We expected this from the embassy. 

Now that it is the last day, the people are losing sleep, saying, "We will help you, your request is valid, it is appropriate for you to say that I will not leave the property and wealth that you have worked hard for and worked hard for." How can they not say, "We are doing our best, we are on your side, take courage." 

We would have been happy if the embassy had said, 'Dig up your property and bury it', rather than keeping quiet. If the Djibouti government does not give us a chance, and our embassy does not comfort us, what can we do, it is truly sad. 

Before, when this people were asked for help, they were called Ethiopians, but today, suddenly, when this bad time came, they were called two different names, legal and illegal. This is not right. Please convey our message to the Ethiopian media to be their voice. "__

**Ato Ahmed Mohamed:**

__" Today, the fear and anxiety are greater than ever. 

The people in Djibouti are leaving, they are not saying whether they will leave or not. Those who have received their salaries and found a place to stay are packing their belongings and leaving. But this is a large population, it is not one that will leave in one or two days. 

How can he leave without receiving his salary, without collecting the debts and loans he has given, without selling and exchanging his wealth? How has our embassy failed to add a little more time to this people? How can the Ethiopian people be destined for abuse, suffering and mourning wherever they go? We ask you to convey this voice to the relevant authorities. How can they be silent while their property is being confiscated? The poor are suffering. What is happening here is very dangerous and frightening. Create an opportunity for this people to leave with their property. Give them an opportunity to collect the property they have worked hard for. Let the relevant authorities arrange for them to collect and bind their belongings and return to their country. 

The thugs are waiting in ambush to rob our property. The parties that should be putting pressure on us, how can our Foreign Minister remain silent, why doesn't he save us from suffering, we didn't rebel saying we won't leave, we are saying that they have given us a short day to gather our belongings and leave. 

We are obedient to the orders of the Djibouti government. The people are in more distress and suffering than ever before. Even the religious leaders of Ethiopia should beg the Djibouti government and extend the deadline for us. If this date is not extended, we will be in grave danger. "

__
Tikvah Ethiopia's efforts to obtain comments and responses from the Ethiopian Embassy and community leaders regarding the suspension of registration and the refugees' complaints have not been successful. We will report back when we receive comments from these parties regarding these issues.

Tikvah Ethiopia
Addis Ababa

የኢትዮጵያ ጤና ባለሙያዎች ማኀበር፣ ጥያቄዎቻቸው ትክክለኛ መሆናቸውን፣ ማኀበሩም ከዚህ ቀደም በዘርፉ ላሉ ችግሮች መፍትሄ እንዲሰጥ ሚኒስቴሩን በደብዳቤ ሲጠይቅ እንደኖረ ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ተናግሯል።

**ባለሙያዎቹ ለጤና ሚኒስቴር በደብዳቤ ያቀርቧቸው ጥያቄች ምንድን ናቸው ?__
__**__
__ሌሎች ሀገራት ጤና ባለሙያዎችን የሚመጥን ካሳና ጥቅማጥቅም እያሰቡ ባለበት ወቅት ጤና ሚኒስቴር እኛ ባለሙያዎችን እየበዘበዘ ነው " ሲሉ አንስተዋል፡፡ 

ከምሥራቅ አፍሪቃ ሀገራት ተሞክሮ በመውሰድ የደመወዝ ክፍያ በወር 1000 ዶላር እንዲተገበር፣ በዓለም ጤና ድርጅት ምክረ ሃሳብ መሰረት የሥራ ሰዓት 45 ሰዓት በሳምንት እንዲገደብ ጠይቀዋል፡፡

መድኃኒት ላልተገኘላቸው በሽታዎች ራሳቸው አጋልጠው እየሰሩ በመሆኑ የቤት ኪራይ፣ የተጋላጭነት፣ የማበረታቻ አበል በአስቸኳይ እንዲስተካከል፣ በሥራ ላይ እያሉ በበሽታ ለተጠቁ ባለሙያዎች ካሳ እንዲከፈል አሳስበዋል፡፡

እንደማንኛውም የመንግስት ሠራተኛ በመታወቂያቸው ነጻ የትራንስፖርት አገልግሎት ተጠቃሚ እንዲሆኑ / የትራንስፖርት አበል እንዲታሰብላቸው፣ ከቀረጥ ነጻ መኪና እንዲያስገቡ እንዲደረግላቸውም ጠይቀዋል፡፡

የትርፍ ሰዓት ክፍያ በወቅቱ እንዲከፈል፣ ከዓመት በላይ ጭምር ክፍያ በሚያዘገዩ ተቋማት አቸኳይ እርምጃ እንዲወሰድ አመልክተዋል፡፡

እንዲሁም የሰሩበትን ክፍያና የመብት ጥያቄ እንዳያነሱ በማሰር፣ ማሰቃት፣ ማሸማቀቅና በማስፈራራት ህገ ወጥ ተግባር በሚፈጸሙ ተቋማት ላይ ምርምራ ተደርጎ እርምጃ እንዲወሰድ፣ ለጤና ባለሙያዎችና ቤተሰቦቻቸው ነጻ የህክምና አገልግሎት እንዲሰጥም አሳስበዋል፡፡

ለመኖሪያ ቤት የማህበር መስሪያ ቦታ ተጠቃሚ እንዲሆኑ፣ የሥራ ቦታ ከባቢ ድህንነት እንጠበቅ፣ የጤና ባለሙያዎች ግድያ እንዲቆም፣ መመሪያ እንዲወጣና ተፈጻሚ እንዲሆንም ጠይቀዋል፡፡

የጤናው ዘርፍ የህክምና እውቀት ወደሌለው ሲቪል ሰርቪስ አስተዳደር ውስጥ በመካተቱ ከዚህ ማዕቀፍ ወጥቶ ራሱን ችሎ በቦርድ እንዲተዳደር እና ሌሎች ምላሽ የሚሹ ነጥቦችንም በደብዴቤው አቅርበዋል፡፡

ጥያቄዎቻቸው የፖለቲካ አውድ እንደሌላቸው ጠቅሰው፣ ለጥያቄዎቻቸው እስከ ግንቦት 3 ቀን 2017 ዓ/ም ድረስ ምላሽ ካላገኙ በሕግ አግባብ  እርምጃ እንደሚወስዱ አስጠንቅቀዋል።

__(የጤና ባለሙያዎቹ ደብዳቤ ከላይ ተያይዟል እንዲሁም በ2015 ዓ/ም ማኅበሩ የፃፈው ደብዳቤም ለማስታወሻ ተያይዟል)__

**__"We are forced to bow our heads and live a life below human dignity just because we are health professionals" - Health Professionals

➡️ "Our demands have no political context!! "

__**
Health professionals in Ethiopia have written to the Ministry of Health, raising various rights issues and demanding a response by May 3, 2017.

The Ethiopian Health Professionals Association told Tikvah Ethiopia that their demands are valid and that the association has previously written to the ministry to address the problems in the sector.

**What are the demands that the experts have submitted to the Ministry of Health in their letter? __
__**__
__While other countries are considering appropriate compensation and benefits for health professionals, the Ministry of Health is exploiting our professionals, they said. 

They asked for the implementation of the salary of 1000 dollars per month, taking the experience of East African countries, and limiting the working hours to 45 hours per week in accordance with the recommendations of the World Health Organization. 

Since they are working at the risk of diseases for which there is no cure, they urged that the rent, exposure, and incentive allowances be adjusted immediately, and compensation be paid to professionals who are infected with diseases while working. 

They also asked that they be provided with free transportation services / transportation allowances, and that they be provided with tax-free vehicles, just like any other government employee. 

Overtime pay should be paid on time, and that urgent action be taken against institutions that delay payments for more than a year They also urged that action be taken against institutions that engage in illegal activities such as arresting, torturing, shaming and intimidating workers and preventing them from raising their demands for their salaries and rights, and that free medical services be provided to health professionals and their families.

They also called for housing and community facilities to be provided, a safe workplace, and an end to the killing of health professionals, and for a directive to be issued and implemented.

They also asked that the health sector, which is included in the civil service administration that does not have medical knowledge, be removed from this framework and be managed independently by a board, and other points that require a response.

They stated that their questions had no political context and warned that legal action would be taken if their questions were not answered by May 3, 2017.

__The 116th Ethiopian Federal Police Foundation Day celebration was held at Meskel Square today.

The program was attended by Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed (PhD) and many invited guests.

In his speech at the ceremony, Prime Minister Abiy (PhD) said, “116 years for the institution is not a simple milestone.” 

“Continuous reform and capacity building are essential,” he said.

“Although the work done in the past few years in the construction of peace and security institutions in Ethiopia has been commendable, they need to be continuously trained and prepared in light of the current global situation,” he said. 

“The work of ensuring Ethiopia’s national interests, peace and unity is expected of the police force,” he said. “If we can be united, we can ensure the unity and prosperity of Ethiopia.”

"Since our enemies' desire is to divide and divide us, our duty is to clearly understand our national interests, maintain our peace, work together, and work together with our brotherly neighboring peoples," he said.

"If there is anything beyond that, it is our duty to protect the unity and national interests of Ethiopia with the patriotic spirit of our fathers," he said, conveying a message to the army.

"The forces that do not want the peace and unity of Ethiopia will be destroyed by our arms in the usual way," he warned.

The ambassador, in his message to the militants and the federal government, called on them to put the people first.

" It is important to stop the fighting, help displaced citizens return to their homes, and ensure that children return to school and have access to health services, " he stressed.

"Illegal and violent actions in the name of armed struggle must stop," he said.

Ambassador Ervin Masinga, in his message, sent separate messages to Fano, the Oromo Liberation Army (OLA) and the federal government.

In this regard, 
- Fano should come with a realistic and peaceful goal/goal;
- The Oromo Liberation Army (OLA) should continue its negotiations to end the conflict in Oromia;
- He called on the federal government to immediately stop its drone attacks on its own citizens and take long-term steps towards peace and find solutions.

**" 47 የጤና ባለሙያዎችን በቁጥጥር ስር አውያለሁ " - ፌዴራል ፖሊስ
**
የኢትዮጵያ ፌዴራል ፖሊስ ዛሬ ባወጣው መግለጫ 47 የጤና ባለሙያዎችን በቁጥጥር ሥር አውሎ ምርመራ ማጣራት እንደጀመረ ገለጸ።

" ሰሞኑን የጤና ባለሙያዎች ያነሱትን የመብት ጥያቄ ሽፋን በማድረግ በሀገራችን ትርምስ እንዲፈጠር ከሚሠሩ ኃይሎች ጋር በማበር ሕገ ወጥ የሥራ ማቆም አድማ በማድረግ፣ በጤና ዘርፉ ላይ ሁከት በመፍጠር እና የታካሚዎችን ህይወት አደጋ ላይ በመጣል የተጠረጠሩ ናቸው " ብሏል።

" ተጠርጣሪዎቹ የጤና ባለሙያዎች ያነሱትን የደመወዝ እና የጥቅማ ጥቅም ጥያቄ እንደሽፋን በመጠቀም ሕገ-ወጥ የሥራ ማቆም አድማ በማድረግ፤ ሌሎችም ሥራ እንዲያቆሙ ለአድማ በማነሳሰት፣ የታካሚዎች ሕይወት ለሞትና ለአደጋ እንዲጋለጥ በማድረግ ሁከትና ብጥብጥ በመፍጠር የተጠረጠሩ ናቸው " ሲል አክሏል።

" ተጠርጣሪዎቹ በተለያዩ የጤና ተቋማት የአድማ መረቦችን በመዘርጋት፤ የጤና ባለሙያ ያልሆኑ አካለትን ነጭ ጋዋን በማስለበስ የሆስፒታል ቅጥር ግቢ ውስጥ ገብተዉ ሁከት እንዲፈጥሩ በማድረግ፣ ያልተገባ ወሬ በመንዛት እና በተለያየ መንገድ ሰላማዊ የሕክምና ሂደትን በማደናቀፍ የሕሙማንና የጤና እርዳታ የሚያስፈልጋቸውን ሰዎች ሕይወት አደጋ ላይ እንዲወድቅ በማድረግ፣ በመንግሥት የሕክምና አገልግሎት እና ትምህርት በሚሰጥባቸው ተቋማት ውስጥ ሰላማዊ የመማር ማስተማር ሂደት እንዲስተጓጎል አድርገዋል " ብሏል።

" ሙያቸውን አክብረው በሥራ ላይ በተገኙ ባልደረቦቻቸው ላይ ዛቻ እና ማስፈራራት ከማድረስ ባለፈ ሁከት እንዲፈጠር ሙከራዎችን አድርገዋል " ሲልም ገልጿል።

" 47ቱን ተጠርጣሪዎች በመረጃና በማስረጃ ለይቼ ነው በቁጥጥር ሥር ያዋልኳቸው " ብሏል።

የኢትዮጵያ ፌደራል ፖሊስ ፤ " የጤና ባለሙያዎቹ የሙያው ሥነ-ምግባርና ሕግ በማይፈቅደው ሁኔታ የዜጎችን ሕይወት ለሞትና ለአደጋ በማጋለጥ ሥራ ማቆም፣ ሌሎችም ሥራ እንዲያቆሙ ማነሳሳት እና ማስፈራራት፣ የወንጀል ተግባር እንደሆነ ይወቁት " ያለ ሲሆን ሌሎችም ከዚህ ተግባር እንዲቆጠቡ አስጠንቅቋል።

ከሰሞኑን የጤና ባለሙያዎች " የጠየቅናቸው  12 የመብት ጥያቄዎች ባስቀመጥነው ከጊዜ ገደብ ምላሽ አልተሰጣቸውም " በማለት የስራ ማቆም እንቅስቃሴ እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።

ከዚሁ ጋር በተያያዘ በርካታ ባለሙያዎች ለእስር መዳረጋቸው ይታወቃል።

አንዳንዶች ሲፈቱ ሌሎች በርካቶች ደግሞ በተለያዩ አካባቢዎች እስር ላይ ናቸው። 
**
**የኢትዮጵያ ሰብአዊ መብቶች ኮሚሽን (ኢሰመኮ) ከግንቦት 5 ቀን 2017 ዓ.ም. ጀምሮ በተለያዩ የሀገሪቱ ክፍሎች የጤና ባለሙያዎች በጤና ተቋማት ውስጥ በማድረግ ላይ የሚገኙት የሥራ ማቆም አድማ እንዲሁም ይህንን ተከትሎ በመንግሥት እየተወሰዱ ያሉ እርምጃዎች የሰብአዊ መብቶች ጥሰቶች እንዳያስከትሉ ትኩረት ሊሰጣቸው እና አፋጣኝ መፍትሔ ሊያገኙ እንደሚገባ አሳስቦ ነበር።

እንዲሁም ፖሊስ " በማኅበራዊ ሚዲያዎች ቅስቀሳ አድርገዋል፤ በሌሎች በሥራ ላይ በተገኙ ባልደረቦቻቸው ላይ ዛቻ እና ማስፈራራት አድርሰዋል " ያላቸውን የጤና ባለሙያዎች በቁጥጥር ሥር ያዋለ መሆኑን ኢሰመኮ ገልጾ በቁጥጥር ሥር የዋሉ የጤና ባለሙያዎች አያያዝን አስመልክቶም ክትትል በማድረግ ላይ እንደሆነ ገልጾ ነበር።

**" 47 Health Professionals Arrested " - Federal Police
**
The Ethiopian Federal Police said in a statement today that they have arrested 47 health professionals and are investigating them.

"They are suspected of colluding with forces that are trying to create chaos in our country by using the rights demands raised by health professionals as a cover to stage an illegal strike, creating chaos in the health sector, and endangering the lives of patients," it said.

"The suspects are suspected of using the salary and benefits demands raised by health professionals as a cover to stage an illegal strike; inciting others to stop working; and creating chaos and violence by exposing patients to death and danger," it added.

"The suspects have set up strike networks in various health institutions; have caused chaos by dressing non-health professionals in white gowns, have spread false rumors, and have disrupted the peaceful medical process in various ways, putting the lives of patients and those in need of health care at risk, and have disrupted the peaceful learning and teaching process in government medical and educational institutions," he said.

"They have threatened and intimidated their colleagues who are at work, respecting their profession, and have also attempted to create chaos," he said.

"I have identified the 47 suspects based on information and evidence and have taken them into custody," he said.

The Ethiopian Federal Police; "Health professionals should be aware that it is a criminal act to stop working, endangering the lives of citizens and inciting and threatening others to stop working, in violation of professional ethics and the law," he said, warning others to refrain from such actions.

Recently, health professionals have been on strike, saying that "the 12 rights issues we asked for have not been responded to within the time limit we set."

It is known that many professionals have been arrested in connection with this.

While some have been released, many others are in detention in various locations. 
**
**The Ethiopian Human Rights Commission (EHRC) has called for attention to the ongoing strike by health professionals in various parts of the country since May 5, 2017, and the measures being taken by the government to prevent human rights violations and to find immediate solutions.

The police also arrested health workers who they said "incited on social media; threatened and intimidated other colleagues at work," ISEMKO said, adding that it was monitoring the treatment of the detained health workers.

**" TV station goes off air for hours " - Staff

➡️ " I haven't received my salary for the month yet ! "**

The Southern Radio and Television Organization (SRT) was broadcasting live news last night when it was suddenly cut off, the station's staff told Tikvah Ethiopia.

The organization, which is said to be in dire financial straits following the dissolution of the former Southern Nations, Nationalities and Peoples' Region, said the suspension was due to airtime payments, according to inside sources.

The station's executive representative also said the suspension was due to a technical problem.

The channel, which was broadcasting its regular 1-hour news broadcast live last night, went off air suddenly, according to inside sources who told Tikvah Ethiopia, "The political leadership promised to pay the airtime rent within a month and it came back on air around 5:00 this morning."

The organization’s journalists, who stated that the salaries of the April employees had not been paid as of May 14, 2017, when this information was prepared, explained to Tikvah Ethiopia that they had also been confirmed by the organization’s officials that the broadcast was suspended due to airtime rental payments.

The organization’s employees stated that the Southern Radio and Television Organization lost a permanent budget source after the dissolution of the former Southern Region and that the budget continues to be drawn from the newly formed Sidama, Southern Ethiopia, Central Ethiopia and Southwestern Ethiopia regions.

“It is good for the relevant parties to pay attention to this as our future work and the existence of the station are at stake,” they said.

በካማሺ ዞን ምዥጋ ወረዳ ታጣቂዎች አደረሱት በተባለ ጥቃት ንጹሐን ሰዎች መገደላቸውን ነዋሪዎች እና የክልሉ ምክር ቤት አባል ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ተናገሩ።

ነዋሪዎቹ፣ “የሸኔ ታጣቂዎች ጥቃት ፈጽመዋል” ብለው፤ ከ10 በላይ ንጹሐን እንደተገደሉ፣ አብዛኛዎቹ ሟቾች ህፃናት እንደሆኑ ተናግረዋል።

ቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ስለ ጥቃቱ የጠየቃቸው የቤንሻንጉል ጉሙዝ ክልል ም/ቤት አባልና የታላቁ ህዳሴ ግድብ ማስተባበሪያ ዳይሬክተር አቶ ለሜሳ ኔኖ፣ “ ትክክል ነው። ንጹሐን ሰዎች ላይ ያነጣጠረ ግድያ ነው የተፈጸመው ” የሚል ምላሽ ሰጥተዋል።

**የክልሉ ምክር ቤት አባል በሰጡን ቃል በዝርዝር ምን አሉ ?
**__
__“__ __በካማሽ ዞን ምዥጋ ወረዳ አንገር ሜጢ የሚባል ታዳጊ ማዘጋጃ ቀበሌ ግንቦት 12 ቀን 2017 ዓ/ም ንጋት 12 ሰዓት ጅምሮ የሸኔ ቡድን ጥቃት ፈጽሟል።

በዚሁ ጥቃት 16 ሰዎች እዛው ነው የሞቱት። አንደኛው ሰው ደግሞ ለህክምና ከሄደ በኋላ ነው የሞተው። የተገደሉት ሰዎች ብዛት 17 ነው። ከሟቾች መካከል 12 ህፃናት ናቸው። ቀሪዎቹ አዋቂ ናቸው። 

ቡድኑ በተለያዩ ጊዚያቶች ጥቃት ሰንዝሯል። እስካሁን በተፈጸሙ ሦስት ጥቃቶች 27 ሰዎች ናቸው የተገደሉት። 

የትላንቱ ጥቃት የተፈጸመበት ቦታ ለኦሮሚያ ክልል አንድ ቀበሌ ሁለት ኪሎ ሜትር ርቀት ነው የሚገኘው። ጥቃቱ በወረዳው ከሚያዚያ ወዲህ ለሦስተኛ ጊዜ የተፈጸመ ነው ” ብለዋል።

**ምክንያቱና መፍትሄው ምንድን ነው ?
**
የታጣቂዎቹ ፍላጎታቸው ምንድን ነው ? መፍትሄውስ ? በሚል ለተነሳላቸው ጥያቄ “ ከምዥጋ ወረዳ የሸኔ ፍላጎት፥ አንደኛ አንገር ሜጢ በጣም ለምና ምርታማ ከሆኑ ቀበሌዎች መካከል ነው። ለም መሬት ስለሆነ አላማው ያንን ለመውሰድ ነው ” ሲሉ መልሰዋል።

“ ሁለተኛ ማህበረሰቡ ተረጋተቶ የእርሻ ሥራ እንዳይሰራ፣ ኑሮውን እንዳያሻሽል የአሻጥር ፓለቲካ አለ ” ብለው፣ “ መፍትሄው፣ መንግስት ጣልቃ ገብቶ ማህበሰቡን ማረጋጋት አለበት ”ነው ያሉት።

“ በሁለት ኪሎ ሜትር ግራና ቀኝ መከላከያዎች አሉ። መከላከያ በቅርብ ርቀት ባለበት በመካከል ገብተው ጥቃት ሲፈጽሙ በጊዜው ችግሩ ሳይሰፋ መድረስ ይችሉ ነበረ። ቀጣይም ችግሩ እንዳይሰፋ ቦታው ላይ የመከላከያ ኃይል በቋሚነት መቀመጥ አለበት ” ብለዋል።

አንድ የፓርላማ አባል በበኩላቸው ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ በሰጡት ቃል፤ የትላንቱ ጥቃት መፈጸሙን እንደሰሙ ገልጸው፣ “ ከሦስት ሳምንታት በፊት በ8  ንጹሑን ሰዎች ላይ ጥቃት ደርሶ የሞቱበት ሁኔታ አለ ” ሲሉ አስታውሰዋል።

ቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ

__**“ The number of people killed is 17. Among the dead are 12 children ” - Benshangul Gumuz Regional Council Member
**
Residents and a member of the regional council told Tikvah Ethiopia that innocent people were killed in an attack allegedly carried out by militants in the Mziga district of Kamashi zone.

The residents said, “Sene militants carried out the attack”; they said that more than 10 innocent people were killed, most of the dead were children.

When Tikvah Ethiopia asked about the attack, Ato Lemesa Neno, a member of the Benshangul Gumuz Regional Council and the Coordination Director of the Grand Renaissance Dam, responded, “That is correct. It was a targeted killing of innocent people.”

**What did the member of the regional council say in detail in his statement?

**__
__“__ __A group of Shene militants attacked a small village called Anger Meti in the Mziga district of Kamash zone at 12:00 AM on May 12, 2017.

16 people died in the attack. One of them died after going for medical treatment. The number of people killed is 17. Among the dead are 12 children. The rest are adults. 

The group has carried out attacks on different occasions. In the three attacks carried out so far, 27 people have been killed. 

The place where yesterday’s attack took place is two kilometers away from a kebele in the Oromia region. This is the third time the attack has taken place in the district since May 1,” he said.

**What is the reason and the solution?
**
What are the militants’ demands? The solution? To the question raised, “What is the interest of Shene from Meziga Woreda? First, Anger Meti is one of the most fertile and productive kebeles. Since it is fertile land, the aim is to take it.”

“Second, there is a policy of oppression that prevents the community from settling down and improving their livelihood,” he said, adding, “The solution is for the government to intervene and stabilize the community.”

“There are defenses two kilometers to the left and right. When the defenses are close enough, they could have intervened and attacked in time before the problem escalated. In order to prevent the problem from escalating further, a defense force should be permanently stationed in the area,” he said.

A member of parliament, for his part, told Tikvah Ethiopia that he heard about yesterday’s attack and recalled, “Three weeks ago, there was an attack on 8 innocent people and they died.”

Tikvah Ethiopia 
Addis Ababa

Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed (PhD) is in Europe for an official working visit.

The Prime Minister arrived in France today and reportedly met with French President Emmanuel Macron.

Their discussions focused on topics that strengthen relations and cooperation between the two countries and were fruitful, PM Abiy (PhD) said after the talks.

He thanked the French for the warm welcome he received and for the talks held today, following the talks in Addis Ababa in December.

**በአለምዋጭ የስደተኞች ካምፕ አንድ ኤርትራዊ በታጣቂዎች ተገደለ።
**
በአማራ ክልል ሰሜን ጎንደር ዞን በዳባት ወረዳ በሚገኘውና፣ በአብዛኛው ኤርትራውያን ስደተኞች በሚኖሩበት የአለምዋጭ ካምፕ፣ ባለፈው ሳምንት አንድ ኤርትራዊ መገደሉንና ሌላ አንድ ስደተኛ ደግሞ መቁሰሉን የካምፑ ስደተኞች ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ገልፀዋል፡፡

ስለጉዳዩ አስተያየት የሰጡን ሁለት ስደተኞች ባለፈው ዕሮብ ግንቦት 6 ቀን 2017 ዓ.ም ምሽት 3 ሰዓት ላይ ወደ ካምፑ የገቡ 3 ታጣቂዎች በረከት ብርሀነ ገብረእግዚአብሔር የተባለ ስደተኛን መግደላቸውን ፤ አባዲ እዮብ የተባለ ስደተኛን ደግሞ ማቁሰላቸውን ተናግረዋል፡፡ 

ሟቹ በጥይት ከተመታ በኋላ ወደ ሆስፒታል ቢወሰድም ህይወቱን ማትረፍ አልተቻለም ተብሏል።

ባለትዳርና የ5 ልጆች አባት ነበር የተባለው ሟቹ በረከት ብርሀነ የቀብር ስነስርዓቱ በቀጣዩ ቀን በዳባት ኪዳነምህረት ቤተክርስቲያን መፈፀሙን አስተያየት ሰጭዎቹ ገልፀዋል፡፡ 

የተባበሩት መንግስታት፣ የስደተኞች ከፍተኛ ኮሚሽነር/UNHCR በአለምዋጭ ካምፕ በተፈፀመ ጥቃት አንድ ሰው መገደሉን ማወቅ ችያለሁ ሲል ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ በላከው የኢሜይል መልዕክት አረጋግጧል።

ሌላ ሁለተኛ ስደተኛም በጥቃቱ ተመትቶ መቁሰሉን የስደተኞች ተቋሙ ጠቅሶዋል፡፡

የቆሰለው ስደተኛ በዳባት የመጀመሪያ ደረጃ ሆስፒታል የህክምና እርዳታ ከተደረገለት በኋላ፣ ወደ አለምዋጭ ካምፕ መመለሱን የጠቀሰው ዩ.ኤን.ኤች.ሲ.አር፣ የተቋሙ ሰራተኞች ከኢትዮጵያ የስደተኞችና ተመላስሾች አገልግሎት ሐላፊዎች ጋር የቆሰለውን ስደተኛ መጎብኘታቸውን አመልክቷል፡፡

በአለምዋጭ የስደተኞች መጠለያ ጣቢያ ያለው የፀጥታ ሁኔታ እንደሚያሳስባቸው የገለፁት አስተያየት ሰጭዎቹ በበኩላቸው፣ ካለፉት ሁለት አመታት ጀምሮ በመጠለያው የጥበቃ ሀይል እንደሌለ ተናግረዋል፡፡ 

ከዚህ በፊትም ወደ ስደተኞች መጠለያ ጣቢያው ንብረትና ገንዘብ ለመዝረፍ የመጡ ታጣቂዎች ተመሳሳይ ግድያና የአካል ጉዳት ማድረሳቸውን አመልክተዋል፡፡

**An Eritrean was killed by gunmen in the Alemwach refugee camp.
**
An Eritrean was killed and another was wounded last week in the Alemwach refugee camp in Dabat district of North Gondar zone in the Amhara region, where most Eritrean refugees live, according to Tikvah Ethiopia.

Two refugees who spoke to us about the incident said that three gunmen who entered the camp at 3pm on Wednesday, May 6, 2017, killed a refugee named Bereket Berhane Gebre Egzigar and wounded another refugee named Abadi Eyob. 

The deceased was taken to the hospital after being shot, but his life could not be saved.

The deceased, Bereket Berhane, who was married and had five children, was buried the following day at the Kidane Mihret Church in Dabat, the commentators said. 

The United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR) confirmed to Tikvah Ethiopia in an email that it has been informed that one person was killed in the attack at the Alemwacha camp. 

The refugee agency also said that a second refugee was injured in the attack. 

The injured refugee was returned to the Alemwacha camp after receiving medical treatment at the Dabat Primary Hospital, the UNHCR said, adding that its staff visited the injured refugee along with officials from the Ethiopian Refugee and Repatriation Service. 

The commentators, who expressed concern about the security situation at the refugee camp, said that there has been no security force at the camp for the past two years. 

They also noted that in the past, gunmen who came to the refugee camp to loot property and money have committed similar killings and injuries. 

The United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees/UNHCR, in an email to Tikvah Ethiopia, said that they are urging the local administration to deploy security forces to the camp. 

Tikvah Ethiopia
Addis Ababa

**__ወደ ኢትዮጵያ ይዞ መግባት የሚቻለው የውጭ ምንዛሪ መጠን ምን ያህል ነው ?__
**
__ወደ ኢትዮጵያ ይዞ መግባትና ከኢትዮጵያ ይዞ መውጣት ስለሚቻለው የገንዘብ መጠን በተመለከተ የብሔራዊ ባንክ ባለፈው አመት መመሪያ አውጥቷል፡፡ 

ይኸው መመሪያ ነዋሪነቱ በኢትዮጵያ የሆነ አንድ ሰው ከውጭ ሀገራት መልስ ወደ ኢትዮጵያ ግዛት የውጭ ምንዛሪ ይዞ ከገባ በ30 ቀናት ውስጥ በንግድ ባንኮች ወይም በተፈቀደላቸው የውጭ ምንዛሪ ቢሮዎች ወደ ብር መቀየር አለበት ወይም ወደ ውጭ ምንዛሪ ባንክ ሒሳቡ ማስገባት ይኖርበታል ይላል፡፡ ከውጭ ያስገባው የገንዘብ መጠን ከ4ሺህ ዶላር በላይ ከሆነ ግን ወደ ባንክ ሒሳቡ ሲያስገባው ለጉምሩክ ማሳወቅ እንዳለበት መመሪያው ይደነግጋል፡፡ 

ሁለተኛ የኢትዮጵያ ነዋሪ ያልሆነ ኢትዮጵያዊ ዜጋ ወይም ትውልደ ኢትዮጵያዊ ከ90 ቀናት በላይ በኢትዮጵያ ለመቆየት ከፈለገ ከውጭ ይዞት የገባውን የውጭ ምንዛሪ በ 90 ቀናት ውስጥ ወደ ውጭ ምንዛሪ የባንክ ሒሳቡ ማስገባት ይጠበቅበታል፡፡ ይዞት የገባው የገንዘብ መጠን ከ 10 ሺህ ዶላር በላይ ከሆነ ግን፣ ወደ ብር ሲቀይረው አለያም ወደ ባንክ ሒሳቡ ሲያስገባው ለጉምሩክ ማሳወቅ/ማስመዝገብ አለበት ይላል መመሪያው፡፡

የኢትዮጵያ ነዋሪ ያልሆነ የውጭ ዜጋ የውጭ ምንዛሪውን የቪዛ ጊዜው እስኪያልቅ ድረስ መያዝ ይችላል፡፡

ስለ ጉዳዩ ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ አስተያየት የሰጡ የባንክ ባለሙያ ፥ አንድ ሰው ወደ ኢትዮጵያ ሲገባ ለጉምሩክ ማሳወቅ/ማስመዝገብ  ከሚጠበቅበት መጠን በታች የሆነ የውጭ ምንዛሪ ከያዘ በጉምሩክ እንዲያስመዘግብ አይገደድም ብለዋል፡፡ 

ለምሳሌ ከ10 ሺህ ዶላር በታች ይዞ የሚገባ ሰው ሳያስመዘግብ ወይም ማሳወቅ ሳያስፈልገው በቀጥታ ይዞት መግባት ይችላል ማለት ነው፡፡ ከ10 ሺህ ዶላር በላይ ከሆነ አሳውቅ የሚባለው አንደኛ ወደ ጥቁር ገበያው ወስደህ እንዳትሸጠው ነው ፤ ሁለተኛ ለምን አላማ ከ10 ሺህ ዶላር በላይ ይዘህ እንደገባህ መግለፅ አለብህ ይላሉ ባለሙያው፡፡ ለንግድ ከሆነም በአግባቡ ማሳወቅ ይጠበቅብሀል፡፡

ሆኖም መመሪያው ከ10 ሺህ ዶላር በላይ ከሆነ አስመዝግብ ቢልም ከዛም በታች ከሆነ ማስመዝገቡ እንደሚመረጥ ገልጸዋል። ሳታሳውቅ ያስገባኸውን ዶላር፣ ስትመለስ ይዘህ መውጣት አትችልም፡፡ 

ቀደም ሲል ከአንድ ዶላር ጀምሮ ተመዝግቦ ይግባ የሚል አሰራር ነበር አሁን እንደዛ ባይባልም በተለይም የተረፈህን ይዘህ ስትወጣ ችግር ላይ ላለመውደቅ ከጅምሩ አስመዝግበህ መግባቱ ይመረጣል ባይ ናቸው፡፡ 

ለምን ቢባል ከውጭ ይዞት ከመጣው የዶላር መጠን ያልተጠቀመበት ካለና እሱን ይዤ ልውጣ ቢል ችግር ይገጥመዋል፡፡ የራሴን ዶላር የተረፈኝን ነው ይዤ የምወጣው ቢል ማስረጃ አቅርብ ስትገባ አሳውቀሀል ወይ ? ይባላል፡፡ ከኢትዮጵያ በጥቁር ገበያ ገዝቶ የያዘውስ ቢሆን ምን ማረጋገጫ አለ ሊባል ይችላል፡፡ ስለዚህ የቀረውን ገንዘብ በዶላር ይዞ ለመውጣት ይቸገራል ብለዋል ባለሙያው፡፡ 

የኢትዮጵያ ብሔራዊ ባንክ መመሪያ እንደዛ ቢልም የመነሻው ሀገር ራሱ ይህን ያህል ገንዘብ በካሽ ይዞ እንዲወጣ ላይፈቅድለት ይችላል ሲሉም ገልፀዋል፡፡ ለምን በባንክ አታስተላልፍም ይባላል፡፡ በባንክ የምታዘዋውርም ከሆነ ለምን ምክንያት እንደሆነ ለንግድ፣ ለኢንቨስትመንት ወይም ለሌላ አላማ ስለመሆኑ መገለፅ አለበት እንደሚባል አስገንዝበዋል፡፡ በተለይም በአውሮፓና በአሜሪካ ከፍተኛ ቁጥጥር እንደሚደረግበት ይናገራሉ ባለሙያው፡፡ ህጋዊ ስለመሆኑ ግብር የተከፈለበት ስለመሆኑና ለህጋዊ አገልግሎት እንደሚወጣ አሳውቆ ነው መውጣት ያለበት ባይ ናቸው፡፡

**__What is the maximum amount of foreign currency that can be brought into Ethiopia?__
**
__The National Bank of Ethiopia issued a directive last year regarding the maximum amount of money that can be brought into and out of Ethiopia. 

This directive states that if a person residing in Ethiopia brings foreign currency into the territory of Ethiopia from abroad, he must convert it into Birr within 30 days at commercial banks or authorized foreign exchange bureaus or deposit it in his foreign exchange bank account. However, if the amount of money brought in from abroad exceeds 4 thousand dollars, the directive stipulates that he must declare it to customs when depositing it into his bank account. 

Secondly, if an Ethiopian citizen or an Ethiopian born person who is not a resident of Ethiopia wants to stay in Ethiopia for more than 90 days, he must deposit the foreign currency he brought from abroad into his foreign exchange bank account within 90 days. However, if the amount of money brought in exceeds $10,000, the person must declare/register it to customs when converting it to Birr or depositing it into a bank account, the guidelines say.

A foreign national who is not a resident of Ethiopia can keep the foreign currency until the expiration of his visa.

A banker who commented on the matter to Tikvah Ethiopia said that if a person carries foreign currency below the amount required to be declared/registered to customs when entering Ethiopia, he is not required to register it with customs. 

For example, a person who enters Ethiopia with less than $10,000 can bring it in directly without registering or declaring it. If it is more than $10,000, the first thing that is called declaring is not to take it to the black market and sell it; second, you must explain why you are entering with more than $10,000, the expert says. If it is for business, you are also required to declare it properly.

However, the guidelines say that if it is more than 10 thousand dollars, it is preferable to register it, and if it is less, it is preferable to register it. You cannot take the dollars you brought in without informing when you return. 

Previously, there was a system that you should register from one dollar, but now it is not said that way, especially when you take the rest with you, it is preferable to register it from the beginning to avoid getting into trouble. 

Why is it said that if there is an unused amount of dollars that you brought from abroad and you want to take it out, you will face a problem. I am taking out my own dollars with me, did you inform me when you entered? It is said. What proof is there if it was bought from Ethiopia on the black market and brought it. Therefore, it will be difficult to take the rest of the money out in dollars, said the expert. 

Even if the National Bank of Ethiopia guidelines say so, the country of origin itself may not allow you to take out this much money in cash, they said. Why don't you transfer money through a bank? If you do transfer money through a bank, it should be explained why, whether it is for business, investment or other purposes. Experts say that it is especially heavily regulated in Europe and America. It should be stated that it is legal, that taxes have been paid and that it is being spent for legal services.

Tikvah Ethiopia
Addis Ababa

የኢትዮጵያ ዜጎች ለማኀበራዊ ፍትሕ ፓርቲ (ኢዜማ ) የባህርዳር ከተማ ስራ አስፈፃሚ እና በአማራ ክልል  የሚገኙ ፓርቲዎች የጋራ ም/ቤት የስራ አስፈፃሚ፣ ሆነው እያገለገሉ የቆዩት አቶ ኃይለማርያም ብርሃኑ ሚያዚያ 21 ቀን 2017 ዓ.ም ምሽት 2፡00 ሰዓት ላይ በፓሊስ ከቤታቸው ተወስደው በባህር ዳር ከተማ በሚገኘው 2ኛ ፖሊስ ጣቢያ መታሰራቸውን የኢትዮጵያ ዜጎች ለማኀበራዊ ፍትሕ የህግና አባላት ደህንነት ጉዳይ መምሪያ ኃላፊ አቶ ስዩም ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ  ተናገሩ።

ግለሰቡ ለ13 ቀናት ያለ ምንም ክስ በፖሊስ ጣቢያው ታስረው መቆየታቸውን የሚናገሩት አቶ ስዩም ፓርቲው " ለክልሉ ሰላምና ፀጥታ ቢሮ፣ ለባህር ዳር ከንቲባ ፅ/ቤት እንዲሁም ለምርጫ ቦርድ አባሉ እንዲለቀ ቅ  አልያም ፍ/ቤት እንዲቀርብ በደብዳቤ ቢጠይቅም ምላሽ ባለማግኘቱ ግንቦት 4 ቀን 2017 ዓ.ም  በባህር ዳር ከተማ ከፍተኛ ፍርድ ቤት አካልን ነፃ የማውጣት ክስ ተመስርቶ ግንቦት 12/2017 ዓ.ም  ፍ/ቤቱ  ከእስር እንዲፈቱ ትዕዛዝ ያስተላለፈ ቢሆንም  የፍርድ ቤቱ ውሳኔ ተግባራዊ አልሆነም " ብለዋል።

ይባሱንም ትላንት ግንቦት 13/2017ዓ.ም ከነበሩበት 2ኛ ፖሊስ ጣቢያ ቤተሰቦቻቸው  ሄደው ሲጠይቁ " ተጭኖ  ሄዷል " የሚል ምላሽ እንደተሰጣቸው  አና አሁን የት እንዳሉ ማወቅ አለመቻሉን አቶ ስዩም አክለዋል።

" አባሉ በምን ተጠርጥሮ እንደታሰረ ፍ/ቤት ቀርቦ የሚያስረዳ አካል ባለመቅረቡ ነው ፍ/ቤቱ በነፃ የለቀቀው ግለሰቡን ያለ አንዳች ምክንያት ከ20 ቀን በላይ ማሰር ፤ ፍ/ቤት ' ይለቀቅ ' ሲል  የፍርድ ቤት ውሳኔን አለማክበር ፤ ከዚያም ግለሰቡን መሰወር መንግስት እራሱ  ስርዓት አልበኛ  መሆኑን ማሳያ ነው "  ብለዋል።

**" The court order should be respected and our member should be released " - Ethiopian Citizens for Social Justice Party **

Ato Hailemariam Berhanu, who has been serving as the Bahir Dar City Executive of the Ethiopian Citizens for Social Justice Party (EZEM) and the Joint Council Executive of the parties in the Amhara Region, was taken from his home by the police at 2:00 PM on April 21, 2017 and detained at the 2nd Police Station in Bahir Dar City, Ato Seyoum, Head of the Legal and Members' Security Department of the Ethiopian Citizens for Social Justice Party, told Tikvah Ethiopia.

Ato Seyoum, who said that the person had been detained at the police station for 13 days without any charges, said that the party "has written to the regional peace and security bureau, the Bahir Dar mayor's office, and the election board to release him or to appear in court, but has not received a response. On May 4, 2017, the Bahir Dar City High Court filed a case to release the person and on May 12, 2017, the court issued an order to release him from detention, but the court's decision has not been implemented."

He also added that when his family went to the 2nd police station where he was on May 13, 2017, they were told that "he has been arrested and gone" and that they could not find out where he is now.

"The government has become above the law," said Ato Seyoum, Head of the Department of Social Justice, Legal Affairs and Members' Security, who called for the immediate release of his member, in accordance with the court order and the rule of law.

Ato Hailemariam Berhanu, a pharmacist, responded to a question raised by Tikvah Ethiopia, asking whether he was arrested on suspicion of being involved in the recent health workers' movement.

"The reason the member was arrested is because no one came to the court to explain what he was arrested on suspicion of. The court released the person without any reason. Detaining the person for more than 20 days without any reason; not respecting the court's decision to 'release' the person; and then hiding the person is a sign that the government itself is incompetent," he said. 

Information from the party indicates that Hailemariam Berhanu, the head of the pharmacy department at Dream Care General Hospital and a member of the Ethiopian People's Democratic Party (EZEMA), was a candidate for the Amhara Regional Council in the 2013 national elections on behalf of the party and was an active participant in the national consultation agenda gathering in the Amhara Regional State.

- የገፅ ዲዛይን ከተማዋ ያለችበትን ደረጃ በሚመጥን እና ፋይዳን መሰረት አድርጎ ሁሉን አቀፍ አገልግሎት የሚሰጥ /Smart Card/ በማድረግ ለማሻሻል ዝግጅት እያደረገ እንደሚገኝ አሳውቋል።

በተቋሙ የወሳኝ ኩነት ምዘገባን ጨምሮ በጠቅላላው ወደ 3 ሚልዮን የሚጠጉ ነዋሪዎች መረጃ በዲጂታል ምዘገባ የመረጃ ቋት ውስጥ እንዳለ ገልጿል።

በሌላ በኩል ፥ በኤጀንሲው የኮልፌ ቀራንዮ፣ የንፋስ ስልክ ላፍቶ እና አቃቂ  ቃሊቲ ክ/ከተማ 
ነዋሪዎችን በማገልገል ላይ ያለው የዶ/ር አበበች ጎበና የዋና መስርያ ቤት ቅርንጫፍ  የማስረጃ ማረጋገጫ ቅርንጫፍ በቢሮ እድሳት ምክንያት ላለፉት ሁለት ሳምንታት ዝግ እንደነበር ገልጿል።

ሲደረግ የነበረው የቢሮ እድሳት በመጠናቀቁ ከሰኞ ግንቦት 18 ቀን 2017 ዓ/ም ጀምሮ አገልግሎት መስጠት የሚጀምር መሆኑና መደበኛ አገልግሎቱን በቅርንጫፉ ማግኘት እንደሚቻል ይፋ አድርጓል።

**" The number of residents whose paper resident ID cards have been converted to digital cards has exceeded 2 million " - Civil Registration and Resident Services Agency**

**➡️ " Preparations are being made to improve the system by making it a **/Smart** Card/ that provides comprehensive services based on the benefits! "**

The Addis Ababa Civil Registration and Resident Services Agency has announced that the number of residents whose paper resident ID cards have been converted to digital has exceeded 2 million.

What did the agency say?

The Addis Ababa City Administration has stated that it has been working for the past years to convert the issuance of resident ID cards from paper to digital in order to eliminate illegality and establish a reliable identity system by transferring them to digital.

Accordingly, yesterday, May 13/2017, it indicated that the number of residents whose paper resident ID cards have been converted to digital has exceeded 2 million.

This digital registration of identity is a system that records more than 35 personal data for statistical purposes, including biometric information of residents.

The institution announced that it is preparing to improve the current resident identification:
- Content, 
- Service period 
- Page design in the coming months by making it a universal service /Smart Card/ that is suitable for the city's current level and based on benefits.

He stated that the institution's vital records, including the information of nearly 3 million residents, are in the digital registration database.

On the other hand, the agency's Dr. Abebech Gobena branch, which serves residents of Kolfe Keranyo, Nefas Sil Lafto and Akaki Qaliti districts, has been closed for the past two weeks due to office renovations.

The office renovations that were being carried out have been completed and will begin providing services from Monday, May 18, 2017, and regular services will be available at the branch.

**" ያጋጠመ ሞት የለም። ታክመው ወደቤታቸው የሄዱ አሉ " - የከተማው ኮሚኒኬሽን**

ከትግራይ ማእከላዊ ዞን ከተሞች አንዷ በሆነችው እንትጮ ቀበሌ 03 በተለምዶ ' እንዳባዱላ ' ተብሎ በሚጠራ ቦታ ዝክር ላይ አጋጥሟል በተባለ የምግብ መመረዝ በርካታ ሰዎች ለህመም መዳረጋቸው ተነገር።

ግንቦት 12 ቀን 2017 ዓ.ም በቅዱስ ሚካኤል ዕለት አንዲት እናት ባዘጋጁት ዝክር ላይ ፀበል ለመቅመስ የታደሙ ሰዎች ጠላና የበሰላ አተር ከቀመሱ በኃላ ህመም እንዳጋጠማቸው እና ወደ ሆስፒታል እንደገቡ ከከተማው ኮሚኒኬሽን ያገኘነው መረጃ ያሳያል።

በወቅቱ ከነበሩት 78 የዝክሩ ታዳሚያን ሁሉም የጤና መታወክ አጋጥሟቸዋል።

ወዲያው በከተማው ወደ ሚገኘው ሆስፒታል አምርተው አስቸኳይ ህክምና ተደርጎላቸዋል።

በክስተቱ አንድም ያጋጠመ ሞት የለም።

ህክምናው ወሰደው ከተሻለቸው ሰዎች መካከል ወደ ቤታታቸው የተመለሱ እንዳሉ  ከሆስፒታል የተገኘው መረጃ ያሳያል።

ዘግይቶ በተገኘ መረጃ ደግሞ ፥ የተዘጋጀውን መበልና መጠጥ ወደ ቤተክርስትያን ተወስዶላቸው የቀመሱ ሌሎች ተጨማሪ አስር (10) ሰዎችም የጤና እክል አጋጥሟቸው ወደ ሆስፒታል እንደገቡ ተሰምቷል።

የታማሚዎች ቁጥር 88 መድረሱ ነው ከአከባቢው የተገኘው መረጃ የሚያመላክተው።

ዝክሩን ያዘጋጁት እናት በፓሊስ ቁጥጥር ስር ውለው ምርመራ እየተደረገባቸው እንደሆነ የከተማው ኮሙኒኬሽን አሳውቋል።

**"No deaths. Some have been treated and returned home" - City Communications**

A number of people have been reported to have fallen ill after a food poisoning incident at a Zikr in Entcho Kebele 03, one of the towns in the Central Zone of Tigray.

On May 12, 2017, a mother organized a Zikr on St. Michael's Day to taste Tzebel, and after tasting the bitter and sour peas, people who were invited to the Zikr fell ill and were hospitalized, according to information we received from the city communications.

All 78 attendees of the Zikr at the time experienced health problems.

They were immediately taken to the city hospital and received emergency treatment.

No deaths were reported in the incident.

Among those who recovered from the treatment, some have returned home, according to information received from the hospital.

According to later information, ten (10) more people who ate the prepared food and drinks taken to the church have also fallen ill and been admitted to the hospital.

The number of patients has reached 88, according to information received from the area.

The mother who prepared the meal is under police custody and is being examined, the city's communications department said.

__**“ ዛቻውና ማስፈራሪያው ውሃ የሚያነሳ ነገር አይደለም ” - ጤና ባለሙያዎች
**
ወደ 12 ጥያቄዎችን በማቅረብ ምላሽ ሲጠይቁ የቆዩና “ ምላሽ አላገኘንም ” በሚል የሥራ ማቆም አድማ እያደረጉ ያሉ ባለሙያዎች ጥያቄያቸው በዛቻ ሳይሆን በውይይት የሚፈታ መሆኑን ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ተናገሩ።

የጤና ሚኒስቴር ዴዔታ ዶክተር ደረጀ ዱጉማ የሰጡትን ገለጻ በተመለከተ ጤና ባለሙያዎቹ አስተያየታቸውን ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ሰጥተዋል።

**ምን አሉ ?
**
“ ጤና ባለሙያውን ' ላይሰንስ እቀማሃለሁ፣ ከሥራ አሰናብትሃለሁ፣ ' እያሉ በብዙ ማስፈራራቱ ተገቢ አይደለም።

አብዛኛዎቹ ጥያቄዎች በመነጋገር የሚፈቱ ናቸው። ስለዚህ ቁጭ ብሎ መነጋገሩ ከማስፈራሪያ፣ ከዛቻ ይልቅ የተሻለ ነው ብለን እናምናለን።

ዛቻውና ማስፈራሪያው ውሃ የሚያነሳ ነገር አይደለም፤ ይህን ፈርቶም ወደ ኋላ የሚመለስ ባለሙያ አለ ብለን አናምንም። እንደዚህ አይነት ነገሮች እንደሚጠብቁን ገና ሀሳቡ ሲመጣ / ስንነሳም እናውቅ ነበር አይደለም ገብተንበት።

ስለዚህ ችግሮቻችን በማስፈራሪያና በዛቻ ሊፈቱ የሚችሉ አይደሉም። ችግሩ የ5፣ 10 ሰዎች ችግር አይደለም፤ የሁሉም ባለሙያዎች ጥያቄ ስለሆነ ጥያቄውን በእንዲህ አይነት ምላሽ መመለስ አይቻልም።

ላይሰንስ ልትቀማ፤ ከሥራ ልታባርር ትችል ይሆናል ነገር ግን የምትመራውን ህዝብ ነው የምትጎዳው። ለምትመሩት ህዝብ ስትሉ፣ እንዲሁም ለምናገለግለው ህዝብ ሲባል ጥያቄዎቹን እናምጣቸውና እንነጋገርባቸው።

ዶ/ር ደረጀ ዱጉማ በደንብ ያውቁታል የኛን ችግር። ከልባቸውም እንዳልሆነም ሲናገሩ አስታውቆባቸዋል። የሚኒስትር ዶ/ር መቅደስ ዳባ ንግግርም እየሰማን ነበር። የባለሙያው ችግር በደንብ እንደገባቸው ካደረጉት ኢንተርቪው ተረድተናል።

ግዴታ ያንን ማድረግ ስላለባቸው እንዳደረጉ ነው ጤና ባለሙያው የሚረዳው። በማንኛውም ጊዜ ተመልሰው ከኛ ጋር ቢቆሙ ልንቀበላቸው በራችን ክፍት ነው። የኛን ችግር ሳይረዱት ቀርተው ሳይሆን ያስገደደ አስገድዷቸው ነው ” ብለዋል።

የጤና ሚኒስቴር ዴዔታ ዶ/ር ደረጄ ዱጉማ ከብሔራዊ ቴሌቪዥን ጋር በነበራቸው ቃለ ምልልስ በሰሞነኛው የጤና ባለሙያዎች ጉዳይ ሰፋ ያለ ማብራሪያ ሰጥተው ነበር።

በዚህም የድንገተኛ ክፍል ታካሚዎችን፣ በህክምና ያሉ ህፃናትን፣ ወላድ እናቶችን ጥሎ መውጣት በፍጹም የማይደረግ ይቅርታ የማይደረግለት ስህተት መሆኑን ተናግረዋል።

በጤና ዘርፍ ላይ ለደቂቃ እንኳን ስራ ማቆም አድማ ማድረግ እንደማይቻል አስገንዝበዋል።

ባለሙያዎቹ " በአስቸኳይ መምጣት አለባቸው ካልመጡ ግን የሙያ ፈቃድ ይዞ መቀጠል እንደሚከብድ መናገር እፈልጋለሁ " ሲሉ ተደምጠዋል።

በአስቸኳይ ወደ ስራ ገበታቸው መመለስ ካልቻሉ በቀጣይ በመንግስትም ሆነ በግል ጤና ተቋማት ለመስራት እና የጤና ባለሙያ ሆኖ ለመቀጠልም አስቸጋሪ ሊሆን እንደሚችል አሳስበው ነበር።

Professionals who have been demanding answers to 12 questions and are on strike because they “did not receive a response” told Tikvah Ethiopia that their questions will be resolved through dialogue, not threats.

Regarding the statement made by the Minister of Health, Dr. Dereje Duguma, the health professionals gave their comments to Tikvah Ethiopia.

**What did they say?
**
“It is not appropriate to threaten a health professional by saying, ‘I will revoke your license, I will dismiss you from work,’”

Most issues are resolved through dialogue. Therefore, we believe that sitting down and talking is better than intimidation and threats.

Threats and intimidation are not a good idea; we do not believe that any professional will back down because of this. We knew that such things would await us even when the idea came up, but we did not understand it.

Therefore, our problems cannot be solved through intimidation and threats. The problem is not a problem of 5 or 10 people; it is a question of all professionals, so it is impossible to answer the question with such a response.

You can revoke your license; you can dismiss you from work, but you are harming the people you lead. Let us bring the questions to them and discuss them for the sake of the people you lead, as well as the people we serve.

Dr. Dereje Duguma knows our problem very well. When he says that he is not sincere, He informed them. We were also listening to the speech of Minister Dr. Maqdes Daba. We understood from the interview that they understood the problem of the professional well.

The health professional is helping them because they have to do it because they have a duty. If they come back and stand with us at any time, our door is open to welcome them. It is not that they did not understand our problem, but they forced them,” he said.

The Deputy Minister of Health, Dr. Dereje Duguma, gave a detailed explanation on the issue of health professionals in an interview with national television.

In this regard, he said that leaving emergency room patients, children undergoing treatment, and mothers is an unforgivable and unforgivable mistake.

He emphasized that it is impossible to strike even for a minute in the health sector.

The professionals were heard saying, “They must come urgently, but if they do not come, I want to say that it will be difficult to continue with their professional license.”

They were concerned that if they were unable to return to work immediately, it would be difficult for them to continue working in public and private health facilities and to continue as health professionals.

**" Time limit imposed again " - Dilla City Police**

Dilla City Police Chief Deputy Inspector Prasad Harbaye told Tikvah Ethiopia that a time limit has been imposed on two-wheeled motorcycles for various reasons.

Recalling that previously, two-wheeled motorcycles were mostly used for smuggling, including robbery and theft, at night, so they were restricted from moving after 12 am, the police chief said, adding that the restrictions were lifted after the crimes had subsided.

In recent times, due to the increase in traffic accidents and the recording of robbery and theft crimes involving motorcycles, he announced that the city's roads and transportation department has once again imposed a time limit on moving after 12 pm.

“The curfew does not include bank employees, security vehicles, or those with special permits,” the police chief told Tikvah Ethiopia. “The city’s main road is closed to rental motorcycles during the day due to traffic congestion,” he told Tikvah Ethiopia.

የጤና ባለሙያዎች ያነሱት ጥያቄ ተከትሎ " ምላሽ አላገኘንም " በማለታቸው  በአገር አቀፍ ደረጃ በተለያዩ ቦታዎች የተከሰተው ስራ የማቆም እንቅስቃሴ በትግራይ ፦
- ማይጨው ፣ 
- መቐለ ፣
- ዓዲግትራና አክሱም መታየቱን የቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ የመቐለ ቤተሰብ አባል ባደረገው ዳሰሳና ምልከታ ተረድቷል።

የቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ መቐለ ቤተሰብ አባል ዛሬ ግንቦት 13/2017 ዓ.ም በመቐለ ዓይደር ሪፈራል ሆስፒታል ያለውን ሁኔታ በአካል በመሄድ ታዝቧል።

ለታካሚዎች የሚሰጠው አገልግሎት ሙሉ በሙሉ እንደቆመ ቀንና ሌሊት ሳይለይ በተገልጋይ ብዛት የሚጨናነቀው ሆስፒታሉ ከግቢው ውጭና ውስጥ ጭር ማለቱን ባደረገው ምልከታ  አረጋግጧል።

ቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ወደ ሆስፒታሉ ግቢ ዘልቆ እንዳስተዋለው ከተረኛ የጥበቃ አባላት ውጪ ሃኪሞችና አገልግሎት ሰጪ ሰራተኞች የሉም።

ስማቸው እንዳይገለፅ የፈለጉ የሆስፒታሉ ከፍተኛ አመራሮች ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ በሰጡት መረጃ በሆስፒታሉ እየተማሩ አገልግሎት የሚሰጡ 320 ሃኪሞች ከትናንትና እስከ ዛሬ በስራ ገበታቸው ላይ አለገኙም።

ሃኪሞች አገር አቀፉ የጤና ባለሙያዎች ስራ የማቆም እንቅስቃሴ ጥሪን በመቀበል ግንቦት 12/2017 ዓ.ም ስራ ቢያቆሙም መቼ ወደ ስራ ገበታቸው እንደሚመለሱ ቁርጥ ያለ ቀን አላስቀመጡም።

ቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ በከፍተኛ ህመም ምክንያት ከሆስፒታሉ መውጣት ያልቻሉ ታካሚ ህሙማንና ረዳቶቻቸው አነጋግሯል።

በዚህም ወቅት ፥ " በጦርነትና ጦርነት ወለድ ጦስ በተጎዳ ክልል ይህንን መሰል ስራ የመቆም አድማ የሚያስከትለው ጉዳት እጅግ ከባድ ነው " ብለዋል።

" የጤና ባለሙያዎች ስራ የማቆም አድማ ታክሎበት ይቅርና እንዲሁ ህዝቡ ታሞ ለመታከም በህክምናና መድሃኒት እጥረትና በአቅም ማነስ ምክንያት በከፍተኛ ፍዳ ውስጥ ነው የሚገኘው ስለሆነም ሃኪሞች እባካችሁን ሰብአዊነት አስቀድሙ " የሚል ተማፅኖ አቅርበዋል።

የሆስፒታሉ ከፍተኛ አመራሮች በበኩላቸው ፤ " ሃኪሞቹ ያነሱት የመብት ጥያቄ ትክክል ነው። መብታቸውን ግን በስራ ገበታው ሆነው መጠይቅ ይችሉ ነበር " ብለዋል።

ሆስፒታሉ አገልግሎት ካቋረጠ ሦስተኛ ቀኑ ይዟል። በርካታ እናቶችና ህፃናት ህክምና ፍለጋ መጥተው አልተሰተናገዱም። በሆስፒታሉ አልጋ ይዘው እየታከሙ ያሉም በየደቂቃውና በየሰዓቱ የሚከታተላቸው ሃኪም ስለሌለ ግራ ተጋብተዋል ብለዋል።

የሆስፒታሉ አመራሮቹ ለሃይማኖት አባቶችና የአገር ሽማግሌዎች ባቀረቡት ተማፅኖ " በስራ ማቆም አድማ የሚገኙት ሃኪሞች በአስቸኳይ ተመልሰው የታማሚዎች ህይወት እንዲታደጉ ሃይማኖታዊና አባታዊ ምክራችሁ የሚፈለግበት ጊዜ አሁን ነው " ብለዋል።

**" The impact of the withdrawal of government medical services on a population that has not fully recovered from the war-torn country is very serious " - Patients

➡️ " We urge religious leaders and elders to be part of the solution before the damage is exacerbated " - Senior Hospital Leaders** 

The health professionals' question was followed by the statement "We have not received a response ". The nationwide work stoppage movement that occurred in various places in Tigray:
- Maychew, 
- Mekelle,
- Adigtra and Axum was observed by a member of the Mekelle family of Tikvah Ethiopia.

A member of the Mekelle family of Tikvah Ethiopia visited the Mekelle Ayder Referral Hospital in person today, May 13/2017.

The hospital, which is constantly crowded with patients day and night, has been completely shut down, according to an inspection conducted inside and outside the hospital.

Tikvah Ethiopia has found that there are no doctors or service staff other than security guards on duty.

According to information provided to Tikvah Ethiopia by senior hospital officials who requested anonymity, 320 doctors who are currently training at the hospital have not been at work since yesterday.

Doctors have stopped work since May 12, 2017, following the call of the nationwide health workers’ strike, but have not set a specific date for when they will return to work.

Tikvah Ethiopia has spoken to patients and their caregivers who have been unable to leave the hospital due to severe illness.

At the same time, he said, "The damage caused by such a strike in a region affected by war and war-torn Tos is very serious."

"Let alone the health professionals' strike, the people are also suffering due to the lack of medical and pharmaceutical treatment and lack of capacity to treat them. Therefore, doctors, please put humanity first," he appealed.

Senior hospital leaders, on their part, said, "The rights demands raised by the doctors are correct. However, they could have asked for their rights while at work."

It has been three days since the hospital stopped its services. Many mothers and children have come to seek treatment and have not been treated. Those who are being treated in hospital beds are confused because there is no doctor to attend to them every minute and every hour.

The hospital leaders appealed to religious leaders and elders, saying, "Now is the time to seek your religious and patriarchal advice so that the doctors who are on strike can return to work immediately and save the lives of patients."

🔈 #የጤና_ባለሙያዎች

**" ሙሉ በሙሉ ስራ አቁመዋል፤ ሌሎች ዉስን የጤና ባለሙያዎች ብቻ በሆስታሉ አሉ፤ ስራ ቆሟል ማለት ይችላል" - የወላይታ ሶዶ ስፔሻላይዝድ ሪፈራል ሆስፒታል ሰራተኞች **

**➡️ " ከሬዝደንት ሐኪሞች በስተቀር ሌሎች የጤና ባለሙያዎች በስራ ላይ ናቸዉ " - የሆስፒታሉ ኤክስክዩትቭ ዳይሬክተር**

የወላይታ ሶዶ ስፔሻላይዝድ ሪፈራል ሆስፒታል የጤና ባለሙያዎች ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ በሰጡት ቃል ፤ ከጤና ባለሙያዎች ሀገራዊ ጥያቄዎች ጋር በተያያዘ ከሰሞኑ መንጠባጠቦች የነበረበዉ የሆስፒታሉ አገልግሎት ከትላንት ጀምሮ አጠቃላይ የሬዝዴንት ስራ በማቆማቸው አገልግሎት ሙሉ በሙሉ በሚባል ደረጃ መቋረጡን አስረድተዋል።

ሆስፒታሉ ከፍተኛ ቁጥር ላለው ማህበረሰብ በየቀኑ አገልግሎት ይሰጥ እንደነበር የገለፁት አንድ ስማቸዉ እንዳይገለፅ የፈለጉ የጤና ባለሙያ ከትላንት ማክሰኞ ጀምሮ ግን የስፔሻሊቲ ሃኪሞች ስራ በማቆማቸዉ ተገልጋዮች እየመጡ እየተመለሱ መሆናቸውን ተናግረዋል።

ቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ በጉዳዩ ዙሪያ ያነጋገርናቸው የወላይታ ሶዶ ዩኒቨርሲቲ ስፔሻላይዝድ ሪፈራል ሆስፒታል ቺፍ ኤክስኪዩቲቭ ዳይሬክተር ዶ/ር ወኪል ወልዴ " ከሬዝዴንቶች በስተቀር ሆስፒታሉ አገልግሎት እየሰጠ ነዉ " ብለዋል።

" ኢንተርን ሐኪሞች በሆስፒታሉ አስቀድሞዉኑ የሉም " ያሉት ዳይሬክተሩ " ሬዝዴንት ሃኪሞችም ወደ ስራቸዉ እንዲመለሱ ዩኒቨርሲቲዉ በማስታወቂያ ጠርቷል " ሲሉ ገልፀዋል።

**" They have completely stopped working; only a few other health professionals are in the hospital; it can be said that work has stopped" - Wolaita Sodo Specialized Referral Hospital staff **

**➡️ " Except for resident doctors, other health professionals are working " - The hospital's executive director **

In a statement given to Tikvah Ethiopia by health professionals at Wolaita Sodo Specialized Referral Hospital; the hospital's services, which had been in the news recently due to national demands from health professionals, have been completely suspended since yesterday.

A health professional who asked not to be named said that the hospital used to provide services to a large number of people every day, but since Tuesday, patients have been returning since the specialist doctors stopped working.

Tikvah Ethiopia spoke to Dr. Wegel Wolde, Chief Executive Director of Wolaita Sodo University Specialized Referral Hospital, about the issue. “The hospital is providing services except for residents,” he said.

“There are no interns at the hospital yet,” the director said. “The university has also announced that resident doctors will return to work.”

**ኢሰመኮ የጤና ባለሙያዎች እያደረጉት ስላለው የሥራ ማቆም አድማ ምን አለ ?

" ጉዳዩ በውይይት እንዲፈታ የሚያደርገው ጥረት ይቀጥላል " - ኢሰመኮ
**
የኢትዮጵያ ሰብአዊ መብቶች ኮሚሽን (ኢሰመኮ) ከግንቦት 5 ቀን 2017 ዓ.ም. ጀምሮ በተለያዩ የሀገሪቱ ክፍሎች የጤና ባለሙያዎች በጤና ተቋማት ውስጥ በማድረግ ላይ የሚገኙት የሥራ ማቆም አድማ እንዲሁም ይህንን ተከትሎ በመንግሥት እየተወሰዱ ያሉ እርምጃዎች የሰብአዊ መብቶች ጥሰቶች እንዳያስከትሉ ትኩረት ሊሰጣቸው እና አፋጣኝ መፍትሔ ሊያገኙ እንደሚገባ አሳስቧል።

ኢሰመኮ አንዳንድ የጤና ባለሙያዎች የደመወዝ እና ከሥራ ሁኔታ ጋር የተያያዙ ጥያቄዎችን መንግሥት እንዲመልስ ሰጥተናል ያሉት የ30 ቀናት የጊዜ ገደብ ግንቦት 3 ቀን 2017 ዓ.ም. መጠናቀቁን ተከትሎ በመንግሥት እና በጤና ባለሙያዎች በመወሰድ ላይ የሚገኙትን እርምጃዎች በመከታተል ላይ እንደሚገኝ ገልጿል።

በዚህም መሠረት ኢሰመኮ ከአዲስ አበባ በተጨማሪ ፦
- ከአጋሮ፣ 
- ከአርባ ምንጭ፣ 
- ከባሕር ዳር፣ 
- ከፍቼ፣ 
- ከጎባ፣ ከሃዋሳ እና ከጅማ ከተሞች መረጃ ማሰባሰብ እንደቻለ ጠቁሟል።

ኢሰመኮ የጤና ባለሙያዎችን በመወከል የቀረቡለትን ከተመጣጣኝ ደመወዝ፣ ከጥቅማጥቅም፣ ከሙያ እድገት ዕድሎች እንዲሁም ከምቹ የሥራ ቦታ እና የሥራ ቦታ ነጻነት ጋር የተያያዙ ጥያቄዎች ሚያዝያ 3 ቀን 2017 ዓ.ም. ለጤና ሚኒስቴር ያቀረቡ መሆኑን እና " መንግሥት እነዚህን ባለ 12 ነጥብ ጥያቄዎች በተሰጠው 30 ቀናት አልፈጸመም " በሚል ከግንቦት 5 ጀምሮ የሥራ ማቆም አድማ ማድረጋቸውን ለመረዳት እንደቻለ ገልጿል።

ኢሰመኮ ጉዳዩን አስመልክቶ ከጤና ሚኒስቴር ኃላፊዎች፣ ከጤና ባለሙያዎች ተወካዮች እና ከሚመለከታቸው የመንግሥት አካላት ጋር ውይይቶችን ማካሄዱን ይፋ አድርጓል።

ከፊል እና ሙሉ የሥራ ማቆም አድማ ተከትሎም በአዲስ አበባ ክትትል ባደረገባቸው ፦
- የጥቁር አንበሳ፣ 
- የቅዱስ ጳውሎስ፣ 
- የቅዱስ ጴጥሮስ እና የዳግማዊ ምኒልክ ሆስፒታሎች ኃላፊዎች በማነጋገር መረጃዎችን እንዳሰባሰበ ገልጿል።

በዚህም መሠረት ፦

• በአንዳንድ የሕክምና ተቋማት በጽኑ ሕሙማን ማዕከል የሚገኙ ታማሚዎችን ጨምሮ በሐኪሞች እጥረት ተገቢውን ሕክምና ማግኘት አለመቻላቸውን፤ 

• ከክልል ከተሞች ረጅም ቀጠሮ ጠብቀው ለሕክምና የመጡ ታካሚዎች ለእንግልት የተዳረጉ መሆኑን፤ 

• በባለሙያዎች እጥረት ምክንያት አንዳንድ የሕክምና ተቋማት ባለሙያዎችን ለረጅም ፈረቃዎች እንዲሠሩ ለመመደብ የተገደዱ መሆኑን፤

• ታካሚዎች ሕክምና ለማግኘት ለረጅም ሰዓታት እንደሚጠብቁ ለማረጋገጥ እንደቻለ አሳውዋል።

በሌላ በኩል ፖሊስ " በማኅበራዊ ሚዲያዎች ቅስቀሳ አድርገዋል፤ በሌሎች በሥራ ላይ በተገኙ ባልደረቦቻቸው ላይ ዛቻ እና ማስፈራራት አድርሰዋል " ያላቸውን የጤና ባለሙያዎች በቁጥጥር ሥር ያዋለ መሆኑን ኢሰመኮ ለመረዳት እንደቻለ ገልጿል።

በቁጥጥር ሥር የዋሉ የጤና ባለሙያዎች አያያዝን አስመልክቶም ክትትል በማድረግ ላይ እንደሆነ አሳውቋቃ።

የኢሰመኮ ዋና ኮሚሽነር ብርሃኑ አዴሎ " በጤናው ዘርፍ የሚደረግ የሥራ ማቆም አድማ በማኅበረሰቡ የጤና እና በሕይወት የመኖር መብት ላይ አሉታዊ ተጽዕኖ ሊያስከትል የሚችል በመሆኑ የጤና ባለሙያዎች ያቀረቧቸውን ጥያቄዎች መንግሥት ትኩረት ሰጥቶ ግልጽ እና አሳታፊ በሆነ መንገድ መፍትሔ የሚያገኙበት ሁኔታ እንዲያመቻች " ሲሉ ጠይቀዋል።

የጤና ባለሙያዎችም የኅብረተሰቡን የጤና እና በሕይወት የመኖር መብቶችን አደጋ ላይ በማይጥል መልኩ ጥያቄዎቻቸውን እንዲያቀርቡ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል።

ዋና ኮሚሽነሩ አክለውም ከሥራ ማቆም አድማው ጋር በተያያዘ የሚወሰዱ አስተዳደራዊ እና ሌሎች ማናቸውም እርምጃዎች አግባብነት ያላቸውን ሕጎች እና የሰብአዊ መብቶች መርሖችን የተከተሉ ሊሆኑ እንደሚገባ አሳስበዋል። 

በተጨማሪም ኢሰመኮ ከመደበኛው የሰብአዊ መብቶች ክትትል እና ምርመራ ሥራው ጎን ለጎን ጉዳዩ የሚመለከታቸውን ባለድርሻ አካላት በማነጋገር ጉዳዩ በውይይት እንዲፈታ የሚያደርገውን ጥረት የሚቀጥል መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።

**What does the Ethiopian Human Rights Commission (EHRC) have to say about the ongoing strike by health workers?

"Efforts to resolve the issue through dialogue will continue" - EHRC

**
The Ethiopian Human Rights Commission (EHRC) has urged that the ongoing strike by health workers in various parts of the country since May 5, 2017, and the subsequent measures taken by the government should be given attention and immediate solutions to prevent human rights violations.

EHRC stated that it is monitoring the actions being taken by the government and health workers following the expiry of the 30-day deadline set by the government for some health workers to respond to their questions regarding salaries and working conditions on May 3, 2017.

Accordingly, ISEMCO indicated that in addition to Addis Ababa, it was able to collect information from:
- Agaro, 
- Arba Minch, 
- Bahir Dar, 
- Fefeche, 
- Goba, Hawassa and Jimma cities.

ISEMCO stated that it had submitted to the Ministry of Health on behalf of health professionals the questions related to fair wages, benefits, career development opportunities, and decent work and workplace freedom on April 3, 2017, and that it was able to understand that they had gone on strike since May 5, saying that "the government had not fulfilled these 12-point questions within the given 30 days."

ISEMCO announced that it had held discussions with officials of the Ministry of Health, representatives of health professionals and relevant government bodies regarding the matter.

Following the partial and full strike, the IOM said it had gathered information by talking to the heads of the following hospitals in Addis Ababa:
- Black Lion, 
- St. Paul, 
- St. Peter and Menelik II hospitals.

Accordingly, it has been learned that:

• In some medical institutions, including patients in intensive care units, patients are unable to receive appropriate treatment due to a shortage of doctors; 

• Patients who have come from regional cities for treatment after waiting for long appointments are being harassed; 

• Some medical institutions have been forced to assign professionals to work long shifts due to a shortage of professionals;

• Patients have been able to confirm that they are waiting for long hours to receive treatment.

On the other hand, the IOM said it has been able to understand that the police have arrested health professionals who "have been inciting on social media; and have threatened and intimidated their colleagues who were at work."

He also announced that he is monitoring the treatment of detained health workers.

ISEMCO Chief Commissioner Berhanu Adelo said, “A strike in the health sector can have a negative impact on the health and right to life of the community, so the government should pay attention to the demands of health workers and facilitate a transparent and participatory solution.”

He also called on health workers to present their demands in a manner that does not jeopardize the health and right to life of the community.

The Chief Commissioner further stressed that any administrative and other measures taken in connection with the strike should be in accordance with relevant laws and human rights principles. 

He also stated that ISEMCO will continue its efforts to resolve the issue through dialogue, in addition to its regular human rights monitoring and investigation work, by contacting relevant stakeholders.

" __**44 ጥንዶች በሥርዓተ ተክሊልና በመዓስባን በአንድ ቀን ጋብቻቸውን ይፈጽማሉ "  - ማኀበሩ
**
ለሁለተኛው ጊዜ በተዘጋጀው " የብዙኀን ጋብቻ " ፕሮግራም በኢትዮጵያ ኦርቶዶክስ ተዋህዶ ቤተ ክርስቲያን ስርዓት ግንቦት 21 ቀን 2017 ዓ/ም 44 ጥንዶችን በኀብረት እንደሚሞሸሩ የኢትዮጵያ ጃንደረባው ትውልድ ጃን ቃና ዘገሊላ ማኀበር ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ገለጸ።

" 44 ጥንዶች በአንድ ቀን ጋብቻቸውን ይፈጽማሉ " ያለው ማኀበሩ፣ ፕሮግራሙ እንደ ሺሕ ጋብቻ አይነት ሆኖ ግን የቤተክርስቲያንን ስርዓት በጠበቀ መልኩ የሚከናወን የሰርግ መርሃ ግብር መሆኑን አስረድቷል።

ጥንዶቹ እያንዳንዳቸው 20 ቤተሰቦቻቸውን በሰርጋቸው ቀን ምሳ እንደሚጋብዙ፣ በግብዣው 1,500 ሰዎች ይገኛሉ ተብሎ እንደሚጠበቅ፣ ሰርጉ ጦር ኃይሎች አካባቢ በሚገኘው ቶታል ደብረ ገነት ቅድስት ሥላሴ ቤተክርስቲያን እንደሚፈጸም ተመልክቷል።

ከሙሽሮቹ ቀለበትና ልብስ ውጭ የሰርጉ ወጪ በማኀበሩና በእስፖንሰሮች እንደደተሸፈነ፣ የፕሮግራሙ ዓላማ " ቤተ ክርስቲያን ልጆቿን የምትድርበት ቀን ክሬት በማድረግ " ወጣቶች በሥርዓተ ቤተ ክርስቲያን ጋብቻቸውን እንዲፈጽሙ ለማድረግ እንደሆነ ተብራርቷል።

ከዚህ ባሻገር ጥንዶቹ ከጋብቻ በኋላም በኢኮኖሚም ሆነ በማኀበራዊ ሕይወት ትስስር ለመፍጠር እንዲችሉ ማድረግ የፕሮግራሙ ዓላማ መሆኑ ተመልክቷል።

ቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያም፣ ይህ አይነቱ ፕሮግራም በሥዓተ ተክሊልም ሆነ በመዓስባን ለሚጋቡ ሙሽሮች ቅድሚያ የንስሃ አባት ሊኖራቸውና የትዳር ሥርዓትን ጭምር በጽሞና ሊማሩ እንደሚገባ የቤተ ክርስቲያኗ አስተምህሮ ያስረዳል፤ ሙሽሮቹ ይህን ቅድመ ሁኔታ አሟልተዋል ? ሲል ማኀበሩን ጠይቋል።

ምዝገባ የተደረገው ማኀበራዊ ሚዲያ እንደሆነ፤ አጠር ያለ ገለጻ ተሰጥቷቸው እንደሚመጡ እንደተነገራቸው፣ ንስሃ አባት እንዳላቸውና እንደሌላቸው ተረጋግጦ የሌላቸውን ንስሃ አባት እንዲይዙ እንደተደረገ በመግለጽ ማኀበሩ ምላሽ ሰጥቷል።

" በሥርዓተ ተክሊልና በመዓስባን የሚያጋቡ ጥንዶች ተለይተዋል። ስለጋብቻ ብቻ ሳይሆን ስለአጠቃላይ የትዳር ሕይወት፣ የልጆች አስተዳደግ፣ ስለስብዕናና ተግባቦት በተለያዩ መምህራን አንድ ወር ሙሉ ኮርስ ወስደዋል። ከመጀመሪያውም መሠረታዊ የሃይማኖት እውቀት ያላቸው ናቸው " ተብሏል።

አቅም ስለሚፈትን ቢያንስ በየሁለት ዓመቱ " የብዙኅን ጋብቻ " እንደሚዘጋጅ፣ ፕሮግራሙን ያዩ በቤተ ክርስቲያን ሥርዓት ያልተጋቡ ወገኖች እድሉ እንዲመቻችላቸው እየጠየቁ በመሆኑ፣ ንስሃ አባት ይዘው ሥጋወደሙ የሚቀበሉበትን የጋራ የቁርባን መርሃ ግብር ለማዘጋጀት በመስከረም 2 ቀን 2018 ዓ/ም እንደታቀደም ማኀበሩ ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ተናግሯል።

" __**44 couples to get married in a single day with Tekli and Maasban rituals " - The Association

**
The Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church will be holding its second "Multiple Marriage" program on May 21, 2017, the Ethiopian eunuch generation Jan Kana Zegelila Association told Tikvah Ethiopia.

The association, which said "44 couples will get married in a single day," explained that the program is similar to a thousand marriages but will be held in accordance with church rituals.

The couples will each invite 20 of their families to lunch on their wedding day, and 1,500 people are expected to attend the reception. The wedding will take place at the Total Debre Genet Holy Trinity Church in the military area.

The association and sponsors explained that the purpose of the program is to "celebrate the day the church places its children" and to allow young people to get married in church.

In addition, the program aims to enable couples to build economic and social ties after marriage.

Tikvah Ethiopia, a church organization, explains that this type of program, whether in a ceremony or in a church setting, requires that brides and grooms have a godfather and learn the rules of marriage thoroughly; the association asked the association whether the bride and groom met this requirement.

The association responded by stating that the registration was made through social media; they were given a brief explanation and told that they would come, and that they had a godfather and that those who did not had a godfather were asked to have one.

"Couples who will marry in the Tekli and Maasban ceremonies have been identified. They have taken a month-long course not only about marriage but also about general married life, raising children, personality and communication with various teachers. They have basic religious knowledge from the beginning," it was said.

Since it is a test of ability, a "plural marriage" is organized at least every two years, and since those who have not been married in the church system have been requesting that the opportunity be made available to them, the association told Tikvah Ethiopia that it is planned to organize a joint communion program on September 2, 2018, where they will receive the body of the deceased with a penitent father.

Tikvah Ethiopia
Addis Ababa

**" የመብት ጥያቄ ያነሱ ሙያተኞችን አስሮ እንደ መደራደሪያነት ማቅረብ አግባብ አይደለም " - ማህበሩ**

በባህር ዳር ከተማ በታሰሩ 6 የጤና ባለሙያዎች ላይ የፍርድ ቤት ትዕዛዝ ተፈፃሚ እንዲሆን ማህበሩ ጠየቀ።

በባህር ዳር ከተማ በሚገኙት በአዲስ አለምና ፈለገ ህይወት ስፔሻላይዝድ ሆስፒታል ይሰሩ የነበሩ 6 የጤና ባለሙያዎች ባለፈው ማክሰኞ ግንቦት 04/2017ዓ.ም መታሰራቸውን ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ የገለፀው የአማራ ክልል የጤና ባለሙያዎች ማህበር " አርብ ዕለት 08/2017 ዓ.ም ፍርድ ቀርበው የዋስትና መብታቸው ተጠብቆ እንዲለቀቁ ፍ/ቤት ቢወስንም ፖሊስ እስካሁን አለቀቃቸውም " ብሏል።

ስማቸው እንዲጠቀስ ያልፈለጉ የማህበሩ አመራር ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ " የባህር ዳር ከተማ ወረዳ ፍ/ቤት ባለፈው አርብ ያስተላለፈውን የዋስትና መብት ባለመፈፀሙ ትላንት ማክሰኞ 12/2017ዓ.ም ፖሊስን እንዲቀርብ አድርጎ ነበር ፖሊስም እንደገና አስቀጥሯል " ብለዋል።

ፍርድ ቤቱ የዋስትና መብታቸው ተጠብቆ ከእስር እንዲለቀቁ ውሳኔ ካስተላለፈ በኃላ ፖሊስ ለ5 ቀናት ከፍርድ ቤት ትዕዛዝ ውጭ በእስር ማቆየቱ የሙያ ማህበሩን አሳዝኖታል አሁንም የፍርድ ቤት ትዕዛዝ ተፈፃሚ እንዲሆን ጠይቋል ማህበሩ።

" የክልል ፣ የዞንና የቦርድ አመራሮች የጤና ባለሙያዎችን በመሰብሰብ ጏደኞቻችሁ ከእስር እንዲለቀቁ ስራ ጀምሩ ብለው እንደተደራደሩና ሰራተኞችም ስራ ሲጀምሩ ባለሙያዎችን ግን አለቀቋቸውም " ሲል ማህበሩ ገልጿል።

**"It is not appropriate to arrest professionals who have raised their rights and present them as bargaining chips" - the association**

The association has requested that the court order be enforced against the 6 health professionals arrested in Bahir Dar city.

The Amhara Regional Health Professionals Association, which informed Tikvah Ethiopia that the 6 health professionals who were working at the Addis Alem and Fele Hiwot Specialized Hospital in Bahir Dar city were arrested last Tuesday, May 04/2017, said, "They were brought to court on Friday, May 08/2017, and although the court ruled that they should be released on bail, the police have not yet arrested them."

The association's leadership, who did not want to be named, told Tikvah Ethiopia, "The Bahir Dar City District Court had ordered the police to appear yesterday, Tuesday, May 12/2017, and the police have arrested them again."

The association is disappointed that the police detained the doctors for 5 days without a court order after the court ruled to release them on bail. The association has now demanded that the court order be enforced.

"The regional, zonal and board leaders gathered health professionals and negotiated for their release from prison, but when the workers started working, they stopped them," the association said.

"It is not appropriate to arrest professionals who have raised their rights and present them as a bargaining chip," the association said, adding, "It is not appropriate to send regional, zonal and board leaders to ease the demand when the doctors' demand is to be addressed at the federal government level."

In a statement on national television yesterday, Health Minister Dera Dugama said that health professionals who have stopped working should resume work immediately. He warned that action would be taken against unlicensed professionals, up to and including revoking their professional licenses. 

The Minister of State, however, did not say anything about the arrested professionals.

Tikvah Ethiopia

**" It would be good if a traditional people-to-people reconciliation system was implemented for the frequent revenge attacks in the area " - Residents of Dasanach**

Residents of Dasanach Woreda told Tikvah Ethiopia that frequent clashes between Kenya's Turkana State and Ethiopia's South Omo Zone Dasanach Woreda have resulted in the deaths of many people, with one deadly attack on both sides in the past five days.

On the Ethiopian side, they said that two months ago, three family members were killed in a revenge attack on Turkana herders, and on the Kenyan side, a fisherman was seriously injured in an attack on Sunday and sent to Jinka Hospital.

The residents told Tikvah Ethiopia that the region has been plagued by such attacks for many years, and that since the pastoralists of Turkana in Kenya and the Dassene in Ethiopia are closely linked, it would be good to hold a traditional reconciliation ceremony to bring lasting peace to the region.

Tikvah Ethiopia had spoken to the leaders of the two neighboring countries a few days ago and noted that the attacks occurred during a scheduled public-to-public peace conference and reconciliation program.
