**TPLF's Deregistration and Legal Expert's Opinion!

(Tikvah Ethiopia - Part One)**

**Did the TPLF Issue Need a Political Solution?

**
The Ethiopian National Election Board deregistered the TPLF from its status as a political party on May 6, 2017.

A legal expert provided a professional explanation to Tikvah Ethiopia regarding this.

The legal expert and human rights activist, Ato Yared Hailemariam, provided the professional explanation and told Tikvah Ethiopia that the TPLF issue should have been addressed politically, not through a rigid legal framework. 

Stating that political parties in Ethiopia have different ages, founding histories, and statuses, the expert said that it is not appropriate to place these parties on one table and view them only through one law. 

The expert said that while the Pretoria Peace Agreement should have determined the fate of the TPLF, there are many issues that the agreement did not address and did not clarify, including this issue. Since the agreement contains a wide range of issues, it should have been clarified in other documents. 

**What did the legal expert say in detail?**

"The questions raised by the Election Board against the TPLF are in accordance with the law, while the issues raised by the TPLF are political. 

'We should not register as a new party, it has been a party for a long time, we will continue as an existing party, we should not register as a new party being established today,' is what the TPLF says. The TPLF issue should have been resolved only through politics.

The TPLF issue only needs a political solution. You cannot solve such a problem with a dry legal article. 

The TPLF is not an organization that was created by simply opening an office, gathering members and registering them with the Election Board. It is an organization that has a territory, has armed forces, and was created through armed struggle. It has been established and governed the country for years without anyone giving it permission. 

In Ethiopia The difference between the parties, some have a state, armed forces, and others only hold offices and members. They are competing forces without equal status. 

You cannot treat such disparate and different parties with the same law. Because the law sees them as equal. But their nature and formation are different. 

Therefore, political dialogue is needed. "

**Is the Pretoria Agreement flawed?**

" Until the Pretoria Agreement was signed, the TPLF was not only a party but also a regional government. One of the problems with the Pretoria Agreement is that it did not include documents that explained in detail the next steps. 

While both signatories had good relations at the time, there were issues that should have been worked on but were not worked on. There were many issues that should have been explained in other documents. 

The Pretoria document is a package, it does not explain many things. The key and main point of that agreement The goal was to end the war immediately and save the people who were suffering. 

It is not a document that sets out the future fate of the Tigray region, the fate of the TPLF, and how the relationship between the federal government and the Tigray regional government will be in a year or two. These things should have been explained in a document later. That package agreement should have been supported by other documents. 

This document should have been prepared after peace was established. It is impossible to think about this while the shooting was going on. However, such a document should have been prepared in the process that could resolve future disputes. "

**Would it have been possible to give special recognition by a political decision?**

" Birtukan Mideksa, who was heading the Election Board, said, 'I will not recognize a party that has been classified as a terrorist organization, the existing law does not allow it,' and the federal government gave a political solution. 

If a new law is passed and an organization that has been classified as a terrorist organization chooses a peaceful path again, It was said that it could be registered. This was a political decision. 

But at that time, it was not necessary to amend the guidelines for re-registering the party, but to directly restore its legal recognition. This was a missed opportunity. 

The fate of the TPLF could have been decided there and then by law. In order to have political legitimacy, it would have been possible to continue by including an additional article in the TPLF's status and confirming its recognition by law without a new registration process, but by fulfilling the conditions and obligations expected of any party. 

After that, questions would have arisen on technical issues, not on the existence of the party. 

If the law recognizing the TPLF were passed by parliament, the Election Board would not have said no. In this way, you would have given special recognition, but from now on, you would have said 'you will be governed by the laws of the Election Board like any other political party'. If that were the case, there would have been no problem. 

The argument that we will give you new recognition today or not is a wrong political argument. "I think it was the decision that made it."

Tikvah Ethiopia
Addis Ababa

**“ Yesterday 89 children came, today 85 children came; tomorrow 90, Saturday 90 children will come” - Parents’ Committee
**
More than 70 of the many Ethiopians who were in trouble in Myanmar have returned to their country in two days, the Parents’ Committee told Tikvah Ethiopia.

In a statement, the committee indicated that 89 Ethiopians arrived yesterday and the Parents’ Committee welcomed them and sent them home.

It also stated that 85 children arrived today, and that 90 will arrive tomorrow and Saturday 90 children.

**“ **Our children are coming to us consistently well,” it told Tikvah Ethiopia.

The committee explained that it is raising the issue of the return of other Ethiopians who have not come to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

“There were some disturbances; children are being misled; I think there are brokers who are deliberately making the children feel uneasy,” it said.

“They said, ‘The NGO can only take a few people; we will stay here; the delegation will return after 18 days; we are in trouble, ask the Ministry of Foreign Affairs,’ so we went and talked to them,” he said.

“The ministry responded that there is nothing new except that those with passports and tickets, first, and second, even if their tickets are expired, those with passports, and third, those without tickets and passports, will be paid 20% by Ethiopian Airlines and 80% by the NGO,” he said.

The committee sent a message through Tikvah Ethiopia to Ethiopians to wait patiently until they return to their country.

**
__➡️ __**“ 'በእጃችን ይዘን በምንገባው ገንዘብ ራሳችንን ለማኖር እየተቸገርን ነው' እያሉ ባሉበት ወቅት ወርደው ሳያወያዩ ከደመወዛቸው መቆረጡ መምህራኑን አስቆጥቷል ” - የባስኬቶ ዞን መምህራን ማኀበር**

በደቡብ ኢትዮጵያ ክልል ባስኬቶ ዞን የላስካ ዙሪያ ወረዳ መምህራን፣ “ለህዳሴ ግድብ የቦንድ ግዥ” በሚል በአመራሮች ያለፈቃዳቸው እና ውይይት ሳይደረግ ደመወዛቸው መቆረጡ እንዳስቆጣቸው መምህራኑ፣ የክልሉና የመምህራን መምህራን ማኀበር ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ተናገሩ።

መምህራኑ፣ “ የዚህን ወር ደመወዛችንን ቆረጡት። ማንም ቀድሞ ያወያዬን የለም። አፈና ነው የተፈጸመብን ” ሲሉ ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ተናግረዋል።

“ ያለፈቃዳይችን ያለአግባብ የተቆረጠ ብራችን ይመለስልን። ለምን ብሎ የጠየቀን መምህር የወረዳው አካላት እያሰቃዩት ነው ” ብለዋል።

የባስኬቶ ዞን መምህራን ማኀበር ሊቀመንበር ወ/ሮ ካሰች ሲደልል የመምህራኑ ደመወዝ መቆረጡን፣ እንደ ዞን ማኀበር ደመወዝ እንዲቆረጥ በሚል ስለውውይቱ “ የማውቀው ነገር የለም ” ብለዋል።

**የዞኑ መምህራን ማኀበር ሊቀመንበር ወ/ሮ ካሰች ሲደልል**__ __**ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ምን አለ ?
**
“ የከተማ አስተዳደሩና የዞኑ መምህራን ማኀበር በውይይቱ አልተሳተፉም። ከወረዳ መምህራን ማኀበርም ሱፐር ቫይዘርና ርዕሳነ መምህሪንን ጠርተው ሲያወያዩ ሀሳብ ለመስጠት እድል የመንፈግ አይነት አዝማሚያዎቹ ነበሩ።

' ከደመወዛችሁ ለመቁረጥ የትኛው ጊዜ ይመቻችኋል? ' በሚል ዙሪያም ውይይት አልተካሄደም። ከየትኛው ወገን ጋር ውይይት እንዳካሄዱ የማውቀው ነገር የለም። ውይይት አልተካሄደም።

ውይይት ባልተካሄደበትም እንደመምህር ያቅሜን ያክል ቦንድ ለመግዛት የተወሰነ ብር ለትምህርት ቤት ርዕሰ መምህር ሰጥቻለሁ፤ ሌሎቹም እንደዚሁ ባላቸው ልክ እየተሳተፉ ናቸው። ይሄንንም ከችግር አኳያ እንጅ ኖሮን፣ ደልቶን አይደለም። 

ከ2012 ዓ/ም ጀምሮ የደረጃ እድገት፣ የትምህርት ለውጥ፣ የትኛውም የመምህራን ጥቅማጥቅም ምንም ተከፍሎ አይታወቅም እንደ ባስኬቶ ዞን። በዚህ ቅሬታ ውስጥ ያለን መምህር ነው አሁን እንዲህ የተደረገው።

'በእጃችን ይዘን በምንገባው ገንዘብ ራሳችንን ለማኖር እየተቸገርን ነው' እያሉ ባሉበት ወቅት ወርደው ሳያወያዩ ከደመወዛቸው መቆረጡ መምህራኑን አስቆጥቷል። ‘እኛ ሥራ እስከማቆም እንደርሳለን እያሉ ነው ” ብለዋል።
**
የክልሉ መምህራን ማኀበር ፕሬዜዳንት አቶ አማኑኤል ጳውሎስ ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ምን አሉ ?
**
“ የወረዳው መምህራንን ሳያወያዩና በአስተዳደር ውሳኔ በሚል ደብዳቤ ከሚያዚያ 2017 ዓ/ም ጀምሮ ደመወዝ ተቆርጦባቸው አቤቱታ እያቀረቡ ነው።

ይህንንም አቤቱታ የቅርብ ክትትል በማድረግ እንዲፈቱ ለክልሉ ትምህርት ቢሮ ያሳወቅንና እነሱም ተገቢ እንዳልሆነ ተረድተው ከዞኑና ከወረዳው አመራሮች ጋር ውይይት እንደሚያደርጉ ቢገልጹም መፍትሄ ሳይገኝ ከደመወዛቸው የተቆረጠባቸው መምህራን አሉ ” ብለዋል።

ቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ለቅሬታው ምላሽ የጠየቀው የደቡብ ኢትዮጵያ ክልል ትምህርት ቢሮ፣ በጉዳዩ ዙሪያ ውይይት እየተደረገ መሆኑን፣ ውይይቱ ሲጠናቀቅ ማብራሪያ እንደሚሰጥ ገልጿል።

ቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ
አዲስ አበባ

__**“ Our salaries have been cut without our consent; let them be returned ” - Teachers 
**
__➡️ __**“ When they were saying, ‘We are struggling to support ourselves with the money we earn,’ the teachers were angered by the fact that their salaries were cut without discussion ” - Basketo Zone Teachers’ Association**

Teachers in the Laska Zuru district of the Basketo Zone of the Southern Ethiopian Region, told Tikvah Ethiopia that they were angry that their salaries were cut without their consent and without discussion by the leaders, saying “bond purchase for the Renaissance Dam.” The teachers, the region’s teachers’ association and the teachers’ association told Tikvah Ethiopia.

The teachers said, “ They cut our salaries for this month. No one talked to us before. We were kidnapped,” they told Tikvah Ethiopia.

“Let’s get our money back, which was cut without our permission. The district authorities are torturing the teacher who asked us why,” he said.

The Chairperson of the Basque Zone Teachers’ Association, Ms. Kassech Sidelle, said that she “does not know anything” about the teachers’ salary cut, and that the Zone Teachers’ Association should cut the salary.

**The Chairperson of the Zone Teachers’ Association, Ms. Kassech Sidelle**__ __**What does Tikvah Ethiopia have to say?

**
“The city administration and the zonal teachers’ association did not participate in the discussion. When the woreda teachers’ association called the supervisor and the head teacher for discussion, they were denied the opportunity to give their opinions.

There was no discussion on the issue of ‘When is it convenient for you to cut your salary?’. I do not know with which party they discussed it. No discussion took place.

Even though there was no discussion, I gave some money to the school principal to buy a bond as much as I can as a teacher; the others are also participating in the same way. We did this only because of the problem, and we did not give it away.

Since 2012, no promotion, education change, or any other benefit has been paid to teachers, according to the Basketo zone. This is what happened to the teacher who is in this complaint.

When they were saying, ‘We are struggling to support ourselves with the money we earn,’ they came down The teachers were angered by the fact that their salaries were cut without discussion. “They are saying that we will stop working,” he said.
**
What did the President of the Regional Teachers’ Association, Ato Amanuel Paulos, tell Tikvah Ethiopia?
**
“The teachers of the district have been complaining about their salaries being cut without discussion and by a letter called an administrative decision since April 2017.

We have informed the Regional Education Bureau of this complaint to resolve it by closely monitoring it, and they have also stated that they will hold discussions with the zone and district leaders, but there are teachers whose salaries have been cut without a solution being found,” he said.

Tikvah Ethiopia asked the Southern Ethiopia Regional Education Bureau for a response to the complaint, stating that discussions are underway on the issue and that an explanation will be provided once the discussions are completed.

**ጤና ሚኒስቴር ምን አለ ?**

**" የጤና ሞያ የሥራ ማቆም አድማ ከማይደረጉባቸው የሥራ ዘርፎች መካከል አንዱ መሆኑ በግልጽ ተደንግጓል " - ጤና ሚኒስቴር**

ዛሬ ምሽት ጤና ሚኒስቴር በወቅታዊ የጤና አገልግሎት ዙሪያ መግለጫ አውጥቷል።

ሚኒስቴሩ "  መቼምና በምንም ሁኔታ መቋረጥ ከሌለባቸው ማኅበራዊ አገልግሎቶች አንዱ የጤና አገልግሎት ነው " ያለ ሲሆን "  ዛሬን ጨምሮ ባለፉት ቀናት በመላ ሀገራችን በሚገኙ የጤና ተቋማት እንደ ወትሮው ሁሉ መደበኛ የጤና አገልግሎቶች ለማኅበረሰባችን ያለምንም መቆራረጥና መስተጓጎል እየተሰጡ ይገኛሉ " ብሏል።

" ይሄንን የተረዳው የጤና ባለሞያ በማኅበራዊ ሚዲያ በሚሠራጩ የተሳሳቱ መረጃዎች ጫና ሳይገፋ የገባውን የሞያ ቃል ኪዳን እና መሐላ ጠብቆ ማኅበረሰቡን እያገለገለ በመሆኑ ምስጋና ይገባዋል " ሲል ገልጿል።

ሚኒስቴሩ " በጥቂት የማስተማሪያ የጤና ኮሌጆች/ተቋማት በመደበኛ የሥራ ገበታቸው ላይ ያልተገኙ የተወሰኑ ባለሞያዎች እንዳሉ መረጃዎች ደርሰውናል " ያለ ሲሆን " ከእነዚህ የጤና  ባለሞያዎች መካከል ብዙዎቹ በሐሰተኛ መረጃ የተወናበዱ ሲሆኑ ጥቂቶቹ ደግሞ ጥፋትን ዓላማቸው ያደረጉ ናቸው " ብሏል።

" ድርጊቱ የራስን ቤተሰብ፣ ዘመድ፣ ወገን እና መላውን ማኅበረሰብ ከመጉዳት ባለፈ ከሞያ ሥነ ምግባር፣ ከሰብአዊነት አኳያ ተቀባይነት የሌለው ተግባር ነው " ሲል ገልጿል።

" ከሕግ አኳያም የጤና ሞያ የሥራ ማቆም አድማ ከማይደረጉባቸው የሥራ ዘርፎች መካከል አንዱ መሆኑ በግልጽ ተደንግጓል። የጤና ባለሞያዎች ጥያቄ እንኳን ቢኖራቸው በሥራ ገበታቸው ተገኝተው መደበኛ ሥራቸውን እያከናወኑ ጉዳያቸውን ለሚመለከተው አካል ማቅረብ ይጠበቅባቸዋል " ብሏል።

" እነዚህ የጤና ባለሞያዎች ወደ ሥራ ገበታቸው ተመልሰው ማኅበረሰባቸውን እንዲያገለግሉ በየተቋማቸው ጥሪ ተደርጓል " ያለው ጤና ሚኒስቴር  " መንግሥት የጤና ባለሞያውን ዘላቂ ተጠቃሚነት ባረጋገጠ መልኩ በጥናት ላይ የተመሠረተ መፍትሔ ለመስጠት ቀደም ብሎ የጤና አገልግሎት አስተዳደርና ቁጥጥር አዋጅ 1362 /2017 አጸድቆ ደንብና መመሪያዎችን በማውጣት ትኩረት ሰጥቶ እየሠራ ይገኛል " ሲል ገልጿል።

" በጎ ኅሊና ያላቸው የጤና ባለሞያዎች ይህንን በመገንዘብ ሥራቸውን በአግባቡ እንዲያከናውኑ  ጥሪ እናቀርባለን " ብሏል ሚኒስቴሩ።

" በሌላ በኩል ኅብረተሰቡ በተለያዩ ማኅበራዊ ሚዲያዎች በሚሠራጩ  የሐሰት መረጃዎች ሳይረበሽ የሚፈልገውን የጤና አገልግሎት በተለመደው መልኩ በጤና ተቋማት ማግኘት እንደሚችል እናሳውቃለን " ብሏል።

" መንግሥት በሆደ ሰፊነት ችግሩን ለመፍታት ያሳየውን ትዕግሥት ወደጎን በመተው በሥራ ገበታቸው ላይ ባልተገኙ እንዲሁም በጤና ተቋሙም ሆነ ከጤና ተቋሙ ውጭ ሆነው ሁከትና ብጥብጥ በሚፈጥሩት ላይ አስፈላጊ የሆነ ሕጋዊ እርምጃ የሚወሰድ መሆኑን ቀድመን እናሳውቃለን " ሲል አስጠንቅቋል።

ከሰሞኑን በተለያዩ የሀገሪቱ አካባቢዎች የጤና ባለሙያዎች " መኖር ከብዶናል የጤና ስርዓቱ መለወጥ አለበት ለዚህም ያቀረብናቸው ጥያቄዎች አሉ የጊዜ ገደብ ብናስቀምጥም ምላሽ አልተሰጣቸውም " በማለት ከፊል የስራ ማቆም አድማ እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።

ሆስፒታሎችም በስራ ገበታቸው ላይ ያልተገኙ ባለሙያዎች ወደ ስራቸው እንዲመለሱ ማስታወቂያ በማውጣት እያስጠነቀቁ ናቸው።

የኢትዮጵያ ጤና ባለሙያዎች ማኅበር በጤና ባለሙያዎች የተነሱት ጥያቄዎች ትክክል እንደሆኑና እንደሚደግፋቸው እንዲሁም ሊመለሱ እንደሚገባቸው በተደጋጋሚ ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ በሰጠው ቃል አቋሙን ገልጿል።

ከትላንት በስቲያ በሰጠው ቃል ደግሞ " ለጤና ባለሙያዎች ጥያቄ ምላሽ ለመስጠት  አረፈደም፤ እልህ በመጋባት የጸጥታ ኃይል በማሰማራት የጤና ባለሙያዎችን ማፈኑ ቁሞ ለጥያቄዎቹ ምላሽ ለመስጠት ትኩረት ይደረግ "  ብሎ ነበር።

ከጤና ባለሙያዎቹ እንቅስቃሴ ጋር በተያያዘ ለእስር እየተዳረጉ በርካታ ባለሙያዎች እንዳሉ በርካቶችም ማስፈራሪያና ወከባ እየደረሰባቸው እንደሆነ ማኅበሩ ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ አሳውቋል።

**What did the Ministry of Health say?**

**" The health profession is one of the sectors where strikes are not allowed " - Ministry of Health**

The Ministry of Health issued a statement on the current health service.

The ministry said, "Health service is one of the social services that should never be interrupted under any circumstances," and added, "In the past few days, including today, regular health services have been provided to our community without interruption or disruption in health institutions across the country."

"The health professional who understood this deserves praise for serving the community by keeping his professional promise and oath, without being pressured by false information spread on social media," he said.

The ministry said, "We have received information that some health professionals are absent from their regular work schedule at some teaching health colleges/institutions," adding, "Many of these health professionals were misled by false information, while some were malicious."

"This act is not only harmful to one's own family, relatives, friends, and the entire community, but is also unacceptable from a professional and humanitarian perspective," it said.

"The law clearly states that the health profession is one of the sectors where strikes are not allowed. Even if health professionals have a question, they are expected to attend their workplace and present their case to the relevant authorities while performing their regular duties," it said.

"These health professionals have been called upon to return to their jobs and serve their communities," the Ministry of Health said, adding that "the government has been working diligently to provide a research-based solution that ensures the long-term benefit of health professionals by approving the Health Service Administration and Supervision Proclamation 1362/2017 and issuing regulations and guidelines."

"We call on health professionals with good conscience to realize this and carry out their duties properly," the Ministry said.

"On the other hand, we inform the public that they can access the health services they need in the normal way at health institutions without being disturbed by false information spread on various social media."

"We warn that necessary legal action will be taken against those who are absent from their work and those who create chaos and unrest both inside and outside the health facility, leaving aside the government's patience to resolve the problem," he warned.

Recently, health professionals in various parts of the country have been going on a partial strike, saying, "It is difficult for us to live, the health system must change, and we have submitted our demands, but they have not been responded to even though we set a deadline."

Hospitals are also issuing notices warning professionals who are absent from their work to return to work.

The Ethiopian Health Professionals Association has repeatedly stated in its statements to Tikvah Ethiopia that the demands raised by health professionals are valid and support them, and that they should be answered.

In a statement issued yesterday, he said, "It is too late to respond to the questions of health professionals; the use of force to suppress health professionals should be stopped and attention should be paid to answering their questions."

The association informed Tikvah Ethiopia that many professionals are being arrested in connection with the activities of health professionals, and many are being threatened and harassed.

Tikvah Ethiopia
Addis Ababa

ዛሬ ግንቦት 7/2017 ዓ.ም በትግራይ ደቡባዊ ዞን  ማይጨው ከተማ የደብረፅዮን ገ/ሚካኤል (ዶ/ር) ህወሓት ባላፈው ሳምንት የሰጠውን ጋዜጣዊ መግለጫ የሚቃወም ሰልፍ ተካሄደ።

የዞኑ አስተዳደር በመራውና ባስተባበረው ዛሬ በተካሄደው ሰላማዊ ሰልፍ የሊቀ-መንበሩን መግለጫ ሙሉ በሙሉ በመቃወም ቡድኑ ያሰበውን ከመፈፀም እንዲቆጠብ የሚያስጠነቀቁ የቁጣ ድምፆች ተሰምተዋል።

በሰልፉ ፦
-  ምርጫችን ሰላም ነው !
-  አስተዳደራችን ለሚነካ የህወሓት ከፋይ ቡድን አንታገስም !
- ኋላቀር አስተሳሰብን እንቃወማወለን !
-  የሻእቢያ ተልእኮ ከሚያስፈፅም ሃይል ግንኙነት የለንም !
- በምስለኔ አንመራም !

የሚሉና ሌሎች መፈክሮች ተደምጠዋል። 

በሰላማዊ ሰልፉ የተገኙ ዳግም ጦርነት አንዳይንቀሳቀስ ስጋት ያደረባቸው እናቶች በምህላና እንባ መሬት ላይ ተኝተው ሲማጸኑ ታይተዋል።

በሰላማዊ ሰልፉ በመገኘት መልእክት ያስተላለፉት የማይጨው ከተማ ከንቲባ ዮሃንስ አዱኛና የዞኑ ዋና አስተዳዳሪ ሃፍቱ ኪሮስ ፤ ህዝቡ ሰላሙ እንዳይነጠቅ ከማንኛውም ጊዜ በላይ ንቁ መሆን አለበት ብለዋል።

**"Our choice is peace; we will not tolerate the TPLF's corrupt group that affects our administration" - Voice of the peaceful protesters of the southern zone of Tigray**

**🔴 "We oppose backward thinking, we have no connection with the forces that carry out the mission of Shabia! " **
 
Today, May 7/2017, a demonstration was held in Maichew town of the southern zone of Tigray to protest the press conference given by Debretsion Geber Michael (Dr.) TPLF last week.

Yesterday, May 6/2017, the chairman of the TPLF, Debretsion Geber Michael (Dr.), who was expelled from Ethiopian political parties, threatened to "conduct a leadership adjustment in the southern zone of the region" in a statement given to his organization, Wine, last week.

In the peaceful demonstration held today, led and coordinated by the zone administration, angry voices were heard warning the group to refrain from carrying out its plans in complete opposition to the statement of the chairman.

During the demonstration:
- Our choice is peace!
- We will not tolerate a TPLF support group that affects our administration!
- We oppose backward thinking!
- We have no connection with the forces carrying out the Shabia mission!
- We will not lead by our own will!

Other slogans were heard.

Mothers who were afraid of resuming the war were seen lying on the ground in tears and begging for mercy.

The mayor of Myechew city, Yohannes Adugna, and the chief administrator of the zone, Haftu Kiros, who delivered messages during the peaceful demonstration; The people must be more vigilant than ever to prevent the peace from being disrupted, he said.

The Tikvah Ethiopia Mekelle family confirmed that the rally was a pre-planned program unrelated to yesterday's TPLF demobilization.

Information obtained from the Tikvah Ethiopia Communications Office shows that the participants, who came from all walks of life, concluded their rally peacefully.

**" We express our deep gratitude to the government for allowing the three blessed bishops to enter the country and for their practical response" - Permanent Synod

**
The Permanent Synod of the Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church has issued a statement regarding the entry of the three blessed fathers into the country.

The Permanent Synod stated in its statement, "Our Holy Church has requested through the Holy Synod that the following persons, who are assigned to overseas dioceses and are carrying out their apostolic ministry:
- His Holiness Abune Petros (Dr.), Secretary General of the Holy Synod and Archbishop of the Diocese of New York and its surrounding areas;
- His Holiness Abune Theophilos (Dr.), Archbishop of the Diocese of Northern California and its surrounding areas;
- His Holiness Abune Yacob, Archbishop of the Diocese of Georgia and its surrounding areas, return to the country and participate in the annual plenary session of the Holy Synod."

"As we have seen in the statement that the government is committed to strengthening national institutions, we understand that close dialogue is the best solution to maintain the peace of our country; to preserve the historical aspect of our Holy Church, and we have allowed the three bishops to enter the country and participate in the Holy Synod Assembly," he said.

"Therefore, we express our deep gratitude for accepting the request made by our Holy Church, allowing the three blessed bishops to enter the country, and for giving a practical response," he said.

The Permanent Synod announced, "In the future, we express our readiness to strengthen our relations and work together on issues that benefit our country and our people so that there will be secure peace in the land that God has given us; the country that our fathers have preserved for us."

ባለፉት 2 እና 3 ዓመታት በተሰራው ስራ ከ15 ሚሊዮን በላይ ዜጎች ለፋይዳ / ብሔራዊ መታወቂያ መመዝገባቸውን ጠ/ሚ ዐቢይ አሕመድ (ዶ/ር) ገለጹ።

ይህን የገለጹት " ቴክ-ቶክ " ከተሰኘ የቴሌቪዥን ፕሮግራም ጋር ባደረጉት ቃለምልልስ ነው።

ባለፉት 2 እና 3 ዓመታት በተሰራው ስራ አሁን ላይ ከ15 ሚሊዮን በላይ ዜጎች የፋይዳ / ብሔራዊ መታወቂያ እንዳወጡ የገለጹት ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ዐቢይ (ዶ/ር) እስከ መጪው መስከረም ወር ድረስ 20 ሚሊዮን ይጠጋል ተብሎ እንደሚታሰብ ተናግረዋል።

በሚቀጥለው ዓመት ፋይዳ መታወቂያ ያላቸው ዜጎችን ቁጥር ወደ 60 እና 70 ሚሊዮን ለማድረስ እንደሚታሰብ ጠቁመዋል።

" በቀጣይ 2 እና 3 ዓመታት ውስጥ እያንዳንዱ ሰው የሚታወቅ ከሆነ እንደ ሀገር ለብዙ ነገር ለፕላኒንግ፣ ለገቢ፣ ለንግድ ፣ ለመተማመን ያግዛል " ብለዋል።

" ፋይዳ ፋይዳው የጎላ ነው " ያሉት ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ ፋይዳ ፦
- የሚፈጸሙ ህገወጥ ንግዶችን ለመከላከል
- መጭበርበሮችን ለመቀነስ
- ያልተስተካከለውን የንግድ ስርዓት ለማሻሻል
- ለኢኮኖሚው
- መተማመንን ለመገንባት
- ለአጠቃላይ የንግድ ስርዓቱ
- ለሰላም እና ደህንነቱ
- ወጥቶ ለመግባቱ
- አገልግሎት ለማግኘቱ ... በአጠቃላይ በሁሉም መስክ ያለው ሚና ከፍተኛ እንደሆነ አስረድተዋል።

ፋይዳ ብዙ ሴክተሮችን የሚነካ መሆኑን በመጠቆም " እያንዳንዱ ዜጋ ሊኖረው የሚግባ ነገር ነው "  ሲሉ ገልጸዋል።

እያንዳንዱ ሰው መታወቅ እንዳለበትም አስገንዘበዋል።

" ፋይዳን የተገበሩ ሀገራት ተጠቅመዋል የተዘናጉ ሀገራት ደግሞ የደረሰባቸው ጉዳት አለ " ያሉት ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ዐቢይ አሕመድ (ዶ/ር) " አፍሪካ ውስጥ የሞከሩ ሀገራት አሉ በትክክል ግን በእኛ በዲጂታል አይዲ መልክ አይደለም የሞከሩት እኛ የጀመርነውን ዲጂታል አይዲ ለመማር ብዙ የአፍሪካ ሀገራት በገንዘብ ውልም ጭምር ጥያቄ እያቀረቡ ነው ያሉት ፤ እኛም የሚሳካልን ለሌሎችም ትምህርት የሚሆን ስራ እንደምንሰራ ተስፋ አደርጋለሁ ጥቅሙም ከፍተኛ ነው " ብለዋል።

ቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ
አዲስ አበባ

**" Everyone should be identified " - PM Abiy Ahmed (PhD) **

Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed (PhD) said that over 15 million citizens have registered for Faida / National ID in the past 2 to 3 years.

He made this statement in an interview with the television program "Tek-Talk".

Prime Minister Abiy (PhD), who stated that over 15 million citizens have registered for Faida / National ID in the past 2 to 3 years, said that it is expected to reach 20 million by September.

He indicated that the number of citizens with Faida IDs is expected to reach 60 to 70 million next year.

" If everyone is identified in the next 2 to 3 years, it will help a lot for planning, income, trade, and trust as a country," he said.

"The benefits are immense," the Prime Minister said. Benefits:
- To prevent illegal trade
- To reduce fraud
- To improve the unregulated trade system
- To the economy
- To build trust
- To the overall trade system
- To peace and security
- To enter and exit
- To obtain services... In general, the role of benefits in all fields is great.

He explained that benefits affect many sectors and said, "It is something that every citizen should have."

He also emphasized that everyone should be recognized.

"The countries that have implemented the benefits have benefited, and the countries that have neglected the benefits have suffered," said Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed (Dr.). "There are countries in Africa that have tried, but not in the form of digital ID. They have tried, but not in the form of our digital ID. Many African countries are asking for financial support to learn the digital ID that we have started. I hope that we will succeed and do something that will be a lesson to others. The benefits are great," he said.

#ኢትዮጵያ

**ኢትዮጵያ ውስጥ በውጭ ምንዛሪ መገበያየት ይቻላል ? የብሔራዊ ባንክ መመሪያ በትክክል ምን ይላል ?
**
የኢትዮጵያ ብሔራዊ ባንክ፣ ባለፈው አመት 2016 ሐምሌ ወር ላይ የውጭ ምንዛሬ ግብይት በነፃ ገበያ እንዲመራ ከወሰነ በኋላ፣ አብሮ ይፋ በተደረገው መመሪያ በውጭ ምንዛሪ ግብይት ላይ አንዳንድ ማሻሻዎችን ማድረጉን አስታውቋል፡፡ 

በመመሪያው ላይ የተዘረዘሩትን ተግባራት መሰረት በማድረግም፣ ከህብረተሰቡ በኩል ኢትዮጵያ ውስጥ በውጭ ምንዛሪ መገበያየት ይቻላል ወይ ? የሚል ጥያቄ ይነሳል፡፡ 

ቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ፣ ይህን በሚመለከት የባንክ ባለሙያዎች ማብራሪያ ጠይቋል፡፡ 

በዚህ ጉዳይ ዙርያ ማብራሪያቸውን ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ የሰጡት የብሔራዊ ባንክ ባለሙያ ምን አሉ ?

" ኢትዮጵያ ውስጥ ከተፈቀደላቸው ሰዎች ውጪ፣ በውጭ ምንዛሪ መገበያየት አይፈቀድም፡፡ ማንኛውም ኢትዮጵያዊ በውጭ ምንዛሪ ወይም ዶላር መገበያየት አይችልም፡፡ 

ግብይትን በዶላር የሚፈፅሙ ሰዎች፣ የተፈቀደላቸው ብቻ ናቸው፡፡ እነዚህም ዶላር ይዘው ከውጭ የሚመጡ ቱሪስቶች፣ ዲያስፖራዎች እና የዲፕሎማቲክ ማህበረሰብ አባላት ሊሆኑ ይችላሉ፡፡ እነዚህ ሰዎች ከውጭ ሲመጡ እስከ 10 ሺህ ዶላር ይዘው እንዲገቡ ስለሚፈቀድላቸው፣ በጉምሩክ አስመዝግበው ባስገቡት ዶላር መገበያየት ይችላሉ፡፡  "

**አገልግሎት ሰጭዎችስ በዶላር ማስከፈል ይችላሉ ?**

" እነዚህ ሰዎች በዶላር መገበያየት የሚችሉት፣ አገልግሎታቸውን በውጭ ምንዛሪ እንዲሸጡ ከተፈቀደላቸው ተቋማት ብቻ ነው፡፡ 

ለምሳሌ ነጋዴዎችና አገልግሎት ሰጭዎች፣ ማለትም ሆቴሎችና አስጎብኝዎች ሊሆኑ ይችላሉ፡፡ ለሰጡት አገልግሎተት በዶላር ክፍያ መቀበል እንዲችሉ ከኢትዮጵያ ብሔራዊ ባንክ ፈቃድ ያላቸው ናቸው፡፡ ኢትዮጵያዊ ሆኖ፣ በዶላር ግብይት መፈፀም አይችልም፣ ከተፈቀደላቸው ተቋማትም ቢሆን፡፡ 

እኔ ኢትዮጵያዊ ሆኜ በዶላር እንዲያስከፍል ወደ ተፈቀደለት ሆቴል ሄጄ በዶላር መጠቀም አልችልም፡፡ ዲያስፖራ ከሆነንክ ግን፣ የሆነ ሆቴል ሔደህ ለተሰጠህ አገልግሎት በዶላር መክፈል ትችላለህ፡፡ ሆቴል ደግሞ ለሰጠው አገልግሎት በዶላር የማስከፈል ፈቃድ ያለው መሆን ይጠበቅበታል፡፡ ከፋዩም፣ አስከፋዩም (ተጠቃሚውና አገልግሎት ሰጪው) በዶላር ለመገበያየት የተፈቀደላቸው ወይም እውቅና የተሰጣቸው መሆን ይጠበቅባቸዋል፡፡ 

**ከአንድ የባንክ ሒሳብ ወደ ሌላ የባንክ ሒሳብ ዶላር ማስተላለፍ ይቻላል ? **

" የውጭ ምንዛሪ ማስተላለፍን (ትራንስፈርን) በተመለከተ፣ ከአንድ የዶላር ሒሳብ ኢትዮጵያ ውስጥ ላለ ሌላ የዶላር ሒሳብ የውጭ ምንዛሪ ማስተላለፍ አይቻልም፡፡ ለምን ዓላማ ነው የሚተላለፈው ? የሚለው ይታያል፡፡ 

ኢትዮጵያ ውስጥ ዕቃ ገዝተህ በዶላር ልክፈል ብትል፣ አንተም በዶላር የመክፈል መብት የለህም፣ ሻጩም በዶላር ክፍያ የመቀበል ፈቃድ የለውም፣ ስለዚህ አይቻልም፡፡ 

ነገር ግን የዶላር አካውንት ኖሮህ፣ ከውጪ ሀገር እቃ ብትገዛ፣ ለእሱ በዶላር የመክፈል መብት አለህ፡፡ በቀጥታ ለእቃ ሻጩ ነው ዶላሩ የሚተለላለፈው፡፡ ውጭ ሀገር እቃ ወደገዛህበት መደብር ትራንስፈር ይደረጋል/ይተላለፋል፡፡ መረጃ አቅርበህ፣ ባንኩ ያንን መረጃ አይቶ አሳማኝ ሆኖ ካገኘው ይህንን ያደርግልሀል፡፡ ከራስህ ዶላር መፅሐፉን ለሸጠልህ ነጋዴ በቀጥታ ማስተላለፍ ይቻላል፡፡ ዋናው ነገር ለምን አላማ ነው የምታስተላልፈው የሚለው ነው፡፡ "

**ኢትዮጵያ ውስጥ በውጭ ምንዛሪ ግብይት መቼ ሊጀመር ይችላል ? **

" በውጭ ምንዛሪ ግብይት መቼም አይጀመርም፡፡ በየትም ሀገር በውጭ ምንዛሪ ግብይት አይደረግም፡፡ እንደዛ ከሆነ፣ የሚነግርህ ትርጉም የሀገርህን ብር አታምነውም ማለት ነው፡፡ ኢኮኖሚዋ ችግር ላይ የወደቀባት ዚምባብዌ እንኳን ያንን አላደረገችም፡፡ 

የውጭ ምንዛሪ ፍሰትን ለመጨመር፣ ኤክስፖርትን ለማበረታታት፣ የምታደርጋቸው ማስተካከያዎች ሊኖሩ ይችላሉ፡፡ ከዛ ውጪ፣ ዜጎችህን በዶላር ተገበያዩ ልትል አትችልም፡፡ 

ለምሳሌ፣ ሪልስቴቶች ወይም አለምአቀፍ ት/ቤቶች የዋጋ እና የክፍያ ተመንን በዶላር ሲያወጡ ይታያል፡፡ ይህ ችግር የለውም፡፡ ክፍያው ሲፈፀም ግን በኢትዮጵያ ብር ነው የምትከፍለው፡፡ "

ቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ በቀጣይ ፦
- ለውጭ ጉዞ ዶላር/የውጭ ምንዛሪ እንዴት ነው የሚሰጠው ?

- የዶላር አካውንት/የውጭ ምንዛሪ የባንክ ሒሳብ ለመክፈት ቅድመ ሁኔታ አለ ? በሚሉ ጥያቄዎች ላይ የባለሙያ ማብራሪያ ያቀርባል።

**Is it possible to trade in foreign currency in Ethiopia? What exactly does the National Bank’s directive say?
**
The National Bank of Ethiopia, after deciding to conduct foreign exchange trading in the free market in July 2016, announced some amendments to the foreign exchange trading in the directive that was published. 

Based on the activities listed in the directive, the question arises whether it is possible for the public to trade in foreign currency in Ethiopia? 

Tikvah Ethiopia has asked for clarification from banking experts on this issue. 

What did the National Bank’s experts who gave their clarification to Tikvah Ethiopia say about this issue?

"In Ethiopia, foreign currency transactions are not allowed except by authorized persons. No Ethiopian can trade in foreign currency or dollars. 

Only authorized persons can trade in dollars. These include tourists, diaspora, and members of the diplomatic community who are bringing dollars from abroad. Since these persons are allowed to bring up to $10,000 when they come from abroad, they can trade in dollars that they have registered with customs. "

**Can service providers charge in dollars?**

" These persons can trade in dollars only with institutions that are authorized to sell their services in foreign currency. 

For example, they can be merchants and service providers, such as hotels and tour operators. They have a license from the National Bank of Ethiopia to accept payment in dollars for their services. As an Ethiopian, you cannot trade in dollars, even with authorized institutions. 

I am an Ethiopian I cannot go to a hotel that is allowed to charge in dollars and use dollars. However, if you are a diaspora, you can go to a hotel and pay for the service provided to you in dollars. The hotel must also be licensed to charge in dollars for the service provided. Both the payer and the payer (the consumer and the service provider) must be licensed or recognized to trade in dollars. 

**Is it possible to transfer dollars from one bank account to another bank account? **

" Regarding foreign currency transfer, it is not possible to transfer foreign currency from one dollar account to another dollar account in Ethiopia. What is the purpose of the transfer? 

If you buy something in Ethiopia and pay for it in dollars, you do not have the right to pay in dollars, and the seller does not have the license to accept payment in dollars, so it is not possible. 

But if you have a dollar account, and you buy something from a foreign country, you have the right to pay for it in dollars. The dollar is transferred directly to the seller. It is transferred to the store where you bought the item from abroad. You provide information, and if the bank sees that information and finds it convincing, it will do this for you. You can transfer the book from your own dollars to the merchant who sold you the book. The main thing is what purpose you are transferring it for. "

**When can foreign exchange trading start in Ethiopia? **

" Foreign exchange trading will never start. Foreign exchange trading will not be done in any country. If so, what you are telling me is that you do not trust your country's currency. Even Zimbabwe, whose economy is in trouble, has not done that. 

There may be adjustments that you can make to increase foreign exchange flow, to encourage exports. Apart from that, you cannot say that your citizens are trading in dollars. 

For example, real estate or international schools will show prices and fees in dollars. This is not a problem. But when the payment is made, you will pay in Ethiopian birr. "

- How do we use bank Visa cards? 
- Is it possible to use bank Visa cards in the country? 
- Are there any prerequisites for opening a dollar account/foreign currency bank account?

በብዝኅ ሃይማኖት ማኅብረሰብ

**" ሰላምን ፕሮሞት ማድረግ ላይ ትልቅ ችግር አለ ' ሃይማኖት ተቋማት ስራችሁን አልተወጣችሁም ' ማለት ላይ ግን ሁሉም ጣቱን ይቀስራል " - ሊቀ ትጉሃን ታጋይ ታደለ**

በሊቀ ትጉሃን ቀሲስ ታጋይ ታደለ የተሰናዳ " ሰላም በብዝኅ ሃይማኖት ማኅበረሰብ " የተሰኘ መጽሐፍ ከሳምንታት በፊት ተመርቆ ገበያ ላይ ይገኛል።

በኢትዮጵያ የሃይማኖት ተቋማት ጉባኤ ጠቅላይ ጸሐፊ በሊቀ ትጉሃን ቀሲስ ታጋይ ታደለ የተሰናዳው መጽሐፍ በዝግጅት ከ3 ዓመት በላይ ወስኗል።

መጽሐፉ በአማርኛ እና በአፋን ኦሮሞ ቋንቋዎች ታትሞ መቅረቡን ቀሲስ ታጋይ ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ገልጸዋል። 

**ቀሲስ ታጋይ ታደለ ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ በሰጡት ቃል ምን አሉ ? **

" ዓለም ላይ በቢሊየን ዶላር ኢንቨስት የሚደረገው ለግጭት ነው ከሁሉም ግጭት እና ውድመት ጀርባ ትልልቅ ገንዘብ ኢንቨስት ይደረጋል።

ገንዘቡ ኢንቨስት የሚደረገው ግጭቶቹ እንዲቆሙ አይደለም እኛ ደሞ ድሆች ነን ደሃ እንደመሆናችን ከጎረቤቶች ጋር ብንጣላ ብዙ መሳሪያ ይሰጡናል ሰላም ስንሆን ግን ስንዴ የሚሰጠን የለም። 

ይህ ከሆነ እኛ ደሞ ሰላም ላይ ኢንቨስት ብናደርግ የራሳችንን ችግር በራሳችን እንፈታለን። 

እኛ ሃገር ትልቁ ችግር ሰላምን ፕሮሞት ማድረግ ላይ ትልቅ ችግር አለ ' ሃይማኖት ተቋማት ስራችሁን አልተወጣችሁም ' ማለት ላይ ግን ሁሉም ጣቱን ይቀስራል። 

ሰላም ላይ ለመስራት በተግባር ያለፈ የተፈተነ ውጤትን ወደ መጽሐፍ ቀይሬዋለሁ። 

በርካታ አማኞች ባሉበት ሃገር በርካታ ሃሳቦች እና ፍላጎቶች ይኖራሉ የኢትዮጵያ ሃይማኖታዊ ገጽታዎች ምን እንደሚመስሉ እና የሃይማኖት ውይይት እና ትብብር ለሰላም ምን አበርክቶ እንዳለው ያሳያል።

**Peace 🕊
The Role of Faith in Building a Peaceful Society in Multi-Religious Communities** 

**" There is a big problem in promoting peace, but everyone points their finger at the idea that 'religious institutions have not done their job' - Like Tuguhan Tagay Tadele**

A book titled "Peace in a Multi-Religious Society" written by Like Tuguhan Qesis Tagay Tadele has been launched and is on the market for weeks.

The book, written by Like Tuguhan Qesis Tagay Tadele, the Secretary General of the Ethiopian Religious Institutions Council, has been in preparation for more than 3 years.

Qesis Tagay told Tikvah Ethiopia that the book has been published in Amharic and Afan Oromo languages. 

**What did Qesis Tagay Tadele say in his statement to Tikvah Ethiopia? **

" Billions of dollars are invested in the world for conflict. Behind all the conflict and destruction, big money is invested.

The money is not invested to stop the conflicts. We are also poor. Since we are poor, if we fight with our neighbors, they give us a lot of weapons, but when we are at peace, they do not give us any wheat. 

If we invest in peace, we will solve our own problems ourselves. 

The biggest problem in our country is that there is a big problem in promoting peace. 'Religious institutions have not done their job,' but everyone points their finger at them. 

I have turned the results of practical work on peace into a book. 

In a country with many believers, there are many ideas and interests. It shows what the religious aspects of Ethiopia look like and what religious dialogue and cooperation have contributed to peace. 

It explains what the Conference of Religious Institutions has contributed to peace, what the future holds for building peace based on faith," he said. 

The book was prepared as an input for the ongoing national consultation, Chief Tighuhan Kesisa Tagay Tadele told Tikvah Ethiopia.

🔈#ጤና_ባለሙያዎች__
**
" ባለሙያው 'ርቦኛል፣ ረሃብ ጊዜ አይሰጥም ነው' ያለው። ስለዚህ አቅምም ከሌላቸው በግልጽ መናገር ነው። ድለላ ነው የደበረው ባለሙያው ” - ማኀበሩ
**
የጤና ሚኒስትር ዶክተር መቅደስ ዳባ በብሔራዊ ቴሌቪዥን ያደረጉት ቃለ ምልልስ ላቀረቧቸው ጥያቄዎች ምላሽ ሊሆን አይችልም ብለው እንደሚያምኑ ባለሙያዎችና የኢትዮጵያ ጤና ባለሙያዎች ማኀበር ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ገለጹ።

ባለሙያዎቹና ማኀበሩ ይህን ያሉት ሚኒስትሯ ከሰሞኑ ባደረጉት ገለጻ፣ ለጤና ባለሙያዎች በቀጣይ ዓመት ከፍ ያለ በጀት ለመበጀት በቂ ዝግጅት መደረጉን ጨምሮ የሰጡትን ማብራሪያ በተመለከተ ነው።

**የኢትዮጵያ ጤና ባለሙያዎች ማኀበር ምን አለ ?
**
“ እንደዚህ አይነት ምላሾች የተለመዱ ናቸው። ነግሮች ለተሾሙበት ስልጣናቸው ስጋት ሲሆኑባቸው በመንግስታዊ ሚዲያዎች ወጥተው መናገራቸው የተለመደ ነው።

ግማሹ አንቋሾ ይመልሳል፤ ፓለታካዊም ያደርጋል። ግማሹ ደግሞ 'እውነት ነው፤ ጥያቄያቸውን ተረድተነዋል ፤ ግን ሌላ አካል እንዳይዘውራቸው' ይላሉ። 

ጥያቄ እያቀረበ ያለው እስከ 20 ዓመት በትምህርት የቆየው ጤና ባለሙያ ነው። በዚህ ልክ በትምህርት ዝግጅት ያለፈን ባለሙያ ‘የማኀበራዊ ድረ ገጽ አክቲቪስቶች አእምሯቸውን ዋሽ አድርገውታል’ ብሎ መግለጽ በራሱ አሳፋሪ ነው።

ባለሙያዎች በቁጥር ጠቅሰው ጥያቄዎችን ጠይቀዋል። ግን በሚደረገው እንቅስቃሴ የሚመለከታቸው አካላት በሚገባ እውቅና አልሰጡትም ‘ባለሙያው ጥያቄ ይኖረዋል፤ እውነት ነው’ ይበሉ እንጂ።

ጤና ሚኒስትሯ የጤና ባለሙያዎችን ጥያቄ እውቅና ቢሰጡት ኖሮ የቀረቡ 12ቱንም ጥያቄዎች ማስረዳት ነበረባቸው። ይሄ ባለሙያ የሚናቅ አይደለም። ቀጥተኛ ምላሽ ቢሰጡበት ነው ምላሻቸውን የምናምነው።

ባለሙያው 'ርቦኛል፣ ረሃብ ደግሞ ጊዜ አይሰጥም' ነው ያለው። ስለዚህ አቅምም ከሌላቸው በግልጽ መናገር ነው። ባለሙያው ድለላ ነው የደበረው። አቅም የለንም እንዳይሉ ደግሞ አለን እያሉ ነው ” ብሏል።

**ጤና ባለሙያዎችስ ምን አሉ ?
**
“ የጤና ሚኒስትር ዶክተር መቅደስ ዳባ ያደረጉትን ቃለ ምልልስ አይተነዋል፤ ግን ለጥያቄያችን ምንም ምላሽ አላገኘንበትም። 

ስለበጀት ማንሳት ካስፈለገ፣ በጀት መበደብ መብት ሳይሆን ግዴታ ነው።

ኢትዮጵያ የፈረመችው ስምምነት አለ በዓለም ጤና ድርጅት። ሪከመንድ የሚያደርገው አገሪቱ ከምትመድበው በጀት 15% ለጤና መበጀት አለባት ይላል። ይሄ ኢትዮጵያ የፈረመችው ነውና ያን ማክበር ነው ያለባቸው።

በ2017 ዓ/ም 3.7% ነው የመደቡት፤ በጤናው ዘርፍ ግማሹን እንኳ ለመመደብ አልታደለችም። እናም ይሄ ባልሆነበት ሁኔታ በቀጣይ ይደረጋል የሚለው ከሆነ ጥሩ ነው። በመልካም ጎኑ እናየዋለን። 

ግን በጀት መመደቡ በጤና ባለሙያው የሚያመጣው ኢምፓክት ነው መታየት ያለበት።

ጤና ተቋማትን ለማስገንባት፣ ማሽነሪዎችን ለማስገባት የተደረጉ ነገሮች አሉ እናደንቃለን። ግን የጤና ባለሙያውን እርካታ ሊጨምር የሚችለውን ኢምፓክት አልተነሳም፤ መነሳት ነበረበት።

በቃለ ምልልሱ ሪፎርሙን ሳይሆን ባለሙያው አንገብጋቢ 12 ጥያቄዎች አሉት ሊመሱለት የሚገባ፤ እነዛን ነበር አድሬስ ማድረግ የነበረባቸው። ስለዚህ ገለጻው ለጥያቄያችን ምላሽ ነው ብለን ለመውሰድ ያስቸግረናል ” ሲሉ ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ገልጸዋል።

**
" The expert said 'I am hungry, hunger does not give time'. Therefore, if they do not have the ability, they should speak openly. The expert is a fraud" - The Association
**
Experts and the Ethiopian Health Professionals Association told Tikvah Ethiopia that they believe that the interview of the Minister of Health, Dr. Mekdes Daba, on national television cannot be an answer to the questions they asked.

The experts and the association said this in relation to the explanation given by the minister in her recent statement, including that adequate preparations have been made to allocate a higher budget for health professionals next year.

**What does the Ethiopian Health Professionals Association say?
**
“These kinds of responses are common. It is common for officials to speak out in government media when their positions are threatened.

Half of them respond with disdain; half with political correctness. Half of them say, ‘It’s true; we understand their questions; but don’t let anyone else interfere.’ 

The person asking the question is a health professional who has been in education for 20 years. It is shameful to say that a professional who has gone through such an education has been ‘fooled by social media activists.’ 

Experts have asked questions in numbers. But the parties involved in the movement have not properly acknowledged them, saying, ‘The expert will have questions; it is true.’ 

If the Minister of Health had acknowledged the health professionals’ questions, she should have explained all 12 questions that were asked. This is not a professional to be despised. We would believe their answers if they gave direct answers. 

The expert said, ‘I am hungry, and hunger does not give time.’ "That's what it is. So if they don't have the capacity, they should speak out clearly. The expert is a fraud. They are saying that they have the capacity so that they don't say they don't have the capacity," he said.

**What did the health experts say?
**
“We have seen the interview of the Minister of Health, Dr. Mekdes Daba; but we did not receive any response to our question. 

If it is necessary to raise the budget, raising the budget is not a right but an obligation.

There is an agreement that Ethiopia signed with the World Health Organization. It recommends that the country should allocate 15% of its budget to health. This is what Ethiopia signed, so they must respect that.

In 2017, 3.7% was allocated; it did not even manage to allocate half of it to the health sector. And if it is said that this will be done in the future, it is good. We will see it on the positive side. 

But the impact that budget allocation brings to the health professional should be seen.

There are things that have been done to build health institutions, to install machinery, and we appreciate it. But the impact that can increase the satisfaction of the health professional has not been raised; it should have been raised.

In the interview, the professional, not the reform "There are 12 pressing questions that need to be addressed; those are the ones that need to be addressed. So it is difficult for us to take the statement as an answer to our questions," he told Tikvah Ethiopia.

🔈 #የጤና_ባለሙያዎች 

ደሴ በሚገኘው ቦሩ ሜዳ አጠቃላይ ሆስፒታል  ከታሰሩ የጤና ባለሙያዎች መካከል 3ቱ እስካሁን አለመለቀቃቸው የስራ ባልደረቦቻቸው ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ገለፁ።

ከ3 ቀን በፊት መፈክሮችን በመያዝ በሆስፒታሉ ቅጥር ግቢ ውስጥ ቅሬታቸውን ለማሰማት ከወጡት ከ10 በላይ የሚሆኑ ጤና ባለሙያዎች በፀጥታ ሀይሎች ተወስደው የነበረ ሲሆን ሌሎቹ ሲለቀቁ 3ቱ ግን እስካሁን አልተለቀቁም ሲሉ የስራ ባልደረቦቻቸው ተናግረዋል።

" የታሰሩት ባለሙያዎች እንደ ማንኛውም ሀኪም ያለውን ቅሬታ በሰላማዊ መንገድ ያቀረቡ እንጂ ምንም አይነት የፖለቲካ ተሳትፎ የሌላቸው ናቸው " ሲሉ ነው የገለጹት።

" በትላንትናው እለት እነሱን ለማስለቀቅ ሁሉም ሀኪም በስራ ገበታው ላይ ቢውልም  ሀኪሞቹ ግን ሊለቀቁ ባለመቻሉ ዛሬ አብዛኛው ሀኪም የስራ ማቆም አድማውን ቀጥሏል " ሲሉ አንድ ስማቸው እንዳይጠቀስ የጠየቁ ሀኪም ተናግረዋል።

በሌላ በኩል፥ ማዕከላዊ ጎንደር ዞን በሚገኘው የአብርሃ ጅራ ሆስፒታል የጤና ባለሙያዎች  በሆስፒታሉ ቅጥር ግቢ ውስጥ ብዛት ያለው የፀጥታ ሀይል በመኖሩ እንዲሁም ማስፈራሪያም በመሰጠቱ በፍርሃት በስራ ገበታቸው ላይ እንደሚገኙ ተናገረዋል።

በአማራ ክልል በተለያዩ አካባቢዎች ከድንገተኛ ፣ ህፃናት ቀዶ ህክምና እና ተኝተው የሚታከሙ ህመምተኞችን ከሚከታተሉ ሀኪሞች ውጭ ሌሎች በከፊል የስራ ማቆም አድማ ላይ እንደሆኑ ለመረዳት ተችሏል።

በተያያዘ መረጃ በተለያዩ የአገሪቱ አካባቢዎችም ላይ " ለዓመታት የጠየቅናቸውን ጥያቄዎች አሁንም በዝርዝር ገልጸን ያቀረብናቸውን ጥያቄዎች የሚመለስ አልተገኘም " በሚል ዛሬም በስራ ገበታቸው ላይ ያልተገኙ የጤና ባለሙያዎች አሉ።

ሆስፒታሎችም በስራ ገበታቸው ላይ ያልተገኙ የጤና ባለሙያዎች ወደ ስራቸው እንዲመለሱ የሚያስጠነቅቁ ማስታወቂያዎችን እያወጡ ናቸው።

🔈 #Health_Professionals 

Three of the detained health workers at Boru Meda General Hospital in Dessie have not yet been released, their colleagues told Tikvah Ethiopia.

More than 10 health workers who protested in the hospital premises with slogans three days ago were taken away by security forces, while the others were released, but the three have not yet been released, their colleagues said.

“The detained workers, like any doctor, have peacefully expressed their grievances and have no political involvement,” they said.

“Yesterday, all doctors were on duty to release them, but the doctors could not be released, so most of the doctors have continued their strike today,” said a doctor who asked not to be named.

On the other hand, health workers at Abraha Jira Hospital in the central Gondar zone said that they are working in fear due to the presence of a large number of security forces in the hospital premises and threats.

It has been understood that in various areas of the Amhara region, doctors other than those attending to emergency, pediatric surgery and inpatient patients are on a partial strike.

Related information is that in various parts of the country, there are health workers who are still absent from their work today, saying that "the questions we have been asking for years have not been answered in detail."

It has also been understood that some health workers have been arrested in connection with this movement.

Hospitals are also issuing notices warning health workers who are absent from their work to return to work.

**__" ግዳጅ ላይ ለነበሩ አባላት ስንቅ ሲወስድ በነበረ ፓትሮል ላይ ጥቃት ተሰንዝሮ አንድ አባል ሲሰዋ 5 አባላት ከባድ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል " - ፖሊስ__**

__በደቡብ ኢትዮጵያ ክልል ፣በጋሞ ዞን አርባምንጭ ዙሪያ ወረዳ ዘይሴ ሀዉሻ ተብሎ በሚጠራ አከባቢ__ __በግዳጅ ላይ ለነበሩ የፀጥታ አካላት ስንቅ በመዉሰድ ላይ በነበረ ፓትሮል ላይ ጥቃት ተፈጽሞ የሰው ህይወት መጥፋቱን የጋሞ ዞን ፖሊስ ገለጸ።__

__ፖሊስ__ __ጥቃቱ የተፈጸመው__ __" የመንግስት ደጋፊዎችን ለይተዉ ያጠቃሉ " ባላቸው ቡድኖች እንደሆነ አመልክቷል።

የዞኑ ፖሊስ ጉዳዩን በተመለከተ ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ በሰጠው ቃል ፥ " በተፈጸመው ጥቃት አንድ የአድማ ብተና አባል ተሰውቷል። በ5 አባላት ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ደርሷል " ሲል አመልክቷል።

ጥቃቱ የተፈጸመው ከትላንት በስቲያ ጠዋት 3 ሰዓት አከባቢ መሆኑን የጠቆመው ፖሊስ " ጉዳት የደረሰባቸው የፀጥታ መዋቅር አባላት በአርባምንጭ እና ሶዶ ክርስቲያን ሆስፒታሎች ሕክምና እየተደረገላቸው ነው  " ብሏል።

ጥቃት አድራሾቹን የመከታተሉ ስራ በፀጥታ መዋቅሩ መቀጠሉን ገልጿል። የአከባቢው ማህበረሰብም ተባባሪ ሊሆን ይገባል ሲል ጥሪ አቅርቧል።

**__" A patrol carrying supplies for members on duty was attacked, killing one member and seriously injuring 5 members" - Police__**

__In the Southern Ethiopian Region, in the Gamo Zone, in the area called Zeise Hawsha around Arbaminch, a patrol carrying supplies for security forces on duty was attacked, killing one person, the Gamo Zone Police said.__

__Police__ __indicated that the attack was carried out by groups that “target government supporters.”

In a statement to Tikvah Ethiopia, the zone police said, “A member of the strike force was killed in the attack. 5 members were seriously injured.”

The police, who indicated that the attack took place around 3 am yesterday, said, "The injured members of the security forces are receiving treatment at Arbaminche and Sodo Christian hospitals."

He said that the security forces are continuing to track down the attackers. He called on the local community to cooperate.

The President of the High Court and his Deputy have been dismissed from their duties.

The President of the Tigray Regional State High Court, Tsegay Berhane Gebre Tekle, and his Deputy Gebre Amlah Yebio, have been dismissed from their duties.

According to a letter signed by the President of the Tigray Interim Administration, Tadesse Werede (Lt. General), dated May 5, 2017, the President and his Deputy have been dismissed with a letter of thanks, in accordance with their request and submission.

The president and his deputy, former president Getachew Reda, came to power after the latter resigned twice, but were unsuccessful.

__**" የፓርቲው መሠረዝ ውጤት በህ.ወ.ሓ.ት እና አመራሮቹ ላይ ይፈጸማል " - ምርጫ ቦርድ**

**የኢትዮጵያ ብሔራዊ ምርጫ ቦርድ ምን አለ ?**__
__
- ህ.ወ.ሓ.ት በዐመጻ ድርጊት ላይ በመሣተፉ ምክንያት ከፖለቲካ ፓርቲነት ተሰርዞ ነበር። ይሁንና የፕሪቶሪያ ስምምነት ከተደረገ በኋላ የህ.ወ.ሓ.ት ሕጋዊ ሰውነት እንዲሰረዝ የተላለፈው ውሣኔ እንዲነሣ ቦርዱን ሚያዝያ 13 እና ሚያዝያ 28 ቀን 2015 ዓ.ም. ጠይቋል። ሆኖም ቦርዱ በዐመጻ ድርጊት በመሣተፍ ከፖለቲካ ፓርቲነት የተሠረዘ የፖለቲካ ፓርቲ ሕጋዊ ሰውነቱ ከተሠረዘ በኋላ ሕጋዊ ሰውነቱን ለመመለስ የሚያስችል ሕግ ስለሌለ ጥያቄውን ውድቅ አድርጎበታል።

- የኢትዮጵያ የምርጫ የፖለቲካ ፓርቲዎች ምዝገባና የምርጫ ሥነ-ምግባር ዐዋጅ ቁጥር 1162/2013 ለማሻሻል የወጣውን ዐዋጅ ቁጥር 1332/2016 መታወጁን ተከትሎ ህ.ወ.ሓ.ት በዐዋጁ መሠረት " በልዩ ሁኔታ " ፓርቲ ሆኖ ለመመዝገብ መቅረብ የሚገባቸውን ሠነዶች በማያያዝ ባቀረበው ጥያቄ እንዲሁም ህ.ወ.ሓ.ትን አስመልክቶ የፍትሕ ሚኒስቴር በሕግ በተሰጠው ሥልጣን መሠረት ሰኔ 17 ቀን 2016 ዓ.ም. በጻፈው ደብዳቤ መነሻ ቦርዱ በማሻሻያ ዐዋጁ መሠረት ፓርቲውን " በልዩ ሁኔታ " መዝግቦ ነሐሴ 3 ቀን 2016 ዓ.ም. ሕጋዊ ሰውነት ማረጋገጫ ሰጥቷል።

-  ህ.ወ.ሓ.ት ምዝገባውን ተከትሎ ቦርዱ እንዲፈጽም የሰጠውን ትዕዛዝ ባለማክበሩ በተለያየ ጊዜ ማሳሰቢያ ቢሰጥም ፓርቲው ግን በሕግ የተጣለበትን ግዴታ አልፈጸመም።

- ህ.ወ.ሓ.ት የፓርቲውን ህጋዊነት የሚያረጋግጥበትን እና በወቅቱም ____#አምኖበትና___ተስማምቶ_የተቀበለውን__ የፖለቲካ ፖርቲ ሕጋዊ ሰውነት ማረጋገጫ " አላውቅም፤ ሕጋዊ ሰውነቴ በዚህ ሠነድ አይረጋገጥም " በማለት ሕግንና መመሪያን ባለማክበርና ለማክበርም ፈቃደኛ ባለመሆን ሲገልጽ ቆይቷል።

- ቦርዱ በዐዋጅ ቁጥር 1162/2011 መሠረት በዐመጻ ተግባር በመሠማራቱ የተሠረዘን ፓርቲ ሕጋዊ ሰውነት የምመልስበት የሕግ ድንጋጌ የለኝም በማለት ግንቦት 4 ቀን 2015 ዓ.ም. ለህ.ወ.ሓ.ት ምላሽ ከሰጠ ከአንድ ዓመት በኋላ ዐዋጅ ቁጥር 1332/2016 ግንቦት 27 ቀን 2016 ዓ.ም. ሲታወጅ ህ.ወ.ሓ.ት ይህንኑ ፓርቲዎችን በልዩ ሁኔታ የሚመዘግብ ዐዋጅ በታወጀ በሁለተኛው ወር ሐምሌ 19 ቀን 2016 ዓ.ም. በዐዋጁ ላይ " በልዩ ሁኔታ " የፖለቲካ ፓርቲ ሆኖ ለመመዝገብ እንዲቀርቡ በሕጉ የተመለከቱትን ዝርዝር ሠነዶች ይኸውም ፦
• የፓርቲውን ፕሮግራም፣ 
• የፓርቲውን መተዳደሪያ ደንብ 
• የፓርቲው አመራሮች ስም ዝርዝር ከፊርማ ጋር ለቦርድ አቅርቧል።

- ህ.ወ.ሓ.ት ሕጋዊ ሰውነቱ እንዲሠረዝ የተላለፈውን ውሣኔ እንዲነሣ በማለት ሚያዝያ 13 እና ሚያዝያ 28 ቀን 2015 ዓ.ም. ለቦርዱ ባቀረበው ጥያቄ በዐዋጅ ቁጥር 1332/2016 " በልዩ ሁኔታ " ፓርቲ ሆኖ ለመመዝገብ እንዲቀርቡ የተጠየቁትን ሠነዶች አንዳቸውንም አያይዞ አላቀረበም። ይህ በግልጽ የሚያስረዳው ህ.ወ.ሓ.ት ሐምሌ 19/ 2016 ዓ.ም. ያቀረበው ጥያቄ ሚያዝያ 13 እና ሚያዝያ 28 ቀን 2015 ዓ.ም. ካቀረበው ጥያቄ በተለየ መልኩ በዐዋጅ ቁጥር 1332/2016 መሠረት " በልዩ ሁኔታ " ፖርቲ ሆኖ ለመመዝገብ እንዲቀርብ ሕጉ በሚጠይቀው መሠረት የፖለቲካ ፓርቲ ምዝገባ ጥያቄ ማቅረቡን ነው።

- ህ.ወ.ሓ.ት ሐምሌ 19 ቀን 2016 ዓ.ም. ጥያቄውን ሲያቀርብ ዐዋጅ ቁጥር 1332/2016 ታውጆ ፤ ለሕዝብ በይፋ ተገልጾ፤ በሥራ ላይ ከዋለ ሁለት ወር ካለፈው በኋላ ነው። ህ.ወ.ሓ.ትም ለሕዝብ ይፋ የሆነውን ዐዋጅ ዐላማና አፈጻጸም በግልጽ በማወቅና በመረዳት በዐዋጁ ላይ የተመለከቱትን ሠነዶች አያይዞ በማቅረብ በዐዋጁ የተጠየቀውን የምዝገባ ሥርዓት በመፈጸም " በልዩ ሁኔታ " ምዝገባው ተከናውኗል።

- ህ.ወ.ሓ.ት ሐምሌ 19 ቀን 2016 ዓ.ም. በጻፈው ደብዳቤ ላይ " የቀድሞው ሕጋዊ ሰውነት ይመለስልኝ " ብሎ ጠይቋል። ያቀረባቸው ሠነዶችና ጥያቄው የቀረበው የተሻሻለውን ዐዋጅ መውጣት ተከትሎ ነው። ቦርዱ ለህ.ወ.ሓ.ት ነሐሴ 3 ቀን 2016 ዓ.ም. " በልዩ ሁኔታ '' በመመዝገብ የሰጠው የሕጋዊ ሰውነት ማረጋገጫ ሠርትፊኬት፣ ከሠርተፊኬቱም ጋር አብሮ በሰጠው ነሐሴ 3 ቀን 2016 ዓ.ም. ደብዳቤ ላይ የህ.ወ.ሓ.ት የቀድሞው ሕጋዊ ሰውነት እንደማይመለስለት በግልጽ ተመልክቶ ይገኛል። 

- ህ.ወ.ሓ.ት የቀድሞው ሕጋዊ ሰውነት እንደማይመለስለት በግልጽ በደብድቤ ሰፍሯል። የፓርቲው ከፍተኛ አመራር በቦርዱ ዋና መ/ ቤት በመገኘት በልዩ ሁኔታ መመዝገቡን የሚገልጽ ሠርትፊኬት እና ደብዳቤውን በሚገባ አይተው፣ አንብበውና ተስማምተው በፈቃዳቸው ፈርመው ከወሰዱ በኋላ ይህ " በልዩ ሁኔታ " ተመዝግቦ የተሰጠን የሕጋዊ ሰውነት ማረጋገጫ " አንቀበለውም " ማለት ተቀባይነት የለውም።

- ቦርዱ በሕግ የተጣለበትን ኃላፊነት ለመወጣትና ፓርቲው ያለበትን ኃላፊነትና ግዴታ እንዲወጣ ለማድረግ በተለያየ ወቅት በጽሑፍ ማሳሰቢያ ሲሰጥ ቆይቷል። 

- ፓርቲው ግዴታውን እንዲወጣ ዕድል ለመስጠት ቦርዱ ፓርቲውን ለሦስት ወራት ከማንኛውም የፖለቲካ ፖርቲ እንቅስቃሴ በማገድ ፖርቲው የዕርምት ዕርምጃ በመውሰድ በሕጉ መሠረት ግዴታውን እንዲፈጽም ቦርዱ ጥረት ቢያደርግም ፓርቲው የተጣለበትን የሕግ ግዴታ ለመወጣት ፈቃደኛ አልሆነም።

-  ቦርዱ የካቲት 5 ቀን 2017 ዓ.ም. በጻፈው ደብዳቤ ፓርቲው በሦስት ወር ዕግድ ጊዜ የዕርምት ዕርምጃ ሳይወስድ ቢቀር የፓርቲውን ምዝገባ እንደሚሰረዝ አሳውቋል።

- ህ.ወ.ሓ.ት ግን የዕርምት ዕርምጃ ባለመውሰዱ ቦርዱ ግንቦት 5/2017 ዓ.ም. ባደረገው ስብሰባ ፓርቲው ከግንቦት 5 ቀን 2017 ዓ.ም. ጀምሮ ከፖለቲካ ፖርቲነት የተሠረዘ መሆኑን ወሥኗል።

- ውሣኔው ለህ.ወ.ሓ.ት፣ ለፍትሕ ሚኒስቴር በጽሑፍ እንዲደርስና ለሕዝብ ይፋ እንደረግና ተወስኗል።

- የፓርቲውን መሠረዝ ውጤትን በተመለከተ የዐዋጅ ቁጥር 1162/2011 አንቀጽ 99 እንደ አግባብነቱ በህ.ወ.ሓ.ትና አመራሮቹ ላይ እንዲፈጸም ቦርዱ ወሥኗል።

__**" The consequences of the party's dissolution will be on the NEP and its leaders " - Election Board**

**What did the National Election Board of Ethiopia say?**__
__
- The NEP was dissolved as a political party due to its participation in acts of violence. However, after the Pretoria Agreement, the board requested the board on April 13 and April 28, 2015, to lift the decision to dissolve the NEP's legal entity. However, the board rejected the request because there is no law that allows a political party that has been dissolved as a political party for participating in acts of violence to restore its legal entity after its dissolution.

- Following the promulgation of Proclamation No. 1332/2016 amending Proclamation No. 1162/2013 on the Registration of Ethiopian Electoral Political Parties and Electoral Ethics, the Ethiopian People's Democratic Party (EPDP) submitted a request to register as a party "under special circumstances" in accordance with the Proclamation, and in accordance with the authority granted by the Ministry of Justice regarding the EPDP, the Board registered the party "under special circumstances" in accordance with the Amending Proclamation and issued a certificate of legal personality on August 3, 2016.

- The EPDP failed to comply with the Board's order to comply with the registration, despite repeated reminders, but the party did not fulfill its obligation under the law.

- The H.W.H.T. has been stating that it does not know the legal status of the political party, which it confirmed and accepted at the time, and that it is not willing to comply with the law and regulations, saying, "I do not know; my legal status is not confirmed by this document."

- The Board responded to the H.W.H.T. on May 4, 2015, stating that it does not have a legal provision to restore the legal status of a party that was dissolved for engaging in violent activities under Proclamation No. 1162/2011. One year later, when Proclamation No. 1332/2016 was promulgated on May 27, 2016, the H.W.H.T. issued a proclamation to register these same parties under special conditions, on July 19, 2016, the second month after the proclamation was promulgated. The following documents were submitted to the Board with their signatures for registration as a political party under the Proclamation:
• The party program, 
• The party’s bylaws, 
• The list of names of the party’s leaders.

- The H.W.H.A.T did not submit any of the documents required for registration as a party under the Proclamation No. 1332/2016 on April 13 and April 28, 2015, requesting the Board to revoke the decision to cancel its legal entity. This clearly shows that the H.W.H.A.T did not submit any of the documents required for registration as a party under the Proclamation No. 1332/2016 on July 19, 2016. Unlike the request submitted, the application for registration of a political party was submitted in accordance with the law to register as a party under Proclamation No. 1332/2016 "under special circumstances".

- The H.W.A.T submitted the request on July 19, 2016, after Proclamation No. 1332/2016 had been promulgated; publicly announced to the public; and two months had passed since its entry into force. The H.W.A.T, knowing and understanding the purpose and implementation of the Proclamation that was made public, submitted the documents specified in the Proclamation and completed the registration process required by the Proclamation, and the registration was completed "under special circumstances".

- The H.W.A.T requested in its letter dated July 19, 2016, "The former legal entity should be returned to me." The documents submitted and the request were submitted following the issuance of the amended proclamation. The Board submitted the documents to the H.E.W.H. on August 3, 2016. The certificate of legal personality issued under "special circumstances" and the letter dated August 3, 2016, issued along with the certificate clearly state that the former legal personality of the H.W.H.P. will not be restored. 

- The H.W.H.P. has clearly stated in Debdbe that the former legal personality will not be restored. After the senior leadership of the party visited the board's headquarters and carefully read, read, agreed, and signed the certificate stating that it was registered under special circumstances, this "special circumstances" certificate of legal personality issued to us is unacceptable.

- The board has been issuing written notices on various occasions to fulfill its legal responsibilities and to ensure that the party fulfills its responsibilities and obligations. 

- In order to give the party an opportunity to fulfill its obligations, the board has suspended the party from any political party activity for three months, and the party has taken corrective action. Despite the Board’s efforts to ensure that the party fulfills its obligations under the law, the party has refused to fulfill its legal obligations.

- The Board, in a letter dated February 5, 2017, announced that the party’s registration would be cancelled if the party did not take corrective action within the three-month suspension period.

- However, the H.W.H.T. did not take corrective action, and the Board decided in its meeting held on May 5, 2017, that the party was deregistered as a political party effective May 5, 2017.

- The decision was to be communicated to the H.W.H.T., the Ministry of Justice in writing, and made public.

- Regarding the consequences of the deregistration of the party, the Board decided to apply Article 99 of Proclamation No. 1162/2011 to the H.W.H.T. and its leaders, as appropriate. He has decided.

የኢትዮጵያ ኦርቶዶክስ ተዋሕዶ ቤተ ክርስቲያን ቅዱስ ሲኖዶስ የርክበ ካህናት ምልዓተ ጉባኤ በዛሬው ዕለት በጽርሐ መንበረ ፓትርያርክ ተጀምሯል።

የርክበ ካህናት ምልዓተ ጉባኤ መጀመሩን አስመልክቶ ብፁዕ ወቅዱስ አቡነ ማትያስ ቀዳማዊ ፓትርያርክ ርዕሰ ሊቃነ ጳጳሳት ዘኢትዮጵያ ሊቀ ጳጳስ ዘአክሱም ወእጨጌ ዘመንበረ ተክለሃይማኖት መልዕክት አስተላልፈዋል።

ከቅዱስነታቸው መልዕክት ፦

" ለሕዝበ እግዚአብሔር የምናበረክተው ኣገልግሎት በመንፈሳዊ ብቻ ሳይሆን በኢኮኖሚውና በማኅበራዊው ኣገልግሎትም ጭምር ነው። ከዚህ ኣንጻር ሕዝባችን የተሻለ ማኅበራዊ ኣገልግሎት እንዲያገኝ፣ በኢኮኖሚውም ከድህነት የተላቀቀ እንዲሆን፤ እንደዚሁም ሰላሙና ኣንድነቱ የተጠበቀ እንዲሆን፣ በማስተማርም በተግባር በመሳተፍም የሕዝቡ መሪዎችና ኣርኣያ ሆነን መስራት ይገባናል።

በተለይም ከሰላም እጦት የተነሣ በእጅጉ እየተጎዳ ያለውን ሕዝባችን ሰላምና ፍትሕ እንዲያገኝ በጸሎትም በትምህርትም፣ በምክርም ተግተን መስራት ኣለብን። እንዳጋጣሚ ሆኖ የኢትዮጵያ ሕዝብ ከእንግልት የተላቀቀበት ጊዜ ብዙ እንዳልሆነ ይታወቃል፤ ለእንግልት እየተዳረገ ያለውም የሌሎች እጅ ባይለየውም በዋናነት በገዛ ልጆቹ ነው፤ እናት በገዛ ልጆቿ ስትንገላታ ማየት እጅግ ኣሳዛኝ ነገር ነው፤ እንደዚህ ያለው ነገር በደንብ ያልታሰበበት ኣካሄድ በብስለትና በንስሓ ማስተካከል አሸናፊነትን እንጂ ተሸናፊነትን አያሳይምና እንዲታሰብበት እንመክራለን።

ከዚህም አንጻር ኢትዮጵያን ወደ ተሻለ ልማትና ዕድገት እናሻግራለን ብላችሁ እየደከማችሁ ያላችሁ ወገኖቻችን እባካችሁ መለስ ብላችሁ እናታችሁ የተንገላታችበትን እዩና በቃ በሉ፤ ሁሉን የሚያግባባ ነገር ፈልጉና ችግሮችን በሰላማዊ ውይይት ፍቱ፤ በዚህ ኣማራጭ እናት ሀገር እፎይታ እንድታገኝ ኣድርጉ፤ ይህንም ለውድ እናት የሚደረግ ካሣ ኣድርጋችሁ ውሰዱት፤ የቤተ ክርስቲያናችን ወቅታዊ መልእክትና ጥሪም ይህ ነው።"

(የቅዱስነታቸው ሙሉ መልዕክት ከላይ ተያይዟል)

__#EOTC____

The Holy Synod of the Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church began today at the Patriarchate of Tsirha.

His Holiness Abune Mathias I, Patriarch and Supreme Pontiff of Ethiopia, Archbishop of Axum and Echege, Zemenbere Teklehaimanot, conveyed a message regarding the beginning of the plenary session of the Rekbe priests.

From His Holiness' Message:

"The service we provide to the people of God is not only spiritual but also economic and social. In this regard, we must work as leaders and role models for our people so that our people can receive better social services, be economically free from poverty; and so that peace and unity are preserved, and we must work as leaders and role models for the people by teaching and participating in practice.

In particular, we must work hard through prayer, education, and counseling so that our people, who are suffering greatly due to the lack of peace, can find peace and justice. It is known that the Ethiopian people have not been free from oppression for a long time; and those who are being oppressed, not by others, but mainly by their own children; it is very sad to see a mother being abused by her own children. We recommend that such an ill-considered approach be corrected with maturity and repentance, not defeat, but victory.

In this regard, we will move Ethiopia towards better development and progress "Our people who are struggling, please look at the way your mother has been treated and say enough is enough; find something that will bring everyone together and resolve the problems through peaceful dialogue; do this so that the motherland can find relief; and take this as compensation for our dear mother; this is the current message and call of our Church."

ከዛሬ ግንቦት 6 / 2017 ዓ.ም ጀምሮ ለተከታታይ 10 ቀናት የኩፍኝ ክትባት ይሰጣል።

ወላጆች ልጆቻችሁን አስከትቡ።

**ኩፍኝ ምንድነው ?**

የኩፍኝ በሽታ የኩፍኝ ቫይረስ በሚባል ረቂቅ ተህዋስ የሚከሰትና በቀላሉ ከሰው ወደ ሰው የሚዛመት የበሽታ ዓይነት ነው፡፡ የኩፍኝ በሽታ ለብዙ ህጻናት ህመም፣ የአካል ጉዳትና ሞት ምክንያት ከሆኑት በሽታዎች አንዱ ነው፡፡

**የበሽታው መተላለፊያ መንገዶች ምንድናቸው ?**

➡️ ኩፍኝ በሽታ ከሰው ወደ ሰው የሚተላለፈው የኩፍኝ በሽታ ከተያዘው ሰው አፍንጫና ጉሮሮ በሚወጡ ፈሳሽና ጠብታዎች ንክኪና በትንፋሽ አማካኝነት ነው፡፡

➡️ የኩፍኝ በሽታ አምጭ ተህዋስ ወይም ቫይረስ በኩፍኝ ከተያዘዉ ሰዉ በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ የመሰራጨት አቅም የሚኖረው የበሽታው ምልክቶች መታየት በሚጀምርበት ወቅት ነው፡፡

➡️ አንድ በኩፍኝ የተያዘ ሰው በአብዛኛው ጊዜ ቫይረሱ ወደ ሰውነቱ ከገባ በኋላ የሽፍታ ምልክቶች በሰውነቱ ከመውጣቱ ከ4 ቀናት በፊት እንዲሁም ሽፍታዎቹ ከወጡ በኋላ እስከ 4 ቀን ድረስ ባለው ጊዜ በሽታውን ወደ ሌሎች ሰዎች በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ያስተላልፋል፡፡

➡️ ህጻናት በሚሰባሰቡበት ቦታ ማለትም በትምህርት ቤቶች፣ በጤና ተቋማት እና በሌሎችም ቦታዎች በሽታው በቀላሉ ሊዛመት ይችላል፡፡

**የበሽታው ዋና ዋና ምልክቶች ምንድናቸው ?**

- ከፍተኛ ትኩሳት፣
- ከራስ ፀጉር ጀምሮ ወደ ሌሎች የሰውነት፣ ክፍሎች የሚዛመት ሽፍታ፣
- የአይን መደፍረስ ወይም መቅላት፣
- ከአፍንጫ የሚወጣ ፈሳሽ መብዛት፣
- የአይን እንባ ማዘል፣
- ሳል እና የመሳሰሉት ናቸው፡፡

ስላ ኩፍኝ መከላከያ ክትባት ፦ የኩፍኝ መከላከያ ክትባት ህፃናት ከተወለዱ በ9 እና በ15 ወር ዕድሜያቸው በመደበኛው የክትባት አገልግሎት ይሰጣል፡፡ 

በተጨማሪም የኩፍኝ ክትባት የህፃናትን በሽታ የመከላከል አቅም ለማዳበር በተለያዩ ጊዜያት በዘመቻ ይሰጣል፡፡

የኩፍኝ በሽታን በዘላቂነት መከላከል የሚቻለው ህፃናትን በመደበኛ የክትባት መርሐግብር እና በዘመቻ መልክ የሚሰጠውን የኩፍኝ በሽታ መከላከያ ክትባትን ማስከተብ ሲቻል ነው፡፡

ልጅዎትን ያስከትቡ !!

#ATTENTION🚨

Starting today, May 6 / 2017, the measles vaccine will be given for 10 consecutive days.

Parents, vaccinate your children.

**What is measles?**

Measles is a disease caused by a microbe called the measles virus and is easily spread from person to person. Measles is one of the diseases that cause illness, disability, and death in many children.

**What are the ways of transmission of the disease?**

➡️ Measles is transmitted from person to person through contact with droplets from the nose and throat of an infected person and through breathing.

➡️ The measles virus or virus is most contagious when symptoms of the disease begin to appear.

➡️ A person infected with measles is most contagious from 4 days before the rash appears and up to 4 days after the rash appears.

➡️ The disease can spread easily in places where children gather, such as schools, health facilities, and other places.

**What are the main symptoms of the disease?**

- High fever,

- Rash that spreads from the scalp to other parts of the body,

- Itching or redness of the eyes,

- Excessive discharge from the nose,

- Watery eyes,

- Cough, etc.

Measles vaccine: Measles vaccine is routinely given to children from birth to 9 and 15 months of age. 

In addition, measles vaccine is given at different times to build children's immunity.

**" የሰላም ጥረቶችን በራስ የገንዘብ አቅም ለመደገፍ የአፍሪካ መሪዎች የሰላም ፈንድ አቋቁመዋል " - የአፍሪካ ህብረት**

የአፍሪካ ህብረት፣ አፍሪካ በተለያዩ ሀገራት የሚቀሰቀሱ ግጭቶችን የምትፈታባቸው የሰላም መርሀግብሮቿን ወጪ በራሷ ለመሸፈን በርካታ ጥረቶችን በማድረግ ላይ ትገኛለች ብሏል።

ከሁለት ወራት በፊት በተደረገው አህጉራዊ ጉባኤ የህብረቱን ኮሚሽን ሊቀመንበርነት የተረከቡት ማሕሙድ ዓሊ ዩሱፍ ፥ በአፍሪካ ህብረት የሚከናወኑ የሰላም ጥረቶችን በራስ የገንዘብ አቅም ለመደገፍ እንዲቻል፣ የአፍሪካ መሪዎች የሰላም ፈንድ ማቋቋማቸውን ገልጸዋል።

ቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ከህብረቱ ሊቀመንበር እንደሰማው እስካሁን በርከት ካሉ ሀገራት 400 ሚሊዮን ዶላር ወደዚሁ የገንዘብ ቋት/የሰላም ፈንድ ገብቷል።

የሕብረቱን ስራዎች በተለይም በእጅጉ ወሳኝ የሚባሉት የሰላምና ፀጥታ እንዲሁም የልማት መርሀግብሮችን በራስ የገንዘብ አቅም ለማከናወንም ቀጣይነት ያላቸው የገንዘብ ምንጮች እየታሰቡ መሆናቸውን ሊቀመንበሩ ገልጸዋል።

ከነዚህ አንዱ ወደ አባል ሀገራት ከሚገቡ ሸቀጦች ላይ የ0.2 በመቶ ቀረጥ መጣል እንደሆነ አብራርተዋል፡፡

እስካሁን የተወሰኑ የአፍሪካ ሀገራት ይህንን የገንዘብ መሰብሰቢያ ስልት መተግበራቸውንና ሌሎችም ሀገራት ይህን አሰራር እንዲከተሉ ደብዳቤ እንደተፃፈላቸው አመልክተዋል።

በተጨማሪም በሕብረቱ ስር ያለውን የሰላምና ፀጥታ ምክር ቤት መዋቅራዊ ማሼል እየተደረገለት እንደሆነ አመልክተው የአህጉሩ ፈተና የሆነውን ግጭትና ጦርነትን በዘላቂነት ለመከላከል የቅድመ ማስጠንቀቂያ ሥርዓት እንደሚዘረጋ ጠቅሰዋል።

ሊቀመንበር ማሕሙድ፣ በተለያዩ የአፍሪካ ሀገራት ያሉትን ግጭቶች ለመፍታት ያለሙ የሰላም ጥረቶች እየተደረጉ መሆናቸውን ተናግረዋል፡፡ 

በሱዳን ያለው ጦርነት እንዲቆም ህብረቱ የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት እንዲደረግ ጥሪ ማቅረቡን እንደሚቀጥል ገልጸዋል።

" የሱዳን ችግር፣ በሱዳኖች ብቻ ነው መፈታት ያለበት፣ የአፍሪካ ህብረት ይህንን ይደግፋል፣ የሌሎች ሀይሎችን ጣልቃገብነትም ይሁን የትይዩ መንግስት መመስረትን አንደግፍም " ሲሉ በአፅንኦት ተናግረዋል፡፡

**" African leaders establish peace fund to support peace efforts with self-financing" - African Union**

The African Union has said it is making significant efforts to finance its peace programs, which Africa uses to resolve conflicts in various countries.

Mahmoud Ali Yusuf, who took over as the Chairperson of the Union Commission at the continental summit held two months ago, said African leaders have established a peace fund to support peace efforts in the African Union with self-financing.

Tikvah Ethiopia has heard from the Chairperson of the Union that so far, $400 million has been contributed to the fund by several countries.

The Chairperson said that sustainable sources of funding are being considered to finance the work of the Union, especially the peace and security and development programs, which are considered very important, with their own funds.

One of these is the imposition of a 0.2 percent tax on goods imported into member states.

He noted that some African countries have already implemented this fundraising strategy and that letters have been written to other countries to follow suit.

He also noted that the Peace and Security Council under the Union is being structurally overhauled and that an early warning system will be established to prevent conflicts and wars that are a challenge for the continent in the long term.

Chairman Mahmoud said that peace efforts are being made to resolve conflicts in various African countries. 

He stated that the Union will continue to call for a ceasefire to end the war in Sudan.

"The problem of Sudan must be solved by the Sudanese alone, the African Union supports this, and we do not support the intervention of other forces or the establishment of a parallel government," he said emphatically.

In just one week, two youths have lost their lives in a gang-related brawl in Mekelle city.

**" አሰራሩ ብክነትን ከመከላከል በተጨማሪ አላግባብ የፓርኪንግ ክፍያ የሚጠይቁ ግለሰቦችን ያስቀራል " - ትራፊክ ማኔጅመንት ባለሥልጣን **

የአዲስ አበባ ከተማ አስተዳደር ትራፊክ ማኔጅመንት ባለሥልጣን ከጥር 1 ቀን 2017 ዓ/ም ጀምሮ አውቶማቲክ ኢንፎርስመንት እና ፓርኪንግ ማኔጅመንት ሲስተም የተሰኘ አሰራር አበልጽጎ ወደ ስራ አስገብቷል።

የዚህ መተግበሪያ ተግባራዊ መሆን የአዲስ አበባ ትራፊክ ማኔጅመንት ባለሥልጣን በየአመቱ ለደረሰኝ ህትመት ያወጣው የነበረውን ከ17 ሚሊየን ብር በላይ እንደሚያስቀር ባለሥልጣን መስሪያ ቤቱ ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ገልጿል። 

የባለሥልጣኑ ምክትል ዋና ዳይሬክተር አቶ አማረልኝ ታረቀኝ " የቁጥጥር ስራው በቴክኖሎጂ የተደገፈ እንዲሆን ለማድረግ በሚል " አሰራሩ ተግባራዊ መደረጉን ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ አብራርተዋል። 

**ምክትል ዋና ዳይሬክተሩ በዝርዝር በሰጡን ሃሳብ ምን አሉ ? **

" ከዚህ ቀደም ማንዋል የነበረ አሰራር ነበር የነበረው ደረሰኞችን በመስጠት የቅጣት አይነቱ ምንድነው የሚለውን በመጻፍ የሚደረግ ሂደት ነበር። 

የአሁኑ አሰራር ግን የደንብ ተላላፊዎችን እንግልት በእጅጉ የሚቀንስ ሆኗል ምክንያቱም የቅጣት አይነቱ ተፈጻሚ የሚሆነው መንጃ ፈቃዳቸውን በመቀበል መረጃቸውን ስካን ተደረጎ በኤስ ኤም ኤስ (SMS) ቴክስት ነው። 

ክፍያውን በስልኩ በሚገኙ የመክፈያ አማራጮች ያከናውናል መንጃ ፈቃድ መስጠትም ሆነ ሰሌዳ ማስፈታት አይጠበቅባቸውም። 

የሚኒስትሮች ምክር ቤት ያወጣው የመንገድ ትራንስፖርት ትራፊክ መቆጣጠሪያ ደንብ ቁጥር 557/2016 አለ እሱ ላይ የተጠቀሱ ህጎችን በሙሉ ወደ ሲስተሙ በመጫን ተግባራዊ እየሆነ ነው። 

አንድ ተላላፊ ምን አይነት ጥፋት ነው ያጠፋው ፣በዛሬው ዕለት ስንት ደንብ ተላላፊዎች ተመዝገቡ ፣የትኞቹን እርከን የጥፋት አይነቶች ነው የተላለፉት ፣ማን የሚባል ተቆጣጣሪ የት ቦታ ላይ ምን አይነት ቅጣት ወሰደ የሚለውን የተሟላ መረጃ ቀጥታ ማግኘት የሚቻልበትን አሰራር ነው የዘረጋነው። 

አሁን የገጠመን ችግር ሙሉ በሙሉ ከመተግበር አኳያ ሁለት ነገሮች ይፈልጋል የመጀመሪያው የአዲስ አበባ አሽከርካሪና ተሽከርካሪ ፈቃድና ቁጥጥር ባለሥልጣን የመዘገባቸውን 1,124,000 (አንድ ሚሊየን አንድ መቶ ሃያ አራት ሺህ) መንጃ ፈቃዶችን እና 772,000 የተሽከርካሪ መረጃዎችን ነው የወሰድነው። 

እዚህ ምዝገባ ውስጥ ያሉ በሙሉ በአዲሱ የአገልግሎት ሲስተም እንዲገለገሉ ለማድረግ እድሉ አለ ነገር ግን የክልሎች መንጃ ፈቃድ እና ሰሌዳዎች በአግባቡ ተመዝግበው ወደ እኛ የመረጃ ቋት ባለመግባታቸው ምክንያት ማንዋሊ አገልግሎቱን ለመስጠት የምንገደድበት ጊዜ አለ። 

ሁለተኛው በመረጃ ቋታችን የተመዘገቡትም ቢሆኑ አድራሻቸውን በትክክል ያለገለጹና መደበኛ ስልክ ቁጥሮችን ያስቀመጡ መረጃው ላይደርሳቸው የሚችልበት እድል ስለሚኖር እና ከ10 ቀን በላይ ቅጣታቸውን ያልከፈሉ አሽከርካሪዎች በደንቡ መሰረት የቅጣቱን 5 በመቶ ወለድ እየጨመረ የሚሄድ በመሆኑ እክል ይፈጠራል። 

በእኛ በኩል በመረጃ ቋት ውስጥ የሌሉ አሽከርካሪዎች ለአንድ ጊዜ በማንዋል ከተቀጡ በኋላ ለሁለተኛው ምዝገባቸውን አከናውነው በሲስተሙ የሚስተናገዱ ይሆናል። 

ጎን ለጎን በክልሎች የሚገኙ የተሽከርካሪ ባለንብረቶችም አድራሻቸውን በትክክል የሚገልጽ መንጃ ፈቃድ መረጃቸው እንዲሰጠን ጥያቄ አቅርበናል በቅርቡ መረጃዎቹም ልናገኝ እንችላለን። 

ይህ በሁሉም ክልሎች ያሉ መረጃዎች እስከሚመጣ ግን በአዲስ አበባ ውስጥ ያሉ የተመዘገቡ መንጃ ፈቃዶች እና የተሽከርካሪ መረጃዎች ላይ ተግባራዊ አድርገን እየሰራን ነው። 

የፓርኪንግ አሰራራችንም ለብክነት የሚዳርግ ፣ ሰአታቸው በትክክል የማይገለጽ እና ማንዋሊ በደረሰኞች የሚሰሩበት ሁኔታዎች ያሉበት እንደሆነ ይታወቃል ይህንንም ለማስቀረት የፓርኪንግ ሲስተሙን በ13 ሳይቶች ላይ ተግባራዊ አድርገናል። 

ተሽከርካሪው የገባበትንን ፣ የወጣበትን ሰዓት እና አጠቃላይ ክፍያው ባስመዘገበው ስልክ ቁጥር በSMS መልእክት እንዲደርሰው ይደረጋል። 

አሰራሩ ብክነትን ከመከላከል በተጨማሪ አላግባብ የፓርኪንግ ክፍያ የሚጠይቁ ግለሰቦችን ያስቀራል። 

አሁን በ13 ሳይቶች ቢጀመርም ሙሉ በሙሉ በከተማችን እያሰፋን ተግባራዊ እንዲሆን ይደረጋል " ብለዋል።

**" In addition to preventing waste, the system will also eliminate individuals who charge improper parking fees" - Traffic Management Authority **

The Addis Ababa City Administration Traffic Management Authority has implemented an automated information and parking management system since January 1, 2017.

The implementation of this application will save the Addis Ababa Traffic Management Authority more than 17 million birr that it used to spend on printing receipts every year, the authority told Tikvah Ethiopia. 

The authority's Deputy Director General, Ato Amareleng Tarekne, explained to Tikvah Ethiopia that the system was implemented "to make the regulatory work supported by technology." 

**What did the Deputy Director General say in detail? **

"Previously, there was a manual process that was done by giving receipts and writing down the type of penalty. 

However, the current process has greatly reduced the inconvenience to violators because the type of penalty is applied by receiving their driver's license, scanning their information and sending it via SMS text. 

They make the payment through the payment options available on their phones, and they do not have to present their driver's license or remove their license plate. 

The Road Transport Traffic Control Regulation No. 557/2016 issued by the Council of Ministers is being implemented by uploading all the laws mentioned in it to the system. 

We have developed a system that allows you to directly obtain complete information about what type of violation a violator committed, how many violators were registered today, which levels of violations were committed, who the inspector was at what location and what type of penalty he imposed. 

The problem we are facing now is that there are two things in terms of full implementation. First, we have taken 1,124,000 (one million one hundred twenty-four thousand) driver's licenses and 772,000 vehicle information registered by the Addis Ababa Driver and Vehicle License and Control Authority. 

There is a possibility that all those in this registry can be used in the new service system, but due to the fact that the driver's licenses and plates of the regions are not properly registered and entered into our database, we are forced to provide the service manually. 

Second, even those registered in our database who do not provide their addresses correctly and have fixed phone numbers, there is a possibility that the information may not be received, and drivers who have not paid their fines for more than 10 days will be penalized by 5 percent interest on the fine according to the rule. 

Drivers who are not in our database will be fined once manually, and then they will be registered for the second time and processed by the system. 

Side We have also requested that vehicle owners in the regions provide us with their driver's license information that accurately indicates their address, and we will soon be able to obtain the information. 

Until this information is available in all regions, we are working on implementing it on registered driver's licenses and vehicle information in Addis Ababa. 

It is known that our parking system is also wasteful, their hours are not stated correctly and there are situations where manual receipts are used. To avoid this, we have implemented the parking system in 13 sites. 

The time the vehicle entered, exited and the total payment will be sent to the registered phone number via SMS. 

In addition to preventing waste, the system will also eliminate individuals who charge improper parking fees. 

Although it has started with 13 sites now, we will gradually expand it to our entire city, " he said.

በ2017 ዓ.ም በሰኔ ወር የሚሰጠው የመውጫ ፈተና መመዝገቢያ ጊዜ እስከ ግንቦት 14 ቀን 2017 ዓ.ም ከቀኑ 6፡00 ሰዓት ብቻ የተራዘመ መሆኑን ትምህርት ሚኒስቴር አሳውቋል።

እስከ አሁን ያልተመዘገቡ የድጋሚ ተፈታኞች (resitters) ከዚህ በፊት ለምዝገባ በተከፈተውና በተገለጸው መመዝገቢያ ፕላትፎረም https://exam.ethernet.edu.et በኩል ገብተው ምዝገባቸውን እንዲያጠናቅቁ ብሏል።

The Ministry of Education has announced that the registration period for the 2017 June exit exam has been extended until May 14, 2017 A.D. at 6:00 PM.

The Ministry of Education also urged candidates who are taking the exit exam for the first time to confirm their registration through their institutions.

The exam will be held from June 2-10/2017 A.D. It was announced that applicants applying for the exit exam must have a national identity card (ID) to register; The Ministry of Education has announced that registration will not be accepted after 6:00 PM on May 14, 2017.

**__" ፍቅረኛዉን በቅናት ተነሳስቶ የገደላት ግለሰብ ማምለጥ እንደማይችል ሲያውቅ እጁን ለፖሊስ ሰጥቷል " - የኮንሶ ዞን ከና ወረዳ ፖሊስ __
**
__በደቡብ ኢትዮጵያ ክልል ኮንሶ ዞን ከና ወረዳ የገዛ ፍቅረኛዉን በስለት በመዉጋት ሕይወቷ እንዲያልፍ ያደረገው ግለሰብ ከሕግ እንደማያመልጥ ሲገባዉ እጁን ለፖሊስ መስጠቱን የከና ወረዳ ፖሊስ አዛዥ ምክትል ኢንስፔክተር ገዛኸኝ ካራተ ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ተናገሩ።

ግለሰቡና ነዋሪነቷ በኮንሶ ዞን ከና ወረዳ የሆነችው መምህርት ተዋበች ኩሲያን ለ5 ዓመታት በፍቅር አብረዉ ቆይተዋል።

በትላንትናዉ ዕለት ማለዳ ላይ በቅናት ተነሳስቶ " ወደ ስራ ልሸኝሽ " ብሎ ደዉሎ ከጠራት በኋላ በስለት ወግቷ በመግደል አስክሬኗን በመደበቅ ለመሸሽ ቢሞክርም ከሕግ እንደማያመልጥ አዉቆ ለፖሊስ እጅ መስጠቱን አዛዡ ገልፀዋል።

**__" A man who killed his lover out of jealousy surrendered to the police when he realized he could not escape" - Konso Zone Kena District Police __
**
__The man who stabbed his lover to death in Konso Zone, Southern Ethiopia, surrendered to the police when he realized he would not escape the law, Kena District Police Chief Deputy Inspector Gezahegn Karate told Tikvah Ethiopia.

The man and the teacher, Tewabech Kusian, who lives in Konso Zone, Kena District, have been together for 5 years.

Yesterday morning, he called her out of jealousy and asked her to "send me to work." She stabbed him to death and tried to hide her body, but he surrendered to the police when he realized he would not escape the law, the police chief said.

The suspect and the deceased were classmates and teachers by profession.

The person told the police that a third party called him and said, "Your girlfriend has started dating someone else." He was jealous and resentful, so he called the deceased to the school where she was teaching in Kolme Woreda in the morning and stabbed her to death when they reached the Fisha River area on foot, hid her body and handed her over to the police, the commander told Tikvah Ethiopia.

Teacher Tewabech Kusia's funeral was held yesterday at St. Michael and St. Arcema Church in Fasha.

The teacher graduated from Debre Birhan University with a high degree in biology and served her people diligently, her colleagues told Tikvah Ethiopia.

Tikvah Ethiopia
Hawassa

__**የኢትዮጵያ ጤና ባለሙያዎች ማኅበር ምን አለ ?**

**“ አሁንም አረፈደም፤ እልህ በመጋባት የጸጥታ ኃይል በማሰማራት የጤና ባለሙያዎችን ማፈኑ ቁሞ፤ በተገቢ ጥያቄዎች ምላሽ ትኩረት ይደረግ ” - ማኀበሩ
**
የጤና ባለሙያዎች ላቀረቧቸው ጥያቄዎች ተገቢውን ምላሽ ባለማግኘታቸው በሚያደርጓቸው እንቅስቃሴዎች የጸጥታ አካላት የሚፈጽሙት እስራትና አፈና ሊቆም ይገባል ሲል የኢትዮጵያ ጤና ባለሙያዎች ማኀበር በአጽንኦት አሳሰበ።

የዛሬው የጤና ባለሙያዎች የሥራ ማቆም እንቅስቃሴ በተመለከተም፣ ባለሙያዎቹ ሙሉ ለሙሉ ባይሆንም ሥራ የማቆም አድማ እያደረጉ መሆኑን ማኀበሩ ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ገልጿል።

**ማኀበሩ ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ በሰጠው ቃል ምን አለ ?
**
“ ሙሉ ለሙሉ ሥራ አላቆሙም፤ ባለሙያዎች የወጡት ከማህበረሰቡ ስለሆነ የድንገተኛ ክፍሎችን አልዘጉም በደረሰን መረጃ መሠረት። ይህም መሠረታዊ ጥያቄ ስላላቸው እንጂ ማኀበረሰብን ለማገልገል ጽኑ ፍላጎት እንዳላቸው ማሳያ ነው።

የባለሙያዎቹ ችግራቸው ሙሉ የሥራ ማቆም ውስጥ የሚያስገባ ነው።

እኛ ያሳሰብነው ጥያቄያቸውን መንግስት እንዲፈታላቸውና ባለሙያዎቹም  ተገቢውን አገልግሎት እንዲሰጡ ነበር፤ ግን አልሆነም እየቆጠሩ የነበሩት ቀን ዛሬ አልቆ፣ የተለያዩ ቦታዎች በከፊል ሥራ ማቆም ጀምረዋል።

በጥቁር አንበሳ፣ በአማራ ክልል ባሉ ሆስፒታሎች፣ በኦሮሚያ ክልል ባሉ ሆስፒታሎች፣ ደቡብ ባሉ ሆስፒታሎች በከፊል ሥራ እንዳቆሙ ነው ያለን መረጃ።

እንዲያውም ጎርደር ዩኒቨርሲቲ እንደዚህ አይነት እንቅስቃሴ የጀመሩ ባለሙያዎችን ‘ባልታወቀ ምክንያት ከሥራ ቦታቸው ቀርተዋል’ የሚል ደብዳቤ እንደለጠፈ፣ ‘ወደ ስራ ቦታችሁ ካልገባችሁ እርምጃ እንወስዳለን’ እንደሏቸው ሰምተናል።

ጉዳዩ የማይታወቅ አይደለም፤ አገር አቀፍ ጉዳይ ነው። 

የጻፈው አካልም ምን አይነት እንቅስቃሴ ሲያደርጉ እንደነበር ያውቀዋል። ያው እንደዚህ አይነት አፃፃፍ የተለመደ ነው በኛ አገር። እነዚህም አመራሮች አመራር ከመሆናቸው በፊት ጤና ባለሙያ ነበሩ። 

በትንሹ በጎረቤት ካሉ አገሮች እንኳ ተወዳዳሪ የምንሆንበት የጤና ስርዓት እንዲኖረን የጤና ባለሙያውን ያላቀፈ ከመሆን ቢከላከሉት ጥሩ ነው።

የጤና ባለሙያዎች የጠየቁት የዳቦ ጥያቄ ነው፤ በአንድ ቀን መግለጫ የሚቆምም አይደለም፤ ያን ጥያቄ ለመመለስ ከባለሙያዎች ጋር ተወያይቶ ተጨባጭ ምላሽ መሰጠት እንዳለበት ነው ማኀበሩ የሚያምነው።

አሁንም አልረፈደም፤ ጤና ባለሙያዎች ጋር እልህ በመጋባት የጸጥታ ኃይል በማሰማራት የጤና ባለሙያዎችን ማፈኑ ቁሞ፤ ተገቢ ጥያቄዎች ምላሽ ትኩረት ይደርግ።

የጸጥታ ኃይሉም ሲጎዳ የጤና ባለሙያው ጋር ነው ሂዶ የሚታከመው። 

የጸጥታ ኃይል የህክምና አገልግሎት የሚሰጠውን ጤና ባለሙያ ይጎዳል ብለን አናስብም፤ ምናልባት ካድሬዎች ሊልኩት ይችላሉ። የጸጥታ ባለሙያው ከጤና ባለሙያው ጋር ተከባብሮ ሰላማዊ ነገር ቢደረግ ጥሩ ነው።

በጤና ባለሙያዎች ላይ በተለያዩ ጤና ተቋማት፣ ሆስፒታሎች እስራቶች፣ አፈናዎች፣ ሥም የማጥፋት ድርጊት እየተሰሩ ነው።

ሆኖም የጤና ባሙያዎች ጥያቄዎቻቸውን አስቀጥለዋል፤ በጥያቄያቸው ምላሽ አለማግኘት መሠረትም ከፊል የሥራ ማቆም እንቅስቃሴ ጀምረዋል።

አድማውን ያላደረገ ባለሙያ ሊኖር ይችላል፤ በተለያዬ ምክንያት ታፍኖ፣ በፍራቻ። አሁን ባለሙያዎች በጣም በችግር ውስጥ ነው ያሉት። ለመጠየቅ ራሱ ኢነርጂ ያስፈልጋቸዋል። 

ያን ኢነርጂ አጥተው የተለያዩ ካድሬዎች አስፈራርተዋቸው ያልወጡ አሉ። ግን ታፍኖ የሚቀር ነገር የለም። መፍትሄው ምላሽና ምላሽ ብቻ ነው ” ብሏል።

__**What does the Ethiopian Health Professionals Association say?**

**“It is too late; the arrests and detentions of health professionals by the security forces should stop; attention should be paid to responding to appropriate questions” - the association
**
The Ethiopian Health Professionals Association strongly urged that the arrests and detentions carried out by security forces in response to the lack of appropriate responses to the questions raised by health professionals should stop.

Regarding today’s health professionals’ strike, the association told Tikvah Ethiopia that the professionals are holding a strike to stop work, although not completely.

**What did the association say in its statement to Tikvah Ethiopia?

**
“They did not stop working completely; the professionals came from the community and did not close the emergency rooms, according to the information we received. This is not because they have a fundamental demand, but because they have a strong desire to serve the community.

The problem of the professionals is leading to a complete work stoppage.

We were concerned that the government should resolve their demands and that the professionals should provide appropriate services; but it did not happen. The days they were counting down have ended today, and various places have started to partially stop working.

We have information that they have partially stopped working in hospitals in Black Lion, Amhara Region, Oromia Region, and South.

In fact, we have heard that Gonder University posted a letter to the professionals who started such activities saying, ‘They have left their workplaces for unknown reasons’ and that ‘We will take action if you do not return to your workplace.’

The issue is not unknown; it is a national issue.

The person who wrote it also knows what kind of activities they were doing. This is the same Writing is common in our country. These leaders were health professionals before they became leaders. 

It would be good if they prevented the health professional from being included in order to have a health system that is competitive even with neighboring countries.

The health professionals asked a question of bread; it is not a one-day statement; the association believes that a concrete response should be given after discussing with experts to answer that question.

It is not too late; the use of security forces to harass health professionals by engaging in a fight with health professionals should stop; appropriate questions should be answered.

When the security force is injured, the health professional goes with him and is treated. 

We do not think that the security force will harm the health professional who provides medical services; perhaps cadres can send him. It would be good if the security professional cooperates with the health professional and does something peaceful.

There have been arrests, kidnappings, and shootings of health professionals in various health institutions, hospitals They are being destroyed.

However, health professionals have continued their demands; they have started a partial strike based on the lack of response to their demands.

There may be professionals who did not go on strike; they were suppressed for various reasons, out of fear. Now professionals are in a very difficult situation. They need the energy to demand it themselves. 

There are those who have lost that energy and have not come out after being threatened by various cadres, but there is nothing left to be suppressed. The solution is only response and response,” he said.

Tikvah Ethiopia

በኦሮሚያ ክልል፣ ምዕራብ ሀረርጌ ዞን፣ ትናንት ማታ 2፡30 ላይ በደረሰ የመኪና አደጋ የ 11 ሰዎች ህይወት ማለፉንና 28 ሰዎች ደግሞ ከባድ ጉዳት እንደደረሰባቸው የዞን የኮሚኒኬሽን ፅ/ቤት ገለፀ፡፡ 

መኪናው ከ50 እስከ 70 ሜትር የሚርቅ ገደል ውስጥ ነው የገባው።

የፅ/ቤቱ ሐላፊ የሆኑት አቶ ፋሪድ ኢሳቅ ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ በሰጡት ቃል በመሰላ ወረዳ፣ አባ አማን በተባለ ቦታ ላይ ያጋጠመው አደጋ፣ ህዝብና ዕቃ አንድ ላይ ጭኖ ሲጓዝ የነበረ የጭነት አይሱዙ መኪና በመገልበጡ እንደሆነ ገልፀዋል፡፡ 

" የአይሱዙ መኪናው ከዕቃዎቻቸው ጋር 42 ሰዎችን ጭኖ ነበር " ያሉት አቶ ፋሪድ፣ " ዕለቱ የገበያ ቀን ነበረ " ብለዋል፡፡ የገበያ ቀን ሲሆን የአካባው ህዝብ በጭነት መኪኖች የመመላለስ ልምድ እንዳለውም ተናግረዋል፡፡ 

መኪናው እዛው በመሰላ ወረዳ፣ ዋልደያ ወደሚባል ከተማ ሲጓዝ እንደነበረ ገልፀዋል፡፡ 

በአደጋው የቆሰሉት 28 ሰዎች በሂርና ሆስፒታል እና በመሰላ ወረዳ ጤና ጣቢያ ህክምና እየተደረገላቸው ይገኛል ሲሉም አስታውቀዋል፡፡

**"The truck was carrying 42 people and their belongings. 11 people died in the accident" - Mr. Farid Isak**

The Zonal Communications Office said that 11 people died and 28 others were seriously injured in a car accident that occurred in the West Hararge Zone of the Oromia Region at 2:30 last night. 

The car fell into a ravine about 50 to 70 meters deep.

In a statement to Tikvah Ethiopia, Mr. Farid Isak, the head of the office, said that the accident that occurred in Aba Aman, Mesela Woreda, was caused by an Isuzu truck that was carrying people and belongings together when it overturned. 

"The Isuzu truck was carrying 42 people and their belongings," said Mr. Farid. "It was a market day." He said that it was a market day and the people of the area have a habit of traveling in trucks. 

He said that the truck was traveling to a town called Waldeya in Mesella Woreda. 

He also announced that the 28 people injured in the accident are receiving treatment at Hirna Hospital and Mesella Woreda Health Center. 

Tikvah Ethiopia
Addis Ababa

**__“ የዲኤችኤል/DHL ሰራተኞች ነገ ወደ ስራ ይመለሳሉ፡፡ ለሰራተኞቹ የ 35 በመቶ የደመወዝ ጭማሪ ይደረጋል ” - አቶ አባትይሁን ታከለ  __**

ባለፈው ሐሙስ ከአሰሪው ድርጅት ጋር ባለመግባባታቸው ስራ ያቆሙት የዲኤችኤል/DHL ሰራተኞች ከዛ በኋላ በተደረገ ድርድር የሰራተኛ ማህበሩና ድርጅቱ ስምምነት ላይ በመድረሳቸው በነገው ዕለት ወደ ስራ እንደሚመለሱ ተገለፀ፡፡ 

የትራንስፖርትና መገናኛ ሰራተኛ ማህበራት ኢንዱስትሪ ፈደሬሽን ፕረዝደንት አቶ አባትይሁን ታከለ ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ በሰጡት ቃል በቦሌ ክፍለ ከተማ የስራና ክህሎት ፅ/ቤት አሸማጋይነት ሲደረግ የሰነበተው የሁለቱ አካላት ድርድር በዛሬው ዕለት በስምምነት መቋጨቱን ተናግረዋል፡፡

**አቶ አባትይሁን ታከለ በዝርዝር ምን አሉ**  ?

“ ባለፈው አርብ የቦሌ ክፍለ ከተማ የስራና ክህሎት ፅ/ቤት በአደራዳሪነት ገብቶበት፣ ሁለቱንም አካላት በማቀራረብ ረገድ አስተዋፅኦ አድርጓል፡፡ የሰራተኛ ማህበሩ 50 ፐርሰንት የደመወዝ ጭማሪ ሲጠይቅ፣ ድርጅቱ ደግሞ 24 ፐርሰንት ብቻ ነው የምጨምረው የሚል አቋም ነበራቸው፡፡ 

በዚህም ሁለቱም ተደራዳሪዎች መስማማት ስላልቻሉ፣ የቦሌ ክፍለ ከተማ የስራና ክህሎት ፅ/ቤት በአሸማጋይነት ጣልቃ ሊገባ ችሏል፡፡ ይኸው መንግስታዊ አካል ያቀረበው የማስማሚያ ሀሳብ ደግሞ የደመወዝ ጭማሪው 35 ፐርሰንት ይሁን የሚል ነው፡፡ 

የቦሌ ክፍለከተማ ይህን ሀሳብ ያቀረበው ሰራተኞችንም በማወያየት ነው፡፡ በመጨረሻም የሰራተኛ ማህበሩ እና ድርጅቱ በዚህ ሀሳብ መስማማታቸውን አረጋግጠዋል፡፡ በዚህ መሰረት፣ የድርጅቱ ሰራተኞች በነገው ዕለት ማለትም ግንቦት 6 ቀን 2017 ዓ.ም ወደ ስራ እንደሚመለሱ ተስማምተዋል፡፡ 

ይኸው አዲሱ የደመወዝ ጭማሪ ከሚያዝያ ወር ጀምሮ ተግባራዊ እንዲሆን በሰራተኛ ማህበሩ በኩል የተጠየቀ ቢሆንም ድርጅቱ ባለመስማማቱ፣ የ 35 ከመቶ ጭማሪው ከግንቦት ወር ጀምሮ ተግባራዊ እንደሚሆን ነው የተገለፀው፡፡ በሚያዝያ ወር ደመወዝ ላይ ግን የ 24 በመቶ ጭማሪ እንደሚያደርግ ድርጅቱ ተስማምቷል፡ ” ብለዋል።

እዚህ ውሳኔ ላይ ለመድረስ አስቸጋሪ የድርድር ሒደቶች መታለፋቸውን የገለፁት አቶ አባትይሁን የቦሌ ክፍለ ከተማ ስራና ክህሎት ፅ/ቤት በአሸማጋይነት ጣልቃ በመግባቱ ችግሩ ሊፈታ እንደቻለ ተናግረዋል።

ለዚህም የቦሌ ክፍለከተማ ስራና ክህሎት ፅ/ቤት ምስጋና እንደሚገባው ጠቅሰዋል፡፡ 

ድርጅቱና የሰራተኛ ማህበሩ ችግራቸውን በመግባባትና በመደራደር መፍታት ሲችሉ ነገሩ የከፋ ደረጃ ላይ (የስራ ማቆም እርምጃ ድረስ) መድረሱ አግባብ አይደለም ሲሉም ተናግረዋል።

የዲኤችኤል/DHL ሰራተኞች፣ ባለፈው ሐሙስ፣ ሚያዝያ 30 ቀን 2017 ዓ.ም ነበር በአሰሪና ሰራተኛ አዋጁ መሰረት የ10 ቀን ማስጠንቀቂያ ከሰጡ በኋላ ወደ ስራ ማቆም እርምጃ የገቡት፡፡ 

ለዚህ እርምጃ ምክንያት የሆኑዋቸው ጥያቄዎችም የቆዩና ብዙ ናቸው። አንደኛው በአዋጅ የተሰጠው የህብረት ስምምነት ድርድር ጥያቄ ሲሆን፣ ሌላኛው ደግሞ የደመወዝ ጭማሪን የሚመለከት ነበር፡፡ 

አቶ አባትይሁን ታከለ ባለፈው ሳምንት እንደገለጹልን ድርጅቱ በየአመቱ ደመወዝ ይጨምር የነበረ ቢሆንም የዘንድሮን ግን ዘሎታል። 

" ከማህበሩ ጋር የማደርገውን ድርድር ሳልጨርስ የደመወዝ ጭማሪ አላደርግም " በሚል ነው ደመወዝ ጭማሪውን የዘለለው። የማናጅመንት አባላት ለሆኑ ሰራተኞች ግም ደመወዝ ጨምሯል፣ ለሰራተኛው ግን አልጨመረም፡፡ ሰራተኞቹም " የገንዘብ የመግዛት አቅምም እየደከመ በመምጣቱ የደመወዝ ጭማሪ መደረግ አለበት " በማለት ነበር የስራ ማቆም እርምጃ የወሰዱት።
