**__“ DHL/DHL workers will return to work tomorrow. A 35 percent salary increase will be given to the workers ” - Ato Atbayihun Takele  __**

DHL/DHL workers, who stopped work last Thursday due to disagreements with the employer, have reached an agreement with the labor union and the organization, and will return to work tomorrow. 

In a statement to Tikvah Ethiopia, Ato Atbayihun Takele, President of the Transport and Communication Workers’ Unions Industry Federation, said that the negotiations between the two parties, which were held at the Bole Sub-city Employment and Skills Office, concluded today with an agreement.

**What did Ato Atbayihun Takele say in detail** ?

“Last Friday, the Bole Sub-City Employment and Skills Office intervened as a mediator and helped bring both parties together. The union demanded a 50 percent wage increase, while the company was only willing to give a 24 percent increase. 

Since both parties could not agree, the Bole Sub-City Employment and Skills Office intervened as a mediator. The government body proposed a compromise proposal of a 35 percent wage increase. 

The Bole Sub-City made this proposal after discussing it with the employees. Finally, the union and the company confirmed that they agreed to this proposal. Accordingly, the employees of the company agreed that they would return to work tomorrow, May 6, 2017. 

Here is the new wage increase Although the union requested that the increase be implemented from April, the organization did not agree, and the 35 percent increase will be implemented from May. However, the organization agreed to a 24 percent increase in wages for April. ” He said. 

Explaining that difficult negotiation processes were passed to reach this decision, Ato Atbayihun said that the problem was resolved thanks to the intervention of the Bole Sub-City Employment and Skills Office as a mediator. 

He mentioned that the Bole Sub-City Employment and Skills Office deserves credit for this. 

He said that when the organization and the union were able to resolve their problem through communication and negotiation, it was not appropriate for the matter to reach a serious level (to the point of a strike). 

DHL/DHL workers went on strike last Thursday, April 30, 2017, after giving a 10-day notice in accordance with the Employers and Workers Proclamation. 

The demands that led to this action were long-standing and numerous. One was the demand for collective bargaining agreements stipulated in the Proclamation, and the other was a salary increase. 

As Ato Atbayihun Takele told us last week, the company used to increase salaries every year, but skipped this year. 

He skipped the salary increase saying, “I will not increase my salary until I finish my negotiations with the union.” The salary of the management staff increased, but not for the workers. The workers also said, “The purchasing power of money is decreasing, so a salary increase is necessary.”

Tikvah Ethiopia

**" ግለሠቦቹ አንዱን ሠሌዳ በ4 ሺህ ብር እንደሚሸጡ የወንጀል ምርመራ መዝገቡ ያስረዳል " - ፖሊስ**

የአዲስ አበባ ፖሊስ ከቆሙ ተሽከርካሪዎች ላይ ሠሌዳ በመፍታት የሚሸጡ ተጠርጣሪዎችን በቁጥጥር ስር አውሎ ምርመራ እያጣራ መሆኑን አስታወቀ።

እንደ ፖሊስ መረጃ በረከት ማዕረጉ እና ሚኪያስ ባየልኝ የተባሉ ተጠርጣሪዎች ሚያዝያ 26 ቀን 2017 ዓ/ም ከሌሊቱ 7:00 ሠዓት በቂርቆስ ክ/ከተማ ወረዳ 11 ልዩ ቦታው ለገሀር ግቢ ውስጥ በአጥር ዘለው ይገባሉ። ከዛም ከሁለት ተሽከርካሪዎች ላይ የፊትና የኋላ ሠሌዳ ፈትተው ሲወጡ በወቅቱ የነበሩት የጥበቃ ሠራተኞች ሊይዟቸው ባለመቻላቸው ያመልጣሉ።

ነገር ግን በሠዓቱ በአካባቢው በስራ ላይ የነበሩ የወንጀል መከላከል አባላት በዚያ ለሊት ሚኪያስ ባየልኝ ሲሮጥ በማግኘታቸው በቁጥጥር ስር አውለው ሲፈትሹት የተሽከርካሪ ሠሌዳ በማግኘታቸው በቁጥጥር ስር አውለውታል።

ፖሊስም ከሚኪያስ ባየልኝ ጋር አብሮት በወንጀሉ ተሳታፊ የነበረውን በረከት ማዕረጉን በቀጣዩ ቀን በመያዝ ባደረገው ምሪት የሠረቀውን ሠሌዳ ከደበቀበት የመኖሪያ ቤቱ ኮርኒስ ውስጥ መርቶ ሊያመጣም ችሏል። 

የፖሊስ ምርመራ ክፍል በተጠርጣሪዎቹ ላይ ምርመራ የማስፋት ተግባር እያከናወነ የሚገኝ ሲሆን ግለሠቦቹ አንዱን ሠሌዳ በ4 ሺህ ብር እንደሚሸጡ መዝገቡ እንደሚያስረዳ ፖሊስ ገልጿል።

የአዲስ አበባ ፖሊስ በየጊዜው የወንጀል ድርጊቶች መልካቸውንና ጸባያቸውን እየቀያየሩ እየተፈጸሙ መሆኑን ጠቁሟል።

በተለይም አንዳንድ ጊዜ በከተማው የሚከሰቱ የሿሿና ሌሎች ወንጀሎች፤ በመሠል ሁኔታ የሚሠረቁ ሠሌዳዎችን በመጠቀም ስለሚሆን ህብረተሠቡ ተገቢውን ጥንቃቄ እንዲያደርግ መረጃ የመስጠት ተግባሩን እንዲያጠናክር አሳስቧል።

(አዲስ አበባ ፖሊስ)

**" The criminal investigation records show that the individuals sell each license plate for 4 thousand birr " - Police **

Addis Ababa Police announced that they have arrested and are investigating the suspects who were selling license plates by removing them from parked vehicles.

According to police information, the suspects, identified as Bereket Maregu and Mikiyas Bayeling, jumped the fence into the premises of the special area of ​​​​Kirkos District, Woreda 11, on April 26, 2017 at 7:00 pm. Then, when they removed the front and rear license plates from two vehicles, the security guards who were there at the time were unable to catch them.

However, crime prevention members who were on duty in the area at that time caught Mikiyas Bayeling running that night and arrested him after searching him for his license plate.

The police were able to arrest Bereket, who was involved in the crime with Mikias Bayeleng, the next day and bring the stolen license plate from the cornice of the house where he hid it. 

The police investigation department is conducting an investigation into the suspects, and the police said that the records show that the individuals sell one license plate for 4 thousand birr. 

Addis Ababa Police noted that criminal acts are constantly changing their appearance and nature. 

Especially, the community is urged to strengthen the act of providing information so that the community can be vigilant, as sometimes the theft and other crimes that occur in the city are carried out using stolen license plates. 

(Addis Ababa Police)

**" 99,880 students in the region will take the exit exam " - Amhara Regional Education Bureau **

The Amhara Regional Education Bureau has announced that more than 99,000 students will take the national 12th grade exit exam this year.

The bureau told Tikvah Ethiopia that 99,880 students will take the national 12th grade exit exam for the 2017 academic year.

Tikvah Ethiopia asked how many students will not take the exam, but the bureau declined to disclose the number of students.

Out of 685 secondary schools in the region, 470 schools are said to be taking the 12th grade exit exam this year.

It is said that candidates who will take the exit exam online will be tested at the assigned testing center by commuting from their homes every day.

This year's exam will be held from June 23 to July 8.

- ከድንገተኛ ክፍል ጋር ተያይዘው የሚሰጡ አገልግሎቶች እነዚህም የድንገተኛ ክፍል መድሃኒት ቤት እና ላቦራቶሪ
- የማዋለጃ ክፍል
- ፅኑ ህሙማን ክፍል (የጨቅላ እና የአዋቂዎች)
- የድንገተኛ ቀዶ ህክምና ክፍል የሚሰሩትን አይመለከትም ሲሉ ተናግረዋል።

" ከግንቦት 10 በኃለ ግን ምላሽ ካልተሰጠን ሙሉ በሙሉ እናቆማለን " ሲሉም ገልጸዋል።

" የእኛ እንቅስቃሴ አንዳችም የፖለቲካ ሆነ ከፖለቲከኞች ጋር የሚያይዘ አይደለም። ታዋቂም ሰዎች ሆኑ ማንኛውም የፖለቲካ እንቅስቃሴ የሚያራምዱ ሰዎችም እጃቸውን እንዲያነሱ ደጋግመን አሳስበናል። ሀገራችንን ህዝባችንን እንወዳለን ሰላምም እንድትሆን ነው የምንፈልገው ነገር ግን ዓመታት ያለፋቸው ጥያቄዎች መልስ ይሰጥባቸው ፤ ሁሌ ሽንገላና ማታለያ ይቁም " ብለዋል።

ጤና ባለሙያዎቹ ፥ " ያሉብን ዘርፈ ብዙ ችግሮች በግልጽ ይታወቃሉ መፍትሄው ላይ ቁጭ ብለን እንነጋገርባቸውና ቁርጥ ያለ ዘላቂ መፍትሄ ይሰጠን። ቢመረን ፤ ኑሮውም ከአቅማችን በላይ ቢሆንብን ፣ ቤተሰብ ማስተዳደር ቀርቶ ጭራሽ ሸክም ወደመሆን በመሸጋገራችን ፤ ድካማችንን እንቅፍል ማጣታችንን የሚመጥን ነገር ሳናገኝ በመቅረታችን ነው እጅጉንም ቢከፋን ቢመረን ነው ወደዚህ እንቅስቃሴ የገባነው እንጂ ለማንም የፖለቲካ አጀንዳ ማራመጃ ለዩትዩብና ሚዲያ መነገጃ ለመሆን አይደለም። በእኛ ስም ፖለቲካ ለሚነግዱትም ተውን በለን ነገራቸዋል " ሲሉ አክለዋል።

ጤና ባለሙያዎቹ " ያሉብንን ችግሮች በይፋ ደጋግመን ጠይቀን ምላሽ ለመስጠት እስካሁን ድረስ ብቅ ያለ አካል የለም " ሲሉ ተናግረው አሁንም ጥያቄዎቻችንን በድጋሚ እናቀርባለን ሲሉ ገልጸዋል።

" ለጤና ሚኒስቴር ያቀረብናቸው ጥያቄዎቻችን ፦

1. የኢትዮጽያ ጤና ሚኒስቴር ዘመኑን በማይዋጅ አሰራር እየበዘበዘን ነው። የደመወዝ ክፍያን ከምስራቅ አፍሪቃ ሃገራት ተሞክሮ በመነሳት በአማካይ 1000$ (አንድ ሺ ዶላር) በወር ክፍያ ይጀምርልን። የዓለም ጤና ድርጅት (WHO) በሚያስቀምጠው ምክረ ሃሳብ መሰረት የስራ ሰዓት 45 ሰዓት በሳምንት ይገደብ ከዛ በላይ ለሆነውም ተመጣጣኝ የትርፍ ሰዓት ክፍያ ይፈጸም።

2. ጤና ሚኒስቴር ለእኛ ለባለሙያዎቹ ተገቢውን የሆነ የቤት ኪራይ ፣ የተጋላጭነት እንዲሁም የማበረታቻ አበል ላይ አስቸኳይ ማስተካከያ ያድረግልን። በሥራ ላይ ሳሉ በበሽታ ለተጠቁ ባለሙያዎች ደግሞ ተጨማሪ ካሳ ይስጥልን።

3. እንደማንኛውም የመንግስት ሰራተኛ በመታወቂያችን የነጻ ትራስፖርት ተጠቃሚ እንሁን አልያም ገበያውን ያማከለ የትራንስፖርት አበል ይታሰብልን። እንዲሁም ባለሙያው ከቀረጥ ነፃ መኪና አስገብቶ እንዲገለገል ጤና ሚኒስቴር መንግስትን ይጠይቅልን።

4. የትርፍ ሰዐት ክፍያ በሁሉም ጤና ተቋማት ላይ ህግን መሰረት አድርጎ በተመሳሳይ ይሰራ፤ ጊዜውን ጠብቆም ይከፈለን። ክፍያ ከዓመት በላይ በማዘግየት ጤና ባለሞያውን የሚበድሉ ተቋማት ላይ አስቸኳይ እርምጃ ይወሰድ።

5. መብታችንን እንዲሁም የሰራንበትን ዋጋ እንዳንጠይቅ በማሰር፣ በማሰቃየት፣ በማሸማቀቅ እና በማስፈራራት ከህግ አግባብ ውጪ በሆነ መልኩ ባለሙያን ለእንግልት እየዳረጉ ያሉ የጤና ተቋማት እና የመንግስት ሃላፊዎች ላይ ምርመራ ተካሂዶ ሕጋዊ እርምጃ እንዲወሰደ ጤና ሚኒስቴር ኃላፊነቱን ይወጣልን።

6. ጤና ሚኒስቴር ለሁሉም የጤና ባለሙያዎች እና ቤተሰቦቻችን በሁሉም የመንግስትም ሆነ የግል የጤና ተቋማት ላይ የነፃ ሕክምና አገልግሎት ያስጀምር። ውጪ ሄደው መታከም ላለባቸው ባለሙያዎችም ግማሽ ወጪ ይሸፍን የኑሮ ግሽበትን ያማከለ ድጋፍ ያድርግልን።

7. ባለሙያዎች በሚስሩበት አካባቢ የቤት ወይም የማህበር መስርያ ቦታ ተጠቃሚ እንዲሆኑ አልያም በረጅም ግዜ ክፍያ ቤት የሚገዙበትን መንገድ ይመቻች።

8. ሚኒስቴሩ በስራ ቦታቸን ላይ ሰላማዊ መስተጋብር እና ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ የመማር ማስተማር ሂደት እንዲሁም የስራ አካባቢ እንዲፈጠር፣ በምንም መልኩ አግባብነት የሌለውን የጤና ባለሙያዎች ሞትንም እምርሮ ይታገልም መመርያም አውጥቶ ተፈፃሚነቱን ይከታተል።

9. የህክምና እውቀቱ ሆነ ሙያው በሌላቸው የሚዲያ ሰዎች በባለሙያው ላይ በሚነሱ አሉባልታና የሐሰት ክሶች ምክንያት ማህበረሰባችን በጤና ባለሙያ ላይ ያለውን እምነት እንዲሸረሸር ተደርጓል። እንዲህ ያለውን ግድየለሽ ተግባር የሚፈፅሙና ማስረጃ የሌለው የሐሰት ዜና የሚያሰራጩ ሰዎች ላይ ሕጋዊ እርምጃ እንዲወሰድ ይደረግ።

10. እኛ ባለሙያዎች ለአለምአቀፍ ገበያ ብቁነታችንን የምናረጋግጥበት ዓለም አቀፍ የፈተና ማዕከላት / USMLE EXAM CENTER, NCLEX EXAM CENTER, PLAB, DHA, AMC / ከዓመት በፊት ቃል በተገባልን መሰረት ጤና ሚኒስቴር በሀገር ውስጥ ያቋቋምልን። 

11. በሁሉም ጤና ተቋማት ላይ የሚታየው የአመራር ምርጫ በሹመት መሆኑ ከጤናው ዘርፍ የማይጠበቅ በመሆኑ ይሄ አሰራር አስቀርታቹ በእውቀት እና በውድድር እንዲሆን አድርጉት ፤ አሰራሩንም አዘምኑት። 

12. የህክምና ዘርፍ ከሲቪል ሰርቪስ ማዕቀፍ እንዲወጣ በማድረግ ውስናችሁ አሳውቁን ፤ እራሱን ችሎ በቦርድ እንዲተዳደር ኃላፊነታችሁን ተወጡልን።  

የሚሉ ናቸው " ብለዋል።

ጤና ሚኒስቴር ለተጠየቁት ለእነዚህ ግልጽ የሆኑ ጥያቄዎች ዙሪያ ጥምጥም መሄድ ሳያስፈልገው 1... 2 ... 3 እያለ በግልጽ ይመልሳቸው ሲሉ አክለዋል።

ቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ የጤና ባለሙያዎቹ ላነሷቸው ጥያቄዎች ከጤና ሚኒስቴር በኩል ማብራሪያ ካገኘ ይዞ ይቀርባል።

ቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ
አዲስ አበባ

english_text:
🔈#Health_Professionals

Health professionals had previously written a letter to the government demanding that their demands be met by May 3/2017 or they would be forced to partially stop working.

They told Tikvah Ethiopia that they had not returned to work in various health facilities in the country today, and that the facilities were posting notices to return to work.

“Our demands have not been met,” the health professionals said. The partial strike, which will last until May 9, will not affect the following:
- Adult Emergency Department
- Pediatric Emergency Department
- Services provided in connection with the emergency department, including the emergency room pharmacy and laboratory
- Delivery Room
- Intensive Care Unit (infant and adult)
- Emergency Surgery Department.

“However, if we are not met after May 10, we will completely stop working,” they said.

"None of our activities are political or related to politicians. We have repeatedly urged celebrities and those who promote political activities to raise their hands. We love our country and our people and we want peace, but the questions that have been going on for years must be answered; let's stop all the deceit and deception," he said.

The health experts added, "The many problems we have are clearly known. Let's sit down and discuss the solutions and give us a definitive and lasting solution. If we are successful, if our livelihood is beyond our means, if we are not able to manage our family, if we are not able to find something that suits our weakness, if we are successful, we are very sad. We have entered this movement not to promote anyone's political agenda, to be a YouTube and media outlet. We have also told those who do politics in our name to leave us alone."

The health experts said, "We have repeatedly asked for our problems publicly, but no one has yet emerged to respond," adding that they will continue to present their questions.

"Our demands to the Ministry of Health:

1. The Ethiopian Ministry of Health is exploiting our time in an unfair manner. Based on the experience of East African countries, the salary should start at an average of $1,000 (one thousand dollars) per month. In accordance with the recommendations of the World Health Organization (WHO), working hours should be limited to 45 hours per week, and overtime should be paid accordingly.

2. The Ministry of Health should urgently adjust the rent, exposure and incentive allowances for our professionals. We should also provide additional compensation to professionals who fall ill while working.

3. Like any government employee, we should benefit from free transport or a market-based transport allowance. The Ministry of Health should also ask the government to provide tax-free vehicles for professionals.

4. Overtime pay should be based on the law in all health institutions It works the same way; it is paid on time. Urgent action should be taken against institutions that abuse health professionals by delaying payment for more than a year.

**" እስካሁን የዋሸሁት ይበቃኛል ፤ እስካሁን የታገስኩት ይበቃኛል " - አቶ ጌታቸው ረዳ
**
በትግራይ ያለው ህገወጥ የወርቅ ንግድ  ከፕሪቶሪያ ስምምነት በኃላ የጀመረ ሳይሆን በጦርነቱ ጊዜም ሳይቀር ሲሰራ የነበረ እንደሆነ የቀድሞው የጊዜያዊ አስተዳደር ፕሬዝዳንት እና የአሁኑ የምስራቅ አፍሪካ ጉዳዮች አማካሪ ሚኒስትር አቶ ጌታቸው ረዳ ይፋ አደረጉ።

አቶ ጌታቸው፤ "ብዙ ሰው የወርቅ ንግድ የፕሪቶሪያ ስምምነት ከተፈራረምን በኃላ የጀመር ይመስለዋል" ያሉ ሲሆን ግን ጦርነቱም እየተካሄደ ንግዱ ነበር ብለዋል።

"እኔ የማምንበትን ትግል ነው ያካሄድኩት ብዬ አምናለሁ በዛ በማምንበት ትግል ውስጥ የትግራይን ህዝብ አጀንዳ ይዘው የታገሉ ብዙ የጦር መኮንኖች አሉ ለሰሩት ስራ ያለኝ ክብር በፍጹም አይቀንስም ግን ደግሞ ገና ገና ጦርነቱ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ወጣቶችን ይበላ በነበረበት ወቅት ሳይቀር ምሽግ ለመቆፈር ብለን የወሰድነው ኤክስካቫተር ወርቅ ለመልቀም ይጠቀሙበት የነበሩ አዛዦችም ነበሩ" ሲሉ አጋልጠዋል።

"ሲዋሹ በጣም ነው የሚገርመኝ" ያሉት አቶ ጌታቸው "እኔ እስካሁን የዋሸሁት ይበቃኛል እስካሁን የታገስኩትም ይበቃኛል" ብለዋል።

አቶ ጌታቸው "የኤርትራን ሰራዊት እናፍርሰው" በሚል አላማ ዘመቻ የጀመረና ዘመቻውን የሚመራው አመራር ሰዎችን እያፈነ ገንዘብ ሲበስብ እንደነበር ተናግረዋል።

"ሰው ሲሸጡ የሚኖሩ ሰዎች አሉ፤ ኤርትራዊ መሸጥ ' ንብረት ' ነው የሚባለው ወርዷል ወይ ? ይባላል፤ ታፍንና ይዘህ 27 ወጣት አንድ ቤት ትዘጋና ቤተሰቦች አላቸው ውጭ ሀገር የሚባሉት ሰዎች አካውንት እየተጠየቀ እያንዳንዱ ሰው በትንሹ 4000 ዶላር እንዲያስገባ ተደርጎ (20 ሰው ካፈንክ 80 ሺህ ዶላር ታስገባለህ) በዚህ የውጭ አካውንት ከፍተው በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎችን እየሸጡ፣ እያገቱ ገንዘብ እንዲሰበሰብ የሚያደርጉ አመራር የሚሰጡ ከፍተኛ አመራሮች አሉ" ብለዋል።

ይህ ተግባር መጀመሪያ በኤርትራውያን መጀመሩን ከዛም ወደ ትግራይ ተወላጆች መዞሩን ተናግረዋል።

እዚህ ጉዳይ ላይ ጥናት ተደርጎ አመራሮቹ ለህግ እንዲቀርቡ ሙከራ ቢደረግም ማቅረብ እንዳልተቻለና 2 ዓመት እንደሆነው ጠቁመዋል።

አቶ ጌታቸው "ይሄን የሚመራ የመረጃ መምሪያ ኃላፊ እርምጃ እንዲወሰድበት ወይ ከስራ እንዲነሳ ብለን ወስነን ስናበቃ ለማስፈጸም ኃላፊነት የሚሰጣቸው የፀጥታ አመራሮች አላስፈጸሙም" ሲሉ ተናግረዋል።

የፀጥታ አመራሮች በባህሪያቸው ጥፋት ያጠፋውም ያላጠፋውም የመተጋገዝ ባህሪ አላቸው ሲሉ ተደምጠዋል።

አቶ ጌታቸው በወርቅ ንግድ ውስጥ ስላሉ አመራሮችም በዝርዝር ተናግረዋል።

"ወርቅ ንግድ ውስጥ የገባ ' ለትግራይ ነጻነት እስከመጨረሻው እሰዋለው ' እያለ የሚፎክር ጀነራል አለ አሁንም፤ እንዲህ አይነቱን የወርቅ ንግድ ውስጥ ነው ያለኸው ሊባል ይገባል" ብለዋል።

አቶ ጌታቸው እነ ጀነራል ምግበ በወርቅ ንግድ ውስጥ ተሰማርተው እንደሚገኙ በስም ጠቅሰው ይፋ አድርገዋል።

"እነ ምግበ የሰሩት ጀግንነት የወጣት መስዕዋት መሰረት ተደርጎ የመጣ ጀግንነት ነው" ያሉት አቶ ጌታቸው "እነዛን ወጣቶች ለስደት በሚዳርግ ደረጃ ወደ ተራ የወርቅ ንግድ ገብተው ሲያበቁ የስርቆት ተግባራቸውን የትግራይ ግዛት አንድነት የማረጋገጥ አርገው እየገለጹ እንደገና ይሄን ወጣት ለሌላ መስዕዋትነት ሊዳርጉ እየተንቀሳቀሱ ነው" ብለዋል።

"እነ ኃይለስላሰም አሁን በትግራይ ህዝብ አንድነት ስም የትግራይን ወጣት ከኤርትራም ጋር ቢሆን አብሬ ለማገዶነት እንዳርገዋለው በሚል በጀግንነት ስም እየፎከረ ነው" ሲሉ ገልጸዋል።

እነ ምግበ ፣ እነ ኃይለስለሰ ፣ ኮሎኔል ተወልደን "በወንጀል የተነከሩ ሰዎች ናቸው" ብለዋቸዋል። 

ድንገት ሰላም ቢፈጠር "ተጠያቂ እሆናለሁ፤ አደጋ ውስጥ እገባለሁ" ብለው ስለሚያስቡም ግርግር እንዲያልቅ አይፈልጉም ሲሉ ገልጸዋቸዋል።

የትግራይን ህዝብ ለሌላ ጦርነት ለማስገባት እያሰቡ እንደሆነ የጠቆሙት አቶ ጌታቸው " የፌዴራል መንግሥት ድንገት ውጊያ ይገጥመናል " በሚል ስጋት ውጊያው ትግራይ ውስጥ እንዲካሄድ የሚያስችል ስትራቴጂ ተቀይሶ እየተንቀሳቀሱ ነው ብለዋል።

" ሰላም መፈጠር አለበት፤ በኢትዮጵያም በኤርትራም መካከል ጦርነት መፈጠር የለበትም፣ የኤርትራ ህዝብ ለአደጋ መዳረግ የለበትም እምነቴ ነው። ግን መምረጥ ካለብኝ የትግራይ ህዝብ ድጋሚ የጦር አውድማ የሚሆንበት ሁኔታ እስከመጨረሻው ድረስ እንዳይሆን እታገላለሁ " ብለዋል።

በዚህ ትግል እንቅፋት የሆኑት የወርቅ ንግድ ላይ የተሰማሩት ዘራፊዎች ናቸው ሲሉ ገልጸዋል።

" ' ግንባር አዛዥ ነኝ ' ይላል ወርቅ ሲዘርፍ ነው የሚውለው " ብለዋል።

"በ2014 ወጣቶች በየግንባሩ ሲተናነቁ በርቀት ዳባት፣ደባርቅ ፣ሊማሊሞ ሆኖ ውጊያ ይመራ የነበረ ሰው በተመሳሳይ ሰዓት በኤክስካቫተር ወርቅ እየቆፈረ ይሸጥ ነበር" ሲሉ ተደምጠዋል።

በዚህ የዝርፊያ ኔትዎርክ ፖለቲከኛውም እንዳለ ገልጸዋል።

ከዚህ ባለፈ አቶ ጌታቸው በመቶ ሚሊዮን ዘርፏል ስላሉት ኃለስላሰም ተናግረዋል።

አብዛኛው ሰው ትግሉን ለትግራይ ህዝብ ካለው የህልውና ጥቅም አንጻር እንጂ "ገንዘብ አገኝበታለሁ" ብሎ አይደለም የተሳተፈው ሲሉ ተናግረዋል።

በጥናት " እገለ እግሌ 300 ሚሊዮን ወስዷል በቁጥጥር ስር ይዋል፣ እገሌ ይሄን ያህል ማሽነሪ ወስዷል በቁጥጥር ስር ይዋል እርምጃ ይወሰድ " ከተባለ 2 ዓመት እንደሆነው አመልክተዋል።

የቀረበውን የጥናት ዶክመት እነ ደብረጽዮን (ዶ/ር) እንደሚያውቁት ጠቁመዋል።

ትግሉ ውስጥ ትልልቅ አስተዋጽኦ ያላቸው ሰዎች ስም ሌሎችን ይዞ እንዳይጠፋና የውሸት አንድነት ለማስቀጠል ሲባል እምርጃ መውሰድ አልተቻለም ብለዋል።

"የመረረኝ ሰዓት እርምጃ እንዲወሰድ ዶክመንት አቅርቤም ተግባራዊ አልተደረግም" ብለዋል።

እነ ምግበን፣ እነ ኃይለስላሰን በስም ጠቅሰን መጠየቅ ስላልቻልን "ሁሉም የሰራዊት አመራሮች ዘርፈዋል" የሚል የጅምላ መልዕክት እያስተላለፍን ነው የመጣነው ይህ ውሸት ነው ብለዋል።

ተጠያቂነት እንዳይሰፍን የፖለቲካ መሪዎቹ እንቅፋት እንደሆኑ ይህን የሚያደርጉትም እነሱም ተጠያቂ ስለሆኑ እንደሆነ አቶ ጌታቸው ረዳ ይፋ አድርገዋል።

አብዛኛው የሰራዊት አመራር ግን ሰላም ፈላጊ እንደሆነ ጠቁመዋል።

**" I have lied enough; I have tolerated enough " - Ato Getachew Reda
**
Former interim president and current East African Affairs Advisor Ato Getachew Reda has revealed that the illegal gold trade in Tigray did not start after the Pretoria Agreement but was even during the war.

Ato Getachew; "Many people think that the gold trade started after we signed the Pretoria Agreement," but the trade was also going on while the war was going on, he said.

"I believe that I fought for what I believed in. In that struggle that I believed in, there were many military officers who fought with the agenda of the people of Tigray. My respect for their work will never diminish. But even when the war was still killing thousands of young people, there were commanders who used the excavators we took to dig forts to extract gold," he revealed.

"I am very surprised when they lie," said Ato Getachew. "I have lied enough so far, and I have tolerated enough so far."

Ato Getachew said that the leadership that started the campaign with the aim of "Let's destroy the Eritrean army" and led the campaign was kidnapping people and extorting money.

"There are people who live by selling people; Has the idea that selling Eritreans is 'property' gone? It is said; you kidnap and take 27 young people, close a house and have families. People who are called foreigners are being asked to open accounts and each person is asked to deposit at least $4,000 (if you kidnap 20 people, you deposit $80,000). There are senior leaders who are leading the way in opening foreign accounts and selling and kidnapping thousands of people to collect money," he said.

He said that this practice first started with Eritreans and then turned to Tigray natives.

He pointed out that although a study was conducted on this matter and attempts were made to bring the leaders to justice, it could not be done and it has been 2 years.

Ato Getachew said, "When we decided to take action against the head of the intelligence department who is leading this, the security leaders who are responsible for implementing it did not do so."

He said that the security leaders have a tendency to be cooperative, whether they are responsible for destroying or not.

Ato Getachew also spoke in detail about the leaders involved in the gold trade.

"There is a general who is involved in the gold trade and boasts that he will sacrifice himself for the freedom of Tigray until the end; it should be said that he is involved in this kind of gold trade," he said.

Ato Getachew mentioned General Mgbbe by name and announced that he is involved in the gold trade.

"The heroism of Mgbbe is a heroism that is based on the sacrifice of youth," said Ato Getachew. "When these youths end up in the gold trade, which leads to exile, they are trying to justify their theft as a means of ensuring the unity of the Tigray state and are moving to sacrifice this young man again." 

"Haile Selassie is now boasting in the name of heroism that he has brought the youth of Tigray to power, even with Eritrea, in the name of unity," he said. 

Mgbbe, Haile Selassie, and Colonel Tewolden are "people who are steeped in crime." 

They said that if peace suddenly comes, they think, "I will be held responsible; I will be in danger," and they do not want the chaos to end. 

Ato Getachew, who indicated that they are planning to drag the people of Tigray into another war, said, "The federal government is worried that we will suddenly face a war." They are changing their strategy to allow the war to take place in Tigray, saying,

"Peace must be created; there should be no war between Ethiopia and Eritrea, and the Eritrean people should not be put in danger, I believe. But if I have to choose, I will fight until the end to prevent the people of Tigray from becoming a battlefield again."

He said that the obstacles in this struggle are the robbers involved in the gold trade.

"He who says 'I am a front commander' is used to loot gold," he said.

"In 2014, when young people were fighting on the front lines, a person who was leading the fight from a distance, from Dabat, Debarq, Limalimo, was digging and selling gold with an excavator at the same time," he said.

He said that politicians are also involved in this looting network.

In the past, Ato Getachew said that he had stolen hundreds of millions.

"It was a Kombolcha issue account; at that time, we needed money for the war, so we decided politically to take the government's money without touching private banks. As far as I know, there was 4 billion birr in the issue account. This can be verified from the National Bank. After I became the interim administration, I received a letter saying, "Tell us what happened in the banks and tell us what happened in the issue account." One of the people assigned to collect the money in the issue account was the front commander, Haile Selassie, who took hundreds of millions of birr. He took about one billion birr. There are his servants who are called "tef tef" who took their share," he said.

He said that most people participated in the struggle for the survival of the Tigray people, not because they "earn money."

"As far as I know, even with the documents I have verified, Haile Selassie is using them when he imports gold machines," he said.

He also pointed out that the political leadership was also involved in the gold trade.

When the people seized the machine, they called federal officials and said, "There is no one like us." They said that they were trying to free the machine by practicing.

He pointed out that it was 2 years since the study said, "Someone took 300 million and was arrested, and someone took this much machinery and was arrested and action was taken."

He pointed out that Debretsion (Dr.) knew the study document submitted.

He said that it was not possible to take action so that the names of people who had made great contributions to the struggle would not be lost along with others and to maintain false unity.

"I was very angry when I submitted a document for action to be taken, but it was not implemented," he said.

Since we could not ask them by name, we are sending a mass message that "all the army leaders have stolen," he said. This is a lie.

Getachew Reda revealed that the political leaders are the obstacle to accountability and that they are doing this because they are also responsible.

However, he pointed out that most of the army leadership is peace-seeking.

ይህ የተናገሩት ከ ' ፋና ቴሌቪዥን ' ጋር በነበራቸው ዘልግ ያለና ጠንካራ ሃሳቦች በሰነዘሩበት ቃለምልልስ ነው።

**" 'TPLF and Tigray people are one' is a deception used by the leadership" - Ato Getachew Reda **

"TPLF and Tigray people are one" is a deception used by the leadership, said Ato Getachew Reda, former President of the Interim Administration of Tigray and current Minister of East African Affairs.

He said this in an interview with 'Fana Television' where he shared his long and strong thoughts.

He described the leadership in the TPLF as "one that focuses only on narrow group interests; one that is not the public agenda; one that wakes up from sleep saying 'only what I said is right' without even knowing what it is saying, confusing the issues that come to it as the public agenda, swearing in the name of the public and leaving the public agenda and issues aside and pursuing its own interests."

"This is not to go out and blame this or that, we should ask ourselves what we have done in terms of setting a public agenda in the process we have all gone through."

Ato Getachew Reda explained that the leadership's claim that "TPLF and the people of Tigray are one" is a fraud.

He explained that the leadership uses this fraud to avoid being held accountable for theft and other crimes committed by the government.

He also said that with this fraud, "it tries to convince people that all the work it does is done with the approval of the people."

**ኢትዮጵያውያን ስደተኞች ከጅቡቲ ለመውጣት የሶስት ወራት ጊዜ እንዲሰጣቸው ጥያቄ ቀረበ።**

በጅቡቲ የሚኖሩ ሰነድ አልባ ኢትዮጵውያን፣ ሀገሪቱን ለቀው ለመውጣት የሶስት ወረ ጊዜ እንዲሰጣቸው ይፋዊ ጥያቄ መቅረቡን፣ በጅቡቲ ያለው የኢትዮጵያ ኮሚኒቲ እና የሀይማኖት አባቶች ህብረት በጋራ ጠየቁ፡፡ 

አንድ የህብረቱ አባል የሆኑ አባት ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ በሰጡት ቃለመጠይቅ፣ በነዚህ አካላት እየተደረገ ያለው ሽምግልና በዜጎች ላይ እንግልትና የመብት ጥሰት እንዳይፈፀም አስተዋፅኦ አድርጓል ብለዋል፡፡    

**የህብረቱ አባል በዝርዝር ምን አሉ ?**

" ሰነድ አልባ ዜጎች ከሀገሪቱ ለቀው ይውጡ የሚለው ነገር በሽምግልና ተይዞ ዜጎቻችንን ህጋዊ ነዋሪዎች ለማድረግ፣ ፓስፖርት እንዲያገኙ ለማስቻል፣ ቪዛም እንዲሰጣቸው፣ ቀደም ሲል የተሰጠው የአንድ ወር ቀነገደብ ወደ ሶስት ወራት እንዲራዘም ነው የጠየቅነው፡፡ 

ይህን ጥያቄ ለሀገሪቱ ፕረዝደንት ፅ/ቤት፣ ለሀገር ውስጥ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር፣ እና ለውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር በደብዳቤ አቅርበናል፡፡ ዜጎቻችን በቂ ዝግጅት አድርገው ከሀገር እንዲወጡ አለያም ህጋዊ እንዲሆኑ ቀኑ ይራዘምላቸው ብለናል፡፡ 

እኛ ወንድሞቻችሁ ነን፣ እናንተም ወንድሞቻችን ናችሁ፣ የሁለት ሀገር አንድ ህዝብ ነን እኛ፣ ልዩነት የለንም፡፡ ይህን ከግምት አስገብታችሁ፣ የትናንቱን ታሪክ የነገውንም ጉዞዋችንን ተመልክታችሁ መፍትሔ ስጡን፡፡ ጅቡቲ እና ኢትዮጵያ የሚለያዩ ሀገራት አይደሉም፡፡ የእኛ ዜጎች እዚህ ጫና እንደሚፈጥሩ ፤ አብዛኛው ዜጋችንም ህገወጥ ነዋሪ እንደሆነ እናውቃለን ብለናቸዋል፡፡ 

የጅቡቲ ባለስልጣናትም ጥያቄያችንን ተገንዝበው፣ ምላሽ እንደሚሰጡን ነግረውናል፡፡ ነገር ግን በምክር ቤት የተላለፈ ውሳኔ ስለሆነ አሁንም ውሳኔውን መለወጥ የሚችለው ምክር ቤቱ ነው ብለውናል፡፡ ነገር ግን ተረድተናችኋል ብለዋል፡፡

በዚህ የሽምግልና ስራችን የተረጋጋ ነገር እንዲኖር አድርገናል፡፡ ፖሊሶች ቤት ለቤት እየገቡ ሁከት እንዳይፈጥሩ፣ በቤት ውስጥ ሰው እንዳይዙ አድርገናል፣ ከዚህ ተግባር እንዲታቀቡ አስችለናል፡፡ 

መንገድ ላይ የሚያገኙትን ሰው ካልሆነ በስተቀር፣ ስራ ላይ ያለውን ሰው እንዳይነኩብን ጠይቀን ሰምተውናል፡፡ በልመና ነው ይህን ያስረዳናቸው፡፡ እኛ የሀይማኖት አባቶች ነን፣ መሸምገል ነው የምንችለው፡፡ 

ማክሰኞ ዕለት ደግሞ ኡጋዞችን ለማነጋገር ወደ ድሬዳዋ እንመጣለን፡፡ በዚህ ሽምግልና መሳተፍ ያለባቸውና የጅቡቲን መንግስት ማሳመን የሚችሉ ኡጋዞችን/የሀገር ሽማግሌዎችን በድረዳዋ እናነጋግራለን፡፡ እነዚህ ኡጋዞች እንደዚህ አይነት ሁኔታ ሲያጋጥም በራሳቸው ህግ ያስተካክሉታል፡፡ ኡጋዞቹን ወደ ሀገሪቱ መንግስት በሽምግልና ለመላክ ነው እየሰራን ያለነው፡፡ 

የእኛ ሽምግልና ከየትኛውም መንገድ የተሻለ ሆኗል፣ ተሳክቶልናልም፡፡ ሰነድ አልባ ዜጎቻችን ህገወጦች ናቸው ሲሉን፣ ህገወጥ ሰውነት የለም፣ ህገወጥ አካሔድ እንጂ ብለን ተከራክረናል፡፡ ሰውነት ህጋዊ ነው፣ ጉዞው ነው ህገወጡ፡፡ በደስታቸው ጊዜ፣ ከትኛውንም እምነት ተከታይ ጋር አብረን ነበርን፣ አሁን ሲያዝኑ ሲያለቅሱ ቆመን ማየት አንችልም፣ እኛ የሀይማኖት አባቶች ነን ብለናቸዋል፡፡ በካቢኔው ውስጥ ያሉት የመንግስት ሐላፊዎች በሀሳቦቻችን ተስማምተዋል፡፡ "

**Ethiopian refugees asked to be given three months to leave Djibouti.**

The Ethiopian community in Djibouti and the Religious Fathers’ Union have jointly requested that an official request be made to give undocumented Ethiopians living in Djibouti three months to leave the country. 

In an interview with Tikvah Ethiopia, a father who is a member of the union said that the mediation being carried out by these bodies has contributed to preventing abuse and violations of rights against citizens. 

**What did the members of the union say in detail?**

"We have requested that the issue of undocumented citizens leaving the country be handled through mediation and that our citizens be made legal residents, be allowed to obtain passports, and be given visas, and that the previously given one-month period be extended to three months. 

We have submitted this request to the Office of the President of the country, the Ministry of Interior, and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in a letter. We have asked that our citizens make adequate preparations and that the date be extended for them to leave the country or become legal. 

We are your brothers, you are our brothers, we are one people of two countries, we have no differences. Take this into consideration, look at the history of yesterday and our journey tomorrow and find a solution. Djibouti and Ethiopia are not different countries. We know that our citizens are creating pressure here; most of our citizens are illegal residents. We told them. 

The Djiboutian authorities have also acknowledged our request and told us that they will respond. But they said that since it was a decision made by the council, it is still the council that can change the decision. But we understand.

We have ensured that there is stability through our mediation work. We have prevented the police from going door to door to create chaos, from arresting people in their homes, and we have allowed them to refrain from this activity. 

We have asked and heard them not to touch anyone at work, except for those they meet on the street. We have explained this to them through begging. We are religious fathers, we can mediate. 

On Tuesday, we will also come to Dire Dawa to talk to the Ugaz/elders who should participate in this mediation and who can convince the Djiboutian government. These When such a situation arises, the Ugaz will regulate it with their own laws. We are working to send the Ugaz to the government of the country through mediation. 

Our mediation has been better than any other way, we have succeeded. When they say that our undocumented citizens are illegal, we argue that there is no illegal person, only illegal behavior. The person is legal, the journey is illegal. When they are happy, we were with the followers of any religion, now we cannot stand by and watch when they are sad and cry, we said that we are religious fathers. The government officials in the cabinet agree with our ideas. "

Tikvah Ethiopia
Addis Ababa

PKK ውሳኔውን ያሳለፈው ታሪካዊ ግቡን በመምታቱና ከዚህ በኃላ የኩርዶች ጥያቄ በዴሞክራሲያዊ ፖለቲካ መፈታት እንደሚችል በማመኑ ነው ተብሏል።

አንካራ ውሳኔውን በደስታ እንደተቀበለችው ተነግሯል። 

ስለ ቀጣይ የትጥቅ ማስወረድ ሂደቶችና ህጋዊ ጉዳዮች ምንም በይፋ የሚታወቅ ነገር የለም። ቡድኑ በቱርክ እና አሜሪካ በአሸባሪነት የተፈረጀ ነው።

የቡድኑ ታጣቂዎች ዕጣፈንታም ምን እንደሆነ አሁን ላይ የሚታወቅ ነገር የለም።

ያም ሆኖ ግን የቡድኑ  የትጥቅ ትግል የማቆም ውሳኔ ለአጠቃላይ ቀጠናው ሰላምና መረጋጋት ትልቅ የሆነ ተስፋን ሰጥቷል። ከፍተኛ የምስራችም ተብሏል።

PKK ከ1984 ጀምሮ ዋና አላማውን ነጻ ኩርድን ለመመስረት በሚል ከቱርክ መንግሥት ጋር የትጥቅ ትግል ሲያደርግ ነበር።

በትጥቅ ትግሉ ከ40 ሺሕ በላይ ዜጎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል ፣ከፍተኛ የኢኮኖሚ ችግር አስከትሏል ተብሏል።

መረጃው ከፊራት ኒውስ እንዲሁም ከሮይተርስ የተወሰደ ነው።

__**The Kurdistan Workers' Party (PKK) has officially announced its decision to end its armed struggle.
**
The Kurdistan Workers' Party (PKK), which has been fighting the Turkish government for the past 40 years, announced that its members would disarm and engage in a peaceful and democratic struggle.

Months ago, its imprisoned leader Abdullah Ocalan called on the group's members to fight peacefully for Kurdish rights.

Last week, the PKK met and made a historic decision to end the armed struggle and fight peacefully.

The PKK said it had reached its historic goal and believed that the Kurdish issue could now be resolved through democratic politics.

Ankara was said to have welcomed the decision. 

There is no official information about the ongoing disarmament process or legal issues. The group is listed as a terrorist organization by Turkey and the United States.

The fate of the group’s fighters is also unknown at this time.

Nevertheless, the group’s decision to end its armed struggle has given great hope for peace and stability in the region. It has also been called a great news.

The PKK has been waging an armed struggle against the Turkish government since 1984, with its main goal being the establishment of an independent Kurdistan.

The armed struggle has claimed the lives of more than 40,000 civilians and caused severe economic hardship.

The information is taken from Firat News and Reuters.

__አሜሪካ እና ቻይና በምርቶቻቸው ላይ ጥለውት የነበረውን ታሪፍ ለመቀነስ ተስማሙ።

ሁለቱ የግዙፍ ኢኮኖሚ ባለቤቶች በተደጋጋሚ የአፀፋ ታሪፎችን እርስ በራሳቸው ሲጣጣሉ የነበረ ሲሆን በጄኔቫ ከተደረገ ውይይት በኋላ የአፀፋ ታሪፎቹን በ115% ለመቀነስ ተስማምተዋል።

አሜሪካ በቻይና ምርቶች ላይ ጥላ የነበረውን የ145% ታሪፍ በመቀነስ ወደ 30% ያወረደች ሲሆን ቻይና በአሜሪካ ምርቶች ላይ ጥላ የነበረውን የ125% ታሪፍ ወደ 10% ቀንሳለች።

አዲሱ የታሪፍ ቅነሳም ለሚቀጥሉት 90 ቀናት በስራ ላይ ይቆያል ተብሏል።

የአሜሪካ የግምጃ ቤት ሃላፊው ስኮት ቤሰንት የታሪፍ አፀፋዎቹ ሁለቱም ሃገራት የማይፈልጉት ነው በማለት ሃገራቱ አብረው መነገድ እንደሚፈልጉ ገልፀዋል።

ቤሰንት አዲሱ ስምምነት አንዳንድ ሴክተሮች ላይ የተጣሉ ታሪፎችን እንደማይመለከት የገለፁ ሲሆን አሜሪካ በመድሃኒት፣ ሴሚ ኮንዳክተር እና ብረት ላይ አሁንም ስትራቴጂካዊ የንግድ ሚዛንን ማስጠበቋን ትቀጥላለች ብለዋል።

በተጨማሪ ቻይና ከታሪፍ በተጨማሪ ውድ ማዕድናት ወደ አሜሪካ እንዳይላኩ ያስቀመጠችውን እገዳ ጨምሮ ሌሎች ከታሪፍ ውጪ የሆኑ የንግድ እገዳዎችን ታነሳለች ተብሏል።

የጄኔቫው ውይይት በሁለቱ ሃገራት ከፍተኛ አመራሮች መካከል ከትራምፕ ወደ ስልጣን መመለስ በኋላ የተደረገ የመጀመሪያ ውይይት ሲሆን በጊዜያዊነት ቢሆንም ሃገራቱ ከገቡበት የንግድ ጦርነት ፋታ እንዲወስዱ አድርጓል።

ሁለቱ ሃገራት ወደ ንግድ ጦርነቱ ከገቡ በኋላ የ600 ቢሊየን ዶላር የንግድ እንቅስቃሴ መቆሙ ከመነገሩ በተጨማሪ የሁለቱንም ሃገራት ኢኮኖሚ በክፉኛ ተጎድቷል።

ቻይናና አሜሪካ ይህ የመጀመሪያው ንግግር መሆኑን ያስታወቁ ሲሆን በንግድ እና ኢኮኖሚ ጉዳዮች ዙሪያ በቀጣይ በቻይና አሊያም በአሜሪካ ወይም በአማራጭነት በሶስተኛ ሃገር ውይይቶች እንደሚቀጥሉ ተናግረዋል።

የመረጃው ምንጮች ሲኤንኤን እና ሮይተርስ ናቸው።

__The United States and China have agreed to reduce tariffs on their products.

The two giant economies have repeatedly been at loggerheads over retaliatory tariffs, and after talks in Geneva, they agreed to reduce their tariffs by 115%.

The United States has reduced its 145% tariff on Chinese goods to 30%, while China has reduced its 125% tariff on American goods to 10%.

The new tariff cuts will remain in effect for the next 90 days.

US Treasury Secretary Scott Besant said the tariffs were not what both countries wanted and that the countries wanted to trade together.

Besant said the new agreement would not address tariffs on certain sectors, and that the United States would continue to tighten its strategic trade balance on pharmaceuticals, semiconductors and steel.

In addition to tariffs, China is also expected to lift other non-tariff trade restrictions, including a ban on the export of precious metals to the United States.

The Geneva talks were the first high-level talks between the two countries since Trump took office, and they helped the two countries temporarily ease their trade war.

The two countries have been locked in a trade war that has cost them $600 billion in trade and has hit both economies hard.

China and the United States have said this is their first round of talks and that they will continue to hold talks on trade and economic issues in China, the United States or, alternatively, in a third country.

The sources of the information are CNN and Reuters.

ከሚያዝያ 14/2017 ዓ.ም ጀምሮ ሲከናወን የቆየው የቅድመ-ምረቃ ፕሮግራሞች የዩኒቨርሲቲ መውጫ ፈተና ዳግም ተፈታኞች ምዝገባ ነገ ግንቦት 05 ቀን 2017 ዓ.ም እንደሚጠናቀቅ ይጠበቃል፡፡

እስካሁን ድረስ ምዝገባ ያልፈጸሙ ተማሪዎች የመመዝገቢያው አድራሻ / ሊንክ https://exam.ethernet.edu.et በአግባቡ እየሰራላቸው እንዳልሆነ በጠቆም የምዝገባ ጊዜው እንዲራዘም ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ በላኩት መልዕክት ጠይቀዋል።

#MoE #AAU #ExitExam

The prestigious Addis Ababa University, in its revised academic calendar released today, Monday, has indicated that the 2017 National Exit Exam, which will be held nationwide in the month of June, will be held from June 2 to June 10, 2017.

It also announced that students will graduate on June 21.

Tikvah Ethiopia has been able to verify the accuracy of the academic calendar released by the institution with the university’s management. “Everything is correct except for the last date of July 2. The last date will be July 8,” said a management official.

Although Addis Ababa University, in its calendar released today, has indicated that the exit exam will be held from June 2 to June 10, 2017, the Ministry of Education has not yet officially announced the date of the exam.

On the other hand, regarding the re-examination of the candidates who will take the exit exam, the Ministry of Education told Tikvah Ethiopia, “We are currently reviewing the registration status of the candidates who will take the exit exam again.” 

It also indicated that the candidates who will take the exit exam again will take the exam together with those who will take the exam for the first time. 

The registration of the re-examination of the university exit exam for undergraduate programs, which has been underway since April 14, 2017, is expected to end tomorrow, May 5, 2017. 

Students who have not registered yet have requested that the registration address / link https://exam.ethernet.edu.et is not working properly for them, and have sent a message to Tikvah Ethiopia to extend the registration period. 

We will follow up if the Ministry of Education reviews and announces anything new regarding the registration. 

In addition, Jigjiga University Exit Exam Center retakers whose results were declared "cancelled due to disciplinary reasons" must register to retake the exam.

__በደብረ ማርቆስ ዩንቨርስቲ በህግ ትምህርት ክፍል መምህር የነበሩት አቶ ታዘባቸው ሙላት " ባልታወቁ ሰዎች  ማንኩሳ ከተማ ላይ ተገድለዋል " ሲል ዩንቨርስቲው ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ገለጸ።

ስማቸው እንዳይጠቀስ የፈለጉ አንድ የደብረ ማርቆስ ዩንቨርስቲ አመራር " በዩንቨርስቲው የህግ መምህር የነበሩት አቶ ታዘባቸው ሙላት ሚያዚያ 29/2017ዓ.ም ለሊት በማንኩሳ ከተማ ማንነታቸው ባልታወቁ ሰዎች ተገድለዋል። ሚያዝያ 30/2017 ዓ.ም ወደ ቤተሰቦቻቸው ዱሩቤቴ ከተማ አስከሬናቸው ተልኮ ስርዓት ቀብራቸው ተፈጽሟል " ሲሉ ገልጸዋል።

አቶ ታዘባቸው ከደብረ ማርቆስ ዩንቨርስቲ ወደ ቡሬ ካምፖስ የማታ ተማሪዎችን እየተመላለሱ እንደሚያስተምሩ የገለፁት አመራሩ " በእለቱ ወደ ቡሬ የሄዱት ለማስተማር ወይም ለግል ጉዳያቸው ይሁን የሚታወቅ ነገር የለም " ብለዋል 

በሌላ በኩል የሟች ጓደኞች እና የስራ ባልደረቦች እንደሆኑ የገለጹ ግለሰቦች ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ በላኩት የፁሁፉ መልዕክት " ከሚሰራበት ደብረ ማርቆስ ዮንቨርሲቲ ተጨማሪ ኮርስ ለመስጠት የዩንቨርሲቲው ሌላው ካምፓስ ወደ ሆነው ወደ ቡሬ ካምፓስ ሲሄድ ማንኩሳ ካለፉ በኋላ ተኩስ ስለነበረ ወደ ማንኩሳ ተመልሶ አልጋ ይዞ ባደረበት ሌሊት ታጣቂዎች  አስወጥተው ገድለውታል " ብለዋል።

ከግድያው ጋር በተያያዘ ዝርዝር መረጃ ከመስጠት የተቆጠቡት የተቋሙ አመራር " ጉዳዩ በፖሊስ ምርመራ እየተደረገበት በመሆኑ ዝርዝር መረጃ መስጠት ምርመራውን ሊያደናቅፍ ይችላል " በማለት ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ገልፀዋል።

አቶ ታዘባቸው ሙላት በደብረ ማርቆ ዩንቨርስቲ በህግ ትምህርት በ2010 ዓ.ም ከተመረቁ በኃላ ከ2011 ዓ.ም ጅምሮ ህወታቸው እስካለፈበት ድረስ በዩንቨርስቲው ሲያስተምሩ መቆየታቸውን እኝሁ የዩኒቨርሲቲው አመራር ገልፀው።

የመምህሩ ጓደኞችና ባልደረቦች አቶ ታዘባቸው ሙላት ጠንካራ ሰራተኛ ፣ ባስተማራቸው ተማሪዎች እና በመምህራን በአጠቃላይ በግቢው ማህበረሰብ ዘንድ የሚወደድ ትሁት መምህር እንደነበር ተናግረው ገና በ30 ዓመት እድሜው ተገድሎ መሞቱ እጅግ መሪር ሀዘን ውስጥ እንደጣላቸው ተናግረዋል።

__Ato Tazebachew Mulat, a law lecturer at Debre Markos University, was “murdered by unknown persons in Mankusa town,” the university told Tikvah Ethiopia.

A Debre Markos University official, who asked not to be named, said, “Ato Tazebachew Mulat, a law lecturer at the university, was murdered by unknown persons in Mankusa town on the night of April 29, 2017. His body was sent to his family in Durubete town on April 30, 2017, and his funeral was held.”

Ato Tazebechew, who stated that he was teaching students from Debre Markos University to Bure Campus, said, "It is not known whether he went to Bure that day to teach or for his personal matters." 

On the other hand, individuals who identified themselves as friends and colleagues of the deceased sent a text message to Tikvah Ethiopia, saying, "He was on his way from Debre Markos University, where he worked, to Bure Campus to give an additional course. After passing through Mankusa, there was shooting. He returned to Mankusa and spent the night in bed. Gunmen took him out and killed him." 

The institution's management, who declined to provide details regarding the murder, told Tikvah Ethiopia, "Since the matter is under investigation by the police, providing details may hinder the investigation." 

Ato Tazebachew Mulat graduated from Debre Marko University in 2010 with a degree in law and continued to teach at the university until his death in 2011, the university's management said.

Friends and colleagues of the teacher said that Ato Tazebachew Mulat was a hard worker, a humble teacher who was loved by the students he taught and the teachers in general, and that he was deeply saddened by his death at the age of 30.

The Education Assessment and Testing Service has announced that 608,000 students will take the national exam for the 12th grade this year.

It is expected that 608,000 students will sit for the national exam, which will be held from June 23 to July 8, 2017.

The exam will be given on paper and online.

Students who will take the exam on paper will be fully enrolled in universities, as in previous years.

Those who will take the exam online will be tested at:
- Universities, 
- Public and private schools, 
- Health and teacher training colleges, 
- Technical and vocational colleges. Students will take the exam from their homes without having to stay in the campus.

The online exam will be conducted in two rounds, the Educational Assessment and Testing Service (EATS) told FMC in a statement.

message:
**" ጎቶሌ"  በቡርጂ ብሔረሰብ የሴቶች  የደቦ ሥራ !

****✊****" አንዲት እማወራ በወር የማትጨርሰዉን አረም በ'ጎቶሌ' በአንድ ቀን እንጨርሳለን " - የቡርጂ ብሔረሰብ ሴቶች**

**(ቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ በቡርጂ)**

" ጎቶሌ " በቡርጂ ብሔረሰብ ዘንድ ትልቅ ትርጉም የሚሰጠዉ ሰዎች በጋራ በመሆን የአንድን ግለሰብ የስራ ጫና ያለምን ክፍያ በነፃ የሚጋሩበት ባህላዊ የመረዳዳት ስርአት ነዉ።

በብሔረሰቡ የሴቶች " ጎቶሌ " ደግሞ ሴቶች በቡድን በመሆን በተለይም ለአርሶ አደሩ እጅግ ፈታኝ የሆነዉን የአረም ስራ በልዩ ልዩ ባህላዊ ዜማዎች እና መሞጋገሶች የሚከዉኑበት ድንቅ የስራ እሴት ነዉ።

**የጎቶሌዉ አባላት እነማናቸዉ ?**

የሴቶች ጎቶሌ አባላት በተቀራራቢ የዕድሜ ክልል ዉስጥ ያሉ የአንድ መንደር ሴቶች ናቸው። እኚህ ሴቶችም አንዳች መስፈርት አዝመራ በአረም መወረር ሲጀምር በመሰባሰብ ይመካከራሉ።

ከ6 እስከ 15 ሴቶች በአንድ ቡድን የሚካተቱ ሲሆን በተፈጥሯዊ ሁኔታም ሆነ በሌሎች ምክንያቶች የአቅም ውሱንነት ያላቸዉ ከብርቱዎቹ ጋር እየተሰባጠሩ በየዓመቱ የሚቀያየር የቡድን መጠሪያ ስያሜ ያወጣሉ።

በማስከተልም የቡድን መሪ (ላላዶ) እና ቃል አቀባይ (ሀወይሴ) በመምረጥ አስቀድመዉ እንደ ማሟሟቂያ የአቅመደካማ አዛዉንቶችና የመበለቶችን ማሳ ያለምንም ክፍያ በነፃ ያርማሉ።

ቀጥሎም የቡድኑ " ጎቶሌ"ዉ አባላት ቤተሰቦችን ማሳ በፍላጎት አልያም በዕጣ ቅደም ተከተል የማረም ስራ ይሰራሉ።

**የቡድን መሪዋ እና ቃል አቀባይዋ ተግባር ምንድነው ?**

የቡድን መሪዋ " ላላዶዋ " ከቡድኑ አባላት ቀልጣፋና ተናጋሪ ስትሆን ልክ እንደ ቃሉ ትርጉም (ላላዶ-አነፍናፊ) በማነፍነፍ የስራ ጥራት፣ ቅደም ተከተልና አጠቃላይ ሂደቱን የመምራት ስራ ትሰራለች። ባለማሳዉ ወገን ምግብና መጠጥ በሰዓቱ እንዲያቀርቡም ታስደርጋለች።

" ሀወይሴ " ወይንም ቃል አቀባይዋ ደግሞ አባላቱን ገና በማለዳ በልዩ የኮድ ጥሪ ለስራ የማሰባሰብ እና የሰዓት ቁጥጥሩን እንዲሁም ቡድኑን የማጫወት የማሳሳቅ ስራን ታከናዉናለች። ልዩ ልዩ አነቃቂ ዜማዎችንም በመጫወት ጠንካሮችን የመሞጋገስና ደከም ያሉትን በመዉቀስ እንዲበረቱ የሚያደርጉ ባለሙያዎችን የመጋበዝ ስራም ትሰራለች።

**የቡድኑ አባላት የሚገኛኙት እንዴት ነዉ ?**

ገና በማለዳ ሀወይሴዋ ማዕከል በሆነ ቦታ ላይ በመሆን የቡድኑ አባላት ብቻ በሚያቁት ኮድ ድምጿን ከፍ አድርጋ ትጣራለች። አባላቱም ወዲያዉ ይሰባሰቡና በዓመቱ በወጣላቸዉ መጠሪያ ስያሜ እያዜሙ ወደ ማሳ ያቀናሉ።

**ስያሜዉ ለምን በየዓመቱ ይቀያየራል ?**

የቡድኑ ስያሜ በአከባቢው በዓመቱ ከተስተዋሉ በጎ በጎ ክስተቶች፣ የብሔረሰቡ የስራ ወቅት ስያሜዎችና አንዳንዴም በመሪዋ ስም ሊሰየም የሚችል ሲሆን በየዓመቱ የሚቀያየረዉም ሁኔቶች ስለሚቀያየሩ ነዉ።

**የቡድኑ ቆይታ እስከ መቼ ነዉ?**

ቡድኑ የአረም ወቅት እስኪጠናቀቅ የሚቀጥል ሲሆን በዚያዉ መጠሪያ ዳግም በአጨዳና ምርት የመሰብሰብ ወቅት ይገናኛል።

ቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ በአከባቢዉ ተገኝቶ ይህን መረጃ ባዘጋጀበት ወቅት " ላቴ " እና " ጦልንዴ " የተሰኙ ሁለት የሴቶች ጎቶሌ ቡድኖችን የተመለከተ ሲሆን ትርጉማቸዉም " ልማት " እና " ኮከብ " የሚል እንደሆነ ከአባላቱ ተረድቷል።

ቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ይህን ጠንካራ የመረዳዳት እሴት በተመለከተበት ወቅት ያነጋገራቸው የቡድኑ አባላትም ፥ አንዲት እማ ወራ ብቻዋን ብትሆን በወራት ልትጨርሰዉ የማትችለዉን አረም በአንድ ቀን እንደሚጨርሱና " ሴት በዛ ጎመን ጠነዛ " የሚባለው አባባል ፍፁም ስህተት እንደሆነ በአደባባይ የሚታይበት እንደሆነ ተናግረዋል።

**"Gotole" is a traditional work of the Burji ethnic group!

****✊**** "We finish the weeds that a woman cannot finish in a month with 'Gotole' in one day" - Burji ethnic group women**

**(Tikvah Ethiopia in Burji)**

"Gotole" is a traditional system of mutual assistance that gives great meaning to the Burji ethnic group, where people come together to share the burden of one individual without any payment.

In the ethnic group, women's "Gotole" is also a wonderful work value where women work together as a group, especially for farmers, to perform the most challenging weeding work with various traditional songs and chants.

**Who are the members of the Gotole?**

The members of the women's Gotole are women of a similar age group from the same village. These women also gather and consult when a certain crop is infested with weeds.

From 6 to 15 women are included in a group, and those who are limited in capacity due to natural or other reasons are grouped with the stronger ones and they come up with a group name that changes every year.

Then, by choosing a group leader (Lalado) and a spokesperson (Haweise), they first prepare the fields of the widows and the widows for free as a supplement.

Next, the "Gotole" members of the group work on preparing the fields of the families according to their wishes or by lot.

**What is the role of the group leader and spokesperson?**

The group leader "Lalado" is the most efficient and talkative of the group members, and works as a sniffer (Lalado-sniffer) to manage the quality of work, order and the overall process. She also ensures that the non-sniffer side serves food and drinks on time.

"Haweise" or the spokesperson also gathers the members early in the morning with a special code call for work and keeps track of the time and the group's activities. She also plays various inspiring songs to encourage the strong and to encourage the weak and to invite experts to strengthen them.

**How ​​do the members of the group meet?**

Early in the morning, the Haweise calls out a code that only the members of the group can understand. The members immediately gather and start singing the names of the year that they have chosen for themselves and head to the field.

**Why does the name change every year?**

The name of the group can be based on the good events observed in the area during the year, the names of the working season of the ethnic group, and sometimes the name of the leader, and it changes every year because the circumstances change.

**How ​​long will the group last?**

The group will continue until the end of the weeding season and will meet again during the harvest and harvest season under the same name.

During the time Tikvah Ethiopia was in the area to prepare this information, it observed two women's Gotole groups called "Latte" and "Tolunde", which mean "development" and "star" respectively.

When Tikvah Ethiopia spoke to members of the group about this strong value of solidarity, they said that they can finish weeds in one day that a single mother would not be able to finish in months, and that the saying "a woman can do that cabbage" is completely wrong.

__**“ ትላንት ‘ለምርመራ ትፈለጋለህ’ ተብሎ እንደተደወለለት አሳውቆን ነበር። ዛሬ ግን ከቤቱ ወስደው እንዳሰሩት ነው ቤተሰቦች ደውለው ያሳወቁን ” - ማኀበሩ
**
የኢትዮጵያ ጤና ባለሙያዎች ማኅበር  ፕሬዜዳንት የሆኑት አቶ ዮናታን ዳኛው “ በጸጥታ ኃይሎች ” ተወስደው ዛሬ መታሰራቸውን ማኀበሩ ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ተናገረ።

አቶ ዮናታን በጸጥታ ኃይሎች ከቤታቸው የተወሰዱት ዛሬ መሆኑን የገለጸው ማኅበሩ “  በአስቸኳይ እንዲፈቱ ”  ሲል አሳስቧል።

“ የማኀበርን ፕሬዝዳንትና ሌሎች አመራሮችን በማሰርና በማገላታት ‘እርቦኛል’ ብሎ አደባባይ የወጣን የኢትዮጵያ ጤና ባለሙያዎች ጥያቄ ማፈን አይቻልም፣ ፕሬዝዳንቱን በአፋጣኝ በመፍታት የጤና ባለሙያዎችን ጥያቄ በአፋጣኝ መመለስ እንዳለበት ማህበሩ ያምናል ” ሲል አክሏል።

አቶ ዮናታን ዛሬ እንደተወሰዱ የገለጸው ማኀበሩ “ ከዛ በፊት ትላንት ‘ለምርመራ ትፈለጋለህ’ ተብሎ እንደተደወለለት አሳውቆ ነበር ዛሬ ግን ከቤቱ ወስደው እንዳሰሩት ነው ቤተሰቦች ደውለው ያሳወቁን ” ብሏል።

“ ጥያቄው አጠቃላይ የጤና ባለሙያ ሆኖ ሳለ ጥያቄው በውይይት እንዲፈታ ያሳሰቡ ግለሰቦችን ማፈን ተገቢ ነውን ? ነገ እኛም ምን እንደምንሆን አይታወቅምና መልክታችን ይህ ነው ” ሲል ገልጿል።__
__
“ ፕሬዝዳንቱ የታሰረው ለግል ጉዳዩ አደለምና ማህበሩን በመወከል ከፍተኛ ድምፅ እየሆነ ለነበረው ፕሬዝዳንት አጋርነታችሁን አሳዩ ”  ያለው የጤና ባለሙያዎች ማኅበሩ “ ሌሎች ጤና ባለሙያዎች ግለሰቦችን ማፈን የናንተን  ረሃብ አያስቀረውምና ፍትሃዊ ጥያቄያችሁን ከፖለቲካ በጸዳ መልኩ እንድትቀጥሉ አበረታታለው ” ብሏል።

“ በቅዱስ ጳውሎስ፤ አርባምንጭ፣ ወላይታ ሶዶ እና ሌሎች የተለያዬ አከባቢዎች ጤና ባለሙያዎች አፈናና ማዋከብ እየደረሰባቸው እንደሆነ እየሰማን ነው ” ሲልም ማኅበሩ ተናግሯል።

The association told Tikvah Ethiopia that Ato Yonatan, the president of the Ethiopian Health Professionals Association, was taken “by security forces” and arrested today.

“The arrest and detention of the president and other leaders of the association cannot silence the demands of Ethiopian health professionals who have come out in the streets saying ‘I am hungry,’ and the association believes that the demands of health professionals should be answered immediately by releasing the president,” he added.

The association, which said that Ato Yonatan was taken away today, said, “Before that, he had been called yesterday saying ‘you are wanted for investigation’, but today, the family called and informed us that he was taken from his home and arrested.”

“When the issue is a general health professional, is it appropriate to arrest individuals who have urged that the issue be resolved through dialogue? We do not know what will happen to us tomorrow, so this is our message,” he said. __
__
“The president was not arrested for his personal issues, and show your solidarity with the president who was becoming a loud voice on behalf of the association,” the health professionals association said, “I encourage you to continue your just demands in a manner free from politics because arresting other health professionals will not end your hunger.”

“We are hearing that health professionals in St. Paul, Arbaminch, Wolayta Sodo and other different areas are being subjected to kidnapping and harassment,” the association said.

Ethiopian health professionals have submitted 12 questions they have “remained unanswered” to the Ministry of Health in the past few weeks, stating that they are waiting for a response, and that if they do not receive a response, they will take further action.

In a statement given to us a few days ago, the Ethiopian Health Professionals Association stated that the health professionals’ question is a question of bread and urged those who are trying to change it, take it in their desired direction, and seek political gain to refrain from their actions.

It called on the government to listen to and answer the rights questions raised by professionals, saying that their questions do not have any political agenda; and those who are trying to gain political gain by pretending that the matter is theirs to sit down.

**"I had no other choice because I was not only the hospital's but also the only specialist in the area, so I had no other choice" - The Doctor Who Saved a Life by Interrupting His Own Wedding**

Dr. Brook Weisha, a specialist at the Bele Primary Hospital in the Wolaita Zone of the Southern Ethiopian Region, is receiving praise from many after he interrupted his own wedding and saved a life by performing a surgery.

Tikvah Ethiopia caught up with Dr. Brook and spoke to him about the incident.

Dr. Brook was at a wedding in Wolaita Sodo town yesterday when he received a call from the hospital telling him that there was a patient who needed urgent surgery and that the patient did not have the financial means to make a referral.

When he heard this, he said that he flew to the hospital.

"There were family members who strictly forbade me from going out on my wedding day," said Dr. Brooke. "But since I was the only specialist not only for the hospital but also for Bela and its surroundings, I was present at the hospital and successfully performed the surgery."

"The illness was urgent and required urgent surgery, so I performed my professional duties properly along with other specialists," he told Tikvah Ethiopia.

Dr. Brooke Woisha said that the patient is currently in stable condition and added, "If the patient's life had been lost because of me, I would have regretted it for the rest of my life."

Bela City Administration is a city located about 40 kilometers from Wolayta Sodo town on the Dawro Jima line.

**" የተሽከርካሪ ታርጋ አይፈታም ክልክል ነው ፤ ደንቡም ላይ ተቀምጧል " - የመንገድ ደኅንነት እና መድን ፈንድ **

➡️** " ተሳፋሪን ለማውረድ ክልክል የነበሩ ቦታዎች እየተፈቀዱ ነው ተጨማሪ ቦታዎችም እየታዩ ቅሬታ የሚነሳባቸው ቦታዎች ላይ ከሚመለከታቸው አካላት ጋር እየተነጋገርን ነው ! " 
**
ከነሐሴ 13 ቀን 2016 ዓም ጀምሮ በስራ ላይ የዋለው " የመንገድ ትራንስፖርት ትራፊክ መቆጣጠሪያ ደንብ ቁጥር 557/2016 " ተግባራዊ ከሆነ ስምንት ወራት ተሻግሯል። 

ነባሩ ደንብን በመተካት ተሻሽሎ የወጣው ደንብ የጥፋት እርከንን በሦስት በመክፈል የትራፊክ ቅጣቱንም ከ500 ብር እስከ 1,500 ብር ከፍ አድርጓል። 

ደንቡ የከተማ የፍጥነት ወሰንን በ 50 ኪሜ በሰዓት ከመወሰኑ በተጨማሪ ፣ የራዳር መቆጣጠሪያ የሚያውኩ መሳሪያዎችን ይዞ መንቀሳቀስን ይከለክላል። 

በተጨማሪም አደጋ አድርሰው በአደጋው ህይወታቸው ያለፈ አሽከርካሪዎች የአደጋውን ምክንያት ለመመርመር ህይወታቸው ካለፈ በኋላም የደም ናሙና እንዲወሰድ የሚፈቅዱ አዳዲስ ጉዳዮችን አካቷል። 

ደንቡ ተግባራዊ ከሆነ ጀምሮ " የቅጣት ገንዘቡ የተጋነነ ነው " የሚሉ ቅሬታዎችን ጨምሮ " ያለ አግባብ እየተቀጣን ነው " የሚሉ ቅሬታዎች በአሽከርካሪዎች ዘንድ ይሰማል። 

ቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ደንቡ ተግባራዊ ከሆነ ጀምሮ ውጤታማነቱ ተገምግሟል ወይ ? ስለሚነሱት ቅሬታዎችን ምን ምላሽ አላቹ ? ሲል የሚመለከተውን አካል ጠይቋል። 

**__የመንገድ ደኅንነት እና መድን ፈንድ ህግ ትግበራ ዴስክ ሃላፊ ወ/ሮ ብርክቲ ባህሩ ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ምን አሉ ? __**

__" ደንቡ ከወጣ ጊዜ ጀምሮ ሁሉም ክልሎች እንዲደርሳቸው ተደርጓል ከደረሳቸውም በኋላ የማስተዋወቅ እና ምን ምን ተሻሻለ የሚለውን ነገር የማሳወቅ ስራ ሰርተናል። 

ጀምረዋል አልጀመሩም የሚለውን አንድ ዙር ተገምግሟል አብዛኛው ክልል ጀምሯል ማለት ይቻላል አጀማመራቸው እኩል ባይሆንም። 

' ቅጣቱ ተጋኗል ' የሚል ቅሬታ በሚመለከት ከዚህ በፊት የነበረው ቅጣት አስተማሪ አልነበረም በጣም አነስተኛ ነበር። 

ዋናው አላማችን አደጋን መቀነስ ነው ቅጣቶቹ የተቀመጡት ከአደጋ አንጻር ነው። 

ቢያንስ ግንዛቤ እየኖረው ነው ' ቅጣቱ ይሄን ያህል ነው ' የማለት የመጠንቀቅ ነገር አለ ለውጥ አለ። 

ደረጃ አንድ፣ ሁለት ፣ ሦስት እና ልዩ ጥፋት እርከን ተብሎ ነው የተቀመጠው። 

አሽከርካሪዎች ደጋግመው ሊያጠፏቸው ይችላሉ የተባሉትን ጥፋቶች ከመጠናቸውም አንጻር ታይቶ በአንደኛ ደረጃ የጥፋት እርከን ነው የተቀመጡት። 

ሁለተኛ እና ሦስተኛ ደረጃ ላይ የተቀመጡት ከበድ ያለ አደጋ ሊያደርሱ ይችላሉ ተብለው የተለዩ ጥፋቶች ናቸው ቅጣታቸውም 1,500 ብር ነው። 

' ተጋኗል ' የሚል ካለ የማያጠፋን አይመለከትውም ቅጣት የሚመለከተው አጥፊውን ብቻ ነው። 

ስፒድ ሊሚተር የሚገጠምላቸው አሽከርካሪዎች አሉ ይህንን ሲፒድ ሊሚተር በትክክል እንዳያሳይ የሚያበላሽ አለ እንደዚህ አይነት ቴክኖሎጂዎችን የሚያሰናክሉ ካሉ የገጠሙት ነገር ይወረሳል ፣በወንጀልም ይጠየቃሉ ቅጣትም አለው። 

ይህን አይነቱን ጥፋት የሚያጠፉ አሽከርካሪዎች እንዳሉ ከዚህ ቀደም በተሰሩ ጥናቶች በመታወቁ በደንቡ ላይ እንዲካተቱ ሆኗል። 

ከዚህ ቀደም በነበረው ድንብ ላይ ጠጥቶ ወይም አደንዛዥ እጽ ተጠቅሞ አደጋ ያደረሰ እና ህይወቱ ያለፈ አሽከርካሪ ላይ ጠጥቶ ይሁን አይሁን ለማረጋገጥ የሚቻልበት መንገድ አያስቀምጥም ነበር። 

በአሁኑ ደንብ አሽከርካሪው በህይወት ባይኖርም የደም ናሙና እንዲወሰድ ይፈቅዳል አተገባበሩ ላይ መመሪያ እየተዘጋጀ ነው። 

ተሳፋሪን ለማውረድ ክልክል የነበሩ ቦታዎች እየተፈቀዱ ነው ተጨማሪ ቦታዎችም እየታዩ ቅሬታ የሚነሳባቸው ቦታዎች ላይ ከሚመለከታቸው አካላት ጋር እየተነጋገርን ነው። 

ህጉ ገና መውጣቱ ነው ረዥም ጊዜው አይደለም መሬት ላይ ያለው ሁኔታ ምን ላይ ነው ያለው ? የሚለውን ከሁሉም ክፍል የተወጣጣ ቡድን በስራ ላይ ነው። 

ከዚህ ቀደም አሽከርካሪዎች ተደጋጋሚ ጥፋት ስለሚያጠፉ የትራፊክ ፖሊሶች ታርጋ ይፈቱ ነበር መንጃ ፈቃድም ይወስዱ ነበር። 

አሁን ላይ የአዲስ አበባ ትራፊክ ማኔጅመንት ይህንን የሚያስቀር መተግበሪያ አበልጽጓል። 

ከዚህ በኋላ ሰሌዳ መፍታትም ሆነ መንጃ ፈቃድ መውሰድ ሳያስፈልግ አሽከርካሪን የሚቀጣበት አሰራር ነው። 

ከዚህ በኋላ ታርጋ አይፈታም ክልክል ነው ደንቡም ላይ ተቀምጧል። 

ሲስተሙ ይፋ ተደርጓል ወደ ተግባር እየገቡበት ነው ተሞክሮው ተወስዶ ወደ ክልሎችም የማስተዋወቅ ስራ ይሰራል።

በህጉ መሰረት እንደማይፈቀድ ሁሉም ግንዛቤ እስከሚኖረው ድረስ ጊዜ ይጠይቃል ነገር ግን ታርጋ መፍታት አይፈቀድም " ብለዋል።
__
ከዚህ ቀደም " የተሽከርካሪን ሰሌዳን መፍታት ክልክል ነው " የሚለው ህግ በተጨባጭ ለምን ተግባራዊ አልሆነም ? የሚል ጥያቄ ቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ለአዲስ አበባ ትራፊክ ማኔጅመንት ባለሥልጣን አቶ ክበበው ሚደቅሳ አቀርቦላቸው ነበር። 

አቶ ክበበው " ሰሌዳ ቁጥሩ የሚፈታበት አጋጣሚ ይኖራል፣ እሱም የሚሆነው የቅጣት እግድ የደረሱ ከሆነ፣  መንጃ ፍቃዳቸው ላይ ያለው ስልክ ቁጥራቸው የማይሰራ ወይም የክፍለ ሀገር ከሆነ ይፈታል፣ ምክንያቱም አስገዳጅ ምክንያቶች ስለሆኑ በሂደት ግን የሁሉም ሰው አንዳይፈታ እናደርጋለን " ሲሉ መልሰው ነበር።

**" It is prohibited to remove the license plate of a vehicle; the regulation is in place " - Road Safety and Insurance Fund **

➡️** " Places that were prohibited from dropping off passengers are being allowed, and additional places are being seen, and we are talking to the relevant parties about the areas where complaints are raised! " 
**
The " Road Transport Traffic Control Regulation No. 557/2016 ", which came into effect on August 13, 2016, has been in effect for eight months. 

The revised regulation, replacing the existing regulation, has increased the level of violations by three and increased the traffic fine from 500 birr to 1,500 birr. 

In addition to setting the city speed limit at 50 km/h, the regulation prohibits driving with devices that interfere with radar control. 

It also includes new provisions that allow blood samples to be taken after the death of drivers who have caused accidents to investigate the cause of the accident. 

Since the implementation of the regulation, complaints have been heard from drivers, including complaints that "the fine is excessive" and "we are being punished unfairly." 

Tikvah Ethiopia has asked the relevant body whether the effectiveness of the regulation has been evaluated since it was implemented? What is the response to the complaints raised? 

**__What did Ms. Birkti Bahru, Head of the Road Safety and Insurance Fund Law Enforcement Desk, tell Tikvah Ethiopia? __**

__" Since the regulation was issued, all regions have been notified, and after it was received, we have done a job of promoting and informing them of the improvements. 

A round of evaluation was conducted to determine whether they have started or not, although most regions have started, although their start is not uniform. 

Regarding the complaint that 'the penalty is too high', the previous penalty was not educational, it was very small. 

Our main goal is to reduce accidents. The penalties are set according to the risk. 

At least there is an awareness that there is a change in the cautionary attitude of saying 'the penalty is this much'. 

It is set as level one, two, three and special offense levels. 

The offenses that drivers are likely to commit repeatedly are considered as level one offenses based on their severity. 

Those placed at level two and three are offenses that are considered to be serious and their penalty is 1,500 birr.

If there is a 'drunk', it does not apply to those who do not drive, the penalty only applies to the violator. 

There are drivers who are equipped with speed limiters, but there are those who tamper with this speed limiter so that it does not display correctly. If there are those who tamper with such technologies, the equipment they have installed will be confiscated, and they will be held criminally liable for punishment. 

It has been known from previous studies that there are drivers who violate this type of law, and it has been included in the law. 

In the past, there was no way to determine whether a driver who caused an accident while drunk or under the influence of drugs and died was drunk or not. 

The current law allows a blood sample to be taken even if the driver is not alive, and guidelines are being prepared for its implementation. 

Places that were previously prohibited from dropping off passengers are being allowed, and additional places are being added, and we are talking to the relevant parties about places where complaints are raised. 

The law has not yet been issued, it is not long What is the situation on the ground? A team from all departments is working on it. 

Previously, traffic police would remove license plates and take away driver's licenses because drivers repeatedly committed violations. 

Now, the Addis Ababa Traffic Management has developed an application that eliminates this. 

From now on, there will be a system where drivers will be fined without having to remove license plates or take a driver's license. 

From now on, it is prohibited to remove license plates, and the rules have been set. 

The system has been announced and is being implemented, the experience has been taken and the work of introducing it to the regions will be done. 

It will take time until everyone understands that it is not allowed according to the law, but removing license plates is not allowed, " he said. 

__
Previously, Tikvah Ethiopia had asked Addis Ababa Traffic Management Authority Ato Kbebew Mideksa why the law that "removing vehicle license plates is prohibited" was not implemented in practice.

Ato Kbebew replied, "There will be a chance that the license plate number will be released, which will happen if they have been convicted of a crime, if the phone number on their driver's license is not working or if it is from another country, it will be released, because there are compelling reasons, but in the process we will not release it for everyone."

#ትግራይ

የህወሓት ሊቀ-መንበር ደብረፅዮን ገ/ሚካኤል (ዶ/ር) የድርጅታቸው ልሳን ከሆነው ወይን ሚድያ ጋር ቃለመጠይቅ አድርገው ነበር።

የሊቀ-መንበሩ የትኩረት ነጥቦች ፦
- የፓርቲው የውስጥ  ጉዳይ ፣ 
- የፕሪቶሪያ የሰላም ስምምነት አተገባበር
- የምርጫ ቦርድ ምዝገባና እውቅና መመለስና ያለመመለስ ፣ 
- እሳቸው የሚመሩት ህወሓት ከኤርትራ መንግስትና ከሌሎች ሃይሎች ይገናኛል ተብሎ ስለሚከሰስበት ጉዳይ የተመለከቱ ናቸው።
**
የፓርቲው የውስጥ ጉዳይ በሚመለከት ምን አሉ ? **

የሚመሩት የህወሓት ክንፍ 14ኛ ጉባኤውን ካካሄደ በኃለ ባለፉት 8 ወራት ሰፋፊ የአመራርና የህዝብ ስብሰባዎች ማካሄዱን ገልጸዋል።

በሰብሰባዎቹ ውጤት ፤ " ከድርጅቱ መርህና ውስጠ ደንብ አፈንግጠዋል እንዲሁም የፓርቲው ሸክም ነው " የሚሉትን በአቶ ጌታቸው ረዳ የሚመራ በርካታ የማእከላዊ ኮሚቴ የያዘ ሃይል ከፓርቲው አመራርና ከጊዚያዊ አስተዳደሩ የስልጣን እርከን ማበረራቸው እንደ ትልቅ ስኬት ጠቅሰውታል።

በአቶ ጌታቸው ረዳ እየተመራ " ከህወሓት አፈንግጧል " የተባለው ቡድን ከጊዚያዊ አስተዳደሩና የፓርቲ ሃላፊነት ቢነሳም በክልሉ ደቡባዊ ዞን የቀረ ቅሪት አመራር እንዳለና በዞኑ ያለው የአቶ ጌታቸው  ቅሪት አመራርን ከቦታው ለማንሳት የእሳቸው ክንፍ የሆነው ህወሓት በቅርቡ ወስኖ ወደ ተግባር እንደሚገባ ሲናገሩ ተደምጠዋል።

" የአቶ ጌታቸው ቅሪት " ተብለው የተገለጹት በዚህ ዞን ያሉ አመራሮች የጊዜያዊ አስተዳደሩ ካቢኔ ደብረፅዮን (ዶ/ር) ለሚመሩት ህወሓት የሚያደላ ነው፤ አቃፊ አይደለም በማለት ተቃውመዋል። ዞኑም ሙሉ በሙሉ አንደማይቀበለው አሳውቋል።
**
የፕሪቶሪያ የሰላም ስምምነትና አተገባበሩ  በሚመለከት ምን አሉ ? 
**
ደብረፅዮን (ዶ/ር) " ጥቅምት 2013 ዓ.ም በተቀሰቀሰው ጦርነት ምክንያት የተፈናቀሉ ወገኖች በርካታ በውስጥ ፤ የማይናቅ ቁጥር ያላቸው ደግሞ በሱዳን በስደት ይገኛሉ " ብለዋል።

" እነዚህ በውስጥና በውጭ የሚኖሩ ተፈናቃዮች ጥቅምት 2015 ዓ.ም የፕሪቶሪያ ስምምነት ከተፈረመ ወዲህ የፌደራል መንግስት የገባው ውል ባለመፈፀሙ ምክንያት ወደ ሞቀው ቤታቸው ሳይመለሱ አምስተኛ ዓመታቸው ይዘዋል " ሲሉ ወቅሰዋል።

" በአሁኑ ወቅት እንደ አሜሪካ መንግስት የመሰሉ ባደረጉት የፓሊሲ ለውጥ የእርዳታ አቅርቦት በመሳሳቱ ምክንያት ተፈናቃዮች ካለፉት ዓመታት በባሰ ሁኔታ ህልውናቸው ጥያቄ ውስጥ ገብቷል " ብለው " አምስተኛ ክረምት ከቤታቸው ውጭ በመጠለያ ጣብያ ማሳለፍ የለባቸውም የሚል አቋም ይዘናል " ሲሉ ገልጸዋል።

" ስለሆነም ያሉንን አቅሞች አሟጠን ተጠቅመን ግዛታዊ  አንድነታችን እንዲከበር ተፈናቃዮች ወደ ቄያቸው እንዲመለሱ እንሰራለን " ብለዋል። 

**የምርጫ ቦርድ ምዝገባና እውቅና መመለስና ያለመመለስ ጉዳይ የሚመለከት ? **

" የምርጫ ቦርድ ህጋዊ እውቅና መስጠት መንሳትና የፕሪቶሪያ የሰላም ስምምነት የተለያዩ ናቸው " ሲሉ ተደምጠዋል።

" ምርጫ ቦርድ ህወሓት ጥር 2013 ዓ.ም ነው ከፓርቲዎች ምዝገባ የሰረዘው ። ከዛ ጊዜ ጀምሮ እስከ አሁን የህወሓት ህጋዊነት አልተመለሰም እንደተሰረዘ ነው። የተመለሰ የህወሓት ህጋዊነት የለም። ይባስ ብሎ ህወሓት መጋቢት 2013 ዓ/ም ላይ በፓርላማ አሸባሪ ተብሎ ተፈርጇል " ብለዋል።

" ስለሆነም አሁን የሚደረግ አዲስ ምዝገባና ስረዛ የለም። እኛ ሙሉ በሙሉ ህጋዊነታችን አልተመለሰም ነው የምንለው " ሲሉ ገልጸዋል።

" ቦርዱ አሁን እያነሳው ያለው ነሀሴ 2016 ዓ.ም ስለሰጠው ጊዜያዊ አዲስ ምዝገባ ነው። የነሀሴው ምዝገባ ሙሉ በሙሉ ውድቅ አድርገነዋል። እኛ እየጠየቅን ያለነው እውቅናና ህጋዊነት የ50 ዓመቱ ህወሓትን ነው " ሲሉ ተናግረዋል። 

" ስለሆነ ቦርዱ ' ግንቦት 5 ቀን 2017 ዓ.ም እሰርዛለሁ ' የሚለው የነሀሴ 2016 ዓ.ም ምዝገባ ነው። መሰረዝ ይችላል ምክንያቱ በምርጫ ቦርድ ምዝገባ የሚፀና ህወሓት የለምና " ብለዋል።

" ህወሓትና የፌደራል መንግስት በፕሪቶሪያ የሰላም ስምምነት እውቅና ተሰጣጥተዋል። ስለዚህ የምርጫ ቦርድ ዛቻና ማስፈራሪያ ለኛ ቀልድ ነው። ህወሓት ቢሰረዝም ባይሰረዝም የፕሪቶሪያ የሰላም ስምምነት ባለቤት መሆኑ የሚያስቀር አይደለም " ሲሉ ተናግረዋል።

**እሳቸው የሚመሩት ህወሓት አንጃ " ከኤርትራ መንግስትና ከሌሎች ሃይሎች ይገናኛል " ተብሎ ስለሚከሰስበት ጉዳይ ምን አሉ ?**

ደብረፅዮን (ዶ/ር) " አቋማችን ግልፅ አድርገናል ከማንኛውም አካል ሰላም እንፈልጋለን። እኛ ፍላጎታችን የሰላም ሃይል መሆን ነው። ለሰላም እንሰራለን። ለዚሁ ማሳያ እንዲሆን ከፌደራል መንግስት በገባነው የሰላም ስምምነት መሰረት ተኩስ ማቆም ተችሏል። ተነፃፃሪ ሰላም ሰፍኗል " ብለዋል።

" ጎረቤቶቻችን ክልል ይሁን አገር  ጦርነቱ የደገፉ አሉ። አማራና ዓፋር ክልሎች እንዲሁም ኤርትራ ጦርነቱ ደገፍው አጥቅተውናል። እነዚህ ጎሮቤቶቻችን ናቸው። ከነዚህ ሁሉ ሰላም እንፈልጋለን። ከኤርትራና ሱዳን ጭምር ሰላም እንፈልጋለን። የተፈናቀለው ህዝብ ወደ ቄዬው እንዲመለሰ ፤ የወደመው መሰረተ ልማት እንዲያንሰራራ ሰላም እንሻለን " ሲሉ ተደምጠዋል።

" ስለሆነም ከሁሉም ጋራ ለሰላም እንሰራለን ማለታችን መንቀሳቀሳችን እንደ ክፋት መታየት የለበትም። ኢትዮጵያና ኤርትራ ወደ ግጭት እንዲገቡ አንደግፍም " ሲሉ አክለዋል።

ሊቀመንበሩ የተጠየቁትን ጥያቄ በግልጽ በቀጥታ ሳይሆን በተዘዋዋሪ መልሰው አልፈዋል።

በሌላ በኩል ... 

ከደብረፅዮን (ዶ ር) ህወሓት ቃለ ምልልስ ጎን ለጎን የጊዚያዊ አስተዳደሩ ፕሬዜዳንት ታደሰ ወረደ (ሌ/ጀነራል) ወደ ክልሉ ደቡባዊ ዞን የመጀመሪቸው የሆነ ይፋዊ ጉብኝት እንዳደረጉ ተነግሯል።

የጉብኝታቸው ዋናው ማጠንጠኛ የዞኑ አመራሮች በተቋቋመው አዲሱ ጊዚያዊ አስተዳደር ላይ ያለው የሳሳ አሳታፊነትና አቃፊነት የተመለከት ሰፊ ልዩነት ማጥበብ እንደሆነ ከአከባቢው የተገኙ መረጃዎች ያመለክታሉ።

የፕሬዜዳንቱ ጉብኝት ከተነገረና የደብረፅዮን (ዶ/ር) ቃለ ምልልስን ተከትሎ የጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ የምስራቅ አፍሪካ ጉዳዮች አማካሪ ሚንስትር አቶ ጌታቸው ረዳ በማህበራዊ የትስስር ገፃቸው " ' ምዕራብ ትግራይ ነፃ እንዳናወጣ እነ እገሌ እንቅፋት ሆኖውብናል ' ሲሉ የነበሩ ደንቆሮዎች ፤ አሁን ' ደቡባዊ ትግራይ ነፃ እናወጣለን ' ወደ ሚል ዘመቻና ፉከራ ተሸጋግረዋል። ለመረዳት የሚከብድ ነው " ሲሉ ኃይለ ቃል ተጠቅመው ሃሳባቸውን ገልጸዋል።

#Tigray

TPLF Chairman Debretsion Gebre Michael (Dr.) gave an interview to Wine Media, the official media outlet of his organization.

The Chairman’s focus points were:
- Internal affairs of the party, 
- Implementation of the Pretoria Peace Agreement
- Return and non-return of registration and recognition of the Electoral Board, 
- The issue of the TPLF he leads being accused of having links with the Eritrean government and other forces.
**
What did he say about the internal affairs of the party? **

He stated that the TPLF wing he leads has held extensive leadership and public meetings in the past 8 months since its 14th congress.

As a result of the meetings; "They have deviated from the principles and internal regulations of the organization and are a burden to the party," they said, referring to the removal of a large number of central committee members led by Ato Getachew Reda from the party leadership and the interim administration as a great success.

The group called "Effected from TPLF" led by Ato Getachew Reda has been heard saying that although there is a remnant leadership left in the southern zone of the region, and that his wing, TPLF, will soon take action to remove the remnant leadership of Ato Getachew in the zone.

The leaders in this zone, who were described as "Ato Getachew's remnants", have protested that the interim administration cabinet is biased towards the TPLF led by Debretsion (PhD), and is not a replacement. The zone has also announced that it will not accept it at all.
**
What do you think about the Pretoria Peace Agreement and its implementation? 
**
Debretsion (Dr.) said, "Many of the displaced people who were displaced due to the war that broke out in October 2013 are internally displaced, and a significant number are in exile in Sudan."

"These internally displaced people and those living abroad have not returned to their warm homes for the fifth year since the Pretoria Agreement was signed in October 2015 due to the failure of the federal government to fulfill its promise," he said.

"Currently, due to the policy changes made by the US government and the failure to provide aid, the lives of the displaced are in question in worse conditions than in previous years," he said, adding, "We are of the opinion that they should not spend the fifth winter in shelters outside their homes."

"Therefore, we will use our available resources to ensure that the displaced people return to their homes so that our territorial integrity is respected," he said. 

**What is the issue of the Electoral Board's registration and recognition and non-return? **

"The Electoral Board's legal recognition and the Pretoria Peace Agreement are different," he said.

"The Electoral Board deregistered the TPLF from the party list in January 2013. Since then, the TPLF's legitimacy has not been restored, it has been revoked. The TPLF's legitimacy has not been restored. What's worse, the TPLF was declared a terrorist organization by Parliament in March 2013," he said.

"Therefore, there is no new registration or deregistration now. We say that our legitimacy has not been fully restored," he said.

"What the board is now raising is a temporary new registration given in August 2016. We have completely rejected the August registration. What we are asking for is the recognition and legitimacy of the 50-year-old TPLF," he said. 

"So the board's 'I will cancel it on May 5, 2017' is the August 2016 registration. It can be canceled because there is no TPLF registered by the Electoral Board," he said.

"The TPLF and the federal government were recognized by the Pretoria Peace Agreement. Therefore, the threats and intimidation of the Electoral Board are a joke to us. Whether the TPLF is canceled or not, it is not a matter of changing the fact that it is a party to the Pretoria Peace Agreement," he said.

**What do you have to say about the accusation that the TPLF faction he leads is "connected with the Eritrean government and other forces"?**

Debretsion (PhD) said, "We have made our position clear. We want peace from all parties. Our desire is to be a force for peace. We will work for peace. As a demonstration of this, a ceasefire has been reached in accordance with the peace agreement we signed with the federal government. Comparative peace has prevailed."

"Our neighbors, whether they are regions or countries, have supported the war. The Amhara and Afar regions, as well as Eritrea, have supported the war. These are our enemies. We want peace from all of them. We want peace from Eritrea and Sudan as well. We want peace for the displaced people to return to their homes; we want peace for the destroyed infrastructure to be rebuilt."

"Therefore, our actions, saying that we will work for peace with everyone, should not be seen as evil. We do not support Ethiopia and Eritrea entering into conflict," he added.

The chairman did not directly answer the question asked, but indirectly.

On the other hand ... 

Alongside the Debretsion (Dr.) TPLF interview, it was reported that the interim administration's president, Tadesse Werede (Lt. General), made his first official visit to the southern zone of the region.

The main focus of his visit is to narrow the wide gap between the leaders of the zone and the new interim administration that has been established.

Following the announcement of the President's visit and the interview with Debretsion (Dr.), the Prime Minister's Advisor on East African Affairs, Ato Getachew Reda, expressed his views on his social media account, saying, "Those fools who used to say 'We will not liberate Western Tigray' have become an obstacle to us; now they have shifted to a campaign and bragging that 'We will liberate Southern Tigray.' It is difficult to understand."

**" ለመጨረሻ ጊዜ ደዉሎልኝ ' ምግቡ ስላልተስማማኝ መጥተህ ዉሰደኝ ' ብሎ ነበር " - ወላጅ አባት**

የዲላ ዩኒቨርሲቲ ሪሚዲያል ተማሪ የሆነዉ ለሚ አደም እስማኤል ከሚማርበት ዩኒቨርሲቲ ከጠፋ አንድ ሳምንት ማለፉን ወላጅ አባቱ ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ተናግረዋል።

" በ25/08/17 ዓ/ም ደዉሎልኝ ' ምግብ እየተስማማኝ ባለመሆኑ አልተመቸኝም መጥተህ ዉሰደኝ ' ብሎኝ ነበር " ያሉት ወላጅ አባቱ " ዐርብ በዚህ ልክ አዉርተን እኔ ቅዳሜ ወደ ዲላ እየመጣሁ ባለኩበት ጓደኞቹ ደዉለዉ መጥፋቱን ነገሩኝ " ሲሉ ገልፀዋል።

" አንድ ሳምንት ሙሉ ለዲላ ዩኒቨርሲቲና ለዲላ ከተማ ፖሊስ አሳዉቀን፣ የአፋልጉኝ ማስታወቂያም ለጥፈን ብናፈላልግም እስካሁን ልናገኘው አልቻልንም " ብለዋል።

ወላጅ አባቱ አሁንም ዲላ ሆነዉ ልጃቸውን እያፈላለጉ መሆናቸዉን ገልፀዋል።

" በዩኒቨርሲቲው ሚዲያ የአፋልጉኝ ማስታወቂያ እንዲለቀቅ ደጋግመን ብንጠይቅም ተፈፃሚ አልሆነም " ሲሉም አክለዋል።

ቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ያነጋገራቸው የዶርም ጓደኞቹም " በዕለቱ ዓርብ ምሽት ላይ ' እኔ ዶርም ልሁን ብሎ'ን እኛ ላይብረሪ ቆይተን ከምሽቱ አራት ሰዓት አከባቢ ስንመለስ ዶርም አጣነዉ " ብለዋል።

" ደጋግመን ብንደዉልም ስልኩ ዝግ ስለነበር ተነጋግረን ጠዋት ካጣነዉ ለቤተሰብ እንደዉላለን በማለት በማግስቱ ጠዋት ለአባቱ ደዉለን አሳወቅናቸዉ " ሲሉ ተናግረዋል።

" ተማሪዉ ከግቢ ወጪ የመዉጣት ፍፁም ልምድ የለዉም " የሚሉት ጓደኞቹ ' የተለየ ባህሪ ስለሌለው ወዲያዉ ግቢ ዉስጥ እናገኘዋለን ብለን የነበረ ቢሆንም ከጠፋ አንድ ሳምንት ሆነዉ " ሲሉ ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ገልጸዋል።

ቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ከዲላ ዩኒቨርሲቲ በጉዳዩ ዙሪያ መረጃ ለማግኘት ያደረገዉ ሙከራ አልተሳካም።

**"The last time he called me, he said, 'I don't like the food, come and get me'" - Father**

A week has passed since Dilla University remedial student, Lam Adam Ismail, went missing from his university, his father told Tikvah Ethiopia.

"On 25/08/17, he called me, 'I don't like the food, come and get me,'" his father said. "It was about this time on Friday, and I was coming to Dilla on Saturday when his friends called me and told me that he was missing."

"We informed Dilla University and Dilla City Police for a whole week, and we even posted a missing persons notice, but we haven't been able to find him yet," he said.

His father said that they are still searching for their son in Dilla.

"We repeatedly asked the university media to release Afgalgun's announcement, but it was not implemented," he added.

His dorm friends, who were interviewed by Tikvah Ethiopia, also said, "On Friday night, we stayed in the library and said, 'Let me be the dormitory'. When we returned around 4 pm, we lost the dormitory."

"We called him repeatedly, but the phone was switched off, so we called his father the next morning and informed him that we would return him to his family in the morning."

"The student has absolutely no experience of leaving the campus," his friends told Tikvah Ethiopia, "We thought we would find him on campus immediately because he has no special behavior, but it has been a week since he disappeared."

Tikvah Ethiopia's attempts to get information about the case from Dilla University were unsuccessful.

#መሶብ

" **__መሶብ የአንድ ማዕከል አገልግሎት በቀጣይ 6 ወራት በሁሉም ክልሎች ይጀመራል__** !! "

መንግስት በቅርቡ ' መሶብ ' የተሰኘ የአንድ ማዕከል አገልግሎት መስጫን ወደ ሥራ ማስገባቱ ይታወሳል። ይኽ ማዕከል በተለይም 117 ዓመታት በቆየው የሲቪል ሰርቪስ አገልግሎት አሰጣጥ ላይ አዲስ ነገር ያሳያል ተብሏል።

የጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ጽ/ቤት ኃላፊና የካቢኔ ጉዳዮች ሚኒስትር ወ/ሮ አለምፀሐይ ጳውሎስ ይህ ማዕከል ሲቪል ሰርቪስ ውስጥ ላለው ከፍተኛ ችግር እንደ መፍትሔ የቀረበ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።

**ይህ ማዕከል ምን ይዟል ?**

በዚህ የአንድ ማዕከል አገልግሎት 12 ተቋማት እና 41 የፌደራል አገልግሎቶች የተካተቱ ሲሆን ክፍያን ጨምሮ ሙሉ ለሙሉ ከወረቀት ነጻ፤ የዲጂታል አገልግሎት ይሰጥበታል።

ለማቋቋም 3 ወራትን ፈጅቷል በተባለው ማዕከል አሁን ላይ በፌደራል ደረጃ በዲጂታል ከሚሰጡ ከ800 በላይ አገልግሎቶች መካከል 41 አገልግሎቶችን ለይቶ ወደ ሥራ ገብቷል። በቅርቡ ተጨማሪ 11 አገልግሎቶች ወደዚሁ ሥርዓት እንደሚገቡ ተገልጿል።

**የአንድ ማዕከል አገልግሎት በክልሎች መቼ ይጀመራል ?**

መሶብ የአንድ ማዕከል አገልግሎት በቀጣይ 6 ወራት በሁሉም ክልሎች እንዲጀመር አቅጣጫ  ተቀምጧል ተብሏል።

በተጨማሪም በአዲስ አበባ በሁሉም ወረዳዎች ይህ ማዕከል እንደሚቋቋም ሲገለጽ በቀጣይ ዓመታት አገልግሎቱን ለማስፋት እቅድ ተይዟል።

**የሰራተኞች ቅጥር በምን መልኩ ነው የተፈጸመው ?**

የሰራተኞችን ቅጥር በተመለከተ አዲስ ቅጥር አለመፈጸሙን የተናገሩት የጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ጽ/ቤት ኃላፊና የካቢኔ ጉዳዮች ሚኒስትር ወ/ሮ አለምፀሐይ ከሁሉም ተቋማት ለተወጣጡ ሰራተኞች ፈተና በመስጠት ምልመላ መደረጉን አስረድተዋል።

" የሚሰጠውን አገልግሎት ተፈትኖ 50 በመቶ ማሳለፍ ያልቻለ ተቋም አለ " ሲሉ የገለጹ ሲሆን ይህም ሲቪል ሰርቪሱ ያለበትን በሽታ ያመላከተ ነው ብለዋል።

ከዚህ በተጨማሪ በዚህ ተቋም ቴክኖሎጂን መጠቀም የሚችሉ ወጣት ሰራተኞች የብሔር ተዋጾን በጠበቀ መልኩ ተመልምለውና በቂ ስልጠና ተሰጥቷቸው ወደ ሥራ መግባታቸውን ተናግረዋል።

**ይህ ማዕከል ሲቪል ሰርቪሱ ያለበትን ችግር የሚቀርፍ ምን የተለየ ነገር ይዟል ?**

የሲቪል ሰርቪስ የኢትዮጵያ ሲቪል ሰርቪስ ኮሚሽነር መኩሪያ ኃይሌ (ዶ/ር) ተቋማቱ በማዕከሉ አገልግሎት የሚሰጡት በአዋጅ የተሰጣቸው ስልጣን እንደተጠበቀ ሆኖ እንደሆነ አመልክተዋል።

ሰራተኞቹ በሚሰሩበት ወቅት የተሻለ አፈጻጸም ካላቸው ማበረታቻ የሚያገኙበት ደካማ አፈጻጸም ያላቸውም ደግሞ እንዲሁ ተገምግሞ ቅጣት የሚጣልበት አሰራር መኖሩንም ገልጸዋል።

በተቋሙ የሚሰጠው አገልግሎት ሙሉ ለሙሉ በዲጂታል መንገድ ሲሆን የአገልግሎት አሰጣጥ ልኬት (Standard) ወጥቶለት እያንዳንዱ አገልግሎት የሚፈጀው ጊዜ ተሰልቶ የተቀመጠ መሆኑም አመላክተዋል።

የሰራተኞቹም ሆነ የተቋሞቹ አፈጻጸም በዚህ የሚለካ ሲሆን ምን ያህል ደንበኞች በምን ያህል ጊዜ እንደተስተናገዱ እና የተገልጋዮች ቅሬታ ጭምር በዲጂታል አሰራር የሚቀርብበት እንዲሁም ጥብቅ ቁጥጥር ያለበት በመሆኑ ሙስናን ለመከላከል እና የአገልግሎት አሰጣጥ ጥራትን ለማሳደግ ተስፋ እንደተጣለበት ተናግረዋል።

**ምን አይነት ቴክኖሎጂ ይጠቀማል ?**

የተቋማት አገልግሎቶችን ለማስተሳሰር በአርቴፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ ኢኒስቲትዩት የበለጸገ appach apiSix- Gatway ቴክኖሎጂን የሚጠቀም ሥርዓት መዘርጋቱንና ለዚህም በውጭ አልሚዎች ተጠይቆ የነበረውን 1 ሚሊዮን ዶላር ማዳን የተቻለበት ነው ተብሏል።

" **__Mesob One-Stop Service to be launched in all regions in the next 6 months__** !! "

It is worth noting that the government recently launched a one-stop service called 'Mesob'. This center is said to be a new feature in the delivery of civil service services, which has been in place for 117 years.

The Head of the Prime Minister's Office and Minister of Cabinet Affairs, Ms. Alemetsehay Paulos, stated that this center is a solution to a major problem in the civil service.

**What does this center include?**

This one-stop service includes 12 institutions and 41 federal services, and it provides completely paperless, digital services, including payment.

The center, which took 3 months to establish, has now launched 41 services out of more than 800 services provided digitally at the federal level. It was announced that 11 more services will be added to this system soon.

**When will the one-center service be launched in the regions?**

It is said that the direction has been set for the one-center service to be launched in all regions in the next 6 months.

It was also announced that this center will be established in all districts in Addis Ababa, and plans have been made to expand the service in the coming years.

**How ​​was the recruitment of employees carried out?**

The Head of the Prime Minister's Office and Minister of Cabinet Affairs, Ms. Alemetsehay, who said that no new recruitment was carried out regarding the recruitment of employees, explained that the recruitment was carried out by giving tests to employees from all institutions.

"There is an institution that has not been able to pass the test of the service provided and pass 50 percent," she said, indicating the disease of the civil service.

In addition, she said that young employees who can use technology in this institution have been recruited in a manner that respects the ethnic heritage and have been given sufficient training and have started working.

**What is unique about this center that solves the problems facing the civil service?**

The Ethiopian Civil Service Commissioner, Mekuria Haile (Dr.), indicated that the institutions provide services at the center while maintaining the authority granted to them by the proclamation.

He also explained that there is a system where employees who perform better during their work are encouraged and those who perform poorly are also evaluated and punished.

He also indicated that the services provided by the institution are completely digital and a service delivery standard has been established and the time taken for each service has been calculated.

He said that the performance of both the employees and the institutions is measured by this, and how many customers are served and how long they are served, and that customer complaints are also submitted digitally and are strictly monitored, so it is hoped to prevent corruption and improve the quality of service delivery.

**What kind of technology does it use?**

It is said that a system using the advanced appach apiSix-Gatway technology developed by the Artificial Intelligence Institute has been developed to connect the services of institutions, and it has been possible to save 1 million dollars that was requested by foreign developers.

The service provision is monitored by more than 100 cameras installed at the center, and there is a monitoring room (Situation Room) prepared for this purpose.

**At the center** **How ​​do we know what services we can get?**

Currently, 41 services are provided by 12 institutions at the center, and citizens can access these services on the website (https://mesobcenter.et/service-catalogue/ ) or by calling the short phone number 9838.

Through this website, users can see and understand what they need before coming, how much time and payment are required. After arriving at the center, they can queue up using digital ticketing. 

**Who are the 12 institutions that are providing 41 services in one place?**

1. National Identification Service
2. Immigration and Citizenship Service
3. Document Verification and Registration Service
4. Ministry of Revenue
5. Ministry of Trade and Regional Integration
6. Ministry of Employment and Skills
7. Ethiopian Investment Commission
8. Ministry of Foreign Affairs
9. Education Assessment and Examination Service
10. Ethio Post
11. Commercial Bank of Ethiopia
12. Ethio Telecom.

**Where is the Mesob One Center Service located?**

The Mesob One Center Service is located in the Imperial Gerji area of ​​Addis Ababa.

Tikvah Ethiopia
Addis Ababa

" የወረዳዉ ፋይናንስ ጽ/ቤትም ሆነ የዞኑ ፋይናስ መምሪያ የካሽ እጥረት ለክፍያዉ መዘግየት ዋነኛ ችግር መሆኑን ገልፀዉልናል " የሚሉት አቶ አሌቶ " በተቻለ መጠን ለጤናዉ ዘርፍ ቅድሚያ እንዲሰጥ ደጋግመን ጠይቀናል "  ብለዋል።

**"We are paid in 2 and 3 monthly installments and have not received overtime pay for the past 3 years" - Health Professionals **

Health professionals working in the Konso Zone of the Southern Ethiopian Region, Kena Woreda, told Tikvah Ethiopia that their regular monthly salary is paid in 2 and 3 monthly installments and that they have not been paid for the overtime they worked outside of their regular working hours for 3 years.

They said that they have not received payment for the overtime work they do at night, on weekends, and during holidays since 2014.

As a result, employees are not working properly and are not happy, which is why they are not providing proper services to the community, the professionals told Tikvah Ethiopia.

**What did Kena Woreda Health Office Head Ato Aleto Assefa say?**

Ato Aleto Assefa confirmed to Tikvah Ethiopia that salaries have been delayed and overtime pay has not been paid in full since 2014.

He also spoke about how this is having a negative impact on the medical work in many ways.

"Both the Woreda Finance Office and the Zonal Finance Department have told us that the cash shortage is the main problem behind the delay in payments," said Ato Aleto. "We have repeatedly asked them to prioritize the health sector as much as possible."

**What did Kena Woreda Finance Office Head Ato Geremu Gebno say? 
**
Tikvah Ethiopia spoke to Ato Geremu Gebno about the issue; the main reason for the cash shortage is low internal revenue collection.

They said that they are not being paid just because there is no cash, but that the arrears will be paid.

ፓሊስ ወንጀለኛውን ያይንሸት ገብረዋህድ ይዞ በእናቲቱ ላይ የፈፀመውን ድርጊት አጣርቶ በፍርድ ቤት ግድያ ሙከራ ክስ ይመሰርትበታል።

በኃላም በዋስ ይለቀቅና ጉዳዩንም ከውጭ ሆኖ መከታተል ይጀምሯል።

ይህ በእንዲህ እያለ ብቸኛ ምስክር ትሆናለች ብሎ ያሰባትን እናቲቱ ከሌላ የወለደቻትን የ14 ዓመቷን ልጃገረድ ከጓደኛው ጋር በመሆን አታልለው ወደ ገደላማ ቦታ በመውሰድ በቡድን ደፍረው ሲያበቁ ወደ ገደል ወርውረው በግፍ ገድለዋታል።

የተፈጸመው የወንጀል ተግባር ውስብስብ ያለና ማስረጃ ለማጥፋትና ለመሰወር ሆን ተብሎ መሰራቱ  የማጣራት ሂደቱ የተወሳሰበና ዘለግ ያለ ጊዜ እንዲወሰድ ምክንያት ሆኗል።

የዞኑ ማእከላይ ፍ/ቤት ወንጀለኞቹ  በኢ/ፌ/ዲ/ሪ የወንጀል ህግ አንቀፅ 539 (1) (ሐ) መሰረት በዕድሜ ልክ እስራት መቅጣቱ አስታውቀዋል። 

መረጃው ከድምፂ ወያነ ቴሌቪዥን የተወሰደ ነው።

The perpetrators who brutally raped and murdered a 14-year-old girl have been sentenced to life imprisonment.

The horrific crime took place in Adi Erar village, Lemlem Kebele Gebre Association, Tsimbla Woreda, North West Zone, Tigray Region, on September 25, 2016.

Yainshet Gebrewahed Imeha, a 35-year-old man, is a native of the area.

He is angry with the mother of his child, who makes a living by selling alcohol and is no longer with him, saying, "I asked you to spend the night with me, but you refused."

The person deliberately planned and prepared to take out his anger by sneaking into the bedroom of the house where she lives and hiding under the bed.

The mother, who had finished her work and was sleeping peacefully, came out of her hiding place at 5 am and was repeatedly beaten by the police, but she survived.

The police arrested the criminal, Yainshet Gebrewahed, and investigated the act against the mother and filed a case of attempted murder in court.

He was later released on bail and began to monitor the case from abroad.

Meanwhile, the mother, who thought she would be the only witness, lured her 14-year-old daughter, whom she had given birth to, to a cliff with her friend, and when they finished, they threw her off the cliff and brutally killed her.

The crime committed was complex and the deliberate destruction and concealment of evidence made the investigation process complicated and time-consuming.

The Zonal Central Court has sentenced the accused to life imprisonment under Article 539 (1) (c) of the Federal Criminal Code.

The information is taken from Demtsi Weyane Television.

#OROMIA : በኦሮሚያ ክልል ምሥራቅ ቦረና ዞን፣ ጉሚ ኤልደሎ ወረዳ 13 የመንግሥት ሠራተኞችን ጨምሮ 18 ሰዎች በታጣቂዎች ታግተዋል።

የጉሚ ኤልዳሎ ወረዳ ምክትል አስተዳዳሪ አቶ ዶዮ ዲባ " ታጣቂዎቹ ሐሙስ ረፋድ 3 ሰዓት አካባቢ ከነገሌ ቦረና ወደ ጉሚ ኤልዳሎ በመኪና ሲጓዙ የነበሩ ሰላማዊ ሰዎችን በማስወረድ አግተዋቸዋል ፤ አጋቾቹ የሸኔ ታጣቂዎች ናቸው " ሲሉ ለቢቢሲ አፋን ኦሮሞ ገልጸዋል።

ከታገቱት መካከል 13ቱ የመንግሥት ሠራተኞች ፤ ቀሪዎቹ ደግሞ የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች እንደሆኑ ተናግረዋል።

" ይኸው ኃይል ከዚህ በፊትም የማሸበር ተግባር ሲፈፅም ቆይቷል። አሁን ደግሞ እገታን የገቢ ምንጭ በማድረግ ሰዎችን ወደ ጫካ እየወሰደ ከቤተሰቦቻቸው ገንዘብ በመጠየቅ ላይ ነው " ብለዋል።

ከታገቱት የመንግሥት ሠራተኞች 11ዱ የወረዳው ን ሁለቱ ደግሞ ከመንገድ እና ሎጂስቲክስ የዞን ፅ/ቤት ለድጋፍ ሥራ እመጡ እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል።

" ከመካከላቸው አንድም የመንግሥት ሹመኛ የለም ፤ መንግሥት በአጋቾቹ ላይ እርምጃ ይወስዳል " ሲሉ ገልጸዋል።

በዚህ አካባቢ ላይ የታጣቂዎች እግታ ሲፈጸም ይህ የመጀመሪያ እንዳልሆነና በተደጋጋሚ ጊዜ የእገታ ወንጀሎች እንደሚፈጸም ጠቁመዋል።

" ታጣቂዎቹ ከዚህ በፊትም የመንግሥት ሠራተኛን፣ ነዋሪዎችን አፍነው በመውሰድ የማስለቀቂያ ገንዘብ ከቤተሰቦቻቸው ይጠይቃሉ። እነዚህ የታገቱት ሰዎች ምንም ዓይነት የፖለቲካ ተሳትፎ የላቸውም። ለሕዝብ አገልግሎት እና ለግል ጉዳያቸው ሲጓዙ የነበሩ ናቸው " ሲሉ አስታውሰዋል።

ይህ መረጃ ባለቤትነቱ የቢቢሲ አፋን ኦሮሞ ነው።
