__**" The questions being raised by health professionals are relevant and the government should provide an urgent solution" - the association
  ** 
The Ethiopian Health Professionals Association urged the government to provide an urgent response to the questions being raised by health professionals without causing national harm, in a statement sent to Tikvah Ethiopia.

**What is it?
**
"The questions raised by health professionals are relevant and the government should provide an immediate solution.

It is known that the association has submitted the questions raised by health professionals to the highest government agencies of the country, including the Ministry of Health, following the legal procedure. 

However, since the questions raised by health professionals have not been answered in a timely and appropriate manner, they are still asking in various ways.

The association supports the activities of health professionals to protect their rights; it also recognizes them. However, it believes that it should be done in a way that does not harm the country and society.
  
The association strongly requests that the government, instead of ignoring the questions raised by health professionals, give them the appropriate space and response before the issue causes problems for the country," he said.

The health professionals stated that they will be forced to take legal action if their questions are not answered; what is their final step? Tikvah Ethiopia asked the association.

**What did the association's president, Jonathan the judge, answer?
**
"We believe that the government will carefully consider the situation and set a direction for a solution. But what can happen if they do not provide a solution? It is the health professionals who are doing the work who will decide. 

As an association, we have acknowledged the questions of the health professionals; they are valid questions and we have submitted them to the relevant body to be resolved," he said. 

__
Tikvah Ethiopia has asked the Ministry of Health what it is doing to respond to the questions raised by health professionals and their associations, and a response will be provided when it is received.

" **A driver without a professional qualification certificate cannot drive" - ​​Ministry of Transport and Logistics**

The Ministry of Transport and Logistics announced, "A nationwide professional qualification assessment of drivers will begin this year."

He said that the qualification assessment was necessary because 83 percent of the traffic accidents in the country are related to drivers and vehicles.

Following this, he confirmed that the assessment will begin this year with drivers who are currently working.

Accordingly, it was stated that professional qualification assessments will be given to drivers in levels 1 to 3 for public and dry cargo, as well as for liquid 1 and 2.

It was said that before the professional qualification assessment is given, the drivers will be given professional training.

After the training, they will take a Certificate of Competency (COC) and their driving licenses that pass the test will be recognized internationally, the ministry said.

On the other hand, he said that drivers who do not pass the professional competency assessment test will undergo retraining and re-testing.

He also announced that a driver who does not have a professional competency assessment certificate will not be able to drive.

በአማራ ክልል ባለፉት ዘጠኝ ወራት ብቻ 200 የሚሆኑ እናቶች ከወሊድ ጋር በተገናኘ ምክንያት ህይወታቸው ማለፉን የክልሉ ጤና ቢሮ ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ገልጿል።

" የእኛ ቀጥር የጤና ተቋሞቻችን ብቻ ሪፓርት የሚያደርጉት ነው አሁን ባለው ሁኔታ ማህበረሰቡ ውስጥ ያለው መረጃ እየደረሰን አይደለም።

የሞቱት እናቶች ቁጥሩ ትንሽ ነው ትልቅ ነው አይደለም የእኛ ስጋት፣ ስጋታችን የእናቶች ሞት ሪፖርት እየተደረገ አይደለም በሁለት ምክንያቶች አንደኛው በእኛ መድረስ አለመቻል ሲሆን ሁለተኛው የእናቶችን ሞት ማህበረሰቡ ጋር እየቀነሱ እያቀረቡ ነው። 

እኛ እንደውም አንሷል ባይ ነን ይሄ ብቻ ከሆነ ጥሩ ስራ ሰርተናል። 

ቤተሰብ በህክምና ተቋም መውለድ አለባት ብሎ መወሰን ላይ እየዘገየ ነው፣ ከተነሳችም በኃላ መንገዱ አስቸጋሪ ነው መኪና አይገባበትም። 

አንቡላንስም ድሮ አገልግሎት ይሰጥ ነበር አሁም ሙሉ በሙሉ በሚባል መልኩ ከከተሞች ውጪ በየገጠሩ እና ቀበሌው እየገባ እናቶችን እያመጣ አይደለም።

**"The number of mothers who died is small, not large, our concern; our concern is that maternal deaths are not being reported" - Amhara Regional Health Bureau **

In the past nine months alone, about 200 mothers in the Amhara Regional Health Bureau have died from childbirth-related causes, the regional health bureau told Tikvah Ethiopia. 

The bureau's Director of Maternal, Child and Adolescent Youth Division, Ato Melsew Enyalew, told Tikvah Ethiopia that this number was only recorded by health institutions in the past nine months, and it was not possible to reach the community and understand the depth of the problem. 

**What did Mr. Melsew say in his detailed comments?** 

"Only our health facilities report, and in the current situation, we are not receiving information from the community. 

This number is not easy at a time when we are working to prevent mothers from dying after reaching health facilities. 

The information we have is only what we have registered in our registration system for nine months. 

To compare with last year, since the war started, the number of mothers who gave birth in institutions was small, and the institutions were not submitting complete reports, so taking last year as a comparison does not work for our region. 

This year, despite the crisis, we have learned from last year that mothers and children should be reached, and we are reopening hospitals, health facilities, and health posts that were closed. This year is a little better than last year. 

The number of mothers who died is small, not large. Our concern, our concern is that maternal deaths are not being reported for two reasons, one is that we cannot reach them, and the second is that They are reducing maternal mortality with the community. 

We are actually saying that it has decreased, if only this is enough, we have done a good job. 

The family is delaying the decision to give birth in a medical facility, and after it is removed, the road is difficult and cars cannot enter. 

Ambulances used to provide service, but they are not bringing mothers to the villages and kebeles outside the cities in a complete way. 

This maternal mortality is especially noticeable in the entire Gondar zone, North and West Gojam areas, which have low birth rates in the region, "he said. 

Tikvah Ethiopia

__**“ More than 40 children to return to Ethiopia tomorrow ” - their families
**
More than 40 of the many Ethiopians who were held hostage in Myanmar and who were begging the government to return them to their country, their families told Tikvah Ethiopia that they will return tomorrow, Wednesday.

It is reported that the children who are expected to return tomorrow are from DKBA and BGF camps, and had recently traveled to Myawaddy.

Their families told us that the Ethiopian government covered their transportation costs from Myawaddy to Bangkok, and Ethiopian Airlines and NGOs covered their flight costs for them to Ethiopia tomorrow.

It has also been reported that more than 40 other Ethiopians are expected to return to their country recently.

More than 700 of the many Ethiopians who were held hostage had repeatedly pleaded with the government to return them by fulfilling certain criteria.

Ministry of Foreign Affairs Spokesperson Ambassador Nebiyat Getachew said 20 days ago, “Work is underway to repatriate about 200 Ethiopians from Myanmar in the next 10 days.”

At the time, he noted that about 130 Ethiopians had returned to their country, and indicated that efforts were underway to repatriate about 700 Ethiopians.

የአርባ ምንጭ ዩኒቨርሲቲ የተማሪው ግድያ አረጋግጦ የሀዘን መግለጫ ዛሬ ምሽት አውጥቷል።

" ሕይወቱን ለማትረፍ በአርባ ምንጭ አጠቃላይ ሆስፒታል ከፍተኛ ርብርብ ቢደረግም ሳይሳካ በመቅረቱ ማምሻውን 12:30 ላይ ሕይወቱ አልፋል " ሲል ገልጿል።

**" He was stabbed to death in a dormitory in a horrific manner " - Students

➡️ " Efforts were made to save his life but failed. The attacker has been arrested " - University**

Students of Arba Minch University have announced that a student was stabbed to death in a dormitory.

The university has announced that the attacker is a student and has been arrested.

Students of Arba Minch University's Chamo Campus, who have pledged their allegiance to Tikvah Ethiopia, have stated that a student was stabbed to death in a horrific manner in Block 9, Men's Dormitory, on Chamo Campus this morning.

The students said, "If stabbing is common on this campus, it is over," and urged the university to stop covering up activities on campus to protect its reputation and provide security for the students.

Students are concerned about what is happening and to provide solutions; They also requested that their safety be ensured.

**What does Arba Minch University say?**

Arba Minch University confirmed the student’s death and issued a statement of condolence this evening.

The university said, “Natnael Tsog Assefa, a 2nd year student of the Department of Psychology at the School of Education and Behavioral Sciences, was seriously injured in a personal altercation with his friend this morning, April 28, 2017.”

“Despite intensive efforts to save his life at Arba Minch General Hospital, he passed away at 12:30 pm,” it said.

It also said that the student who committed the attack has been arrested and is undergoing necessary investigations, and promised to follow the legal process and make a decision soon.

**" 102,604 people have been treated for mental illness and related issues in just 9 months " - The hospital__
__**__
__The Emmanuel Mental Specialized Hospital in Le Tikvah Ethiopia announced that it has treated 102,604 people for mental illness and related issues in just nine months.

The hospital stated that 98, 803 of these patients were treated as outpatients.

Also, 1, 421 patients were treated in inpatient psychiatric care, and 2,380 people were treated as emergency psychiatric care.

This is part of the hospital's plan to provide mental illness and related issues services to 124,800 citizens in the first nine months of the 2017 fiscal year, the hospital stated.

Information received by Tikvah Ethiopia indicates that 371 children received psychiatric treatment and 597 received addiction treatment in the past 9 months.

Regarding forensic treatment, it was said that "570 criminal and civil investigators were provided with services in outpatient and inpatient settings."

On the other hand, the hospital reported that the average length of stay at the hospital decreased from 36 days in the 2016 fiscal year to 33 days in the 2017 fiscal year, while the bed occupancy rate was 84%.

እያንዳንዳቸው በቀን ከ40 -60 ሊትር ወተት የመስጠት አቅም ያላቸው 165 የሆላንድና የዴንማርክ ላሞች በኢትዮጵያ አየር መንገድ ካርጎ ተጭነው ትግራይ ክልል መቐለ ከተማ ገብተዋል።

" ላሞቹ ብዙ ሊትር ወተት የመስጠት የተሻለ ዝርያ ያላቸው ናቸው " ያሉ ሲሆን " በቀጣዮቹ የግንቦትና የሰኔ ወራት 435 ተጨማሪ የወተት ላሞች ይገባሉ " ብለዋል።

ባለሃብቱ 600ዎቹ ላሞች ተጠቃልለው ወደ አገር ሲገቡ በቀን ከ24 - 30 ሺህ ሊትር ወተት የመስጠት አቅም እንዳላቸው ገልጸዋል።

ባለሃብቱ በተሰማሩበት የዘመናዊ እርሻ ፣ የላሞች እርባታ የወተትና የወተት ተዋፅኦ ስራ ለ1,100 ወገኖች ጊዚያዊና ቀዋሚ የስራ እድል መፍጠራቸው ጠቅሰዋል።

አሁን ላይ የጀመሩት የፋብሪካ የማስፋፍያ ስራ ሲጠናቀቅ ተጨማሪ 500 ወገኖች ተጠቃሚ ይሆናሉ ብለዋል።

በተሰማሩበት ዘርፍ ኢንቨስት ለማድረግ ካቀዱት 7 ቢሊዮን ብር 5 ቢሊዮኑ ስራ ላይ በማዋል ተግባራዊ  እንቅስቃሴ በማድረግ ላይ እንደሚገኙ ከክልሉ የኢንቨስትመንት ኮሚሽን የተገኘው መረጃ ያሳያል።

ባለሃብቱ ከአውዳሚው ጦርነት በፊት ከሆላንድ የገዙዋቸው የተሻለ ወተት መለገስ የሚችሉ 495 ላሞች ሙሉ በሙሉ የወደሙ ሲሆን በአሁኑ ወውት 500 ሄክታር ዘመናዊ የእርሻ መሬት በማልማት ላይ ይገኛሉ ተብሏል።

**"I have created temporary and permanent jobs for 1,100 people through my modern farming, dairy farming and dairy products business" - Investor**

165 Dutch and Danish cows, each capable of producing 40-60 liters of milk per day, have arrived in Mekelle, Tigray Region, loaded onto Ethiopian Airlines cargo.

Haleka Mogos Nguse, an investor who is involved in hotel and agricultural investments in Raya Azebo, said that he has purchased 600 cows and is importing them into the country in batches.

"The cows are of a better breed that produces more liters of milk," he said, adding that "435 additional dairy cows will be imported in the coming months of May and June."

The investor said that the 600 cows, when brought together, have the capacity to produce 24-30 thousand liters of milk per day.

The investor mentioned that he has created temporary and permanent employment opportunities for 1,100 people in the modern farming, dairy farming and dairy products business he is engaged in.

He said that an additional 500 people will benefit when the factory expansion work they have started is completed.

Information from the Regional Investment Commission shows that they are implementing 5 billion birr of the 7 billion birr they planned to invest in the sector they are engaged in.

The investor said that the 495 cows that could give better milk that they bought from Holland before the devastating war have been completely destroyed and that they are currently developing 500 hectares of modern agricultural land.

Tikvah Ethiopia
Mekelle

**“ ዜጎችን ከጅቡቲ የማስወጣቱ ሒደት መብትና ክብራቸውን በጠበቀ ሁኔታ እንዲፈፀም ክትትል አደርጋለሁ ” - በጅቡቲ የኢ.ፌ.ዲ.ሪ ኤምባሲ**

በጅቡቲ የሚኖሩ ሰነድ አልባ ኢትዮጵያውያን ፍልሰተኞችን ወደ ሀገራቸው የመመለሱ ሒደት ሰብአዊ መብታቸውንና ክብራቸውን በጠበቀ መልኩ እንዲከናወን ክትትል እንደሚያደርግ፣ በጅቡቲ የሚገኘው የኢትዮጵያ ኤምባሲ አስታወቀ፡፡

ኤምባሲው ትናንትና ምሽት፣ ሚያዝያ 27 ቀን 2017 ዓ.ም ባወጣው መግለጫ፣ የጅቡቲ መንግስት ህጋዊ የመኖሪያ ሰነድ ሳይኖራቸው በሀገሪቱ ውስጥ የሚኖሩ የውጭ ሀገር ዜጎች ወደየሀገራቸው እንዲመለሱ ያወጣውን መመሪያ ተከትሎ በርካታ ኢትዮጵያውያን በፈቃዳቸው ወደ ሀገራቸው በመመለስ ላይ እንደሚገኙ ገልጿል።

በውሳኔው አፈፃፀም ሒደትም በኢትዮጵያውያን ፍልሰተኞች ላይ ሊፈጠሩ የሚችሉ ጉዳቶችን ለመቀነስ እንዲቻል ኤምባሲው ከሚመለከታቸው የጅቡቲ መንግስት አካላት ጋር ተከታታይ ውይይቶች እንደተደረጉም አመልክቷል፡፡ 

በውይይቶቹ የጅቡቲ መንግስት ህጋዊ የመኖሪያ ሰነድ ሳይኖራቸው በሀገሪቱ ውስጥ የሚኖሩ ኢትዮጵያውያን መብትና ክብራቸው ተጠብቆ ወደ ሀገራቸው እንዲመለሱ ለማድረግ እንደሚሰራና በመብት ጥሰት ላይ የሚሳተፉ የሀገሪቱ ዜጎች ካሉም በሚቀርብለት መረጃ ላይ በመመስረት እርምጃ ለመውሰድ ዝግጁ መሆኑን አረጋግጧል ይላል የኤምባሲው መግለጫ፡፡ 

ይህ ውሳኔ የጅቡቲ መንግስት እንደ አንድ ሉዓላዊ ሀገር መብቱን ተጠቅሞ ያስተላለፈው ውሳኔ መሆኑን ከግምት በማስገባት በውሳኔው አፈፃፀም ሒደት፣ “ በዜጎቻችን ላይ ሊፈጠሩ የሚችሉ ጉዳቶችን መቀነስ የሚያስችሉ ተግባራትን በማከናወን ላይ እንገኛለን ” ሲልም አክሏል።

ሰነድ አልባ አትዮጵያውያንን ወደ ሀገር ቤት የመመለሱ ሒደት ከአደጋ የፀዳና የዜጎች መብትና ክብርን ያረጋገጠ እንዲሆን ኤምባሲው ጉዳዩ ከሚመለከታቸው የጅቡቲ መንግስት አካላት ጋራ ከመወያየት በተጨማሪ በጅቡቲ ከሚገኙ ልዩ ልዩ የዳያስፖራ አደረጃጀት አመራሮች ጋር ውይይት እያደረገ እንደሚገኝም መግለጫው አብራርቷታ።

ወደ ሀገር ቤት የሚመለሱ ዜጎች የሚያጋጥሟቸው ችግሮችን በተመለከተ በመረጃ ላይ የተመሰረተ ሪፖርት ለማሰባሰብና ለሚመለከተው የጅቡቲ መንግስት አካል በማቅረብ መፍትሔ ለማፈላለግም እየተሰራ እንዳለ ኤምባሲው በመግለጫው አውስቷል፡፡

በመሆኑም የጅቡቲ መንግስት ያስተላለፈውን ውሳኔ ተከትሎ ወደ ሀገር ቤት በመመለስ ላይ የሚገኙ ዜጎች በማንኛውም ሁኔታ ችግር ሲገጥማቸው ለኤምባሲውም ሆነ ለአደረጃጀቶች እንዲያሳውቁ ኤምባሲው አሳስቧል።

ህጋዊ የመኖሪያ ሰነድ ሳይኖራቸው በጅቡቲ የሚኖሩ ዜጎችን ወደ ሀገር ቤት ለመመለስ በጅቡቲ መንግስት የተላለፈው ውሳኔ አፈፃፀም ሒደት የዜጎችን መብትና ክብር ባረጋገጠ ሁኔታ መፈጸሙን የሚከታተል መሆኑንም አረጋግጧል። 

ከጅቡቲ በስልክ ደውለው ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ አስተያየታቸውን ያደረሱ ስደተኞች በበኩላቸው፣ የዚያች ሀገር መንግስት ተጨማሪ ጊዜ እንዲሰጣቸው፣ ንብረታቸውን ሰብስበውና ሸጠው ከሀገር የመውጣት ዕድልም እንዲመቻችላቸው ጥሪያቸውን በማሰማት ላይ ናቸው፡፡ የኢትዮጵያ መንግስትም ቀነገደቡን በማራዘም ረገድ ግፊት እንዲያደርግ በድጋሚ ተማፅነዋል፡፡ የኤምባሲው መግለጫ ግን በዚህ ዙርያ ያለው ነገር የለም፡፡

**“I will monitor the process of deporting citizens from Djibouti to ensure that their rights and dignity are respected” - Ethiopian Embassy in Djibouti**

The Ethiopian Embassy in Djibouti announced that it will monitor the process of repatriating undocumented Ethiopian migrants living in Djibouti to ensure that their human rights and dignity are respected.

In a statement issued last night, April 27, 2017, the embassy stated that many Ethiopians are returning to their country voluntarily following the Djiboutian government’s directive to return foreign nationals living in the country without legal residence documents.

The embassy also indicated that it has held a series of discussions with relevant Djiboutian government bodies to minimize the harm that may be caused to Ethiopian migrants during the implementation of the decision. 

During the discussions, the Djibouti government confirmed that it is committed to ensuring that Ethiopians living in the country without legal residence documents can return to their country with their rights and dignity preserved, and that it is ready to take action based on information provided to it if there are citizens of the country who are involved in human rights violations. 

Considering that this decision was made by the Djibouti government in exercise of its rights as a sovereign state, it added that “we are taking measures to minimize the harm that may be caused to our citizens” during the implementation of the decision. 

The embassy also explained that in addition to discussing the issue with the relevant Djiboutian government bodies, the embassy is also holding discussions with the leaders of various diaspora organizations in Djibouti to ensure that the process of repatriating undocumented Ethiopians is safe and that the rights and dignity of citizens are guaranteed. 

The embassy said in a statement that it is working to collect a data-based report on the problems faced by citizens returning home and to present it to the relevant Djiboutian government body to find solutions.

Therefore, the embassy urged citizens returning home following the decision of the Djiboutian government to inform the embassy and the organizations if they encounter any problems.

It also confirmed that the implementation of the decision of the Djiboutian government to return citizens living in Djibouti without legal residence documents is being monitored in a manner that ensures the rights and dignity of citizens. 

The refugees who called Tikvah Ethiopia from Djibouti to express their views are calling on the government of that country to give them more time, and to provide them with the opportunity to collect and sell their assets and leave the country. They also appealed once again to the Ethiopian government to exert pressure to extend the deadline. The embassy statement, however, has nothing to say about this. 

Tikvah Ethiopia

**የመከላከያ እና የኢሰመኮ ምላሽ ምንድነው ?**

የኢ.ፌ.ዴ.ሪ መከላከያ ሚኒስቴር የህዝብ ግንኙነት ዳይሬክተር ኮረኔል ጌትነት አዳነ ከቀናት በፊት በወቅታዊ የጸጥታ ጉዳይ ላይ ለመከላከያ ቴሌቪዥን በሰጡት መግለጫ ላይ የሰራዊት ምልመላን አስመልክቶ ማብራሪያ ሰጥተዋል።

" የመከላከያ ሰራዊት ህገ-መንግስታዊ ኃላፊነቱን ለመወጣት በተፈጥሮም ሆነ በሰው ሰራሽ ነገር የሚወጣን ሰው ለመተካት እንዲሁም ሚዛን የጠበቀ የኃይል አሰላለፍ ታሳቢ ያደረገ የሰራዊት ዝግጅት ያስፈልጋል " ሲሉ የምልመላ አስፈላጊነትን ጠቅሰዋል።

ኮ/ል ጌትነት፥ " ተቋሙ በሚያወጣው መደበኛ የምልመላ መስፈርት ወጣቶችን ወደ ሰራዊቱ መቀላቀል በየትም ዓለም አቀፋዊ አሰራር ያለ ነው " ሲሉ ገልጸዋል።

ዳይሬክተሩ የምልመላ መስፈርቶች ብለው ካቀረቧቸው በዋናነት ፦
- ህገ-መንግስቱን የተቀበሉ፤
- ዕድሜያቸው ከ18 ዓመት በላይ የሆነ፤
- ሀገራቸውን ለማገልገል ሙሉ ፈቃደኛ የሆኑ፤
- ከማንኛውም ፖለቲካ ድርጅቶች ወገኝተኝነት ነጻ የሆኑ፤
- ስልጠናውን ከወሰዱ በኋላ 7 ዓመት ለማገልገል ውል የሚገቡ፤
- ከወንጀል ነጻ የሆኑ፤
- የሚወጡትን አካላዊ መስፈርቶች የሚያሟሉ የሚሉት በጥቂቱ የሚጠቀሱት ናቸው።

**የምልመላ አሰራሩን በተመለከተ ዳይሬክተሩ ምን አሉ ?**

የምልመላ ሂደቱ በወረዳ እና በቀበሌ ያሉ የፀጥታ እና የመስተዳድር አካላት በኮሚቴ ሆነው የሚያከናውኑት ነው ሲሉ አፈጻጸሙን በተመለከተም ለመከላከያ ሪፖርት የሚቀርብበት መሆኑን አንስተዋል።

ምልመላው የብሔር ሚዛናዊ ተዋጽኦ ያካተተ መሆን ስላለበትም ከብሔራዊ ስታስቲክስ ቢሮ በተወሰደ ቁጥራዊ የክልሎች መረጃ መሰረት መከላከያ ለክልሎች ኮታ እንደሚሰጥ ነው የተናገሩት።

አፈጻጸምን በተመለከተ ኮ/ል ጌትነት " እንደ አቅሙ ነው " በሚል የገለጹ ሲሆን ከወረዳ እና ቀበሌ የተደረገው ምዝገባ እንዲሁ የሚወሰድ ሳይሆን በዞን ደረጃ እንዲሁም ማሰልጠኛ ሲደርሱ የማጣራት ሥራ እንደሚሰራም አንስተዋል።

በዚህም የክልሎች ተወካዮች ባሉበት ቅሬታ ሰሚ ኮሚቴ ተሰይሞ በፈቃዱ መምጣቱን ብቻ ሳይሆን ከተቀነሰም የተቀነስኩበት አግባብ ትክክል አይደለም ብሎ ቅሬታ ማቅረብ እንደሚቻል ነው ያነሱት።

**የኢትዮጵያ ሰብዓዊ መብቶች ኮሚሽን በጉዳዩ ላይ ምን አለ ?**

በየአካባቢው የሚስተዋሉ የወጣቶች አፈሳ ስለመኖሩ ቅሬታ ደርሷቸው እንደሆነ ከሪፖርተር ጋዜጣ ጥያቄ የቀረበላቸው ዋና ኮሚሽነር ብርሃኑ አዴሎ ተከታዩን ምላሽ ሰጥተዋል።

" ክትትሉ አልቆ የወጣ የተጠናቀቀ ዶክመንት የለንም። ሚዲያ ላይ የምንሰማው ነገር ስላለ ይሄን ይዘ [ከቀናት በፊት] ከሀገር ሚኒስቴር ከፍተኛ ባለሞያዎች ጋር ተወያይተናል።

በእነሱ በኩል የምልመላ መስፈርቱ ላይ፤ የምልመላ አካሄዱ ላይ ምንም ችግር የለም ችግር ያለው ምንአልባት ታች አከባቢ የአስተዳደር አካላት ምልመላውን ሲያካሄዱ የሚፈጸሙ ትክክል ያልሆኑ አካሄዶች ካሉ በጋራ ለመስራት ተስማምተን ነው የተለያየነው " ሲሉ ገልጸዋል።__
__
**ኢሰመኮ ይህ ድርጊት ስለመፈጸሙ መረጃው ኖሮት ነው ውይይቱን ያደረገው ?**

ዋና ኮሚሽነሩ በዚህ ጉዳይ ላይ በሰጡት ቃል ኮሚሽኑ ዓለም አቀፍ መስፈርቶችን በመከተል አስገዳጅ ወታደራዊ ምልመላ እየተካሄደ መሆን አለመሆኑን እያጣራ እንደሚገኝ እና ሥራው ሲጠናቀቅ ለህዝብ ይፋ እንደሚያደርግ ገልጸዋል።

በዚህም ኮሚሽኑ ዓለም አቀፍ ስታንደርዱን ጠብቆ የቀረበ ዶክመንት ወይም Standard of Proof ጨርሶ መደምደሚያ ላይ አለመድረሱን ጠቁመው ይህ ሲጠናቀቅ በየአራት ወሩ በሚወጣው ሪፖርት አካተው እንደሚያወጡ ተናግረዋል።

ውይይቱን በተመለከተ ግን ኮሚሽነሩ " ሚዲያ ላይ የምንሰማው ነገር ስላለ እሱን ይዘን ነው ከመከላከያ ሚኒስቴር ባለሞያዎች ጋር የተወያየነው " ሲሉ ውይይቱ በግል ተነሳሽነት ጭምር የተደረገ መሆኑን ጠቁመዋል።

**What is the response of the Ministry of Defense and ISEMCO?**

The Director of Public Relations of the Ministry of Defense of the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia, Colonel Getnet Adane, gave an explanation regarding the army recruitment in a statement he gave to Defense Television a few days ago on current security issues.

"In order for the Defense Army to fulfill its constitutional responsibility, it is necessary to replace those who are removed by natural or artificial means, as well as to prepare an army that considers a balanced force alignment," he said, referring to the importance of recruitment.

Col. Getnet said, "The regular recruitment criteria issued by the institution are the same as those in other countries, where youths join the army."

The director's recruitment criteria are mainly:
- Those who accept the constitution;
- Those who are over 18 years old;
- Those who are fully willing to serve their country;
- Free from any political affiliation;
- Sign a contract to serve for 7 years after completing the training;
- Free from criminal record;
- Meet the physical requirements are just a few of the mentioned ones.

**What did the director say about the recruitment process?**

He said that the recruitment process is carried out by the security and administrative bodies in the woreda and kebele as a committee, and that a report will be submitted to the defense regarding its implementation.

Since the recruitment must include a balanced ethnic composition, he said that the defense will provide quotas to the regions based on the quantitative regional data taken from the National Bureau of Statistics.

Regarding the implementation, Col. Getnet stated that "it is according to its capacity" and that the registration made in the woreda and kebele is not just taken at the zone level, but also that a verification process will be carried out when they arrive at the training center.

They raised the issue that not only was the complaint hearing committee, where regional representatives were present, appointed and came voluntarily, but also that if they were reduced, they could file a complaint that the reduction was not fair.

**What does the Ethiopian Human Rights Commission have to say on the matter?**

When asked by the Reporter newspaper whether they had received complaints about the youth exodus that are taking place in various areas, Chief Commissioner Berhanu Adelo gave the following response.

"We do not have a final document that the investigation has been completed. We have discussed this with senior experts from the Ministry of Interior [a few days ago] because we heard about it in the media.

On their part, there is no problem with the recruitment process; the problem is that there are incorrect procedures being carried out by the local administrative bodies when conducting the recruitment. We have agreed to work together to resolve the issue," he said. __
__
**Did ISEMCO have information about this incident and held the discussion?**

In his statement on this matter, the Chief Commissioner stated that the commission is investigating whether compulsory military recruitment is taking place in accordance with international standards and will make it public when the work is completed.

He pointed out that the commission has not yet reached a conclusion on the international standard or Standard of Proof, and said that when this is completed, it will be included in the report to be published every four months.

Regarding the discussion, the commissioner said, "We discussed it with the experts of the Ministry of Defense based on what we heard in the media," adding that the discussion was also held on his own initiative.

**ነዋሪዎች እየተካሄደ ነው ስላሉት አፈሳ ምን አሉ ?**

በተለያዩ ከተሞች ወጣቶች በግዳጅ በመንግሥት የፀጥታ ኃይሎች እየተያዙ እየተወሰዱ መሆኑን ነዋሪዎች ቅሬታ አቅርበዋል።

ቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ያነጋገራቸው በባህር ዳር፣ አዴትና ሞጣ እንዲሁም ጋይንት አካባቢ ያሉ ነዋሪዎች " በ20ዎቹ መጀመሪያ አካባቢ ያሉ ወጣቶችን የመከላከያና የአድማ ብተና መለዮ የለበሱ የመንግስት የፀጥታ አካላት ወጣቶችን እያፈሱ እስር ቤት እየከተቷቸው ነው " ሲሉ ገልጸዋል።

በሰሜን ጎጃም ዞን ይልማና ዴንሳ ወረዳ የአዴት ከተማ ነዋሪ መሆናቸውን እና ስማቸውን በይፋ እንዳንጠቅስ የጠየቁን ግለሰብ እርሳቸው በሚኖሩበት አካባቢ ባለፈው ሀሙስ እለት ከገረገራ ጎንጂ ቆለላ የሚያመላልሱና የትራንስፖርት አገልግሎት የሚሰጡ 5 ሞተረኞች ከነሞተራቸው፤ እንዲሁም 3 ሴቶችን ጨምሮ 17 ተማሪ የነበሩ ወጣቶች መወሰዳቸውን ተናዥተዋል።

የተያዙት ወጣቶች እስር ቤት መወሰዳቸውን የሰሙ ወላጆች እስር ቤት በመሄድ በገንዘብ ተደራድረው ልጆቻቸውን ያስለቀቁ እንዳሉ ሁሉ፥ ገንዘብ የሌላቸው ወላጆች እያለቀሱ ተመልሰዋል ሲሉ እኝህ አስተያየት ሰጭ አክለዋል።

በምስራቅ ጎጃም ዞን ሞጣ ቀራኒዮ ከተማ ነዋሪ መሆኑን የሚናገረው እና በደህንነት ስጋት ምክንያት ስሙ እንዳይጠቀስ የፈለገ ግለሰብ በቀራኒዮ ከተማ በርካታ ከ18 እስከ 20 የእድሜ ክልል ያሉ ወጣቶች እየታፈሱ እንደሆነ ተናግሯል።

በአካባቢው ትምህርት በመቋረጡ ከትምህርት ገበታ ውጭ በመሆናቸው በከተማው ያለ ስራ ሲዘዋወሩ የመንግስት የፀጥታ ሀይሎች በብዛት በመኪና እየጫኑ ሲወስዷቸው እንደተመለከቱ ይህው አስተያየት ሰጭ ተናግረዋል።

የአከባቢው ነዋሪ የሆነና ስሙ እንዳይጠቀስ የጠየቀን ግለሰብ በደቡብ ጎንደር ዞን ጋይንት ወረዳ ባሉ ንዑስ ወረዳዎች ወጣቶች ብቻ ሳይሆኑ የ11 ዓመት ታዳጊ ጭምር በመንግስት የፀጥታ ሀይሎች መውሰዳቸውንና ልጆቻቸውን ለማስለቀቅ ወደ ደብረታቦር የሄዱ ወላጆችም እያለቀሱ መመለሳቸውን እንደተመለከተ ገልጾልናል።

ያነጋገርናቸው ሁሉም አስተያየት ሰጭዎች መንግስት በየአካባቢው በግዳጅ  የሚሰበስባቸውን ወጣቶች ወደ ወታደራዊ ማሰልጠኛ ካምፕ እያስገባ ነው ብለው ይከሳሉ።

በተመሳሳይ ቢቢሲ አፋን ኦሮሞ ከሁለት ሳምንት በፊት ጀምሮ በኦሮሚያ የተለያዩ አካባቢዎች ወጣቶች ከመንገድ እየታፈሱ ስለመሆኑ በሰራው ዘገባ ጠቅሷል።

በተለይም በአዳማ ከተማ የሚገኝ እና ወጣቶች ከመንገድ ላይ ታፍሰው ታጉረውበታል የተባለን አንድ መጋዘን መመልከቱንና ይሄው መጋዘን የኦሮሚያ ሚሊሺያ የደንብ ልብስን የለበሱ የፀጥታ ኃይሎች ጥበቃ የሚደረግለት ነው ብሏል።

በአዳማ ነዋሪ የሆነ እና ለደኅንነቱ በመስጋት ስሙን ከመናገር የተቆጠበ ወጣት ፦

" ሦስት ጓደኞቼን ሳር ተራ [አዳማ] አካባቢ በቁጥጥር ስር አዋሏቸው። በአስር ሺዎች የሚቆጠር ብር ጉቦ እንዲከፍሉ ተጠየቁ። 

ከዚያም እነርሱ ለመልቀቅ የግድ ሦስት ሰዎችን መተካት ነበረባቸው፤ የእነርሱን ቦታ ከተማ ውስጥ ዞር ዞር ብለው ሌሎች ሦስት ሰዎችን ይዘው ካመጡ በኋላ ነው እነዚህ ሦስቱን የለቀቁት " ሲል ገልጿል።

የኢፌዴሪ መከላከያ ሚኒስቴር ህዝብ ግንኙነት እና የኢትዮጵያ ሰብዓዊ መብቶች ኮሚሽን በጉዳዩ ላይ የሰጡት ምላሽ በቀጣይ ይቀርባል።

**What do residents say about the ongoing eviction?**

Residents have complained that young people in various cities are being forcibly taken away by government security forces.

Residents in Bahir Dar, Adet, Mota and Gayant areas that Tikvah Ethiopia spoke to said that “government security forces wearing protective and strike uniforms are evicting young people in their early 20s and putting them in prison.”

A resident of Adet town, Yilmana Densa district, North Gojjam zone, who asked not to be named, said that on Thursday, five motorcyclists who provide transportation services from Geregera to Gonji Kolela, as well as 17 students, including 3 women, were taken away from their vehicles in their area.

The commenter added that parents who heard that the arrested youths were being taken to prison went to prison and negotiated for their children to be released, while parents who did not have money returned crying.

A person who said he was a resident of Mota Keraniyo town in East Gojjam zone and did not want to be named due to security concerns said that many young people between the ages of 18 and 20 were being kidnapped in Keraniyo town.

This commenter said that they saw government security forces loading them in large numbers in cars while they were roaming around the city without work due to the suspension of education in the area.

A person who is a resident of the area and asked not to be named told us that in the sub-districts of Giant Woreda in South Gondar zone, not only young people but also 11-year-olds were taken by government security forces, and that parents who went to Debre Tabor to release their children also returned crying.

All the commentators we spoke to accused the government of forcibly conscripting young people from various areas into military training camps.

Similarly, BBC Afan Oromo reported that young people have been being forcibly removed from the streets in various parts of Oromia since two weeks ago.

In particular, it said it had seen a warehouse in Adama town where young people were allegedly being forcibly removed from the streets, and that this warehouse was guarded by security forces wearing Oromia militia uniforms.

A young man from Adama, who asked not to be named for fear of his safety, said:

"They arrested three of my friends in the Sar Tera [Adama] area. They asked them to pay a bribe of tens of thousands of birr. 

Then they had to replace them with three people in order to release them; they went around the city and brought three other people and then they released the three," he said.

The response of the Federal Ministry of Defense Public Relations and the Ethiopian Human Rights Commission on the matter will be presented later.

እንዳያመልጥዎ !!
በምስራቅ አፍሪካ የመጀመሪያው ዓለም አቀፍ የቴክኖሎጂ ኤክስፖ (ETEX 2025)

ኢትዮጵያ በሀገራችን እንዲሁም በምስራቅ አፍሪካ ደረጃ የመጀመሪያ የሆነ ዓለም አቀፍ የቴክኖሎጂ ኤክስፖ (Ethiopian Tech Expo - ETEX 2025) ከግንቦት 8 እስከ 10/2017 ዓ.ም በአዲስ አበባ፡ አዲስ አለም አቀፍ ኮንቬንሽን ማዕከል ታካሂዳለች፡፡ 

የኢንፎርሜሽን መረብ ደህንነት አስተዳደር (INSA) እና የኢትዮጵያ አርቲፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ ኢንስቲትዩት በጋራ በመሆን ከተባበሩት አረብ ኢሚሬትስ የሳይበር ደህንነት ካውንስል ጋር በመተባበር ይህንን ኤከስፖ አዘጋጅተዋል።

የኢትዮጵያ የቴክኖሎጂ ኤክስፖ (Ethiopian Tech Expo - ETEX 2025) በ5 ዋና ዋና መስኮች ላይ ትኩረት አድርጎ የሚካሄድ ሲሆን ፤ እነዚህም በሳይበር ደህንነት ፣ በሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎት(AI) ፣ ፋይናንስ ቴክኖሎጂ (FinTech) ፣ ስማርት ከተማ (Smart City) ፣ እንዲሁም በቴክኖሎጂ ትምህርት (Tech Education) ላይ ያተኮረ ነው::

በኤክስፖው አለም አቀፍ የቴክኖሎጂ ኩባንያዎች ፣ ፖሊሲ አውጭዎች ፣ ተመራማሪዎች ፣ መሪዎች እና ሙህራን በአጠቃላይ ከ 10 ሺህ በላይ ሰዎች ተሳታፊ ይሆናሉ::

የኢትዮጵያ የቴክኖሎጂ ኤክስፖ (Ethiopian Tech Expo - ETEX 2025) ከግንቦት 8 እስከ 10/2017 ዓ.ም በአዲስ አበባ፡ አዲስ አለምአቀፍ ኮንቬንሽን ማዕከል (Addis International Convention Center) ለሦስት ተከታታይ ቀናት የሚቆይ ሲሆን:-

•  በሁለተኛው ቀን በአርቲፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ ዙሪያ ላይ ያተኮሩ መርሃ ግብሮች ፤

#ETEX 

Don't miss it!!
The first International Technology Expo in East Africa (ETEX 2025)

Ethiopia will host the first International Technology Expo in our country and in East Africa (Ethiopian Tech Expo - ETEX 2025) from May 8 to 10, 2017 at the Addis Ababa International Convention Center. 

The Information Network Security Administration (INSA) and the Ethiopian Artificial Intelligence Institute jointly organized this expo in collaboration with the United Arab Emirates Cyber ​​Security Council.

The Ethiopian Technology Expo (Ethebian Tech Expo - ETEX 2025) will focus on 5 main areas: These are focused on Cybersecurity, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Financial Technology (FinTech), Smart City, and Tech Education.

The Expo will bring together more than 10,000 global technology companies, policymakers, researchers, leaders, and scholars.

The Ethiopian Tech Expo (ETEX 2025) will be held from May 8 to 10, 2017 at the Addis International Convention Center in Addis Ababa for three consecutive days:

•  The first opening day will feature topics related to cybersecurity; 
•  The second day will feature programs focused on Artificial Intelligence;
•  The third day (May 10, 2017) will be open to the general public.

You are invited to participate in this first-of-its-kind expo and visit the exhibition organized at the expo!!
👉 Register to visit: www.etexethiopia.com

(ዶክተር ኃይለልዑል መኮንን)

ሁሌም ስታገኙት ደስተኛና ሳቂታ የነበረ ሰው በድንገት ራሱን አጥፍቶ ሞተ ሲባል ሰምታችሁ ታዉቃላቹ ? 

ብዙ ሰዉ የድብርት ህመም ደስተኛ አለመሆን ፣ የሀዘን ስሜት ፣ ተስፋ መቁረጥ እና የመሳሰሉት ብቻ ይመስለዋል። አንዳዴ እየሳቁ እና እየተጫወቱ በከባድ የድብርት ህመም የሚሰቃዩ ሰዎች አሉ። በህክምናዉ (atypical depression) ይባላል። 

- አብዛኛዉን ጊዜ ደስ የሚያሰኝ ነገር ሲያገኙ ለተወሰነ ጊዜ መደሰት ከዛም መልሶ የሀዘን እና የባዶነት ስሜት ዉስጥ መግባት፣ 
- ምግብ ፍላጎት እና ክብደት መጨመር፣ 
- ከሳምንታት በላይ ቀኑን ሙሉ መድከም እና እንቅልፍ ማብዛት፣ 
- በትንንሽ አስተያየቶች እና ትችቶች መሰበር፣ 
- የዘወትር ተግባራትን ለመከወን መቸገር የድብርት በሽታ ሌላኛዉ መልክ ሊሆን ይችላል። 

ስለዚህ የሳቀ ሁሉ ደስተኛ አይደለም፤ ምናልባት ከሳቁ ጀርባ የተደበቀ የባዶነት እና የሀዘን ስሜት ይኖራልና እርስ በእርስ እንጠያየቅ። 

(ይህ የግንቦት ወር በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ የአዕምሮ ጤና ግንዛቤ ወር ነው)

**Not everyone who laughs is happy!!**

(Dr. Haileul Mekonnen)

Have you ever heard of someone who was always happy and smiling and suddenly committed suicide? 

Many people think that depression is just feeling unhappy, sad, hopeless, and so on. There are people who laugh and play and suffer from severe depression. It is called (atypical depression) in medicine. 

- Most of the time, when you find something pleasant, you feel happy for a while and then you feel sad and empty again, 
- Increased appetite and weight gain, 
- Feeling tired and sleepy all day for more than a week, 
- Getting upset with small comments and criticisms, 
- Difficulty in doing daily activities can be another form of depression. 

So not everyone who laughs is happy; Maybe there is a hidden emptiness and sadness behind the laughter, so let's ask each other. 

(This month of May is World Mental Health Awareness Month)

__
__በደቡብ ኢትዮጵያ ክልል ጎፋ ዞን ገዜ ጎፋ ወረዳ አምና  ተከስቶ በነበረዉ የመሬት መንሸራተት የበርካቶች ሕይወት ማለፉን ተከትሎ ለስጋት የተጋለጡ በሚል በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ነዋሪዎች ወደ ሌላ ቦታ ተወስደዉ እንዲሰፍሩ ተደርጎ እንደነበር አይዘነጋም።

ዘንድሮ በድጋሚ በአከባቢው በጣለው ከባድ ዝናብ ለመልሶ ማቋቋም እየተገነቡ ከነበሩ ያልተጠናቀቁ መኖሪያ እና ትምህርት ቤቶች በድጋሚ ጉዳት እንደደረሰባቸው ነዋሪዎቹ ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ  ተናግረዋል።

" አደጋ የለበትም ተብሎ የመጣንበት ቦታ በአከባቢዉ በጣለዉ ነፋስ ቀላቅሎ በጣለዉ ከባድ ዝናብ የመሬት መንሸራተት አስከትሎ ጉዳት በማድረሱ ከፍተኛ ስጋት ዉስጥ ነን " ሲሉ አስረድተዋል።

የገዜ ጎፋ ወረዳ አደጋ ስጋትና የአከባቢ ጥበቃ ጽ/ቤት ኃላፊ አቶ ማስረሻ ማናዬ በጉዳዩ ዙሪያ ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ እንደተናገሩት የአከባቢው ደጋነትና የመልክአምድሩ ሁኔታ ከዝናብ መጠን መጨመር ጋር ተዳምሮ ልክ እንደ አምናዉ ሁሉ በድንገት አደጋ ማስከተሉንና በሰዉና ንብረት ላይ ጉዳት ማድረሱን ገልፀዋል።

አብዛኞቹ ቤቶች ተጠናቀዉ ለተፈናቃዮች የተሰጡ ሲሆን በመጠናቀቅ ላይ የነበሩ መኖሪያ እና ትምህርት ቤቶች በነፋስ መገነጣጠላቸዉንና በናዳዉ የተዋጡ ቤቶችም ስለመኖራቸው አረጋግጠዋል።

" በአደጋው ጉዳት የደረሰባቸውን የማገዝና መልሶ የማቋቋሙ ስራ ከዞንና ከክልሉ መንግስት ጋር በመሆን እየተሰራ ነዉ " ብለዋል።

__**" We are still in danger ! " - Residents**

__
__It is worth noting that thousands of residents were evacuated to other places after a landslide in Geze Gofa Woreda, Gofa Zone, Southern Ethiopia Region, claimed the lives of many people.

This year, residents told Tikvah Ethiopia that unfinished houses and schools that were being rebuilt for rehabilitation due to heavy rains in the area have been damaged again.

" We are in great danger because the area where we came from was considered safe due to the heavy rains and landslides that have occurred in the area," they explained.

The Head of the Geze Gofa District Disaster Risk and Environmental Protection Office, Ato Masresha Manaye, told Tikvah Ethiopia that the high altitude and topography of the area, combined with the increase in rainfall, have led to sudden disasters and damage to people and property, as expected.

Most of the houses have been completed and given to the displaced, but he confirmed that houses and schools that were under construction were damaged by the wind and that there were houses that were submerged in the water.

"The work of assisting and rehabilitating those affected by the disaster is being carried out in collaboration with the zone and regional governments," he said.

**" ከስህተታቸው የማይማሩ ጥቂት የቀድሞ የህወሓት ሀይሎች ለስልጣን ሲሉ ወደ ግጭት ለመግባት ፍላጎት እንዳላቸው እየገለጹ ነው " - አቶ ጌታቸው ረዳ**

**የጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ የምስራቅ አፍሪካ ጉዳዮች አማካሪ ሚኒስትር አቶ ጌታቸው ረዳ ምን አሉ ?**

አቶ ጌታቸው ረዳ እና አብርሃም በላይ (ዶ/ር) በአዲስ አበባ ከሚኖሩ የትግራይ ተወላጆች ጋር በትግራይ ክልል ወቅታዊ ሁኔታ ላይ ውይይት እያደረጉ ነው።

አቶ ጌታቸው በዚሁ ወቅት " የፕሪቶሪያ የሰላም ስምምነት መፈረሙ ትግራይን የጦርነት አውድማ የማድረግ ፍላጎት ያላቸው አካላትን ምኞት ያስቀረ ነው " ብለዋል፡፡

" የፕሪቶሪያ የሰላም ስምምነት ከተፈረመ በኋላ በህገ-መንግስቱና በፕሪቶሪያው ስምምነት ተፈናቃዮችን በሚፈለገው ልክ ወደ ቀያቸው መመለስ አልተቻለም " ሲሉ ገልጸዋል።

" ለዚህም በትግራይ ክልል በስልጣን ላይ ያለው ኃይል የሕዝቡን አጀንዳ ከማስቀደም ይልቅ ስልጣንና ስልጣን ብቻ በማለቱና እዚህ ግባ የሚባል ስራ ባለመስራቱ ነው " ሲሉ ተናግረዋል።

አቶ ጌታቸው  በትግራይ ክልል አሁን የተፈጠረው ችግር የትግራይ ፖለቲከኞች የፈጠሩት መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። አመራሩ የያዘው ግትር አቋም ትግራይን ከአደጋ ስጋት እንዳትወጣ እያደረጋት ተናግረዋል።

" የፕሪቶሪያ የሰላም ስምምነት ዓላማው ችግሮች በህገ-መንግሥታዊ አውድ እንዲፈቱ ማድረግ ቢሆንም፤ ከስህተታቸው የማይማሩት ጥቂት የቀድሞ የህወሓት ሀይሎች ለስልጣን ሲሉ ወደ ግጭት ለመግባት ፍላጎት እንዳላቸው እየገለጹ ነው " ብለዋል። 

" ከአሁን ቀደሞ የተፈጠረው ግጭት የትግራይን ህዝብ ዋጋ አስከፍሏል። አሁንም የትግራይ ህዝብ ተመሳሳይ ነገር እንዳይገጥመው የእነዚህን ሀይሎች እኩይ ፍላጎት እንዲያውቅ እያጋለጥን ነው " ሲሉ ገልጸዋል።

" በስልጣን መቀጠል የሚፈልጉ ጥቂት የአመራር ቡድኖች ልጆቻቸውን አስቀምጠው የደሀ ልጆችን ለእሳት እንደማገዱ በተግባር ያሳዩ ናቸው " ያሉ ሲሆን " ይህ ኃይል ' የእኔ ስልጣን ካልተረጋገጠ ሁሉም ነገር ገደል ይግባ ' የሚል ነው ዓላማውም ከተጠያቂነት ለማምለጥ ነው " ሲሉ አስረድተዋል።

የትግራይ ህዝብ ሰላም ፈላጊ መሆኑን ገልጸው " ከተጠያቂነት ለማምለጥ ዳግም የትግራይ ህዝብን ወደ ግጭት ለማስገባት የሚያደርገውን ጥረት ማጋለጥ ይገባል " ብለዋል።

" የትግራይ ክልል ግንኙነት ከፌዴራል መንግስት ጋር መሆኑ ግድ ነው ' ከእከሌ ጋር ሆኜ ማጥቃት እችላለሁ ' የሚለውን ማጋለጥ አለብን " ሲሉ ተናግረዋል።

" የፕሪቶሪያ የሰላም ስምምነትን በትክክል ገቢራዊ ለማድረግ ከፌዴራል መንግስት ጋር ያለው ግንኙነት መጠናከር አለበት የትግራይ ህዝብ ለተወሰኑ ሰዎች የስልጣን ጥም መሞት የለበትም " ብለዋል።

" በአሁኑ ወቅት 99 በመቶ የሚሆነው አመራር ሰላም ፈላጊ ነው ፤ ጥቂት የግጭት ጠማቂዎች በጋራ ልንታገላቸው ይገባል "ሲሉ ገልጸዋል።

መረጃው የኢትዮጵያ ዜና አገልግሎት ነው።

**"Some former TPLF forces who do not learn from their mistakes are expressing their desire to enter into conflict for the sake of power" - Ato Getachew Reda**

**What did Ato Getachew Reda, the Prime Minister's Advisor on East African Affairs, say?**

Ato Getachew Reda and Abraham Belay (PhD) are discussing the current situation in the Tigray region with Tigray natives living in Addis Ababa.

Ato Getachew said at the same time, "The signing of the Pretoria Peace Agreement has put an end to the desire of those who want to turn Tigray into a battlefield."

"After the signing of the Pretoria Peace Agreement, it was not possible to return the displaced to their homes as required by the constitution and the Pretoria Agreement," he said.

"This is because the power in power in the Tigray region is only interested in power and authority and has not done any meaningful work, instead of putting the people's agenda first," he said.

Ato Getachew said that the current problems in Tigray region are the creation of Tigray politicians. He said that the leadership’s stubborn stance is keeping Tigray from emerging from the crisis.

“Although the Pretoria Peace Agreement aims to resolve the problems within a constitutional framework, a few former TPLF forces who do not learn from their mistakes are expressing their desire to enter into conflict for the sake of power,” he said. 

“The conflict that has already occurred has cost the people of Tigray. We are now exposing the evil intentions of these forces so that the people of Tigray do not face the same thing,” he said. 

“A few leadership groups who want to remain in power have shown in practice that they are putting their children in the fire and feeding poor children,” he said, adding that “this force says ‘if my authority is not established, everything will go to hell’ and its purpose is to escape accountability.”

He said that the people of Tigray are seeking peace and that "in order to escape accountability, we must expose the efforts being made to bring the people of Tigray back into conflict."

"The relationship of the Tigray region with the federal government must be established, and we must expose the idea that 'I can attack with my own people'," he said.

"The relationship with the federal government must be strengthened to properly implement the Pretoria Peace Agreement. The people of Tigray should not succumb to the thirst for power of a few people," he said.

"Currently, 99 percent of the leadership is seeking peace; we should fight together against the few instigators of conflict," he said.

Information is from the Ethiopian News Service.

**" መንግሥት ከኃይል ውጪ ያሉ ሰላማዊ አማራጮችን መፈለጉን ይቀጥል " - አሜሪካ

➡️ ስለ ድሮን ጥቃት የሚገልጸው መልዕክት ተነስቷል።**

በትላንትናው ዕለት በአዲስ አበባ ያለው የአሜሪካ ኤምባሲ በአምባሳደር ኧርቪን ማሲንጋ በኩል ለፌዴራል መንግሥት ፣ ለፋኖ እንዲሁም ለኦሮሞ ነጻነት ሰራዊት (OLA) መልዕክት አስተላልፎ ነበር።

አምባሳደሩ ያስተላለፉት መልዕክት ፥ 
- ፋኖ ተጨባጭ እና ሰላማዊ የሆነ ዓላማ ይዞ እንዲመጣ ፤
- የኦሮሞ ነጻነት ሰራዊት በኦሮሚያ ግጭት እንዲቆም የጀመረውን ድርድር እንዲቀጥል ፤ 
- የፌዴራል መንግሥትም በራሱ ዜጎች ላይ የድሮን ጥቃት መፈጸም በአስቸኳይ እንዲቆምና ለሰላም መፍትሄዎችን እንዲያመቻች የሚጠይቅ ነበር።

ይህንን መልዕክትም በይፋዊ የማህበራዊ ትስስር ገጾቹ ላይ አሰራጭቶ ነበር።

በኃላ ላይ የፌደራል መንግሥት " በራሱ ሕዝብ ላይ  የሚፈጽማቸውን የድሮን ጥቃቶች በአፋጣኝ ያቁም " የሚል ጥሪ የቀረበበትን መልዕክት ከማህበራዊ ትስስር ገጾቹ ላይ አውርዶ ለውጥ አድርጎበታል።

ለውጥ በተደረገበት የአምባሳደሩ መልዕክት ላይ የድሮን ጥቃትን በተመለከተ ለፌደራል መንግሥት የቀረበው ጥሪ " መንግሥት ከኃይል ውጪ ያሉ ሰላማዊ አማራጮችን መፈለጉን ይቀጥል " በሚል ጥሪ ተተክቷል።

**"Government should continue to seek peaceful alternatives to violence" - US

➡️ The message about drone attacks has been removed.**

Yesterday, the US Embassy in Addis Ababa, through Ambassador Ervin Masinga, sent a message to the Federal Government, Fano and the Oromo Liberation Army (OLA).

The message sent by the Ambassador: 
- Fano should come with a realistic and peaceful objective;
- The Oromo Liberation Army should continue the negotiations it has started to end the conflict in Oromia;
- The Federal Government should immediately stop drone attacks on its own citizens and facilitate peaceful solutions.

It also shared this message on its official social media pages.

Later, the Federal Government removed the message from its social media pages that called for "immediately ending drone attacks on its own people" and changed it.

The revised message from the ambassador replaced the call for the federal government to “continue to seek peaceful alternatives to force” with a call for the government to “continue to seek peaceful alternatives to force.”

**" ሆስፒታሉ 5 ዶክተሮችን ከስራ አባሯል " - ማኅበሩ**

የደብረታቦር አጠቃላይ ስፔሻላይዝድ ሆስፒታል 5 ዶክተሮችን ከስራ ማሰናበቱን አሳወቀ።

በአማራ ክልል ደቡብ ጎንደር ዞን የደብረታቦር አጠ/ስፔሻላይዝድ ሆስፒታል በስራ ማቆም አድማ ምክንያት በስራ ገበታቸው ላይ ያልተገኙ 5 የህክምና ዶክተሮችን ከስራ ማሰናበቱን በቅጥር ግቢው ባወጣው ማስታወቂያ ገልጿል።

ሆስፒታሉ ባወጣው ማስታወቂያ መሰረት ግንቦት ከ12/2017 ከስራ ገበታ ላልተገኙ የሆስፒታሉ ባለሙያዎች 23 የጤና ባለሙያዎች ግንቦት 13/2017ዓ.ም እስከ 8:00 ድረስ ሪፖርት እንዲያደጉ ማስታወቂያ ማውጣቱን አስታውሷል።

በስም የጠቀሳቸው 5 ዶክተሮች ግን በወቅቱ ሪፖርት ባለማድረጋቸው ከስራ ማሰናበቱን ነው በማስታወቂያው ያስታወቀው።

ሆስፒታሉ ከስራ አሰናብቻቸዋለሁ ያላቸው ዶክተሮች ዝርዝር፦

1. ዶክተር ኤልሻዳይ ዋለ
2. ዶክተር አስማማው አለልኝ
3. ዶክተር እንግዳው ገሌ
4. ዶክተር በሪሁን ደጀን 
5. ዶክተር አያል ደሴ ናቸው።

ከስራ የተሰናበቱ ዶክተሮችን አስተያየት ለማካተት ያደረግነው ጥረት ለጊዜው አልተሳካም።

የደብረታቦር ሆስፒታል ሥራ አስኪያጅ ቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ለማነጋገር በእጅ ስልካቸው ላይ ቢደውልም ጥያቄውን ከሰሙ በኋላ ምላሽ ሳይሰጡ ስልኩን ዘግተዋል።

የአማራ ክልል ጤና ባለሙያዎች ማህበር ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ በሰጠው ቃል ሆስፒታሉ 5 ዶክተሮችን ማባረሩንና የሆስፒታሉን ሜዲካል ዳይሬክተር ጨምሮ 6 ዶክተሮችን ማሰሩን ገልጿል።

ማህበሩ እንደተናገረው ሆስፒታሉ ዶክተሮችን ያባረረው ግንቦት 13 እና 14 " በስራ ገበታችሁ ላይ አልተገኛችሁም  " ብሎ ባወጣው ማስታወቂያ ነው ብሏል።

በተመሳሳይ ከማክሰኞ ግንቦት 11 ቀን 2017 ዓ.ም ጀምሮ የሆስፒታሉ ሜዲካል ዳይሬክተሩን ጨምሮ 6 ዶክተሮች መታሰራቸው ማህበሩ አክሎ ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ገልጿል።

**" Hospital dismisses 5 doctors " - Association**

Debretabor General Specialized Hospital announced that it has dismissed 5 doctors from work.

In the South Gondar Zone of the Amhara Region, Debretabor General Specialized Hospital has dismissed 5 medical doctors who were absent from work due to a strike, the hospital announced in a notice issued by the recruitment office.

According to the notice issued by the hospital, 23 health professionals of the hospital who were absent from work since May 12/2017 were notified to report by May 13/2017 by 8:00.

However, the 5 doctors it mentioned by name were dismissed from work because they did not report on time, the notice stated.

List of doctors who the hospital has dismissed:

1. Dr. Elshaday Wale
2. Dr. Asmamaw Alleghen
3. Dr. Gedaew Gele
4. Dr. Berihun Dejen 
5. Dr. Ayal Dessie.

Our efforts to include the comments of the dismissed doctors have been unsuccessful for the time being.

Debre Tabor Hospital Manager Tikvah Ethiopia tried to contact him on his mobile phone, but he hung up without responding after hearing the question.

In a statement to Tikvah Ethiopia, the Amhara Regional Health Professionals Association stated that the hospital dismissed 5 doctors and arrested 6 doctors, including the hospital’s medical director.

According to the association, the hospital dismissed the doctors on May 13 and 14, saying, “You were not at your desk.”

Similarly, the association further informed Tikvah Ethiopia that since Tuesday, May 11, 2017, 6 doctors, including the hospital's medical director, have been arrested.

**" የሂሳብ መዝገብ እንዲይዙ በህግ የሚገደዱ ግብር ከፋዮች ከመጪው ሀምሌ የግብር ማሳወቂያ ወር ጀምሮ የተሟላ የሂሳብ መዝገብ በመያዝ ካልመጡ በስተቀር አይስተናገዱም "- የገቢዎች ቢሮ **

የአዲስ አበባ ከተማ አስተዳደር ገቢዎች ቢሮ ከመጪው ዓመታዊ የግብር ማሳወቂያ ወር ጀምሮ የደረጃ "ሀ" እና "ለ" ግብር ከፋይ ሆነው በህግ የሚገደዱ ግብር ከፋዮች ያለ ሂሳብ መዝገብ የማይስተናገዱ መሆኑን አሳውቋል።

አይስተናገዱም የተባሉት በደረጃ "ሀ" እና "ለ" የግብር ከፋይነት የተመዝገቡ እና በህጉ መሰረት የሂሳብ መዝገብ እንዲይዙ የሚገደዱትን ብቻ ነው። 

የቢሮው የኮምዩኒኬሽን ዳይሬክተር አቶ ሰውነት አየለ ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ እንደተናገሩት በህጉ መሰረት የሂሳብ መዝገብ እንዲይዙ የሚገደዱ ነጋዴዎች ከሚቀጥለው በጀት አመት በኋላ ግብር ለመክፈል ያላቸውን አጠቃላይ ወጪ እና ገቢያቸውን በዝርዝር የሚያሳይ መዝገብ መያዝ ይጠበቅባቸዋል ብለዋል። 

**አቶ ሰውነት አየለ በዝርዝር ምን አሉ ? **

" የሂሳብ መዝገብ ማለት ያላቸውን አጠቃላይ ሽያጭ እና ወጪ በዝርዝር የሚያሳይ ሰነድ/መዝገብ ነው። 

ህጋዊ የሆነ ግብይት የሚፈጸም ከሆነ እና በደረሰኝ ላይ የተመሰረተ ግብይት ካለ ከዚህ መዝገብ ጋር ተያይዞ ነው የሚቀርበው። 

ይህ ህግ ከወጣ ረጅም ጊዜ ነው ነገር ግን አፈጻጸም ላይ የተለያዩ ክፍተቶች በመኖራቸው በቁርጥ ግብር የሚስተናገዱ ነበሩ።

ለእነዚህ ግብር ከፋዮች በተለያየ መንገድ መረጃዎችን እያደረስን ነው ያለነው ከሚቀጥለው በጀት አመት በኋላ ከዚህ ሂሳብ መዝገብ ውጪ እንደማናስተናግዳቸው እንዲያውቁ እያደረግን ነው። 

ግብይቶቻቸውን በደረሰኝ ላይ ተመስርተው ፈጽመው በሂሳብ ባለሙያ አልያም የድርጅታቸው ተቀጣሪ በሆነ የሂሳብ ባለሙያ የተዘጋጀ የሂሳብ መዝገብ ማቅረብ አለባቸው።

ግብር ከፋዮች ከግምት የጸዳ የግብር አሰባሰብ ስርዓት የራሳቸውን ሚና እንዲጫወቱ ለማስቻል ይህንን የማሳወቅ ስራ እየሰራን ነው። 

በደረጃ "ሀ" እና "ለ" ከ120 ሺ በላይ ግብር ከፋዮች አሉ ከእነዚህ ውስጥ ገቢ እና ወጪያቸውን በአግባቡ እየመዘገቡ ፣ደረሰኝ እየቆረጡ አመታዊ ግብራቸውን የሚያሳውቁ አሉ ነገር ግን ከዚህ ውጪ ሲስተናገዱ የቆዩ ግብር ከፋዮቾም ነበሩ።

ይህ አሰራር ተለምዶ ከአመት አመት ዝም ብሎ በቁርጥ ግብር ለመስተናገድ የመፈለግ አዝማሚያ ይታያል ህጉ ግን ይህንን አሰራር የማይፈቅድ በመሆኑ ከመጪው ሐምሌ ወር ጀምሮ ሲመጡ በተሟላ መንገድ ሂሳብ መዝገባቸውን ይዘው ካልመጡ በስተቀር አይስተናገዱም። 

መያዝ አለባቸው እያልን ያለነው በደረጃ "ሀ" እና "ለ" የግብር ከፋይ ተመዝግበው በህጉ መሰረት የሂሳብ መዝገብ እንዲይዙ የሚገደዱትን ብቻ ነው። 

ሁሉንም ማለት አይደለም በተሰማሩበት የንግድ ዘርፋቸው ምክንያት እዚህ ውስጥ የማይካተቱ ይኖራሉ የሚመለከተው የተሰማሩበት የስራ ዘርፍ የሂሳብ መዝገብ መያዝ እያስገደዳቸው በተለያየ ምክንያት የማይዙትን እና በቁርጥ ግብር ሲስተናገዱ የነበሩ የንግዱን ማህበረሰብ ነው። 

ይህ አይነቱ አሰራር ግብር በዛብኝ በማለት ለሚቀርቡ ቅሬታዎች መፍትሄ የሚሆን ነው " ብለዋል።

**"Taxpayers who are required by law to keep accounting records will not be processed unless they come with a complete accounting record starting from the upcoming July tax notification month" - Revenue Bureau **

The Addis Ababa City Administration Revenue Bureau has announced that starting from the upcoming annual tax notification month, taxpayers who are required by law to be class "A" and "B" taxpayers will not be processed without accounting records.

The only ones who will not be processed are those who are registered as class "A" and "B" taxpayers and are required to keep accounting records according to the law. 

The bureau's Communications Director, Ato Mansal Ayele, told Tikvah Ethiopia that traders who are required by law to keep accounting records are required to keep a detailed record of their total expenses and income for the next fiscal year. 

**What did Mr. Mansal Ayele say in detail? **

"A ledger is a document/record that shows the total sales and expenses of a business. 

If a legal transaction is made and there is a transaction based on a receipt, it is submitted with this record. 

This law has been in effect for a long time, but due to various gaps in implementation, they were treated as fixed taxes. 

We are providing information to these taxpayers in various ways, letting them know that after the next fiscal year, we will not treat them outside of this ledger. 

They must complete their transactions based on receipts and submit a ledger prepared by an accountant or an accountant employed by their organization. 

We are working to inform taxpayers about this in order to enable them to play their role in a tax collection system that is free from accounting. 

There are more than 120,000 taxpayers in levels "A" and "B", of which there are those who are properly recording their income and expenses, cutting receipts and declaring their annual taxes, but they have been treated outside of this. There were also taxpayers.

This practice is usually seen as a tendency to want to be treated with flat tax every year, but the law does not allow this practice, so starting next July, they will not be treated unless they bring their accounts in a complete manner. 

We are saying that they must keep only those who are registered as taxpayers in levels "A" and "B" and are required to keep accounts according to the law. 

This does not mean that everyone is excluded because of their business sector. It concerns the business community that is forced to keep accounts for various reasons and who have been treated with flat tax. 

This type of practice will be a solution to complaints that taxes are too high, " he said.

Tikvah Ethiopia

Kenyan President William Ruto was pelted with shoes while he was delivering a speech.

The president was addressing a gathering of people in Suna West yesterday when shoes were thrown at him.

President Ruto was seen blocking the shoes with his hands.

Police have arrested three people following the incident. Security agencies said “security around the president needs to be beefed up.”

Ruto was reportedly speaking about government-built houses in the area and efforts to reduce the cost of farming in the country before the shoes were thrown at him.

Security forces said that more people could be arrested in addition to the three individuals, and that the attack may have been politically motivated.

__በትግራይ ክልል፤ በእንደርታ ወረዳ መሰረት ቀበሌ ገበሬ ማህበር መንጨልፎ በተባለ መንደር በጥበቃ ሙያ የተሰማራ ግለሰብ በሚሰራበት ቦታ ከተዋወቃት ሴት አንድ ልጅ ይወልዳል።

የተወለደው ልጅ በተለይም ጀሮው አከባቢው አብሮት የጥበቃ ሙያ ከሚሰራው የስራ አጋሩ ጋር የመመሳሰል ጉደይ ደጋግሞ ይከነክነዋል።

ይባስ ብሎ ደግሞ ልጅ የወለደችለት ሴት በልጁ መመሳሰል የጠረጠረውን የስራ ባልደርባ " ሊደፍረኝ ሞክሮ ነበር " ትነግረዋለች።

ይህን የነገረችውን ቂምና ነገር ቋጥሮ የስራ ባልደረባውን በአህልህና በብስጭት ደግጋሞ በገጀራ በመውጋት መግደሉ ለፓሊስ ቃሉ እንደሰጠ ከትግራይ ደቡባዊ ምስራቅ ዞን ፖሊስ ያገኘነው መረጃ ያሳያል።

የዞኑ ፓሊስ ግድያ ፈፃሚው ከህብረተሰብ ጥቆማ በመነሳት ባደረገው ክትትል   በቀናት ውስጥ በቁጥጥር ስር አውሎታል።

" ካንተ ነው የወለድኩት ያለችኝ ልጅ በተለይ ጆሮው አካባቢ ከኔ ሳይሆን አብሮኝ ከሚሰራ ሰው ስለሚመስል አባቱ እሱ ነው ብዬ በመጠርጠሬ በገጀራ ደጋግሜ በመውጋት ገድየዋለሁ " ሲል ቃል መስጠቱ ፓሊስ አስታውቀዋል።

" በራስ አእምሮ ያለን ጥርጣሬ እንደ ፍፁም እውነት በመቆጠር ጉዳዩ በህክምና መረጃና ማስረጃ ሳይረጋገጥ በሌሎች ሰዎች ላይ ይህን መሰል የጭካኔ እርምጃ መውሰድ ለማያባራ የህሊና ፀፀት ይዳርጋል " ያለው ፓሊስ " ትእግስትና ማስተዋል ይቅደም " በማለት መክሯል።__

**__" Patience and understanding come first " - Police__**

__In Tigray Region; In a village called Menchelfo, a Kebele Gebre Association under the Enderta Woreda, a man working as a security guard gives birth to a child from a woman he met at his workplace.

The child, especially the one in the Jerow area, is often teased for looking like his workmate, who also works as a security guard.

To make matters worse, the woman who gave birth to the child tells her co-worker, who suspects the child of looking like him, "He tried to rape me."

The information we received from the Tigray Southeastern Zone Police shows that he confessed to the police that he killed his co-worker by stabbing him repeatedly with a javelin in anger and frustration.

The police arrested the perpetrator within days of the investigation based on a tip-off from the community.

"I suspected that the child I gave birth to was from you, especially because his ears looked like a co-worker's, not mine, so I stabbed him repeatedly with a knife," the police said, adding that he had committed suicide.

"Since our suspicions are considered absolute truths, taking such cruel measures against other people without confirming the matter with medical information and evidence will lead to unbearable remorse," the police said, adding, "Patience and understanding should come first." __

**ኢትዮጵያ የቢትኮይን ኩባንያዎችን ትኩረት ለምን ሳበች ? **

በአዲስ አበባ የሚገኘው የኢንፎርሜሽን ቴክኖሎጂ ፓርክ፣ ዋነኛው የቢትኮይን ኩባንያዎች መዳረሻ ሆኗል፡፡ 

ካለፈው አንድ አመት ጀምሮ 10 ኩባንያዎች በዚሁ ፓርክ ውስጥ መሰረተልማት ገንብተው እየሰሩ መሆናቸውን፣ የአይቲ ፓርኩ ሐላፊ አቶ ሔኖክ አሕመድ ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ተናግረዋል፡፡ 

በሌሎች የሀገሪቱ አካባቢዎችም በዚሁ ስራ ላይ የተሰማሩ አለምአቀፍ ኩባንያዎች እንዳሉ ከኢትዮጵያ ኤሌክትሪክ ሀይል የተገኘ መረጃ ያመለክታል፡፡ 

ካለፈው አንድ አመት ጀምሮ፣ ተቋሙ ከ 36 የቢትኮይን ኩባንያዎች ጋር ሀይል የማቅረብ ስምምነት ተፈራርሟል፡፡ ከነዚህ ውስጥ 25ቱ ስራ ሲጀምሩ፣ 11 የሚሆኑት ደግሞ በሒደት ላይ ናቸው ተብለዋል፡፡ 

ሀገራት የቢትኮይን ኢንቨስትመንትን ሲቀበሉ የተለያዩ ጥቅሞችን ከግምት ያስገባሉ ይላሉ አቶ ሔኖክ፡፡ 

“ አንደኛው ሀገራት ያመነጩትን ሀይል በአግባቡ ለመጠቀምና የውጭ ምንዛሪ በማመንጨት ኢኮኖሚያዊ ጠቀሜታ ማግኘት ነው፡፡ የቴክኖሎጂ ሽግግርን ማምጣት፣ እና ቢትኮይንን (ምናባዊ ዲጂታል የመገበያያ መሳሪያ) ለንግድ አገልግሎት መጠቀም የሚሉትም ሌሎች ምክንያቶች ናቸው፡፡ 

ወደ ኢትዮጵያ ስንመጣ፣ እነዚህን ኩባንያዎች የመሳቡ እርምጃ የተለያዩ አላማዎችን የያዘ ነው፡፡ ኢንቨስትመንትን ማበረታታት፣ የውጭ ምንዛሪ በማመንጨት ኢኮኖሚያዊ ጠቀሜታ ማግኘት፣ እና የቴክኖሎጂ ሽግግር የሚሉት ዋናዎቹ ናቸው፡፡ የፋይናንስ ጎኑን አናይም፣ ለምን ቢባል በሀገሪቱ በቢትኮይን ወይም በክሪፕቶ ከረንሲ ግብይት አይከናወንም፡፡ እየተጠና ያለ ነገር ግን አለ፣ ገና ነው እሱ፡፡ ”

ይህ ዘርፍ የውጭ ኢንቨስትመንትን ለመሳብ እንደ ጥሩ አጋጣሚ ነው የምናየው ሲሉም አክለዋል፡፡ 

“ እነዚህ ኩባንያዎች በሚያገኙት አገልግሎትና ጥቅም፣ ሌሎችን ይስባሉ፣ ራሳቸውም በሌሎች ዘርፎች ላይ ሊሰማሩ ይችላሉ፡፡ ስለዚህ የኢንቨስትመንት እድሎቻችንን ለማስተዋወቅ እንጠቀምባቸዋለን፡፡ 

የቢትኮይን ኩባንያዎች የስራ ዕድል አይፈጥሩም፣ ግብር አይከፍሉም (የግብር ስርዓታችን ስለ ማያውቃቸው)፣ የሀይል አቅርቦትንም ከሌሎች ዘርፎች ይሻማሉ፣ ለምን ከፍተኛ የኤሌክትሪክ ሀይል ነው የሚጠቀሙት፡፡ እነዚህ ክፍተቶች ቢኖሩበትም፣ ዘርፉ የውጭ ምንዛሪ ስለሚያመጣና ሀገራችን ለኢንቨስትመንት ምቹ መሆኗን ስለሚያስተዋውቁ እየተቀበልናቸው እንገኛለን፡፡ 

ሌላው፣ በውጭ ምንዛሪ በኩል የሚገኘው ኢኮኖሚያዊ ጠቀሜታ ነው፡፡ የኢትዮጵያ ኤሌክትሪክ ሀይል፣ ሀብቱን ውጤታማ በሆነ መንገድ ለመጠቀም ያስችሉታል፡፡ የሚባክን ሀይል ሲኖረው ለእነሱ በመሸጥ የውጭ ምንዛሪ ያስገኛል፡፡ 

በሶስተኛ ደረጃ የቴክኖሎጂ ሽግግርን ታሳቢ እናደርጋለን፡፡ በዚህ ዘርፍ የተሰማሩ ኩባያዎችን በመሳብ፣ ለዚህ ቴክኖሎጂ መጋለጥ እንፈልጋለን፡፡ ጀማሪ የቴክኖሎጂ ተቋሞቻችንን በማሰልጠን እና እውቀት በማሸጋገር በኩል ሐላፊነታቸውን እንዲወጡ እናደርጋለን፡፡ 

በሒደት ደግሞ፣ ለሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎት (AI) የሚጠቅመን የመረጃ ማዕከል እንዲከፍቱ ልናደርግ እንችላለን፡፡ እነሱም የኤአይ ዳታ ሴንተር ማቋቋም ላይ ያለውን እድል እያዩት ነው፡፡ ይህ ለእኛ ጠቃሚ ነገር ይሆናል፡፡ 

የኩባንያዎቹ ሀይል ፍላጎት ትልቅ ነው እየጨመረ ይሔዳል፡፡ ሀገሪቱ ከነሱ በምታገኘው ገቢ ተጨማሪ ሀይል የማመንጨት እቅድ መንደፍ አለባት፡፡ ከ5 እስከ 10 አመት የሚቆይ ስትራቴጂክ እቅድ ያስፈልጋታል፡፡ 

ይህ ኢንቨስትመንት በሆነ አጋጣሚ የመጣ ትልቅ እድል ነው፣ ይህን መጠቀም መቻል አለብን፡፡ ሀገራዊ ፖሊሲም ሊወጣለት ይገባል፡፡ የሐገር ውስጥ ባለሃብቶችም በሽርክና ቢገቡበትና ቢጠቀሙበት መልካም ነው፡፡ ግንዛበቤውና እውቀቱ ቢፈጠርና ኢትዮጵውያንም ከዚህ ቢጠቀሙ መልካም ነው፡፡ 

እኔ የምመኘው በፍጥነት ገብተንበት ከዘርፉ መጠቀም ብንችል ነው፡፡ የማይቀር ነገር ስለሆነ፣ በጊዜ ገብተን የሚገባንን ጥቅም ማግኘቱ የተሻለ ነው፡፡ ” 

የቢትኮይን ኩባንያዎቹ ትኩረታቸውን በኢትዮጵያ ላይ እያደረጉ ያሉት በዝቅተኛ ዋጋ ታዳሽ ኤሌክትሪክ ሀይል ስለምታቀርብ እንደሆነ አንድ የኢትዮጵያ ኤሌክትሪክ ሀይል ሐላፊ ለቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ተናግረዋል፡፡ 

በኢትዮጵያ ያለው የኤሌክትሪክ ዋጋ ከሌሎች የአፍሪካ ሀገራት ጋር ሲነፃፀር ዝቅተኛ ነው፣ ይህ ደግሞ ለኩባንያዎቹ ወደዚህ ሀገር መምጣት ትልቅ ምክንያት ሆኗል ይላሉ፡፡ መሰረተልማት ዘርገተው ሀይል የሚጠቀሙትም ሰርቨራቸውን ለማንቀሳቀስ መሆኑን ተናረዋል፡፡  

**ኃላፊው በዝርዝር ምን አሉ ?**

“ በአፍሪካ የቢትኮይን ኩባንያዎች ብዙም የሉም፣ በኤስያ እና ሰሜን አሜሪካ ናቸው በብዛት የሚገኙት፡፡ ከነሱ አንፃር በኢትዮጵያ ያለው የኤሌክትሪክ ዋጋ ዝቅተኛ ነው፡፡ ከዛም ውጪ፣ ሌሎች ሀገራት ሀይል ለማመንጫነት የድንጋይ ከሰልን ነው የሚጠቀሙት፡፡ ይህ ደግሞ የአካባቢ ብክለት ጥያቄ ያስነሳባቸዋል፡፡ ስለዚህ በአካበቢ ጥበቃ በኩል የሚነሳባቸውንም ትችት ለመሸሽ ወደ ኢትዮጵያ ይመጣሉ፡፡ 

እኛ ታዳሽ የሀይል ምንጭ ነው የምንጠቀመው፡፡ ብክለት አያሳስበንም፡፡ አብዛኞቹ ቢያንስ 100 ሜጋዋት ይጠይቃሉ፣ እስከ 600 ሜጋዋት የሚጠይቁም አሉ፡፡ ይህን ማቅረብ እንደማንችል ነግረናቸዋል፡፡ አሁን እየተጠቀሙ ያሉት ከ 20 እስከ 40 ሜጋዋት ድረስ ብቻ ነው፡፡ የሀገር ውስጥ ፍላጎትን ሳናሟላ ለእነሱ አንሰጥም፡፡ ይሔ ስምምነቱም ላይ አለ፡፡ ወደ ኢትዮጵያ መገግባት ከጀመሩ አንድ አመት ሆኖዋቸዋል፡፡ ግን ትልቅ የሆነ የውጭ ምንዛሪ የሚገኝበት ዘርፍ እየሆነ መጥቷል፡፡ 

አቅም ኖሮን የፍላጎታቸውን ያህል ሀይል ማቅረብ ብንችል፣ ይህ ትልቅ የውጭ ምንዛሪ ማግኛ ዘርፍ በሆነ ነበር፡፡ በአንድ አመት ውስጥ በብዙ ሚሊዮን የሚገመት ሀብት አስገኝቷል፡፡ በዚህ አመት ደግሞ እስከ 120 ሚሊዮን ዶላር ለማግኘት አቅድ አለ፡፡ የህግ ማዕቀፍ ተዘጋጅቶለት ቢሰራ ብዙ የውጭ ምንዛሪ ማግኛ ነው፡፡ ” 

በጉዳዩ ዙርያ ተጨማሪ አስተያየት እንዲሰጡን የጠየቅናቸው፣ የኢትዮጵያ ኤሌክትሪክ ሀይል የኮሚኒኬሽን ዳይሬክተር አቶ ሞገስ መኮነን፣ ምላሽ ሊሰጡን አልቻሉም፡፡ ከቢትኮይን ኩባያዎቹም እንደዚሁ ተጨማሪ አስተያየት ለማግኘት ያደረግነው ጥረት አልተሳካም፡፡

ቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ
አዲስ አበባ

**Why has Ethiopia attracted the attention of Bitcoin companies? **

The Information Technology Park in Addis Ababa has become a major destination for Bitcoin companies. 

Since the past year, 10 companies have been building infrastructure in the park, IT Park Director Henok Ahmed told Tikvah Ethiopia. 

Information from Ethiopian Electric Power indicates that there are international companies engaged in the same work in other parts of the country. 

Since the past year, the institution has signed power supply agreements with 36 Bitcoin companies. Of these, 25 are said to have started operations and 11 are in the process. 

Henok says that countries consider various benefits when accepting Bitcoin investment. 

“One is to make the most of the energy that countries generate and to gain economic benefits by generating foreign exchange. Other reasons include bringing in technology transfer, and using Bitcoin (a virtual digital currency) for commercial purposes. 

When it comes to Ethiopia, the move to attract these companies has various objectives. Encouraging investment, generating economic benefits by generating foreign exchange, and technology transfer are the main ones. We do not see the financial side, because there is no Bitcoin or cryptocurrency trading in the country. But there is something that is being studied, but it is still there.”

We see this sector as a good opportunity to attract foreign investment, he added. 

“These companies attract others with the services and benefits they provide, and they can also engage in other sectors. So we use them to promote our investment opportunities. 

Bitcoin companies do not create jobs, do not pay taxes (because our tax system does not recognize them), and they also divert power supply from other sectors, which is why they use a lot of electricity. Despite these gaps, we are accepting them because the sector brings in foreign currency and promotes the country as a good place for investment. 

Another is the economic benefit from foreign currency. Ethiopian Electric Power allows us to use our resources effectively. When there is wasted energy, it sells it to them and generates foreign currency. 

Thirdly, we consider technology transfer. We want to attract talents engaged in this sector, and expose them to this technology. We will make our startup technology institutions fulfill their responsibilities by training and transferring knowledge. 

In the process, We can have them open a data center that will benefit us from artificial intelligence (AI). They are also seeing the opportunity in setting up an AI data center. This will be beneficial for us. 

The energy demand of the companies is huge and increasing. The country needs to plan for generating additional energy with the income it gets from them. It needs a strategic plan that will last for 5 to 10 years. 

This investment is a great opportunity that has come at a time, we must be able to use it. A national policy should also be developed for it. It would be good if local investors could also enter and use it in partnership. It would be good if the knowledge and expertise were created and Ethiopians could benefit from this. 

I wish we could enter the sector quickly and benefit from it. It is inevitable, so it is better to enter in time and get the benefits we deserve. ” 

The bitcoin companies are focusing on Ethiopia because of the low-cost renewable energy An Ethiopian Electric Power Company official told Tikvah Ethiopia that the price of electricity in Ethiopia is low compared to other African countries, which is a big reason for companies to come to the country. They said that they have built infrastructure and are using the power to power their servers. 

**What did the official say in detail?**

“There are not many Bitcoin companies in Africa, they are mostly in Asia and North America. The electricity price in Ethiopia is low compared to them. Besides, other countries use coal to generate power. This also raises environmental pollution issues. So they come to Ethiopia to avoid the criticism from environmentalists. 

We use renewable energy sources. We are not concerned about pollution. Most of them ask for at least 100 megawatts, some ask for up to 600 megawatts. We have told them that we cannot provide this. They are currently using only 20 to 40 megawatts. We will not give them without meeting the domestic demand. This is the agreement. It has been a year since they started entering Ethiopia. But it is becoming a sector that earns a lot of foreign exchange. 

We have the capacity If we could provide as much power as they need, this would be a big foreign exchange earner. It has generated millions of dollars in a single year. This year, there is a plan to generate up to $120 million. If the legal framework is put in place and implemented, it will generate a lot of foreign exchange.” 

When asked for further comment on the matter, Ethiopian Electric Power’s Communications Director, Ato Moges Mekonnen, did not respond. Efforts to get further comment from the Bitcoin Cups were also unsuccessful.

Tikvah Ethiopia
Addis Ababa

**እናት ፓርቲ በአማራ ክልል ስላለው ሁኔታ ምን አለ ?

" ጦርነቶች በድርድር መቆም አለባቸው፡፡ መንግስት ከግፋ በለው አካሄዱ ቆም ብሎና ወደቀልቡ ተመልሶ ሁሉን አካታች ፖለቲካዊ ድርድር መካሄድ አለበት " - እናት ፓርቲ**
__
ቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ከእናት ፓርቲ ጋር በነበረው ቃለ ምልልስ ፓርቲው በአማራ ክልል ስላለው ጦርነት እና ስለ ሀገራዊ ምክክር ኮሚሽን ሀሳቡን አንስቷል።

ጦርነት ለማስቆም ሀገራዊ ኮሚሽኑ ምን አይነት መንገድ መከተል ነበረበት ? ጦርነቱን ለማስቆምስ አቅም ይኖረዋል ብላችሁ ታምናላች ? ምክክር ያደረጉ የሌሎች ሀገራት ተሞክሮስ ምን ይመስላል ? የሚል ጥያቄ ለፓርቲው ቀርቧል።

እናት ፓርቲ ፥__ __" የጦርነቱ ጠማቂም፣ አሳላፊም የብልጽግና መንግስት ነው፡፡ ግን ኮሚሽኑም ይሄን ጉዳይ ውስጥ ሆኖ ሳይሆን ከውጭ በኩል ገለልተኛ ሆኖ መመልከት ይኖርበታል " ብሏል።

" ይህን ብናድርግና ይህን ብንል ያኛው ይከፋዋል፣ ያኛውን ያስደስተዋል በሚል ሳይሆን በሁሉም ላይ ዓለም አቀፉ ማህበረሰብ ጫና እንዲደረግ አስተባበረው ተኩስ አቁም፣ ፖለቲካዊ ድርድር እንዲያድግ መስራት አለባቸው " ሲል ገልጿል።

" መንግስት በቀደዳላቸው ቦይ ከመፍሰስ ወጣ ብለው ከሳጥኑ ውጭ መመልከት አለባቸው፡፡ ለምክክሩ አስቻይ ሁኔታ እንዲፈጠር መንግስት መሪ ኃላፊነቱን እንዲወጣ ግፊት ማድረግ ይጠበቅባቸዋል " ብሏል።

በተዋጊ ኃይሎችም በእኩል ጫና መፍጠር እንደሚያስፈልግ ፓርቲው አንድቷል።

ፓርቲው " ተሞክሮን ካነሳን፥ የአየርላንድ ተሞክሮ የረጂም ጊዜ ደም መፋሰስን በGood Friday ያስቆመው ምክክርና በቱኒዚያ እስከ ሕገ መንግስት መቀየር የሚያደርስ አዲስ ማኅበራዊ ውል የተደረገባቸው ውጤታማ የሚባሉ ናቸው " ብሏል።
 
" ሀገራቱ በቅድሚያ ያደረጉት የመሳሪያ ድምጽ ፀጥ እንዲልና ሁሉም ወደ ልቡናው ተመልሶና አካታች በማድረግ ለምክክሩ ውጤታማነት መሰረት መጣል ነው " ያለው ፓርቲው " በአንጻሩ ብዙ ተጠብቆና ተሰርቶበት ግን በአካታችነትና ግትርነት የአካሄድ ስህተት የየመኑ ምክክር መክሸፍ የሚያስቆጭና በሌላው አጽናፍ የሚጠቀስ፣ ከዚያ በኋላም የመንን ወደ failed state የመራ አጋጣሚ ሆኗል።" ሲል አስገንብዟል።

እናት ፓርቲ የአማራ ህዝብ ያለበትን ወቅታዊ ሁኔታ እንዴት እንደገመገመው ፤ ካለበት የከፋ ሁኔታ እንዴት መውጣት እንዳለበት መፍትሄው ምን እንደሆነ ላነሳልነት ጥያቄ ምላሽ ሰጥቷል።

እናት ፓርቲ " በህዝቡ የደረሰው ግፍ እንደመጋዝ ነው፡፡ እየተመላለሰ ነው ክልሉን የቆራረጠው፡፡ ያለፈው 50 ዓመት በትርክት እዳ ፍዳውን ሲያይ ኖሯል፣ የግፍ ግፍ ተፈጽሞበታል " ብሏል።

" ወጣቱም በሱስና ተስፋ በመቁረጥ በባህር እየተሰደደ እያለቀ ነው፡፡ ወጥቶ መግባት፣ በልቶ ማደር ብርቅ ነው፡፡ ከምድር፣ ከሰማይ እሳት እየዘነበበት ነው" ሲል ጋጿል።

**What does the Mother Party say about the situation in the Amhara region?

"Wars should be stopped through negotiations. The government should stop its aggressive approach and return to the path of inclusive political negotiations" - Mother Party**

__
In an interview with the Mother Party, Tikvah Ethiopia raised the party's views on the war in the Amhara region and the National Consultation Commission.

What path should the National Commission have followed to stop the war? Do you believe it will have the capacity to stop the war? What is the experience of other countries that have consulted? The party was asked.

Mother Party:__ __" The instigator and perpetrator of the war is the prosperous government. But the commission should look at this issue from an outside perspective, not from within."

"If we do this and say this, that one will be hurt, that one will be happy, not because it pleases that one, but because the international community should work together to put pressure on all of them, to establish a ceasefire, to promote political negotiations," he said.

"The government should look outside the box and not to dig in the ditch they have dug. They should put pressure on the government to take responsibility to create an environment conducive to dialogue," he said.

The party also agreed that equal pressure should be put on the warring parties.

"If we look at experience, the Irish experience, which ended the long-term bloodshed on Good Friday, and the new social contract in Tunisia, which led to a change in the constitution, are considered effective," the party said.

"The first thing the countries did was to silence the sound of weapons and bring everyone back to their senses and to lay the foundation for the effectiveness of the consultation," the party said. "On the contrary, much has been done and much has been done, but the failure of the Yemeni consultation due to inclusivity and rigidity has become an opportunity that will be mentioned in the rest of the world, and has led Yemen to a failed state." 

The mother party responded to the question of how it assessed the current situation of the Amhara people; what is the solution to get out of the dire situation it is in. 

The mother party said, "The injustice suffered by the people is like a saw. It is cutting the region. It has been suffering for the past 50 years, and injustice has been committed against it." 

"Many innocent people are being killed en masse. More than 6 million children are out of school. More than 4,500 schools have been destroyed or closed. Many health facilities have been destroyed," he said.

"The youth are also fleeing to the sea due to addiction and despair. It is rare to go out and stay overnight. Fire is raining down from the earth and the sky," he said.

The party, which stated that the people of the Tigray region have been subjected to political infighting and have become a big troublemaker, said, "The ongoing fighting in the Oromia region is also showing the people the difference between the rulers by day and the rulers by night."

"Wars must end through negotiations. The government must stop its aggressive behavior and return to the path of inclusive political negotiations. Politics needs urgent treatment," he said.

Tikvah Ethiopia
Addis Ababa

**#እናትፓርቲ**

**__" አማራ ክልል በተሟላ ጦርነት ውስጥ ነው። በየቀኑ ሰዎች በድሮን ጭምር ይጨፈጨፋሉ__**። __**ኮሚሽኑና መንግስት ደግሞ ' የለም እየሞትክም ተመካከር' ' ይላሉ ! "  - እናት ፓርቲ
**
እናት ፓርቲ የኢትዮጵያ ሀገራዊ ምክክር ኮሚሽን በአማራ ክልል ባደረገው አጀንዳ የማሰባሰብ ሂደት ያልተሳተፈበትን ምክንያትና የኮሚሽኑን አካሄድ በተመለከተ የሰላ ትችት ሰንዝሯል።

**Q.**__ __**በክልሉ አጀንዳ የማሰባሰብ ሂደት ያልተሳተፋችሁበት ምክንያት ምንድን ነው? ኮሚሽኑ ‘ይምጡ በራችን ክፍት ነው’ ይላል፤ እናንተ ደግሞ እየተሳተፋችሁ አይደለምና ልዩነቱ ምንድን ነው? መፍትሄውስ?**

**እናት ፓርቲ ፦

"**__ __ግልጽ ነውኮ! ክልሉ በተሟላ ጦርነት ውስጥ ነው ያለው፡፡ በየቀኑ ሰዎች በድሮን ጭምር ይጨፈጨፋሉ፡፡ በአጠቃላይ ከባድ ውድመት እየደረሰ ነው፡፡

በክልሉ ለሚሊዮን የሚጠጉ ተፈናቃዮች፤ በብዙ ቦታዎች ከፍተኛ ድርቅና ሰው ሰራሽ ረሃብ አለ፡፡ ለሕዝቡ ጥቅም ሊሟገቱ የሚችሉ በርካታ ምሁራንና ፖለቲካኞች በእስር ናቸው ወይም ተሰደዋል።

በየሳምንቱ ዜጎች እየታገቱ በሚሊዮን የሚቆጠር ገንዘብ ይጠየቅባቸዋል፡፡ በክልሉ እንኳን ምክክር ሊያስደርግ የሚችል አውድ ገበያ ወጥቶ ቤት ለመግባት፣ ነብሰጡርን ሀኪም ቤት መውሰድ፣ ህፃናትን ትምህርት ቤት መሄድ፣ ከቦታ ቦታ መንቀሳቀስም ብርቅ ሆኗል፡፡

ማህበረሰቡ 'የህልውና ችግር ገጥሞኛል በቅድሚያ እሱን ፍቱልኝ' (quick fix) እያለ ነው፡፡ ኮሚሽኑና መንግስት ደግሞ 'የለም እየሞትክም ተመካከር” ይላሉ።

በእነዚህ አበሳዎች ውስጥ ያለን ማህበረሰብ ነው ለፖለቲካ ትርፍ ሲባል 'ናና  አዲስ ማኅበራዊ ውል ለሚፈራረምበት ምክክር አጀንዳ አዋጣ'፣ ተመካከር' የሚባለው?

ኮሚሽኑ ከነችግሩ መጀመሪያ የነበረውን አቋም ወደመያዝ መመለስ አለበት፡፡ ኮሚሽኑ ለመንግስት የፕሮፓጋንዳ መሳሪያነት እየዋለ ነው። እንደዚያ መሆናቸውን ያቁት ይሆን አይሆን እርግጠኞች አይደለንም።

መፍትሄው፥ በአጠቃላይ ከምክክሩ በፊት ድርድር መቅደም፤ ተኩስ መቆም አለበት፡፡ ጦርነቱ ፖለቲካዊ መፍትሄ ያሻዋልል።

የኮሚሽኑ ሰዎች ያ እንዲሆን ባላቸው ተጽዕኖ በጎ አስተዋጽዖ ቢያሳራፉ ውለታም ጭምር ነው፤ ካልሆነ ግን ቢያንስ በሰው ቁስል እንጨት ከመስደድ ቢቆጠቡ እንመክራለን” ብሏል።

**Q. በአማራ ክልል አጀንዳ ማሰባሰብ ሂደት እንደማትሳተፉ ገልጻችሁ ለነበረው በተለይም "ቅድሚያ ጦርነት ይቁም" የሚለውን ሀሳባችሁን ኮሚሽኑ ምላሽ ሰጠበት ? **
**
እናት ፓርቲ ፦
**
" እንደማንሳተፍ የሚገልጸውን ደብዳቤ ለኮሚሽኑ ከላክንና ለህዝብ ይፋ ካደረግን በኋላ በሚዲያዎች በኩል በተወሰወነ ደረጃ መልስ የሚመስል ነገር ሰጥቷል።

ሀሳቡ የሚጣል እንዳልሆነና በጊዜ ሂደት (እስከዚያው) የተጠቀሱ ችግሮች ይፈታሉ ብለው እንደሚያምኑ የሚያወሱ ነበሩ፡፡ 

ከሦስት ሳምንታት በፊትም ከክልሉ ባለስልጣናት ጋር በባሕር ዳር ተገኝተው በተወያዩበት ወቅት እኛ ያነሳናቸውን፥ መንግስት በራሱ ተነሳሽነት ተኩስ አቁም እንዲያውጅ፣ እስረኞችን እንዲፈታ የሚሉትን ቅድመ ሁኔታዎች አንስተዋቸዋል።

ግን አጠንክረው አልዘለቁባቸውም፤ አይዘልቁባቸውም፡፡ "

**Q. ኮሚሽኑ በአዲስ አበባ አጀንዳ ማሰባሰብ ሲጀምር ተሳትፋችሁ ነበር፤ ከዚያ በኋላስ በሌሎች ክልሎች (ለምሳሌ በኦሮሚያ) ተሳትፋችሁ ነበር ?

እናት ፓርቲ ፦
**
__"አዎ ተሳትፈናል፡፡ በአጠቃላይ የፓርቲያችን እምነት በዋናው ምክክር ላይ ቅድመ ሁኔታዎች ቢኖሩንም በአንጻራዊነት ለመመካከር የምትሆን ክፍተት ከተገኘች ለዚህ አገር ከምክክር የተሻለ መፍትሄ ይኖራል ብለን አናምንም፤ ያንንም ከማንም በላይ ስናቀነቅን ቆይተናል፡፡ 

የአስቸኳይ ጊዜ ዐዋጅ መነሳትን ጨምሮ ሌሎች ቅድመ ሁኔታዎች እንዳሉ ሆነው የመነመነም አስቻይ ሁኔታ አለ ብለን ስላመንን አድርገነዋል፡፡"

**Q. በአማራ ክልል በነበረው ሂደት ኮሚሽኑ ምን ክፍተቶችን ቢያስተካክል አሁንስ አጀንዳችሁን ታስረክባላችሁ ? ነው ወይስ ከዚህ በኋላ አጀንዳ የማስገባት እቅዱ የላችሁም? ከሌላችሁ ለምን ? **

**እናት ፓርቲ **፦

" የእኛ የቅድሚያ ቅድሚያ ጉዳይና ሆድ ቁርጠት የህዝብ ደህንነትና በሰላም ወጥቶ የመግባት ሁኔታ ነው።

የመሳሪያ ድምጽ በቅድሚያ ፀጥ ይበል፣ የፖለቲካ እስረኞች ይፈቱ፤ በአንድም በሌላም ከምክክሩ ራሳቸውን ያገለሉ ኃይሎች እንዲመለሱ ይደረግ። በተለይ አሁን አሁን ደግሞ የኮሚሽኑ ለመንግስት ያደላና ፖለቲካዊ ዝንባሌ ያለው አካሄድ ካልተስተካከለ አጀንዳ ማቀበሉንም አናደርገውም ከዋና ምክክሩም ለመግባት ይቸግረናል።

ኳሱ እነርሱ እግር ላይ ነው፡፡ እንዲያውም አሁን አሁን አንድ ሥጋት እየጫረብን የመጣ ጉዳይም አለ፡፡ ምን አልባት እንዲህ እያጓተቱ ምርጫ 2018’ን ለመጋፋት እንዲውል ሊያደርጉት ይሆን? የሚል። " 
 
**Q. የምክክር ኮሚሽኑ በተለያዬ ክልሎች ያካሄዳቸውን አጀንዳዎች የማሰባሰብና የመረከብ ሂደቶች እንዴት ገመገማችኋቸው ? ምንስ መስተካከል አለበት? ምንስ ጥሩ ጎን አለው ?**

**እናት ፓርቲ ፦**

" በአጠቃላይ በጣም ጥሩ ባይባልም መጥፎ የሚባል አልነበረም፡፡ እንዲነሱ የያዝናቸው አጀንዳዎች በተለያዩ አካባቢዎችና የማኅበረሰብ ክፍሎች ጉዳይ ሆነው ሲነሱ ታዝበናል፡፡ አብዛኛው ሰው አዲስ ማኅበራዊ ውል ሰርተን የተሻለች ሀገር እንድትኖረን የመናፈቅ ነገሩ ይታያል።

በአንጻሩ በርካታ ለብልጽግና ታማኝ የሆኑ ሰዎች እንዲሳተፉ የማድረግ፣ በአንዳንድ ቦታዎችም ጭሬ ላፍሰው ዓይነት አካሄዶችን ታዝበናል፡፡ ወደ ፊት የመራመድ ጥማት ሳይሆን ወደ ኋላ የመመለስና የብጥበጣ ዓይነት አዝማሚያም አስተውለናል፡፡

ኢትዮጵያን ከስሟ ጀምሮ ክዶ የመነሳትና ፖለቲካ ወለድ ጉምዠታና የኔ፣ የኔ ዓይነት ነገሮች ነበሩት፡፡ ኮሚሽኑን ደጋግመን እንዳሳሰብነው የማይታለፉ ቀይ መስመሮች ይኖሩታል ብለን እናምናለን።

ምክክር ያስፈለገው ከነበረው የተሻለ ለመጨመርና ጥሩ ለማድረግ እንጂ ጭራሽ ያለንንም ለማጣት እንዳልሆነ ማስታወስ አይከፋም" ብሏል።

(ፓርቲው በአማራ ክልል ጉዳይ ስላነሳው ሀሳብ በቀጣይ ይቀርባል)

**#MotherParty**

**__" Amhara region is in a full-scale war. People are being killed every day, even by drones__**. __**The commission and the government are saying 'No, consult even if you die' '! " - Mother Party
**
The Mother Party has sharply criticized the Ethiopian National Consultative Commission for not participating in the agenda-setting process in the Amhara region and the commission's approach.

**Q.**__ __**What is the reason for not participating in the agenda-setting process in the region? The commission says, 'Come, our door is open'; what is the difference if you are not participating? The solution?**

**Mother Party:

"**__ __It's clear! The region is in a state of full-scale war. People are being killed every day, even by drones. There is widespread devastation.

There are nearly a million displaced people in the region; there is severe drought and man-made famine in many places. Many intellectuals and politicians who could have advocated for the interests of the people are in prison or have fled.

Every week, citizens are being kidnapped and asked for millions of dollars. Even in the region, it has become rare to go out to the market to get advice, take a pregnant woman to the doctor, send her children to school, or move from place to place.

The community is saying, 'I have a problem of survival, solve it first' (quick fix). The commission and the government are saying, 'No, consult even if you are dying.'

Is this the kind of society we are in, where we are supposed to 'contribute to the agenda of the consultation process for a new social contract' for political gain?

The commission should return to the position it took at the beginning of the crisis. The commission is being used as a propaganda tool for the government. We are not sure whether they are aware of it or not.

The solution: In general, negotiations should precede consultations; the shooting should cease. The war needs a political solution.

If the people of the commission can contribute positively to that, it would be a great honor; If not, we recommend that you at least refrain from using wood for human wounds.”

**Q. Did the commission respond to your statement that you would not participate in the Amhara regional agenda-setting process, especially your idea of ​​“stopping the war first”? **
**
Mother Party:
**
“After we sent the letter to the commission stating that we would not participate and made it public, it gave a vague response through the media.

They said that the idea was not to be abandoned and that they believed that the problems mentioned would be resolved over time. 

Three weeks ago, when they met with the regional authorities in Bahir Dar, they raised the conditions that we had raised, namely that the government declare a ceasefire on its own initiative and release prisoners.

But they did not insist on them; they will not. "

**Q. Did you participate when the commission started to compile the agenda in Addis Ababa? Did you participate in other regions (for example, Oromia) after that?

Mother Party:
**
__"Yes, we did. In general, our party believes that even if there are preconditions for the main consultation, if there is a gap that is relatively open to consultation, we do not believe that there is a better solution for this country than consultation; and we have been ignoring that more than anyone else. 

We did it because we believed that there were other preconditions, including the lifting of the state of emergency, and there was a possibility of a compromise."

**Q. What gaps did the commission fix in the process in the Amhara region? Will you submit your agenda now? Or do you not have any plans to submit an agenda after this? If not, why not? **

**Mother Party **:

" Our priority and concern is public safety and safe entry and exit.

Let the sound of weapons first be silenced, political prisoners be released; let the forces that have distanced themselves from the consultation in one way or another be allowed to return. Especially now, if the commission’s biased and politically motivated approach to the government is not corrected, we will not accept the agenda and we will have difficulty entering the main consultation.

The ball is in their court. In fact, there is an issue that is now threatening us. Is it possible that they will use it to disrupt the 2018 elections by delaying it like this? "

**Q. How did you evaluate the processes of collecting and submitting the agendas that the Consultative Commission carried out in different regions? What needs to be corrected? What is its good side?**

**Mother Party:**

" Overall, it was not very good, but it was not bad. We have observed that the agendas that we have set for discussion are being discussed in different areas and sections of society. Most people are eager to create a new social contract and have a better country.

On the other hand, we have observed many people who are loyal to prosperity participating, and in some places, they have even thrown away their belongings. We have not seen a thirst for progress, but a tendency to go back and be disorganized.

There was a tendency to deny Ethiopia from its very beginning, and political ambitions and things like that. As we have repeatedly reminded the commission, we believe that there will be red lines that cannot be crossed.

It is not bad to remember that the consultation was needed to add to what was better and to make it better, not to lose what we have at all," he said.

(The party's proposal on the Amhara regional state will be presented later)

Tikvah Ethiopia
Addis Ababa

ዘንድሮ የሚካሄደው 4ኛው ሀገር አቀፍ የክህሎት ውድድር " ብሩህ አዕምሮዎች በክህሎት የበቁ ዜጎች " በሚል ሀሰብ እንደሆነ የሥራና ክህሎት ሚኒስቴር አስታውቋል።__
__

ውድድሩ በክህሎት፣ በቴክኖሎጂና ተግባራዊ ጥናትና ምርምር ዘርፎች ነው የሚካሄደው።

በውድድሩም፣ " በሁሉም ክልሎችና በሁለቱም ከተማ አስተዳደሮች በተካሄዱ ተመሳሳይ ውድድሮች አንደኛ ሆነው ያጠናቀቁ የቴክኒክና ሙያ አሰልጣኞችና ሰልጣኞች፣ የኢንተርፕራይዝ ባለቤቶች ይሳተፋሉ " ተብሏል።

ለውድድሩ አሸናፊዎች የሜዳሊያ፣ የዋንጫና የገንዘብ ሽልማት ይበረከታል።

የውድድሩ ዓላማ የዘርፉን አዲስ እሳቤ መሠረት ያደረገ የአሰልጣኞች፣ የሠልጣኞችና ኢንተርፕራይዝ አንቀሳቃሾች ሙያቸውን እንዲያዳብሩ፣ አቅማቸውን እንዳያሳዩ፣ ቴክኖሎጂችን ባለሃብቶችና ኢንተርፕራይዞች ወደ ምርት አገልግሎት እንዲያሸጋግሩ ጭምር ነው።

በ2015 ዓ/ም በ3ኛው ዙር ሀገር አቀፍ የክህሎት ውድድር፣ አዳዲስ ቴክኖሎጂ የፈጠሩ ተወዳዳሪዎች በ2016 ዓ/ም ከ80 በላይ ቴክኖሎጂዎችን እንዳመረቱ ተነግሯል።

__The 4th National Skills Competition has started today.

It has been indicated that medals, trophies and cash prizes have been prepared for the winners.

The Ministry of Labor and Skills has announced that the 4th National Skills Competition to be held this year is under the theme "Bright Minds, Skilled Citizens".

__
The program will be held from April 27 to October 2, 2017 at Technical and Vocational Institutes nationwide.

The competition is held in the fields of skills, technology and applied research and development.

It was said that "technical and vocational trainers and trainees, enterprise owners who have finished first in similar competitions held in all regions and both city administrations will participate in the competition."

The winners of the competition will be awarded medals, trophies and cash prizes.

The aim of the competition is to develop the skills of trainers, trainees and enterprise operators based on the new concept of the sector, to demonstrate their capabilities, and to transfer our technology to investors and enterprises for production services.

In the 3rd round of the National Skills Competition in 2015, it was reported that competitors who created new technologies produced more than 80 technologies in 2016.

The program was continued under the name “Skill Ethiopia” in the 2017 budget year, and currently, about 180 participants of the program are in the process of producing and deploying new technologies.

የወቅቱ አርበኞቻችን ለሀገራቸው ነጻነት የከፈሉትን መስዋዕትነት እና ያስገኙትን ድል ለማሰብ ነው በየአመቱ ሚያዚያ 27 የኢትዮጵያ አርበኞች የድል በዓል የሚከበረው።

**" ጌታቸው ላይ መፈንቅለ መንግስት ፈፅሜ ከሆነ በገለልተኛ አካል ይጣራ " - ሌ/ጄነራል ታደሰ ወረደ **

የትግራይ ጊዚያዊ አስተዳደር ፕሬዜዳንት ታደሰ ወረደ (ሌ/ ጀነራል) " አውራ እምባ ታይምስ " ከተባለ ሚድያ ጋር ቃለ መጠይቅ አድርገው ነበር።

በዚህም ወቅት በትግራይ ተካሂደዋል ተብሎ ተደጋግሞ ስለሚነገረው የመፈንቅለ መንግስት ጉዳይ  ተጠይቀው መልሰዋል። 

በቀድሞ ፕሬዜዳንት አቶ ጌታቸው ረዳ የሚመራው የህወሓት ሃይል ባለፈው  ባወጣው መግለጫ " በትግራይ ወታደራዊ መፈንቅለ መንግስት በማካሄድ ስልጣን ከተያዘ 40 ቀናት ተቆጠረዋል " ብሎ ነበር።

ይኸው ኃይል " የአቶ ጌታቸው አስተዳደር ህገ-ወጥ ተግባሩ ተጋግሎ ወደ ተባባሰ ግጭት እንዳያመራ ስልጣን ጭምር ለሰላም ሲል አሳልፎ ሰጥቷል " የሚል አገላለፅም ተጠቅሞ ነበር።

ፕሬዜዳንት ታደሰ ወረደ (ሌ/ጀነራል) ፥ " ጌታቸው ረዳ የፕሪቶሪያ የሰላም ስምምነት አካል ሆኖ በተቋቋመው ጊዚያዊ አስተዳደር ወደ ኃላፊነት የመጡ ናቸው " ያሉ ሲሆን " ወደ ሃላፊነት መጋቢት 2015 ዓ.ም ነው የመጡት። የጊዚያዊ አስተዳደሩ ቆይታ ሁለት ዓመት መሆኑ ይታወቃል። እንዲያ ሆኖም 6 ወር ሊራዘም ይችላል። ይሁን እንጂ የነበረው ጊዚያዊ አስተዳደር ለ6 ወራት ለማራዘም የሚያስገደድ በቂ ምክንያት አልተገኘም " ብለዋል።

" መጋቢት 2015 ዓ.ም ወደ ሃላፊነት የመጡት አቶ ጌታቸው መጋቢት 2017 ዓ.ም የሁለት ዓመት ቆይታቸውን ጨርሰዋል " ሲሉ አስረድተዋል።

" አሁን የተደረገው በፓርላማ በፀደቀ አዋጅ ጊዚያዊ አስተዳደሩ ለአንድ ዓመት ማራዘም ነው።  በተራዘመው የጊዚያዊ አስተዳደሩ ዕድሜ የነበረው ፕሬዜዳንት ሊቀጥል ላይቀጥል ይችላል። አጋጣሚ ሆኖ አቶ ጌታቸው በሃላፊነት አልቀጠለም " ሲሉ ገልጸዋል።

" እኔ እንደ አዲስ በተራዘመው ጊዚያዊ አስተዳደር ወደ ሃላፊነት መጥቻለው። በትግራይ የሃላፊነት ጊዜው ጨርሶ ከሃላፊነት የወረደ እንጂ የተካሄደ መፈንቅለ መንግስት የለም። መፈንቅለ መንግስት አልተካሄደም ብቻ ሳይሆን ወደዛ የሚወሰድ ምክንያትም አልነበረም " ብለዋል።

**"If a coup has been carried out against Getachew, it should be investigated by an independent body" - Lt. Gen. Tadesse Werede **

The President of the Interim Administration of Tigray, Tadesse Werede (Lt. Gen.), gave an interview to the media outlet "Aura Emba Times".

During the interview, he was asked about the coup that has been repeatedly reported to have taken place in Tigray.

In a statement issued by the TPLF, led by former President Ato Getachew Reda, he said that "40 days have passed since the military coup in Tigray took power."

The same force also used the expression "Ato Getachew's administration has surrendered power for the sake of peace in order to prevent its illegal actions from leading to an escalation of conflict."

President Tadesse Werede (Lt. General) said, "Getachew Reda came to power under the interim administration established as part of the Pretoria Peace Agreement." He added, "He came to power in March 2015. It is known that the interim administration's term is two years. However, it can be extended for 6 months. However, there was no sufficient reason to extend the interim administration for 6 months."

"Getachew, who came to power in March 2015, completed his two-year term in March 2017," he explained.

"What has now been done is to extend the interim administration for one year through a proclamation approved by Parliament. The president who was in office during the extended interim administration may not continue. Unfortunately, Getachew did not continue in office," he explained.

"I came to power in the newly extended interim administration. There was no coup in Tigray, only a coup. Not only did a coup not take place, but there was no reason to do so," he said.

"If the issue is so serious that there is a debate and debate about whether a coup took place or not, let's give a third party a chance. Let there be a body to investigate. Perhaps I should establish a body to investigate this issue, but I would say that it would not be credible and acceptable, so let a third party investigate it," he replied.

"If a coup was carried out against their master, let it be investigated by an independent body," he added.
